Vi er stadig på utkikk etter nye, engasjerte og motiverte medarbeidere. Les mer om Trondheim kommune på vår hjemmeside og siden Jobb hos oss.

Trondheim kommune legger til rette for mangfold, og våre ansatte skal gjenspeile byens befolkning. Vi oppfordrer kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke uansett alder, kjønn, funksjonsevne, seksuell orientering, religion, etnisitet, eller hull i CV-en. Trondheim kommune tilrettelegger arbeidsforholdene så langt det er mulig.

Deltidsansatte i Trondheim kommune som ønsker utvidelse av sin stilling og som er kvalifisert oppfordres og tilbys her å søke på stillinger som er utlyst. 

Attester, vitnemål og vedlegg må legges ved søknaden. Vi oppfordrer til å benytte Vitnemålsportalen. Utdanning gjennomført utenfor Norge må være godkjent av Direktoratet for høyere utdanning og kompetanse (tidligere NOKUT), og godkjenningen må dokumenteres.

Vi gjør oppmerksom på at søkere føres opp på offentlig søkerliste. Det kan søkes om anonymitet, men det må foreligge særskilte omstendigheter for å få innvilget unntak, jf. Offentleglova § 25. 

Gyldig politiattest må fremlegges der det er påkrevd. Gyldig legitimasjon fremvises både på intervju og første arbeidsdag. 

Som en del av vårt samfunnsansvar og vårt arbeid med personellsikkerhet, foretar vi bakgrunnssjekk av aktuelle kandidater der dette er relevant.

jobs.title: Faglærer, vikariat
jobs.description:
Vi har behov for deg som er en engasjert og omsorgsfull lærer, med et stort hjerte for barn og unge. 

På Mellomhagen ungdomsskole har vi behov for et 100% vikariat etter vinterferien og ut skoleåret. Vi leter etter den rette læreren til å gjøre denne viktige jobben. Er det deg?

Vi ønsker at du har formalkompetanse i følgende fag: matematikk, naturfag og kroppsøving. Andre fag kan også være relevante. Det er flott om du har erfaring som kontaktlærer, stillingen kan medføre kontaktlærerfunksjon.

Mellomhagen har ca 230 elever,  og er en tre-parallell ungdomsskole som ligger på Østre Halsen i Larvik. Vi opptatt av at alle skal høre til og legger godt tilrette for mening, mestring og medvirkning i skolehverdagen. Vi er med i en pilot hvor vi tilstreber økt praktisk opplæring i alle fag. Vi er også med i Læringsmiljøprosjektet i regi av Utdanningsdirektoratet. Vi er en Liv og røre - skole med fokus på fysisk aktiv læring. 

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Undervise klasser, grupper eller enkeltelever i ulike fag
  • Utøve god klasseledelse
  • Bidra til et trygt, inkluderende og positivt læringsmiljø
  • Fremme et godt skole-hjem samarbeid
  • Ha høye forventninger til elevenes læring
  • Delta aktivt i et profesjonsfaglig fellesskap
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Du har godkjent lærerutdanning på oppstarttidspunktet
  • Det er ønskelig med undervisningskompetanse i matematikk, naturfag og kroppsøving. Andre fag kan også være aktuelle
  • Det er ønskelig med erfaring fra kontaktlærerjobb
Personlige egenskaper
  • Du er en trygg og tydelig klasseleder
  • Du har sterke relasjonsbyggende ferdigheter og evne til å skape varmt, støttende læringsmiljø
  • Du viser positive holdninger og har forventninger til alle elevers faglige og sosiale utvikling
  • Du må like ungdommer
  • Du tar konstruktive initiativ og er medskapende i samarbeidsprosesser

Personlig egnethet vektlegges.

Vi tilbyr
  • Ledere som er læringsstøttende og gir deg utviklingsmuligheter
  • Varierte og spennende utfordringer i en skole med høye ambisjoner for eleven
  • Lønns- og arbeidsvilkår som er fastsatt i avtaleverk
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger i SPK
  • Gode velferdsordninger, blant annet hytte og kunstforening, bedriftsidrettslag og rabatt på treningssenter

 

Viktig å vite før du starter hos ossSom arbeidstaker i kommunen blir du ansatt på de vilkår, rettigheter og plikter som følger avtaler, reglementer og lover.Mangfold er en styrkeLarvik kommune ser mangfold som en styrke. Vi oppfordrer derfor alle som er kvalifiserte til å søke på ledige stillinger hos oss, uavhengig av alder, kjønn, funksjonsevne, seksuell orientering, nasjonal eller etnisk bakgrunn. Vi kan tilrettelegge innenfor stillingens rammer.Kan bli ført opp på offentlig søkerlisteVi gjør oppmerksom på at du som søker kan bli ført opp på offentlig søkerliste, selv om du har bedt om anonymitet. Dette blir du så fall varslet om.

Vise frem politiattestFør du tiltrer må du legge frem politiattest uten merknader som har betydning for arbeidsforholdet.

Hvordan søkeDu må sende søknaden din elektronisk innen fristen via Webcruiter, og legge ved attester og vitnemål. For å sikre en mer effektiv og rettferdig vurdering av søknader, bruker vi kunstig intelligens (KI) som støtte i vår rekrutteringsprosess. Dette innebærer at dine søknadsdokumenter blir analysert av en KI-basert løsning levert av vår systemleverandør, Talentech. KI benyttes utelukkende som et støtteverktøy – alle endelige vurderinger og beslutninger tas av mennesker.

KontaktinformasjonCathrine Haakestad, Rektor, 98231011 ArbeidsstedMellomhagen 33 3261 Larvik Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Larvik kommune Referansenr.: 5211054092 Stillingsprosent: 100% Vikariat Startdato: 01.03.2027 Sluttdato: 31.07.2027 Søknadsfrist: 14.12.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Larvik kommune, med våre 49 000 innbyggere, er blant de flinkeste til å få mest mulig ut av hver krone. Vi er rangert som en av landets mest effektive og best styrte kommuner. Det gir oss et godt utgangspunkt når vi står midt i en stor utfordring: vi blir flere eldre, færre yrkesaktive og har ikke nok arbeidskraft til å kunne drive tjenestene på samme måte som før.

Vi må tenke nytt. Det betyr blant annet at vi må bli flinkere til å ta i bruk ressursene som finnes ute i lokalsamfunnet, og til å samarbeide på nye måter med innbyggere, frivillighet, næringsliv og andre. Sammen med rundt 3700 ansatte i Larvik kommune blir du en viktig del av dette samfunnsoppdraget. Uavhengig av hvor du jobber i kommunen, gjelder de samme verdiene:

  • Vi er nysgjerrige – søker kunnskap og utfordre
  • Vi er ærlige – tydelige om utfordringer og forventninger
  • Vi er rause – verdsetter mangfold og ulikheter
  • Vi er engasjerte – inspirerer og motiverer til endring

Hos oss får du en jobb med mening, der du er med på å utgjøre en forskjell i livene til Larviks innbyggere hver dag. Sammen skaper vi gode dager!

De gode dagene fortsetter når arbeidsdagen er over. 

Naturen er tett på. Vi er blant kommunene i landet med flest soltimer, to av tre innbyggere har under to kilometer til nærmeste badeplass, og enkelte av naturopplevelsene våre er anbefalt av Lonely Planet. Og med unntak av en bilkø som er mer sjarmerende enn irriterende, har vi også de mer urbane kvalitetene. Restauranter som hevder seg i norgestoppen, et spahotell som vinner internasjonale priser og et stort og variert næringsliv.

jobs.title: Barnehagelærer
jobs.description:
Brenner du for barnas lek,språk og utforskning? Er du en trygg, tydelig og tilstedeværende barnehagelærer  som heier frem medarbeiderne dine og «tar dem på fersken» i å gjøre en god jobb? Da vil vi gjerne ha deg med på laget!

Ved Øvre Sjetnan barnehager er det fra 1. februar 2027 til 31. juli 2028 ledig et vikariat 100 prosent stilling som barnehagelærer.

Vårt verdigrunnlag er lek, trygghet, naturklok og livsmestring. Disse fire verdiene ligger til grunn i alt vi gjør og alt vi er.Øvre Sjetnan barnehager er en flerkulturell fargeklatt og har familier fra et vidt spekter boende på Tiller. Vi arbeider for å ta imot og inkludere et mangfold av barn og familier inn i et sterkt fellesskap.

Enheten består av barnehagene Brinken, Moltmyra og Tonstad som ligger i gangavstand til hverandre på Tiller. Brinken åpen barnehage er lokalisert ved Trondheim mottakssenter på Sandmoen. Vi har ca 180 barn og ca 60 ansatte. Administrasjonen består av enhetsleder, to avdelingsledere, konsulent og en spesialpedagogisk koordinator.

Trondheim kommune jobber etter en helhetlig modell for inkluderende praksis som innebærer at alle barn skal oppleve tilhørighet til fellesskapet i barnehagen og sikres et tilpasset, inkluderende og likeverdig tilbud, uavhengig av hvilken barnehage barnet går i. Vi er vertsbarnehage, noe som betyr at vi har ansvar for koordinering og samarbeid med Norlandia Tiller barnehage, samt personal- og oppfølgingsansvar for det spesialpedagogiske teamet. 

Vårt motto “Leken i dag skaper fremtidens drømmer” er utgangspunkt for hvordan vi planlegger, organiserer og evaluerer den jobben vi gjør. Med fokus på relasjonsbygging, barns læringsmiljø og språkutvikling, jobber vi med å utvikle robuste barn som kan møte en hverdag i rask utvikling. Vi er med i BARN&Rom-nettverket, Reggio-nettverket og Flerkultureltnettverk i Trondheim kommune.

Det er viktig for oss å jobbe ut ifra en grunnleggende respekt for alle, hvor inkluderingstanken skal stå svært høyt. Enheten vår er representert med mange kulturer og ulike bakgrunner som gir oss et rikt og spennende mangfold. Vi bruker ASK (alternativ supplerende kommunikasjon) i alle deler av dagen, og har ansatte med høy kompetanse innenfor foreldreveiledningsprogrammet ICDP.

Alle våre barnehager ligger nært turområder og vi jobber for å være en naturklok enhet.

Mer informasjon om jobb i barnehage i Trondheim kommune finnes på Jobb i barnehage.

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Ansvar for å lede avdelingen/gruppen i samsvar med gjeldende lover og forskrifter som: Lov om barnehager, Rammeplan for barnehager, samt vedtak, bestemmelser og planer som gjelder for barnehagen
  • Ansvar for å veilede ansatte.
  • Ansvar for å utvikle og tilrettelegge for et godt leke- og læringsmiljø, slik at alle barn får delta aktivt og utforskende. 
  • Ansvar for å samarbeide med de andre avdelingenen/gruppene i barnehagen og ha evne og vilje til å skape gode omsorgsfulle relasjoner og bygge en delingskultur.
  • Ansvar for å skape et nært og godt samarbeid mellom barnehagen og hjemmet.
  • Ansvar for å sikre at alle barn har et godt og trygt psykososialt miljø.
  • Ansvar for å bidra til faglig utvikling og ta medansvar i forhold til endrings- og utviklingsarbeid.
  • Ansvar for pedagogisk planlegging og innhold
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Godkjent barnehagelærerutdanning
  • Ønskelig med  kompetanse og/eller erfaring med ASK ( alternativ saupplerende kommunikasjon i barnehagen)
  • Ønskelig med kompetanse og/eller erfaring med veiledning
  • Ønskelig med kompetanse og/eller erfaing å jobbe med inkludering og endring
  • Ønskelig med kompetanse og eller erfaring med Barns Læringsmiljø og Reggio Emilia 
  • Må ha norsk skriftlig og muntlig nivå A2 og B1
Personlige egenskaper
  • Du er en tydelig og trygg rollemodell som bidrar til å skape et godt psykososialt miljø for barn og kollegaer og foresatte
  • Du har en positiv tilnærming til utfordringer og ser muligheter
  • Du evner å skape tillit og gode omsorgsfulle relasjoner med barn, foreldre og kollegaer er langt fremme i hverdagens krav og omskiftelighet
  • Du evner å arbeide under press med ro og tålmodighet
  • Vi ønsker en som brenner  for å arbeide med fokusområdene våre
  • Du ser på naturen og været som en god inspirasjonskilde og pedagogisk verktøy
  • Du ser løsninger som skaper samhold og stabilitet 
  • Helse som er forenlig med arbeidets art, samt kunne mestre hektiske arbeidsperioder
  • Ha kunnskap om relasjonsjonsarbeid og veiledning
  • Personlig egnethet blir vektlagt.
Vi tilbyr
  • Et arbeidsmiljø med god faglig kompetanse, og som er i stadig utvikling
  • Positive og løsningsorienterte kolleger
  • Et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med høy grad av åpenhet, deling og læring
  • Et spennende fysisk miljø både ute og inne, samt fine turmuligheter rett utenfor gjerdet
  • Gode muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling
  • En trygg og god pensjonsordning i Trondheim kommunale pensjonskasse.
  • Stillingens kvalifikasjonskrav og din kompetanse er førende for innplassering i stillingsbenevnelse og lønnsplassering.
  • Informasjon om lønn og tariffavtaler finnes på kommunens hjemmeside.
  • Bedriftsmedlemskap hos 3T og Nidarø treningssenter. Ansatte kan bli medlem i Trondheim kommune bedriftsidrettslag

Attester, vitnemål og vedlegg må legges ved søknaden. Vi oppfordrer til å benytte Vitnemålsportalen. Utdanning gjennomført utenfor Norge må være godkjent av Direktoratet for høyere utdanning og kompetanse (tidligere NOKUT), og godkjenningen må dokumenteres.

Vi gjør oppmerksom på at søkere føres opp på offentlig søkerliste. Det kan søkes om anonymitet, men det må foreligge særskilte omstendigheter for å få innvilget unntak, jf. Offentleglova § 25. 

Gyldig politiattest må fremlegges der det er påkrevd. Gyldig legitimasjon fremvises både på intervju og første arbeidsdag. 

Som en del av vårt samfunnsansvar og vårt arbeid med personellsikkerhet, foretar vi bakgrunnssjekk av aktuelle kandidater der dette er relevant.

jobs.title: Kiosk Manager / Retail Store Manager søges til kiosk og pakkeshop i København
jobs.description:
Kiosk Manager / Retail Store Manager søges til kiosk og pakkeshop i København

Arbejdssted: København, Danmark Stillingsbetegnelse: Kiosk Manager / Retail Store Manager Antal stillinger: 1 Ansættelsesform: Fastansættelse Arbejdstid: Fuldtid – 37 timer om ugen Tiltrædelse: Efter aftale

Om stillingen

Vi søger en ansvarsbevidst og resultatorienteret Kiosk Manager til at stå i spidsen for den daglige drift og ledelse af vores kiosk og pakkeshop i København.

Virksomheden driver en detailbutik med salg af dagligvarer, drikkevarer, snacks, kioskvarer og andre convenience-produkter. Butikken fungerer desuden som pakkeshop med afhentning, indlevering og returnering af pakker.

Som Kiosk Manager får du det overordnede ansvar for butikkens daglige drift, medarbejderledelse, salgsudvikling, lagerstyring og administrative funktioner.

Du vil have ledelsesansvar for 2–4 medarbejdere og sikre, at butikkens aktiviteter gennemføres effektivt og i overensstemmelse med virksomhedens mål og procedurer.

Arbejdsopgaver og ansvarsområder

1. Ledelse og organisering af butiksdriften

● Have det overordnede ansvar for butikkens daglige drift og forretningsmæssige aktiviteter.

● Planlægge, organisere og koordinere butikkens arbejdsprocesser.

● Udarbejde medarbejdernes arbejds- og vagtplaner.

● Fordele arbejdsopgaver og sikre effektiv udnyttelse af medarbejderressourcer.

● Supervisere, vejlede og motivere 2–4 medarbejdere.

● Deltage i rekruttering og oplæring af nye medarbejdere.

● Sikre overholdelse af interne procedurer og driftsstandarder.

2. Salgs- og økonomistyring

● Overvåge butikkens omsætning, salgsresultater og driftsomkostninger.

● Følge op på salgs- og driftsmål.

● Planlægge og implementere salgsfremmende aktiviteter og kampagner.

● Optimere varesortiment, prissætning og produktplacering.

● Analysere salgstal og identificere muligheder for at forbedre butikkens indtjening.

● Følge op på kasseafstemning og daglige transaktioner.

3. Lagerstyring, indkøb og leverandørkoordinering

● Planlægge og koordinere indkøb og varebestillinger.

● Sikre korrekt varemodtagelse og lagerregistrering.

● Overvåge lagerbeholdning og genbestilling.

● Koordinere med leverandører og følge op på leverancer.

● Forebygge varespild, lagerfejl og svind.

● Sikre korrekt opbevaring og præsentation af varer.

4. Ledelse af pakkeshoppens aktiviteter

● Have det overordnede ansvar for pakkeshoppens daglige drift.

● Organisere processer for modtagelse, scanning, registrering og udlevering af pakker.

● Sikre korrekt håndtering af returpakker og forsendelser.

● Koordinere medarbejdernes arbejdsopgaver i forbindelse med pakkelogistik.

● Håndtere driftsmæssige udfordringer og kundehenvendelser vedrørende pakkeservice.

● Sikre overholdelse af samarbejdspartnernes procedurer og krav.

5. Kundeservice og kvalitetskontrol

● Sikre en høj standard for kundeservice.

● Håndtere kundehenvendelser, reklamationer og klager.

● Sikre en effektiv håndtering af kundeproblemer.

● Overvåge butikkens daglige driftsprocedurer.

● Sikre overholdelse af gældende regler for fødevaresikkerhed, arbejdsmiljø og detailhandel.

● Arbejde kontinuerligt med at forbedre butikkens service og effektivitet.

Kvalifikationer og kompetencer

Vi forventer, at du:

● Har gode organisatoriske og administrative kompetencer.

● Har forståelse for detailhandel, butiksdrift og kundeservice.

● Kan planlægge og koordinere medarbejdernes arbejdsopgaver.

● Har forståelse for lagerstyring, indkøb og salgsoptimering.

● Har gode kommunikations- og samarbejdsevner.

● Er struktureret, ansvarsbevidst og løsningsorienteret.

● Kan arbejde selvstændigt og træffe beslutninger i den daglige drift.

Tidligere erfaring med personaleledelse eller butiksledelse er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Erfaring fra kiosk, convenience store, dagligvarehandel eller pakkeshop er ligeledes en fordel.

Vi tilbyder

● En fast fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen.

● En månedsløn på 37.500 DKK inklusive pension.

● En selvstændig lederstilling med ansvar for butikkens samlede drift.

● Mulighed for at påvirke og udvikle virksomhedens daglige aktiviteter.

● Et dynamisk arbejdsmiljø med detailhandel og pakkelogistik.

Ansøgning

Send dit CV og en kort ansøgning til:

Virksomhed: Falkonershop Aps

Arbejdsadresse: Falkoner alle 6

Kontaktperson: Osman Afzal

E-mail: Falkonershop@outlook.dk

Ansøgningsfrist: Snarest

jobs.title: Servicemitarbeiter:in (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Servus und herzlich willkommen beim BergBaur :)

Unser Hotel in Neukirchen am Großvenediger ist kein übliches Hotel in den Bergen, sondern das einzige "Crazy Farming" Hotel der Alpen. 1.030 m hoch im Herzen des Nationalpark Hohe Tauern, mit direktem Blick auf den grandiosen Großvenediger, mit 3.657 m der höchste Gipfel des Salzburger Landes, bieten wir euch ein etwas anderes Hotelerlebnis.

Aktuell suchen wir: 1 Servicemitarbeiter:in (w/m/d) Warnung: Das hier könnte dein Lieblingsplatzerl werden.

Menschen kommen zum BergBaur, um zu arbeiten. Und bleiben, weil es sich einfach richtig anfühlt.

Schnuppertage werden zu einer Saison. Aus Kolleginnen und Kollegen wird ein eingespieltes Team. Und nicht selten entsteht aus einem Job ein Stück Zuhause. Kein großes Versprechen, sondern etwas, das hier ganz selbstverständlich passiert.

Arbeiten beim BergBaur ist echt, herzlich und manchmal ein bisschen chaotisch. Wir helfen zusammen, lachen, essen gemeinsam und jede:r findet hier schnell seinen Platz.

Warum das so ist? Schwer zu sagen. Vielleicht liegt es an der Luft hier oben. Vielleicht an den Menschen. Wahrscheinlich aber einfach an beidem.

Eines ist sicher: Wer einmal hier ist, kommt gern wieder. Oder bleibt einfach gleich da.

Der BergBaur hat so seine eigene Art, Menschen festzuhalten. Vielleicht ja auch dich?

Von uns, für dich

* 5-Tage-Woche

* faire Dienstplanung & planbare Freizeit

* Verpflegung & Unterkunft (bei Bedarf)

* gute Entlohnung

* Arbeitsbekleidung

* ein herzliches Team

* Raum für eigene Ideen & Kreativität

Wir suchen eine:n Stimmungsmacher:in im Service, der:die auch dann den Überblick behält, wenn's mal richtig rund geht. Jemanden, der Service nicht einfach macht, sondern lebt - mit Gespür für Menschen, für gute Drinks und für den perfekten Moment am Tisch.

Jemanden, der weiß, wann man mit anpackt und wann ein Lächeln mehr sagt als 1000 Worte. Kurz gesagt: eine Persönlichkeit, die den Service trägt - und ihm genau die Leichtigkeit gibt, die unsere Gäste verdienen.

Und wenn du dabei noch eigene Ideen mitbringst: umso besser. Wir sind offen für neue Impulse, frische Perspektiven und alles, was den Service noch ein bisschen besonderer macht.

Berufsgruppe: Restaurantfachkraft, Servierkraft Dienstverhältnis: Saisonstelle (gern auch länger)

Arbeitszeit: Vollzeit

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Identity
jobs.description:
About the team:

The Identity team plays a critical role in delivering secure and seamless experiences for millions of SumUp users worldwide. We build and maintain authentication and account protection services, as well as central identity solutions that enable teams and products across SumUp.

We are a cross-functional, engineering-driven team that values technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement. We keep our processes lean, encourage open discussions, and believe in a strong team-first mentality where everyone contributes to the team's success.

As a Senior Software Engineer, your primary focus will be backend development in Go, building reliable and scalable solutions that support SumUp's identity ecosystem. Depending on your interests and strengths, you'll also have opportunities to contribute to infrastructure, web, or mobile development. Previous experience in all these areas isn't required, curiosity and a willingness to get hands-on are what matter.

We're looking for someone proactive and adaptable who enjoys taking ownership and driving initiatives end-to-end. You'll collaborate with engineers and stakeholders to shape requirements, design technical solutions, make implementation decisions, and drive rollouts. You'll have the opportunity to influence how we build and improve our services while making a meaningful impact on the security and experience of SumUp users.

 

What you'll do:

  • Collaborate with other engineers to design and build clean, reliable APIs, such as the next generation of our central Authentication and Permission APIs and facilitate a smooth gradual migration to these new systems.
  • Evolve our authentication and authorization services that serve both internal and external users.
  • Develop and ship solutions that enhance the security of our apps and SDKs, protect millions of users from fraud and account takeovers.
  • Create secure, user-friendly self-service features that empower our users to manage their accounts and contact preferences with confidence.
  • Work with a talented distributed team that values collaboration, learning, and continuous improvement.
  • Enjoy your work! We are looking for someone to be paid to do what they love.

 

You'll be great for this role if you have:

  • Experience in backend or fullstack development, primarily with Go. Familiarity with other languages like TypeScript, Ruby, Java, Kotlin, or Swift is a big plus and can be helpful for working across different systems.
  • Excitement for security and reliability topics. Experience with authentication and authorization technologies (e.g. OAuth, Multi-Factor Authentication) would be nice to have.
  • A flexible mindset and the ability to adapt quickly in a fast-moving environment and navigate complex domains. You are a quick learner and have a proven ability to pick up new skills and concepts swiftly.
  • A structured, proactive way of working. You enjoy working independently but also effectively collaborate with your cross-functional team and other teams.
  • A natural drive to improve things—you're always looking to make systems and processes better. You strive for great solutions, but also know when to be pragmatic.
  • Confidence in asking for help or using available tools (like search engines or AI assistants) when something is beyond your grasp.
  • Strong communication skills in English, both spoken and written. As part of a globally distributed team, clear and respectful communication is essential.

Why you should join SumUp:

🌍 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Sofia office. This involves an office-first setup

🧑‍🔬 We take learning and experimentation seriously with Hack Days every second Friday, and entire global Hack Weeks.

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: Be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2,000 for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education

🚀 Enrolment onto our VSOP program: You will own a stake in SumUp's future success

🏖️ Generous time off: 25 days of paid leave, plus one extra day per year of service (up to 35), along with public holidays and special leave options

🔄 30 Days Sabbatical: Enjoy the unique opportunity to take a well-deserved break with our 30 days sabbatical benefit after completing 3 years of employment with SumUp

🍽️ Meal support: benefit from a tax-free food voucher program plus flexibility via our Re:Benefits platform

🚌 Easy commute: free shuttle buses connecting directly to Joliot-Curie metro station

🏥 Peace of mind: additional health insurance and life insurance

💪 Stay active: on-site yoga and a co-sponsored Multisport card offering access to hundreds of sports facilities

🔗 Referral Bonus: Earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

 

SumUp is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that proudly pursues and hires a diverse workforce. SumUp does not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by Company policy. SumUp also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind.

 

About us:

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 36 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify. 

SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited.

Explore career opportunities with us and join a team driven by collaboration, innovation, and a shared vision of creating a world where everyone can build a thriving business. Discover more about our vibrant and inclusive work culture and how we work on our careers website, and follow our journey on LinkedIn and Instagram.



Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer (Power Electronics)
jobs.description:
Hyperscale Power is building the power backbone for the AI data center era: a complete power conversion chain from 13.8kV–35kV medium-voltage AC down to 800V DC, combining ultra-compact SiC-based power blocks. Our Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) are the core of this revolution, providing unprecedented control, efficiency, and compactness.

As a Senior Mechanical Design Engineer, you will turn our power electronic modules into a robust, compact and safe product. You will design how the SiC-based power modules, magnetics, busbars and cooling come together into one unit, working closely with our power electronics, magnetics and thermal engineers.

Instead of handing your designs over for someone else to build, you take them all the way: you calculate them, build and assemble the prototypes yourself in our workshop, and take the design from first prototype to a product ready for series production.

This role is for you if…

you've designed the mechanical integration of power electronics or other electronic systems and know your way around creepage, clearance and insulating plastics. You back your designs with solid calculations, and you're as comfortable with a screwdriver in the workshop as with CAD at your desk.

This role isn't for you if…

your experience is in classic mechanical design only, such as gears, gearboxes or pumps, or you prefer to stay at your desk while someone else builds your prototypes. It's also not a fit if you need technicians for assembly or established processes before you can start.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design the mechanical integration of power electronic modules into the SST: enclosures, holders, fixtures and jigs, and interfaces to the busbar system, with a modular design approach.

  • Model and design electro-mechanical parts and assemblies, including plastics, sheet metal, insulation systems, magnetic components and cooling system interfaces.

  • Ensure electrical safety through the design on both the medium-voltage and low-voltage side: creepage and clearance distances, CTI and material selection, electrical isolation and sealing.

  • Design for manufacturing, assembly and test from the first concept, working with suppliers on processes such as injection molding, sheet metal and machining.

  • Own the DFMEA for your designs and drive the resulting actions into the design.

  • Validate designs with structural FEA, including static, modal, shock and vibration analysis, before they are released for production, and correlate the results with test data.

  • Build and assemble prototypes and test assemblies hands-on in our workshop, together with the engineering team, using additive manufacturing where it speeds things up.

  • Collaborate with other engineers to take designs from concept through prototype to series production.

  • Share your expertise and support other engineers on best practices in mechanical engineering.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in mechanical engineering or a related field.

  • 4+ years of full-time industry experience in mechanical design, with a focus on the mechanical integration of power electronics or other electronic systems.

  • Proven experience applying DFM and DFA to your own designs, with parts and assemblies that made it into production.

  • Hands-on experience leading or actively contributing to DFMEAs.

  • Strong experience with structural FEA (e.g. ANSYS), including static, modal, shock and vibration analysis. You set up the models yourself and use the results to drive design decisions.

  • Solid knowledge of creepage, clearance, CTI, insulation coordination and electrical safety (e.g. IEC 60664-1, IEC 62477-1), ideally up to medium voltage.

  • Solid experience designing with polymers/plastics, ideally for electronics integration.

  • Proficiency in 3D CAD (e.g. SolidWorks), GD&T and tolerance stack-up analysis.

  • Hands-on experience building and assembling prototypes in a professional setting.

  • Experience with environmental, reliability and safety standards for power delivery products.

  • Basic understanding of electrical design fundamentals; familiarity with PCBAs and PCBA components.

  • Strong organization, written and verbal communication skills.

  • Fluent English; German is a plus.

  • Eligible to work in Switzerland (Swiss or EU/EFTA citizenship, or a valid Swiss work permit).

The job will be located at our HQ in Egg b. Zürich, Switzerland.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with industrialization: taking hardware from prototype to series production and designing with series production in mind from the start (tooling such as injection molds, supplier involvement, cost and process capability).

  • Experience with high-volume manufacturing and automated assembly processes.

  • Experience with additive manufacturing (e.g. SLA, SLS, FDM) for prototypes, fixtures and jigs, ideally including insulating or flame-retardant materials.

  • Experience with PFMEA, DFT and DFR.

  • Experience with insulation design for medium voltage, including partial discharge.

  • Experience with liquid cooling integration or CFD.

Benefits

  • Equity + competitive salary.

  • Unique technology and market opportunity – design the hardware of a new product category for the energy transition.

  • Hybrid work with flexible working times.

About myTomorrows 

myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options.   

We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem.   

We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection.   

With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business.  

Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. 

The Opportunity: Senior Engineering Manager

As an Engineering Manager at myTomorrows, you will lead Backend, Frontend, Full Stack and QA engineers building the platforms that help patients find their treatment options.

Our Expanded Access Program (EAP) platform and Clinical Trials (CT) platform connect patients and healthcare professionals with treatments in development and give our BioPharma Partners the tools to run their programs and trials. You’ll shape how these platforms grow, building a high-performing team that ships well-designed, scalable, secure and compliant software, and delivers it on time.

You won’t do it alone. You’ll partner closely with Product, Design, EAP and CT Operations, and our Platform colleagues in DevOps, Security and Data. Together, you’ll turn ambitious company goals into product outcomes that make a real difference in patients’ lives.

Given that most of our team is located in the Netherlands, we only consider candidates for this position who live within commuting distance of our office in Amsterdam.

What you’ll do in this role:

  • Lead, mentor and manage a team of Backend, Frontend, Full Stack and QA engineers. Foster a collaborative, inclusive and high-performing culture.

  • Own engineering delivery for your areas of the EAP and CT platforms, from discovery through to release and operation in production.

  • Partner with Product Managers and Designers to shape the roadmap, refine priorities, and plan and execute features and improvements.

  • Provide technical leadership in architecture and design, ensuring solutions are robust, maintainable, scalable and secure. Work with engineers on decisions about tools, frameworks and approaches.

  • Champion engineering best practices: proactive exploration AI-enabled and agentic development, code quality, testing, code review, API design, observability, documentation and secure development.

  • Ensure quality and compliance requirements are built into how the team works. This includes data privacy and the regulatory context of healthcare.

  • Build a culture of ownership, experimentation and continuous improvement, including healthy team rituals and retrospectives.

  • Partner with Recruitment to attract, hire and onboard top talent.

What you bring to the table:

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 6+ years of experience in software engineering, with a solid background in backend, frontend or full stack development.

  • 5+ years of experience leading or managing engineering teams.

  • A proven track record of delivering high-quality web products and developing engineers.

  • Hands-on familiarity with modern backend and frontend technologies. Experience with Python and Angular is a plus.

  • A strong understanding of Agile ways of working, product development and engineering best practices.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and influence stakeholders at all levels.

  • A passion for working in a mission-driven organisation focused on improving patient outcomes.

  • Experience in a regulated domain such as healthcare or life sciences or in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, is a plus.

What success looks like in the first 6 months:

  • You’ve built trust within your team and with Product, Design and Operations, and established clear ownership across your areas of the EAP and CT platforms.

  • Delivery is predictable and transparent. The team ships valuable increments regularly, with a clear link to product goals.

  • Code quality, test coverage and release reliability are visibly improving.

  • Every team member has clear expectations and a development plan, and you’ve addressed any key gaps in team composition.

  • The team works with autonomy and accountability, and collaborates well with Platform and other engineering teams.

  • You’ve identified and started executing key technical or organisational improvements that enhance scalability and team effectiveness.

  • You’re seen as a trusted technical and people leader, balancing strategic direction with hands-on support where needed.

Our current tech stack:

  • We are fully cloud-native on AWS. We follow a lean, API-first product development approach.

  • Our platform services, both microservices and AI, are built in Python.

  • Our frontends are built with Angular.

  • We use GitHub Actions for CI/CD to EKS and Terraform for IaC, with staging/production parity, continuous deployment and Grafana for observability.

  • Security is built in through managed secrets, SSO, dependency scanning, end-to-end encryption and periodic pen-tests.

Equal opportunities

myTomorrows is an Equal Opportunity Employer and, beyond upholding discrimination-free practices, we are committed to cultivating a workplace where difference and diversity are protected and celebrated. The best work comes from our best selves, and we go to great lengths in supporting our team members to be just that.

jobs.description:
System Engineer – Machine Control
Location: Eindhoven, the Netherlands (on-site, High Tech Campus) | Type: Full-time | Level: Senior, 8+ years of relevant experience

About us
AIM Solutions is an early-stage deep-tech startup in Eindhoven building inspection and metrology equipment for the semiconductor industry. We are in an active build phase, small, and growing.

The role
You own how our tool is controlled and operated. The machine combines lasers, high-speed cameras, a nanometer-precision wafer stage and GPU-based image reconstruction. Every measurement depends on these parts working together in tight synchronization. You are the system engineer for that layer: the control architecture, the timing, the machine software, and the data path from sensor to result. You work side by side with our system engineer for the metrology hardware and with our algorithms team, and together you lead the system.

You will:

  • Own the system control architecture: machine software, control hardware, timing and synchronization, and the data path from acquisition to reconstruction

  • Translate system performance and throughput goals into requirements for control, software and compute, and keep them traceable

  • Own the timing, throughput and data budgets, and decide where time is won or lost in a measurement

  • Define and guard the interfaces between control software, hardware and algorithms, including the hardware abstraction layer

  • Define how the machine is operated: machine states, sequencing, recipes, error handling, logging and monitoring

  • Steer the software and embedded engineers on the control side: set priorities, run design reviews and resolve trade-offs

  • Set up integration and verification of the control layer, with a test strategy that keeps it reliable as the hardware changes between builds

  • Carry the machine software from lab prototype toward a production tool that runs unattended in a fab

Your profile

  • 8+ years in high-tech equipment, including several years as a system engineer, software architect or control architect for a complex machine

  • Experience with machine control in semiconductor, lithography, metrology or scientific instruments

  • Hands-on understanding of real-time and deterministic systems: hardware triggering, FPGA-based synchronization, motion control and high-rate data acquisition

  • Strong in equipment software architecture: layered designs, hardware abstraction, state machines and concurrency

  • Comfortable reading code and reviewing designs in Python and C/C++. You won’t write most of the code, but you can.

  • Strong in requirements, budgets and interface management across hardware and software

  • This is not a role in a large organization with fixed processes: you help decide how we work. You thrive in a small, fast-moving team where roles are fluid, and you are as likely to be at the lab bench debugging a trigger as in a design review.

  • A clear communicator with engineers, management and partners

  • Full professional proficiency in English

Bonus:

  • Taking machine software from prototype to production, including SEMI standards for equipment communication and automation (such as SECS/GEM) and machine safety

  • Integration with wafer handling and factory automation

  • High-throughput data pipelines or GPU computing

  • Experience with optical or imaging systems: cameras, lasers, image data

  • Model-based systems engineering or modern requirements tools

We care more about systems thinking and ownership than about a perfect match. If your title was software architect, control architect or lead engineer, but you have owned how a complex machine runs, apply anyway.

What we offer

  • Shared technical leadership of a tool that does not exist anywhere else yet

  • Small team, short feedback loops, real impact on the product

  • Competitive salary for the Dutch market

At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative.

As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. You will work closely with Support, Sales, and Product teams to connect technical delivery with each customer's business goals.

Strategic account ownership

Delivery and collaboration

jobs.title: Director/Senior Director, EMEA Health Economics and Outcomes Research (HEOR) Leader

Scholar Rock is delivering muscle-targeted breakthroughs to transform the treatment of spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) and other rare neuromuscular diseases where muscle atrophy remains a critical unmet need.

As a global leader in myostatin biology, a field focused on proteins that regulate muscle mass, the biopharmaceutical company is named for the visual resemblance of a scholar rock to protein structures. Our commitment to unlock fundamentally different treatment approaches is powered by broad application of a proprietary platform, which has developed novel monoclonal antibodies to modulate protein growth factors with extraordinary selectivity. Scholar Rock works every day to create new possibilities for patients through its highly innovative anti-myostatin program, including opportunities in additional rare neuromuscular diseases. Learn more about our neuromuscular franchise at ScholarRock.com and follow @ScholarRock on X and on LinkedIn.

The Director/Senior Director, EMEA Health Economics and Outcomes Research (HEOR) Leader, reporting to the Vice President Global Medical Affairs, will lead the development and execution of the go-to market strategy and deliverables to support value of apitegromab as well as the clinical stage Scholar Rock portfolio, in close partnership with the cross-functional matrix team. 

This individual will serve as the strategic leader and subject matter expert for EMEA HEOR, responsible for country-level budget impact and cost-effectiveness model adaptations, evidence generation plans, and value communications required to support the national health technology assessment (HTA), payer dossiers, EU Joint Clinical Assessment (JCA), and reimbursement negotiations of Scholar Rock treatments. The role requires strong strategic leadership and cross-functional collaboration with Medical Affairs, Market Access, Commercial, Clinical Development and the regional teams in EMEA to optimize access and reimbursement for patients worldwide. 

The successful candidate will develop strategic partnerships and research collaborations with external experts, healthcare policymakers, payers and various academic centers to support the strategy for apitegromab and future products.

  • Develop HEOR strategies for EMEA, with an emphasis on Europe, that support product value demonstration, reimbursement, market access, and launch objectives.
  • Lead the design, implementation, and oversight of HEOR studies, models, and deliverables for Europe.
  • Collaborate with Medical, Market Access, and Biostatistics to determine real-world evidence needs for payers in Europe—including registries, natural history and external control analyses, burden of illness, treatment patterns, resource use, and addressing evidence requirements arising in HTA appraisal and reimbursement negotiations.

  • Direct evidence synthesis and value communication for payer and HTA bodies.

  • Own the HEOR deliverables for timely submissions to EU JCA, including PICO-driven evidence planning and comparative effectiveness analyses.

As a leading ERP provider for the DACH market, we believe that financial clarity is the backbone of a successful business—especially in the fast-paced world of B2B and E-commerce. In this role, you will play a key part in safeguarding our financial data, ensuring our reporting is accurate and our growth is measurable. You will work closely with our Finance leadership team, providing the insights needed to navigate our evolving market landscape.

Your Tasks:
  • You manage the monthly reporting process, preparing topline performance updates and supporting consolidated management P&L and Cash Flow statements.
  • You support the annual budgeting process and monthly forecasting cycles, helping ensure that our revenue projections and cost structures are accurate and evidence-based.
  • You perform regular data health checks between our backend systems and Looker, identifying discrepancies to ensure our reporting is bulletproof.
  • You collaborate with department heads and senior management across the company, providing ad-hoc analysis and data-driven insights for various strategic projects.
  • You maintain and update our financial views within LucaNet, ensuring that accounting postings are correctly reflected and the reporting structure meets management needs.
  • You leverage AI tools such as Claude Code to automate FP&A processes and enhance reporting efficiency
  • You may join senior leadership meetings to provide technical financial context and help answer detailed questions regarding our performance and KPIs.

    • Your Profile:
  • You are a Senior Finance Professional with 4+ years of relevant experience.
  • You have a solid working knowledge of LucaNet and are comfortable navigating the tool, managing consolidations, and adjusting reporting layouts.
  • You are highly proficient in Excel and have experience using BI tools like Looker to analyze datasets and monitor business performance.
  • You have a strong background in accounting or a related finance degree You have a deep understanding of P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow mechanics.
  • You have an uncompromising eye for detail and enjoy digging into data to find the root cause of an error until the numbers tie out.
  • You are familiar with standard SaaS and subscription metrics and understand how to translate these into meaningful reports for B2B and E-commerce contexts.
  • You are fluent in English and German (written and spoken).
    • What we offer

    Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy remote work options across Europe or from our office-hubs in Augsburg, Amsterdam, Berlin, Munich, and Lohne (Oldenburg), along with flexible working hours.

    Competitive Compensation & Comprehensive Benefits: Attractive salary packages and a generous leave policy that includes 28 annual leave days, special leave days, and nursing care days. Our comprehensive benefits package also provides a monthly voucher to choose from a variety of providers, including Urban Sports Club, grocery stores, entertainment, and lifestyle options. Additionally, we equip all employees with state-of-the-art home office equipment and offer a 50% subsidy on private pension plans for permanent employees in Germany.

    Professional Growth & Development: Benefit from a significant budget dedicated to learning and personal development, supporting your career growth and continuous learning.

    Inclusive & Engaging Culture: Participate in virtual and in-person company events and in our yearly culture connect days, fostering a collaborative and vibrant company culture with minimal hierarchies and respectful communication.

    Diverse & International Team: Work alongside a multicultural and international team across 17 different work locations within Europe and 32 nationalities, embracing diversity and a global perspective.

    Mental Health & Well-being: Access comprehensive, evidence-based mental health care with 24/7 counseling, therapy placement, on-site support, and legal and financial guidance to help you thrive at work and in life.

    You have what it takes? Then apply now with your CV or LinkedIn profile.

    We look forward to your application!


    About us

    We are an established tech startup with major tech investors Sequoia Capital and Visionaries Club on our side. We are aiming at defining a new SaaS category and empower entrepreneurs and e-commerce vendors to automate their resource planning and focus on the things that matters most to them: their business.
    We grow all over Europe, join us fully remote or in one of our hubs in Augsburg, Amsterdam, Berlin, Munich and Lohne (Oldenburg). You decide!

    At Xentral, it doesn’t matter where you come from, what you believe in, or how you identify - what matters is the person you are and the skills you bring. We’re a remote-first company operating across Europe, so you can work from wherever you feel most comfortable.     What unites us at Xentral is not one location, but one mission: making business software simple, powerful, and accessible for everyone. We strive to create a workplace where everyone feels respected, supported, and empowered to do their best work.
    Convince us with your personality and your skills – and together we’ll make great things happen.

Sinu masinaparki kuuluvad lõikamis-, fileerimis-, pakendamis- suitsutamis-, külmutamisseadmed, pesuliinid ja üldventilatsioon. Planeerid ja tellid varuosi ning tööriistu. Ja nagu öeldud, ei pea sa kõike esimesel päeval oskama — me aitame ja juhendame kui peamised oskused peavad Sul siiski olemas olema.Asume Lesta 7, Tallinn (Haabersti linnaosa).

jobs.title: HR Specialist & Office Manager
jobs.description:
Work tasks: DreamApply is an international EdTech company providing world-class SaaS admission solutions for universities. We are a small, dynamic team with a big mission: to make the application process a hassle-free experience for millions of students globally. Our roots are in Estonia, and our team is global. We are looking for a proactive and dependable HR Specialist & Office Manager to serve as management’s right hand in daily HR and administrative matters. Above all, we value strong organizational skills, initiative, and a genuine enthusiasm for keeping operations running smoothly. It is an ideal fit for someone who appreciates a balanced workload, while bringing precision, reliability, and an in-person presence when it counts. Key Responsibilities: Recruitment: Drafting and posting job openings, screening incoming applications, and conducting initial interviews through to final candidate selection. Onboarding & Offboarding: Facilitating smooth, welcoming onboarding for new hires and managing exit steps. Team Support: Addressing day-to-day HR inquiries from team members and assisting management with HR-related topics and projects. Team Events and Trainings: Planning and organizing virtual and in-person team events, trainings, and informal get-togethers when colleagues visit. Office Management: Managing daily office needs and ensuring a comfortable, well-run workspace. Operational & Administrative Support: Handling ad-hoc operational and administrative tasks.

We offer: What We Offer:Flexibility: A remote-friendly hybrid setup and a balanced workload that supports an exceptional work-life balance. International Environment: Hands-on exposure to the dynamic EdTech industry alongside a diverse global team. Open Culture: A flat hierarchy with direct, transparent communication. Benefits: sports compensation or health insurance, according to your choice

Other requirements: Requirements:Fluency in English and Estonian (both spoken and written), as everyday internal collaboration with our distributed team takes place in English. Previous experience or strong familiarity with the HR field and regulations, recruitment, office management, and administrative support. Strong organizational abilities, analytical skills, diligence, and attention to detail. High autonomy and proactivity - you readily spot what needs doing. Strong interpersonal and empathetic skills, acting as an approachable point of contact for colleagues. Excellent self-management and time-management skills, a proactive mindset with strong initiative, and great communication skills.

Option to work from home: Yes

jobs.description:
Vi trenger medarbeidere på butikk, camping og renhold som kan jobbe ukedager, helger og ferier. Er du glad i å jobbe med mennesker og teknologi? Liker du en variert arbeidshverdag? Da er du kanskje den vi leter etter på Hegna, som er en historisk plass med sin første høyteknologiske døgåpne butikk!

Hva vi ser etter

Hva gjør en medarbeider på HegnaLand?

Som en del av HegnaLand-teamet får du være med på å utvikle plassen videre, og du har varierte arbeidsoppgaver, både i butikken og på campingplassen. Og har du telefonvakt jobber du fra der det måtte passe deg!

HegnaLand søker deg som er opptatt av å gi kundene og gjestene våre gode opplevelser, er målrettet og motivert, pålitelig og organisert, handlekraftig og kreativ.

Vi ser etter deg som ikke er redd for å ta i et tak der det trengs, har gjennomføringsevne, og som vil ta i bruk teknologi på en helt ny måte!

En arbeidsdag på HegnaLand innebærer generell drift av destinasjonen i sin helhet, og kan bestå av alt fra å fylle varer i butikken, klippe gress på campingplassen, håndtering av campinggjester, kundeservice/vakttelefon, renhold og vedlikehold, og annet forefallende arbeid.

Arbeidstid vil være både ukedager og helger, dagtid og kveldstid gjennom sommeren, med mulighet for forlengelse.

Stillingsprosent settes etter nærmere avtale.

Kvalifikasjoner

• Du er over 18 år og har plettfri vandel, bl.a. for å få salgsbevilling på alkohol

• Førerkort og bil

Arbeidsoppgaver

Arbeidsoppgaver:

Arbeidsoppgaver på HegnaLand er generell drift av destinasjonen i sin helhet og innebærer blant annet:

• Varepåfyll og kundebehandling i butikk

• Håndtering av campinggjester

• Kundeservice/vakttelefon

• Renhold og vedlikehold

• Praktisk forefallende arbeid

Vi tilbyr

Vi tilbyr arbeidserfaring fra en av Norges mest innovative arbeidsplasser:

Her på HegnaLand verdsetter vi våre ansattes kompetanse og personlighet, og legger til rette for faglig og personlig vekst. Her får du rom til å utfolde deg kreativt i et trivelig arbeidsmiljø.

På HegnaLand har vi Norges første høyteknologiske dagligvarebutikk og en av Norges eldste og mest moderne campingplasser. Her kan du være med på å tilby våre kunder en unik opplevelse, uansett om de handler mat eller overnatter hos oss.

Teknologien har gitt oss mulighet til å ha åpent døgnet rundt, hele året, men vi trenger også engasjerte og serviceinnstilte medarbeidere som vil være med på å skape liv og glede i lokalsamfunnet i møte med våre gjester og kunder!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

På HegnaLand har vi Norges første høyteknologiske dagligvarebutikk og en av Norges eldste og mest moderne campingplasser. Her kan du være med på å tilby våre kunder en unik opplevelse, uansett om de handler mat eller overnatter hos oss.

Teknologien har gitt oss mulighet til å ha åpent døgnet rundt, hele året, men vi trenger også engasjerte og serviceinnstilte medarbeidere som vil være med på å skape liv og glede i lokalsamfunnet i møte med våre gjester og kunder!

jobs.title: Amart ApS søger 2 kokke
jobs.description:
Fuma Consulting ApS søger på vegne af Amart ApS to dygtige kokke til virksomhedens køkken i Kastrup.

Arbejdssted: Kirstinehøj 17, 2770 KastrupAntal stillinger: 2

Arbejdsopgaver

  • Tilberedning af kinesiske og andre asiatiske retter.

  • Fremstilling af traditionelle kinesiske specialiteter, herunder marinerede og krydderbraiserede retter (lu wei).

  • Forberedelse, behandling og kvalitetskontrol af råvarer.

  • Sikring af god fødevarehygiejne og ensartet kvalitet.

  • Deltagelse i den daglige drift af køkkenet.

Kvalifikationer

  • Erfaring som kok, gerne inden for kinesisk eller asiatisk madlavning.

  • Erfaring med tilberedning af kinesisk lu wei er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

  • Evne til at arbejde selvstændigt og samarbejde med kolleger.

  • Ansvarsbevidst, stabil og kvalitetsorienteret.

Vi tilbyder

  • Ansættelse hos Amart ApS.

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer og erfaring.

  • Et godt arbejdsmiljø med engagerede kolleger.

  • Tiltrædelse efter aftale.

Ansøgning

Interesserede ansøgere bedes sende CV via email.

Skriv venligst "Kok – Amart ApS" i emnefeltet.

Rekrutteringen varetages af Fuma Consulting ApS (CVR 39846535) på vegne af Amart ApS (CVR 42842087). Ansættelsen sker direkte hos Amart ApS.

Tõmblukkude, lukkude ja muu furnituuri vahetus jalatsitel. Võtmete valmistamine (korteri-, garaaži- ja postkastivõtmed jm) võtmemasinaga. Klientide teenindamine: töö vastuvõtt, hinna ja valmimisaja kokkuleppimine, valmis töö üleandmine. Kassatööd ja hooldustoodete müük. Töökoja ja tööriistade korrashoid.

Omalt poolt pakume: Tööandja tervisekindlustust.Põhjalikku väljaõpet kogenud meistri käe all, kui kogemust veel pole. Kaasaegseid tööriistu ja masinaid. Stabiilset ja püsivat tööd. Sõbralikku meeskonda. Võimalust õppida haruldast ja hinnatud ametit. Lisaks põhipalgale ka tulemusepõhine boonus.

Muud nõuded: Kohusetundlikkus ja usaldusväärsus.Täpsus ja tähelepanelikkus detailide suhtes. Kannatlikkus ja rahulik meel. Sõbralik ja abivalmis suhtumine klientidesse. Õpihimu ja valmisolek uusi oskusi omandada. Iseseisvus ja oskus oma tööd planeerida. Korrektsus ja puhtuse hoidmine töökohal.

jobs.title: Rioolarbeider speciale technieken
jobs.description:
Onze klant is een gespecialiseerd en groeiend bedrijf in renovatie- en infrastructuurwerken. Ze combineren vakmanschap met moderne technieken om ondergrondse leidingen, rioleringen en infrastructuur duurzaam te herstellen. Er wordt sterk ingezet op veiligheid, kwaliteit en de groei van medewerkers. De werksfeer is collegiaal en praktisch, met respect voor ervaring én motivatie.

Je komt terecht in een organisatie die inzet op speciale technieken zoals UV-relining, putrenovatie en betonherstel.

Jobomschrijving

Als rioolarbeider speciale technieken werk je mee aan het vernieuwen en herstellen van rioleringsleidingen met speciale technieken zoals putrenovatie en injecties/betonherstel.

Je taken:

  • je voert putrenovaties uit door glasvezel te plaatsen en deze aan te smeren
  • je voert injecties uit en herstelt beton op beschadigde plaatsen
  • je brengt afwerklagen aan na injecties en betonherstellingen
  • je werkt met moderne machines zoals inspectiecamera’s en freesrobots
  • je helpt bij sleufloze renovaties (relining)
  • je past je aan aan verschillende werven en omstandigheden

Dit heb je nodig voor de job

Voor de vacature van rioolarbeider speciale technieken, zoeken we iemand die niet afschrikt van lange dagen en op logement gaan.

Verder herken je jezelf in onderstaand profiel:

  • je hebt ervaring in de rioleringen
  • je hebt interesse in speciale technieken zoals UV, putrenovatie en betonherstel
  • je hebt interesse in innovatieve technieken
  • je hebt een rijbewijs C en kan je vlot verplaatsen naar verschillende oppikpunten
  • je spreekt Nederlands en/of Frans
De ideale collega is...
  • je bent gemotiveerd en leergierig
  • je werkt graag in teamverband
  • je kan zelfstandig taken uitvoeren
  • je bent flexibel naar werkuren, nachtwerk en overnachtingen
  • je werkt veilig en volgt afspraken correct op
  • je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je werk

jobs.title: Zelfstandig Werkend Kok I voor Vina's noodles & more in Leiden
jobs.description:
Vacature: 2X Zelfstandig Werkend Kok I-Leiden

Over Vina’s Noodles & More

Vina’s Noodles & More is een gezellig en modern Aziatisch restaurant in Leiden, gespecialiseerd in verse noedelgerechten en authentieke smaken uit de Vietnamese en Aziatische keuken. Wij staan bekend om onze kwaliteit, gastvrijheid en informele werksfeer. Ons team is hecht, professioneel en altijd gericht op het leveren van de beste ervaring aan onze gasten.

Functieomschrijving

Als zelfstandig werkend kok I ben je verantwoordelijk voor:

- ingrediënten worden zelf voorbereid

- toepassing van basis-kooktechnieken

- levert input t.a.v. de samenstelling en wijziging van

menu’s, kaart en methoden

- verantwoordelijk voor voorraad- en bestelbeheer

- vaktechnisch aansturen van hulpkracht(en).

Functie-eisen

- mbo 3 werk- en denkniveau

- aantoonbare kennis van de basis kooktechnieken

jobs.title: Customer service medewerker voor Duitsland
jobs.description:
Weet jij wat pas écht voldoening geeft? Allerhande vragen en problemen oplossen, hoe complex die ook mogen zijn! Deel jij deze mening, wil jij met jouw kennis Duits kunnen pronken op de werkvloer, en heb jij interesse in logistiek en/of transport? Dan kun jij binnenkort wel jouw contract tekenen hier!

Voor dé regionale specialist in diepvriestransport, gelegen in Oostkamp, zoeken wij een talenknobbel die al te graag de klanten in regio Duitsland te woord staat. Perfect voor wie van een stevige portie klantencontact houdt!

Jouw takenpakket

Als customer service medewerker ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt voor de klanten in regio Duitsland. Jij en jouw collega's van de klantendienst bieden hen graag een luisterend oor én een helpende hand.

Concreet ga jij:

  • Bestellingen verwerken en doorsturen naar de planning
  • Vragen en problemen van klanten verwerken en oplossen, zowel telefonisch als via mail
  • Intern overleggen met jouw collega's, jouw verantwoordelijke en andere diensten

Ben jij dit?

  • Bachelor, graduaat OF gelijkwaardig door ervaring
  • Uitstekende kennis Nederlands en goeie kennis Engels en Duits
  • Vlot met PC en met Office
  • Klantvriendelijk, service minded en commercieel ingesteld

Stel jou dan zeker kandidaat, want jij maakt kans!

Ervaring in customer service is niet vereist maar wel een pluspunt.

jobs.title: Grondwerker / wegenwerker
jobs.description:
Houd je van ruwbouw, maar blijf je graag met je twee voeten op (of in) de grond? 

Wij zijn opzoek naar nieuwe collega's die onze huidige teams regio Duffel kunnen versterken. Als firma zijn wij actief binnen infrastructuurwerken wat van wegenwerken tot asfalt- en betonproductie loopt maar ook labo werk, signalisatie- en onderhoudsdiensten.

Jij zal als grondwerker / wegenwerker worden ingezet op grote projecten zoals tunnels, bruggen, stedelijke projecten, ...Dit in een stabiel team met goed materiaal zodat je werk vlot verloopt.

Jouw takenpakket ziet er als volgt uit:

  • Plaatsen van borduren
  • Rioolaansluiting
  • Algemene grondwerken
  • Uitschieten van beton
  • Kolken plaatsen in het wegdek
  • Enz.

Je gaat vaak met buizen in aanraking komen die 2 tot 3meter breed zijn.Daarom vragen we wel de nodige ervaring met zo'n grote materialen.

Een rijbewijs is noodzakelijk binnen onze firma, zo kunnen wij er op rekenen dat je het stuur kan overnemen indien de chauffeur ziek is.Er kan gevraagd worden naar nacht- of weekendwerk, uiteraard krijg je hiervoor een extra toeslag op het loon.Bovenop de standaard verloning krijg jij ook nog een mooi extra in de vorm van maaltijdcheques (€5.60/dag) en Benefits@Work.

Verder zetten wij als firma in op persoonlijke groei en bieden tal van opleidingen.

 

Wil jij deel uitmaken van een sterke speler binnen infrastructuur werken?

Kennis van de Nederlandse taal

Ervaring binnen grond / wegenwerken

Rijbewijs B

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
Over onsMirkoz Vending ontwikkelt en bouwt zijn eigen smart fridges en levert daarnaast verkoopautomaten en refurbished koffieautomaten aan bedrijven in heel Europa. Klanten zoals Albert Heijn, Domino's en politiezone LaMa rekenen op ons. We zijn een klein, snelgroeiend team en breiden uit naar de Franstalige markt: Frankrijk, Wallonië en Luxemburg.

Jouw job

  • Je belt warme leads en offerteaanvragen op, in het Nederlands en het Frans, en peilt naar hun interesse en behoeften.
  • Je plant online meetings in met beslissers, gericht op een directe aankoop.
  • Je volgt offertes en openstaande aanvragen op tot er een duidelijke ja of nee is.
  • Je houdt je belresultaten en opvolging dagelijks bij in onze leadlijst.
  • Je rapporteert dagelijks kort over je resultaten en hebt wekelijks een één-op-één met de zaakvoerder.
  • Je helpt de Franse markt mee opbouwen, van prospectie tot klantrelatie.

Jouw profiel

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vlot Nederlands én Frans. Dat is een absolute vereiste.
  • Je belt graag en je durft door te vragen. Een "nee" schrikt je niet af.
  • Je werkt zelfstandig en resultaatgericht, en je volgt je afspraken nauwkeurig op.
  • Je bent digitaal vaardig, met mail, Excel en een online agenda.
  • Ervaring in B2B-sales, telesales of klantenservice is een plus, maar geen vereiste.
  • Je hebt affiniteit met technologie en innovatieve producten.

jobs.title: Grondwerker rioleringen
jobs.description:
Heb jij kennis van rioleringswerken op zoek naar een nieuwe uitdaging? 

Om ons team van grondwerkers te versterken, zijn wij op zoek naar extra collega’s.Als familiebedrijf zijn wij uitgegroeid tot een sterke speler binnen de bouwsector, met een duidelijke focus op infrawerken.

Samen met de collega's van het rioleringsteam zorgen jullie voor de aanleg en plaatsing van rioleringssystemen.

Je takenpakket bestaat uit:

  • Aankoppelen van buizen, putten en andere elementen

jobs.title: Mission Manager
jobs.description: At SSC Space, you are part of something bigger. Every day, our people contribute to missions that expand knowledge, support critical services, and help society benefit from space. We believe the best results come from passionate experts who collaborate, take ownership, and turn ambitious ideas into reality.  As Mission Manager, you will oversee customer payload missions from initial planning through launch and post-mission review. Working in an international environment, you will bring together customers, brokers, satellite manufacturers, launch vehicle providers and operators, and internal teams to define mission requirements and coordinate delivery against agreed objectives. You will serve as the customer's primary point of contact throughout the mission lifecycle, combining technical coordination, project management, and customer relationship management. The role is part of Sales & Customer Operations within Orbital Launch & Rocket Test and reports to the Head of Sales & Customer Operations. JOB REQUIREMENTSTo succeed in this role, we believe you have:     A master's degree in aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.     A proactive, solution-focused mindset and strong analytical skills.     The ability to read, understand, and interpret complex technical documentation.     Effective communication skills and the ability to build strong relationships with customers, partners, and colleagues.     A collaborative approach and the ability to work effectively across teams and organizational boundaries.     A high level of spoken and written English. Experience with satellite systems, launch vehicle operations, mission planning, satellite qualification and integration, CAD and space industry practices, as well as familiarity with launch regulations is considered an advantage. A high level of spoken and written Swedish is also desirable. JOB RESPONSIBILITIESIn this role, you will:     Lead mission planning with customers and partners, defining objectives, requirements, interface control documentation, constraints, launch timelines, orbital parameters, payload integration plans, and mission success criteria.     Act as the primary customer contact throughout the mission lifecycle, providing progress updates, responding to inquiries, and managing expectations to support customer satisfaction.     Coordinate payload integration, testing, and verification with satellite engineers, launch engineers, payload specialists, and launch vehicle providers and operators.     Conduct launch readiness reviews covering technical readiness, safety compliance, regulatory requirements, and risk management, and ensure necessary approvals and certifications are obtained.     Oversee and coordinate launch campaign activities, including launch vehicle transportation, pre-launch preparations, and final readiness activities, together with launch site personnel, ground support teams, and external stakeholders.     Manage mission projects, identify and assess risks, develop mitigation strategies and contingency plans, and address issues throughout the mission lifecycle.     Conduct post-mission reviews, capture lessons learned, and implement improvements to processes and working practices for future missions. WE OFFER YOU    Meaningful work connected to science, society and the future of space.     The opportunity to collaborate with talented and passionate colleagues across disciplines, countries, and missions.     Real responsibility, trust, and the freedom to influence both your work and your development.     A unique chance to contribute directly to projects where you can see the impact of your ideas and efforts. Additional Benefits     In addition to vacation and traditional public holidays, we offer extra paid leave throughout the year, such as time off between Christmas and New Year and Ascension Day, amounting to 6-11 extra days depending on the calendar.     Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year.     Health benefits such as voluntary health insurance and regular health checks for eligible employees.     Access to a benefit bike through a tax-efficient leasing program.     Support for employee-driven activities that promote connection, health, and culture across teams.     Collective Agreement, including competitive pension plans, parental pay, and insurance. LOCATIONThis is a full-time, permanent position based at our office in Solna or Kiruna. FURTHER INFORMATIONFor questions regarding employment terms or union-related matters, you are welcome to contact: Sveriges Ingenjörer: SverigesIngenjorer-AF@sscspace.com Unionen: unionen@sscspace.com NEXT STEPIf this opportunity sparks your interest, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible! We review applications continuously and conduct interviews throughout the process. When applying, please include your CV. While you are welcome to include a brief personal note or letter, our evaluation will primarily focus on your skills and qualifications as outlined in your CV, ensuring a fair and unbiased recruitment process. This position requires approved pre-employment screening. These controls are based on the role that you will fulfill within the company. Additional requirements regarding citizenship may apply. WE HELP EARTH BENEFIT FROM SPACESSC Space is a trusted end-to-end mission partner and employer of choice, recognized for reliability, expertise and enabling mission success. From satellite communications and spacecraft operations to launch services, engineering, and consultancy, we help customers around the world achieve their space ambitions.  Our unique capabilities include Esrange Space Center in northern Sweden and one of the world's most dependable ground station networks. Together with around 800 colleagues worldwide, we are creating new opportunities in space while helping Earth benefit from Space.  Limitless Together.  Learn more at sscspace.com

jobs.title: Marketing-Manager (m/w/d) in Teilzeit (20-30 Std./ Woche)
jobs.description:
Über Heless

Heless entwickelt und produziert seit 1949 in Schwetzingen hochwertige Spielwaren und Produkte für Kinder. Als familiengeführtes Unternehmen in der dritten Frauengeneration legen wir großen Wert auf Qualität, Innovation und pädagogischen Wert, um Familien auf der ganzen Welt zu begleiten und zu inspirieren.

Wir suchen eine Marketingpersönlichkeit, die Ideen entwickelt und selbst umsetzt. Sie betreuen unsere Website und unseren Shop, setzen Kampagnen und Händleraktionen um und verantworten unsere Messeauftritte.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Sie planen Marketingmaßnahmen für unsere Marke und unsere Produkte und setzen sie um. Gemeinsam mit dem Vertrieb entwickeln Sie Händleraktionen, Katalogaktionen und weitere Maßnahmen zur Verkaufsförderung.

  • Sie pflegen und entwickeln unsere Website und unseren Shop weiter. Sie erstellen Landingpages und Produktpräsentationen und aktualisieren Produktdaten im Shopsystem.

  • Sie erstellen Newsletter und Mailings für Handelspartner und Interessenten. Sie setzen Maßnahmen mit Google- und Meta-Tools um und nutzen die Ergebnisse, um Kampagnen und Inhalte weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Sie verantworten die Themen- und Redaktionsplanung für Social Media und steuern unsere Social-Media-Kraft, die die laufenden Inhalte erstellt und veröffentlicht.

  • Sie erstellen einfache Grafiken, Banner und Marketingmaterialien selbst, beispielsweise mit Canva oder Adobe Illustrator.

  • Sie briefen und koordinieren unsere Grafikdesignerin sowie bei Bedarf externe Gestalter. Sie begleiten die Umsetzung vom Briefing über die Abstimmung der Entwürfe bis zur Freigabe.

  • Sie planen, organisieren und betreuen unsere Messeauftritte eigenständig, insbesondere auf der Spielwarenmesse Nürnberg. Sie koordinieren Standbau, Materialien und Messekommunikation, stimmen sich mit internen und externen Beteiligten ab und verantworten den Ablauf vor Ort.

Das bringen Sie mit

  • Sie bringen praktische Berufserfahrung im Marketing mit und haben Marketingmaßnahmen eigenständig geplant, umgesetzt und ausgewertet.

  • Sie arbeiten sicher mit Shopsystemen und Content-Management-Systemen. Erfahrung mit Shopware ist ein Plus.

  • Sie haben praktische Erfahrung mit Google- und Meta-Tools und können die Ergebnisse Ihrer Maßnahmen anhand relevanter Kennzahlen einordnen.

  • Sie haben Erfahrung mit Social Media und können Inhalte redaktionell und gestalterisch beurteilen. Kenntnisse in Pinterest oder TikTok sind willkommen.

  • Sie bringen praktische Kenntnisse in Adobe Illustrator mit und können bestehende Layouts und Grafiken selbstständig anpassen. Kenntnisse in Photoshop oder InDesign sind ein Plus.

  • Sie schreiben stilsicher auf Deutsch, haben ein gutes Gespür für Gestaltung und können sich auf Englisch sehr gut verständigen.

  • Sie setzen Prioritäten, verfolgen vereinbarte Aufgaben und bringen Projekte eigenständig zum Abschluss. Erfahrung mit Messen, Handelsmarketing oder Konsumgütern ist willkommen.

  • Sie können während der Spielwarenmesse Nürnberg vor Ort in Vollzeit mitarbeiten.

Das erwartet Sie bei uns

  • Eine vielseitige Marketingaufgabe mit Verantwortung für eigene Projekte und Raum für Ihre Ideen.

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung und dem Vertrieb sowie Unterstützung durch unsere Grafikdesignerin und unsere Social-Media-Kraft.

  • Produkte, mit denen Sie vor Ort arbeiten und eigene Inhalte entwickeln können.

  • Eine Teilzeitstelle mit überwiegender Präsenz in Schwetzingen. Den regulären Wochenstundenumfang stimmen wir gemeinsam ab.

Interesse?

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung über JOIN mit Ihrem möglichen Eintrittstermin, Ihrem gewünschten Wochenstundenumfang und Ihrer Gehaltsvorstellung. Schicken Sie uns gerne ein bis zwei Arbeitsproben und schreiben Sie kurz dazu, was Sie selbst umgesetzt und welches Ergebnis Sie damit erzielt haben.

jobs.title: Grondwerker / wegenwerker
jobs.description:
Houd jij van ruwbouw, maar blijf jij graag met je twee voeten op (of in) de grond? 

Wij zijn opzoek naar nieuwe collega's die onze huidige teams kunnen versterken. Als firma zijn wij actief binnen infrastructuurwerken wat van wegenwerken tot asfalt- en betonproductie loopt maar ook labo werk, signalisatie- en onderhoudsdiensten.

Jij zal als grondwerker / wegenwerker worden ingezet op grote projecten zoals tunnels, bruggen, stedelijke projecten, ...Dit in een stabiel team met goed materiaal zodat je werk vlot verloopt.

Jouw takenpakket ziet er als volgt uit:

  • Plaatsen van borduren
  • Rioolaansluiting
  • Algemene grondwerken
  • Uitschieten van beton
  • Kolken plaatsen in het wegdek
  • Enz.

Jij gaat vaak met buizen in aanraking komen die 2 tot 3meter breed zijn.Daarom vragen we wel de nodige ervaring met zo'n grote materialen.

Een rijbewijs is noodzakelijk binnen onze firma, zo kunnen wij er op rekenen dat je het stuur kan overnemen indien de chauffeur ziek is.Er kan gevraagd worden naar nacht- of weekendwerk, uiteraard krijg jij hiervoor een extra toeslag op het loon.Bovenop de standaard verloning krijg jij ook nog een mooi extra in de vorm van maaltijdcheques (€5.60/dag) en Benefits@Work.

Verder zetten wij als firma in op persoonlijke groei en bieden tal van opleidingen.

Wil jij deel uitmaken van een sterke speler binnen infrastructuur werken?

jobs.title: All Round F&B
jobs.description:

Je komt terecht in een uniek historisch kader: een prachtig 13de-eeuws pand met een moderne vleugel, omringd door een gezellige binnenplaats en uitgestrekte tuinen waar regelmatig evenementen plaatsvinden. 

Als F&B Allrounder ben je een onmisbare schakel in de beleving van onze gasten. Je taken zijn gevarieerd en afwisselend:

Je ondersteunt bij ontbijt, bar, restaurant en evenementen

Je geeft directe en warme service aan gasten
