jobs.title: Marknadschef till Visit Dalarna AB, Rättvik
jobs.description: Om företagetVisit Dalarnas uppdrag är att marknadsföra och sälja Dalarna som besöksmål nationellt och internationellt för att fler besökare ska komma hit. Bolaget ska även vara den samlande kraften för besöksnäringen i Dalarna. Tillsammans med företag inom besöksnäringen, kommuner och andra aktörer arbetar vi för att stärka Dalarna som besöksmål och skapa förutsättningar för en konkurrenskraftig och hållbar besöksnäring. Här får du vara med och utveckla ett starkt destinationsvarumärke med en plats som väldigt många redan har en relation till. Vårt arbete ska väcka intresse för Dalarna, bidra till fler besök och samtidigt skapa konkret nytta för de företag som verkar inom besöksnäringen. Uppdraget sträcker sig från marknadsföring i Sverige och internationellt till digital besöksservice, kunskapsdelning och analys. Visit Dalarna ägs via holdingbolag av Dalarnas 15 kommuner och arbetar nära både besöksnäringen och våra samarbetspartner. Hos oss blir du en del av en organisation där samarbete, utveckling och nytänkande är viktigt och där resultatet av vårt arbete märks långt utanför den egna organisationen.Vill du vara med och sälja och marknadsföra Dalarna som besöksmål nationellt och internationellt stärka Dalarna som destination och skapa verklig nytta för besöksnäringen? Hos Visit Dalarna får du möjlighet att påverka hur Dalarna syns, upplevs och väljs som resmål – idag och i framtiden.Dina arbetsuppgifterSom marknadschef leder och utvecklar du Visit Dalarnas samlade arbete inom försäljning och marknad. Du ansvarar och omsätter bolagets affärsplan till en tydlig marknadsplan med prioriterade målgrupper, marknader, aktiviteter och nyckeltal. Rollen kombinerar strategisk riktning med ett verksamhetsnära ledarskap och ger dig möjlighet att påverka hur Dalarna positioneras som besöksmål. Arbetet omfattar både svenska och internationella målgrupper samt samarbeten med researrangörer och andra aktörer som kan bidra till fler besök i Dalarna. Du utvecklar strukturer och arbetssätt som gör ansvar, prioriteringar och leveranser tydliga. Genom analys och relevanta nyckeltal visar du vilken effekt marknadsinsatserna ger och tar fram underlag till vd, ledningsgrupp och styrelse. Försäljningsperspektivet handlar framför allt om att skapa efterfrågan och affärsnytta för Dalarnas besöksnäringsföretag.I rollen bygger du relationer med besöksnäringsföretag, kommuner, Visit Sweden och andra samarbetspartner. Du fångar upp besöksnäringens behov och omsätter dem till relevanta insatser. Som företrädare för Visit Dalarna är du också en nyckelperson som representerar bolaget och behöver du också kunna förklara bolagets uppdrag.Under ditt första år ligger fokus på att omsätta och utveckla den nya affärsplanen och marknadsplanen, etablera en tydlig uppföljning och skapa stabilitet och framdrift i avdelningen. Din profilVi söker dig som har en gedigen bakgrund inom marknadsföring och erfarenhet av att leda både människor och verksamhet. Du har relevant högskole- eller universitetsutbildning och har tidigare haft ansvar för personal, arbetsmiljö och budget. Strategi är en naturlig del av ditt arbete, men du trivs också nära verksamheten och är van att omsätta riktning och mål till något som faktiskt händer.Du har en bred förståelse för marknadsföring och varumärkesutveckling och känner dig hemma i det digitala landskapet. Snarare än att själv vara specialist inom varje område kan du samla olika kompetenser, sätta riktning och avgöra vad som behöver prioriteras. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Vitec BidTheatre
jobs.description: Vitec BidTheatre builds software and solutions for data-driven online marketing. Our platform enables media agencies, brands and other marketing professionals to manage and deliver programmatic advertising campaigns.We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our small engineering team in Stockholm. The position offers a high degree of independence, technical ownership and the opportunity to influence the continued development of our platform.About the roleAs a member of our engineering team, you will work across our technology stack, developing and maintaining the applications and services that power our advertising platform.A key part of your role will be taking the lead in the continued development of BidTheatre Studio, our web application used by clients and internal teams to manage digital advertising campaigns. You will have significant influence over frontend architecture, technical decisions and development practices.Beyond the frontend, you will also be actively involved in developing and maintaining our backend systems, including APIs, business logic and data processing. We are looking for someone with solid experience in both frontend and backend development who is comfortable taking responsibility across the entire application stack.Our frontend uses React, TypeScript and Redux. Our backend is primarily Java-based, with technologies such as SQL, Redis, Aerospike, Kafka and Spark supporting our data-intensive platform.We embrace modern development practices, including AI-assisted coding, and encourage experimentation with tools that improve productivity and code quality.We believe you are an experienced and versatile developer who enjoys understanding how systems work as a whole. You are comfortable taking ownership of complex tasks, making technical decisions and working independently, while collaborating closely with your colleagues.Requirements    5+ years of professional software development experience    Strong experience with React, TypeScript and modern frontend development    Solid professional experience in backend development using Java or comparable technologies such as C#/.NET or Kotlin    Ability and willingness to work with Java-based backend systems    Good understanding of SQL and relational databases    Experience developing and maintaining larger web applications    Good understanding of software architecture, performance and maintainability    Ability to independently drive technical decisions and development    Experience with Git, testing and modern development practices    Good written and spoken English skillsNice to have    Experience with Redux Toolkit, RTK Query or Redux Saga    Experience with distributed or high-volume systems    Experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Codex, Claude Code or similar    Interest in UX/UI design    Experience with ad tech or programmatic advertising    Degree in Computer Science    Fluency in SwedishWhat we offerYou will be part of a small, experienced engineering team where your contributions make a real difference. You will have the freedom to take ownership of your work, influence technical decisions and contribute across different parts of a complex platform.Our systems handle large volumes of data and real-time transactions, offering a broad range of technical challenges in a profitable and established software business.Application: The application deadline is 13th of December 2026. We encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible, as applications are reviewed and interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis.If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact Andreas Green at Andreas.Green@vitecsoftware.com.Location: The position is based at our office in Stockholm.Start date: As soon as possible, by agreement.About Vitec BidTheatreBidTheatre DSP is a programmatic marketing platform built for media agencies, advertisers and integrators. With BidTheatre, marketers get unified and efficient access to the fragmented media landscape with banner, video, audio, native, CTV, and digital out of home (DOOH) advertising. The platform can be used to launch awareness building or conversion driving advertising campaigns, target niche audiences and gain marketing insights. BidTheatre is an independent and close partner that puts transparency and innovation in the forefront. BidTheatre has offices in Stockholm and Oslo and has been part of Vitec Software Group since 2024 Read more at bidtheatre.com.About Vitec Software GroupVitec is a leading provider of Vertical Software and has its origin and headquarters in Umeå, Sweden. Our products have been developed to meet specific needs within various niche markets in society. The expertise of our employees, combined with our shared corporate culture and business model, enable continuous improvement and innovation. We grow through the successes of our business units, as well as through acquisitions. Everything we do is based on a long-term perspective. Because we are to rely on – today and tomorrow. Vitec has 1,870 employees, is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm and had net sales of SEK 3,633 million in 2025. Read more at vitecsoftware.com.

jobs.title: Production Manager (m/f)
jobs.description: Description des tâches:LUXUAV is an innovative technology company headquartered in Luxembourg, shaping next-generation airspace security for defence, civil, firefighting and police missions.We build a fully integrated Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) ecosystem that connects mission systems across ground, air, and stratosphere into one coherent governmental and commercial architecture.Job Title: Production ManagerReports to: Chief Operating OfficerRole overview:The Production Manager is responsible for leading the company's production operations, ensuring the safe, efficient and timely manufacture of high-quality unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). The role manages the production team, oversees daily manufacturing activities, and works closely with Engineering, Industrialisation and Quality to deliver products that meet customer expectations, quality standards and business objectives.The Production Manager is accountable for production planning, workforce management, productivity, quality, continuous improvement and operational performance while fostering a positive and engaged team culture.Key ResponsibilitiesProduction Operations• Lead and manage all daily production activities to ensure safe, efficient andon-time delivery of products.• Develop and execute production schedules and targets.• Monitor production progress and adjust resources to meet changing priorities.• Ensure production targets are achieved while maintaining quality and safety standards.• Identify production bottlenecks and implement solutions to improve throughput.• Ensure effective utilisation of labour, equipment, and production resources.Team Leadership• Lead, coach, develop and motivate the production team.• Manage workforce planning, shift allocation and daily work assignments.• Manage performance and provide regular coaching and feedback.• Manage day-to-day employee relations issues within the production team, partnering with HR on formal or complex cases.• Identify training and development needs to enhance team capability.• Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork and continuous improvement.Quality• Ensure products are manufactured in accordance with quality requirements; and approved engineering drawings, specifications, Bills of Materials (BOMs) and work instructions developed by the R&D team.• Work closely with the Quality Manager to resolve production quality issues.• Promote a "right first time" approach throughout production.• Ensure production teams understand and comply with quality procedures.• Support non-conformance investigations and implement corrective actions.Production Planning & Performance• Ensure production plan is aligned to meet sales plan and/or customer delivery deadlines.• Ensure production plan and corresponding timely materials procurement requests are factored into the procurement plan.• Monitor production KPIs including output, efficiency, labour utilisation, schedule adherence, rework and productivity.• Analyse production performance and recommend improvements.• Prepare production reports for management.• Support capacity planning and future production growth.Health, Safety & Compliance• Promote a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with health and safety requirements.• Ensure employees follow safe working practices and company procedures.• Participate in risk assessments and incident investigations.• Maintain a clean, organised and safe production environment.Continuous Improvement• Lead continuous improvement initiatives within production (e.g. 5S program implementation).• Improve production workflows, layouts and processes.• Reduce waste, rework and production downtime.• Support Lean manufacturing and other operational excellence initiatives.• Encourage employee suggestions for operational improvements.Inventory & Materials• Work closely with Supply Chain and Procurement to ensure material availability.• Monitor inventory accuracy within the production area.• Ensure appropriate handling and storage of components and finished products.• Minimise material waste and production losses.Cross-functional Collaboration• Collaborate with Engineering and Industrialisation to introduce new products into production.• Support prototype, pilot and low-rate initial production (LRIP) builds.• Provide manufacturing feedback to improve product design and manufacturability.• Support production readiness for new product introductions and engineering changes.Equipment & Facilities• Ensure production equipment is maintained and available.• Report equipment issues and coordinate maintenance activities.• Recommend investments in tools, equipment, and production capability.Qualifications & ExperienceMust have• Bachelor's degree or vocational qualification in Manufacturing, Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field. Equivalent manufacturing leadership experience will also be considered.• Minimum of 5 years' experience in a manufacturing environment.• Previous experience leading production teams.• Strong understanding of manufacturing operations and production planning.• Understanding of quality management systems and manufacturing quality principles.• Familiarity with health and safety requirements within manufacturing.• Strong leadership and people management skills.• Excellent organisational and planning abilities.• Effective problem-solving and decision-making skills.• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.• Good analytical skills with the ability to interpret production data.• Free criminal record no. 3Nice to have• Experience within electronics, aerospace, defence, automotive, or other high- technology manufacturing environments is advantageous.• Experience introducing new products into production is desirable.• Experience using ERP or manufacturing planning systems is advantageous.• National from a NATO member country or one of the following NATO Indo- Pacific partners: Australia, Japan, South Korea, New Zealand or Ukraine.

jobs.description: Description:Director Global Marketing & Sales Enablement (m/f/d)Id: 21688 Type: FullTime Location: Luxembourg Job DescriptionThe Director Global Marketing & Sales Enablement is responsible for defining and driving Husky's global brand strategy, leading B2B marketing and demand generation, advancing sustainability advocacy and industry engagement, delivering actionable market intelligence, and improving global sales effectiveness.Reporting to the EVP, Sales & Marketing, this leader will strengthen Husky's market position and industry influence, build an integrated commercial support function, and connect market insights, customer engagement, and sales capabilities to deliver measurable business growth.Responsibilities:1. Global Brand Strategy, Marketing & Industry Advocacy• Own Husky's global brand strategy, positioning, identity, and differentiation, ensuring a compelling and consistent presence across markets and customer touchpoints.• Develop and execute global B2B marketing programs that generate qualified leads and commercial opportunities through digital channels, integrated campaigns, account-based marketing, trade shows, and customer events.• Lead Husky's sustainability advocacy and industry engagement strategy, partnering with industry associations, customers, and value-chain stakeholders to advance science-based understanding of plastics, address misconceptions, and promote responsible use, recycling, and circularity.• Represent Husky's perspectives in relevant industry initiatives and advocacy programs, strengthening its reputation as a credible technology leader and constructive voice in sustainability discussions.• Establish metrics to evaluate brand strength, marketing contribution to pipeline, and the reach and effectiveness of advocacy initiatives.2. Strategic Customer Engagement & Sales Enablement• Lead the development of executive-level content and strategic narratives for Top-to-Top (T2T) customer meetings, supporting senior leadership and strategic account engagement.• Develop high-impact sales enablement content, including value propositions, product and solution presentations, competitive positioning, case studies, and customer value tools.• Partner with Sales, Product Line Management, and Engineering to ensure differentiated, consistent, and customer-focused messaging.• Equip global commercial teams with the content, knowledge, and capabilities required to engage customers effectively and win business.4. Sales Effectiveness & Commercial Excellence• Partner with Sales leadership to improve sales productivity, commercial processes, opportunity management, and overall sales effectiveness.• Drive adoption of sales methodologies, CRM capabilities, digital tools, and AI-enabled solutions to strengthen commercial execution.• Develop scalable approaches to sales training, onboarding, best-practice sharing, and continuous improvement of capability.• Establish performance metrics and improvement initiatives focused on sales efficiency, conversion rates, win rates, and commercial productivity.Leadership & Experience• The successful candidate will be a strategic, commercially oriented leader with proven experience in global brand management, complex industrial B2B marketing, market intelligence, and sales enablement.• Experience engaging industry associations, building external partnerships, and shaping industry narratives around sustainability, circularity, or related topics is highly desirable.• The role requires strong business acumen, the ability to lead global multidisciplinary teams, and the credibility to influence executive stakeholders while translating market insights and brand strategy into measurable commercial outcomes.Qualifications:• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Engineering, or a related field; MBA or other advanced business degree considered an asset.• 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in global B2B marketing, brand strategy, commercial excellence, or sales enablement within a complex industrial, manufacturing, technology, or capital equipment environment.• Demonstrated success developing and executing integrated marketing strategies that drive brand growth, lead generation, customer engagement, and measurable commercial results across global markets.• Proven experience leveraging market intelligence, competitive insights, and voice-of-customer research to influence business strategy, portfolio decisions, and growth initiatives.• Strong track record leading cross-functional and global teams, influencing executive stakeholders, and driving adoption of sales methodologies, CRM platforms, digital tools, and AI-enabled solutions to improve sales effectiveness.Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. No agency or telephone inquiries please.Are you looking to join a world-class manufacturing organization? At Husky TechnologiesTM, we strive to be the best with a strong foundation built on innovation, collaboration and a unique culture with great people. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!What we offer• Excellent benefits package and retirement savings plans as well as life insurance program• Competitive vacation policy promoting work-life balance• Challenging career opportunities and growth • Opportunity to work, innovate and collaborate with passionate people who drive change• Amazing team – we are the best in the world at what we do!Husky TechnologiesTM Campus• Large, beautiful campus with clean, state-of-the-art air-conditioned offices and manufacturing facilities with high air quality, climate control and outstanding safety records• Onsite fitness and wellness center• Organized out- and indoor sports activities such as running teams, and bicycle teams• Access to onsite medical practitioners• Onsite cafeterias with fresh and healthy meal options• Free parking

jobs.description: Description:Analyste de données - Pilotage Commercial et Support RéseauxLocation: Leudelange Experience Level: Professionnels Home Office: Oui Votre job en bref Tu aimes analyser les données et transformer tes insights en décisions concrètes ? Rejoins-nous !En tant qu'analyste de données en charge du pilotage commercial et du support aux réseaux, tu accompagnes les équipes commerciales grâce à tes analyses, identifies les opportunités de développement et aides à piloter la performance de nos réseaux de distribution. En collaboration avec de nombreux métiers, tu transformes les données en recommandations à forte valeur ajoutée pour soutenir notre croissance.Ce qui vous attendÀ ce titre, tes principales des recommandations basées sur les données afin de soutenir la prise de décision• Contribuer à la réflexion stratégique relative au développement commercial et à la gestion des portefeuillesSupport aux intermédiaires :• Accompagner les intermédiaires dans l'élaboration de leurs business plans et analyser et challenger les business plans proposés afin d'en assurer la cohérence et la viabilité• auxquels les intermédiaires peuvent prétendre• Apporter un support analytique et opérationnel aux partenaires de distribution• Analyser régulièrement les écarts entre les objectifs, les prévisions et dashboards• Participer à la mise en œuvre technique des challenges commerciaux, campagnes et actions commerciales et supporter les équipes commerciales dans la mesure de l'efficacité de ces campagnes ou évènements• Fournir aux équipes commerciales des analyses leur permettant d'optimiser leur activité et d'atteindre leurs objectifsReporting & audit : • Produire et communiquer aux intermédiaires les données nécessaires à leurs obligations de reporting• Garantir la fiabilité et la cohérence des données communiquées aux intermédiaires• Répondre aux demandes d'informations dans le cadre d'audits internes ou externes• Participer à l'amélioration continue des processus de reporting ainsi qu'à l'automatisation des contrôles et des processus de reportingCe que nous attendons•  Diplôme de niveau Bac +3 à Bac +5 en finance, statistiques, data analytics, économie ou domaine équivalent•  Expérience de 3 à 5 ans dans une fonction de Data Analyst orienté données, contrôle de gestion commercial ou pilotage de la distribution. Une expérience dans le secteur de l'assurance ou des services constitue un atout majeur•  Français et anglais courant. L'allemand et le luxembourgeois sont considérés comme un atout•  Capacité à réaliser des analyses quantitatives et financières•  Excellente maîtrise d'Excel et des outils d'analyse de données•  Expérience dans la création et le suivi de tableaux de bord (Ex : Power BI)•  Bonne compréhension des indicateurs de performance commerciale •  Maîtrise des techniques de reporting et de contrôle de la qualité des données•  Organisation et rigueur•  Esprit d'analyse et de synthèse•  Sens critique et capacité à challenger de manière constructive•  Orientation résultats et orientation client•  Excellentes capacités de communication •  Esprit d'équipe et sens de la collaboration•  Force de proposition et capacité à transformer les données en recommandations opérationnellesÀ propos de Baloise Nous sommes plus qu'une compagnie d'assurance traditionnelle : nous sommes le partenaire personnel de quiconque veut se sentir tout simplement en sécurité. rôle avec nous ?Réception & accueil• Assurer l'accueil physique et téléphonique des collaborateurs, clients, visiteurs et prestataires.• Gérer la boîte mail de la réception et assurer le suivi des demandes.• Veiller au bon fonctionnement de la réception et à la qualité de l'expérience visiteurs.• Assurer la réservation, la préparation et la gestion quotidienne des salles de électroniques.• Assurer le suivi administratif des déclarations et formalités diverses.• Réaliser diverses commandes administratives et assurer le suivi des fournisseurs.Facilities & gestion du bâtiment• Assurer la gestion des fournitures de bureau et le suivi des stocks.• Coordonner les commandes liées à la vie du bureau (eau, consommables, matériel de bureau, imprimantes, etc.).• Superviser les demandes d'intervention, les incidents et les opérations de maintenance du bâtiment.• Assurer le suivi des travaux et des prestataires externes.• Participer à la recherche de nouveaux fournisseurs et au suivi des devis (services de nettoyage, catering, paniers de fruits, etc.).• Assurer le suivi des bornes de recharge et des équipements liés au parking.Onboarding & Offboarding• photographie, postes de travail et accueil.• Assurer la gestion et la traçabilité des badges collaborateurs et visiteurs.• Gérer les départs des collaborateurs : récupération du matériel, désactivation des accès et suivi administratif associé.Organisation & événements• Participer à l'organisation logistique des événements internes et externes.• Assurer le suivi des demandes de devis et la coordination avec les prestataires.• Organiser les déjeuners, réunions et événements d'équipe.Support administratif transversal• Assurer un support administratif aux différentes équipes de l'entreprise.• Être le back-up de certains membres de l'équipe Administrative & Facilities afin de garantir la continuité des activités.• Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des processus administratifs et organisationnels.• Participer, selon les besoins de l'entreprise, aux activités liées à la sécurité et à la gestion du site.Qu'est-ce qui vous rend unique ? • Titulaire d'un Bac +2 minimum dans le domaine administratif, vous justifiez d'une expérience réussie de 3 ans minimum sur un poste similaire.• Vous maîtrisez parfaitement le français et possédez un bon niveau d'anglais vous permettant d'accueillir et d'accompagner des visiteurs internationaux.• Une connaissance de la plateforme MyGuichet constitue un véritable atout.• Une première expérience dans la gestion administrative d'un site ou dans un environnement de services est appréciée.• Vous êtes à l'aise avec les outils informatiques et les applications bureautiques courantes.Compétences et qualités personnelles• Excellent sens du service et de la relation client.• Très bonnes capacités d'organisation et de suivi.• Rigueur et sens des priorités.• Esprit d'équipe et entraide.• Dynamisme et réactivité.• Proactivité et force de proposition pour améliorer les processus existants.• Fiabilité, discrétion et sens des responsabilités.Qu'avons-nous à vous offrir ?• Un salaire basé sur votre expérience et vos réalisations• 29 jours de congés par an (26 + 3 offerts par SD Worx)• Des chèque-repas (13,5 € / jour travaillé, 2,80 € à charge de l'employé)• Un plan de pension d'entreprise• Un jobs.title: Senior toxicologist and risk assessor PhD (m/f/x)
jobs.description: Senior toxicologist and risk assessor PhD (M/F/X) Ref° 200Type de contrat : CDD 1 anLe Laboratoire national de santé (LNS) recherche actuellement un(e) toxicologue pour rejoindre le département de Protection de la santé, dans le cadre d'un contrat à durée déterminée (CDD) à temps plein d'une durée d'un an.Description de l'offre d'emploiA propos du Département Protection de la santéLe Département Protection de la santé du LNS soutient la santé publique et les soins de santé pour les problématiques causées ou aggravées par l'environnement. Nos principaux partenaires sont les hôpitaux, les ministères et les services de santé au travail au Luxembourg.Le Département est composé de deux services :Service de l'Hygiène de l'environnement et de la surveillance biologique humaine (EnvirOH) (laboratoire)Service de l'Expertise médicale et de l'intelligence des données (MEDI)ResponsabilitésNous recherchons un(e) candidat(e) hautement motivé(e), titulaire d'un doctorat (PhD) en toxicologie, en santé environnementale et en évaluation de la sécurité des substances chimiques.La personne retenue travaillera dans le cadre du programme PARC, afin de contribuer à l'évaluation des effets sur la santé et à l'évaluation intégrée des risques, tout en apportant son soutien au Département en qualité de responsable scientifique de projets.Le/la candidat(e) sera directement rattaché(e) au responsable du Département et aura pour principales missions :Participer à différentes activités et réunions dans le cadre de programmes scientifiques internationaux destinés à soutenir l'élaboration des politiques publiques (science-policy), notamment le programme PARC.Contribuer aux activités générales de gestion de projets au sein du Département, notamment dans le cadre des programmes PARC et EIRENE.Assurer la gestion scientifique du projet PARC portant sur l'élaboration de valeurs guides pour la qualité de l'air intérieur fondées sur des critères sanitaires, en collaboration avec différents partenaires européens, afin de garantir sa bonne exécution scientifique, le respect des étapes clés et la remise des livrables, ainsi que la gestion des rapports techniques et des tâches connexes.Élaborer des valeurs guides sanitaires pour les polluants présents dans l'air intérieur, sur la base de données toxicologiques et/ou épidémiologiques.Définir des valeurs guides sanitaires pour le biomonitoring humain (Human Biomonitoring - HBM), sur la base de données toxicologiques et/ou épidémiologiques, notamment dans le cadre de l'évaluation des substances per- et polyfluoroalkylées (PFAS).Collaborer avec des partenaires nationaux et internationaux au sein du réseau PARC.Assurer la diffusion et la valorisation des résultats au moyen de présentations lors de conférences nationales et internationales, de réunions avec les parties prenantes, ainsi que de publications dans des revues scientifiques à comité de lecture.Participer aux réunions de projet et contribuer aux activités de diffusion des résultats ainsi qu'à l'élaboration de rapports pertinents pour l'orientation des politiques publiques.Réaliser des évaluations des risques pour la santé humaine à partir de données de biomonitoring humain et de données relatives à l'exposition aux polluants de l'air intérieur, concernant la population générale et les travailleurs, sur la base des données recueillies dans le contexte national et dans le cadre d'initiatives scientifiques et institutionnelles telles que HBM4EU et PARC.Cette liste de missions n'est pas exhaustive. Les fonctions pourront évoluer en fonction des besoins spécifiques du Département et du programme PARC.ProfilDoctorat (PhD) en toxicologie, sciences de l'environnement, sciences biomédicales, sciences de la vie, biotechnologie ou dans une discipline scientifique connexe.Au moins deux années d'expérience professionnelle pertinente.Expérience avérée en matière de publications scientifiques internationales dans des revues à comité de lecture, dans les domaines de la toxicologie environnementale, professionnelle et/ou médicale.Expérience dans l'évaluation des risques pour la santé humaine dans un contexte réglementaire, notamment en matière de caractérisation des dangers et de détermination de valeurs de référence sanitaires.Expérience dans l'évaluation des risques chimiques et de l'exposition aux substances chimiques sur la base de données de surveillance, y compris les données de biomonitoring humain.Expérience confirmée en matière de mise en réseau et de capacité à obtenir des résultats au sein de grands consortiums internationaux.Expérience en gestion de projets et en collaboration au sein de consortiums internationaux.Excellentes compétences en communication et en pédagogie.Solides capacités organisationnelles et analytiques, ainsi qu'une méthode de travail structurée.Capacité à travailler de manière autonome tout en contribuant efficacement au sein d'équipes pluridisciplinaires.Capacité à recueillir et à synthétiser les informations nécessaires dans le cadre des activités professionnelles, afin d'assurer le reporting et les échanges avec la direction ainsi qu'avec les services de soutien.Maîtrise professionnelle complète de l'anglais, à l'oral comme à l'écrit, exigée. Une bonne maîtrise du français et/ou de l'allemand, à l'oral comme à l'écrit, constitue un atoutComment postuler ?Si vous correspondez au profil ci-dessus et que vous souhaitez postuler, veuillez soumettre votre candidature (CV et lettre de motivation) via notre site web. Votre candidature sera traitée de manière confidentielle.Lors des dernières étapes du processus de recrutement, le candidat retenu sera invité à fournir des documents justificatifs tels que des copies des diplômes et des certificats de travail. Un extrait de casier judiciaire officiel (bulletin n° 3 ainsi que le bulletin n° 4 pour les postes de chauffeur) sera également demandé à des fins de consultation.

jobs.title: SENIOR SCIENTIST IN AGENTIC AI FOR ENVIRONMENTAL DIGITAL TWINS (m/f)
jobs.employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
jobs.description: Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact. Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/ How will you contribute? LIST is looking for an experienced Senior Scientist to strengthen its capabilities in agentic artificial intelligence for geospatial and environmental applications, with a particular focus on large language models (LLMs), scientific workflow orchestration and space-enabled environmental digital twins. The successful candidate will join the Remote Sensing and Natural Resources Modelling (REMOTE) group, an interdisciplinary team combining Earth Observation (EO), environmental modelling, AI, data assimilation and terrestrial/non-terrestrial communication networks. Our ambition is to turn cutting-edge AI and space-enabled technologies into solutions for disaster risk reduction, resilient agri-food systems, terrestrial ecosystem resilience, civil security and humanitarian action. The new colleague will contribute to ongoing RDI projects while progressively developing new methodologies, collaborations and research directions with the group's scientists. Building on REMOTE's established expertise in AI for Earth Observation, multimodal satellite-data analysis and environmental modelling, the successful candidate will bring complementary expertise in the design of reliable LLM-based agentic systems that can reason across EO datasets, scientific knowledge, models and services; plan and execute scientific workflows; verify results; and communicate uncertainties and findings transparently. Experience with vision-language models (VLMs) and geospatial foundation models would further strengthen multimodal and spatial reasoning. A central objective is to enable users to interact more intuitively with environmental digital twins: formulate questions in natural language, identify suitable observations and models, configure and run simulations, compare alternative scenarios, and receive scientifically grounded, interpretable answers. Illustrative “what-if” questions include:• Flood risk: How would altered precipitation patterns or proposed flood-protection measures affect inundation extent, water depth and the exposure of buildings in urban catchments? An agentic workflow could combine historical and near-real-time satellite observations, hydrological and hydraulic models, and alternative climate or adaptation scenarios to compare risk-reduction options.• Agriculture: How might prolonged drought, altered irrigation practices or a warmer growing season affect crop water stress and yield at field or regional scale? A digital twin could couple EO-derived soil moisture, crop water stress, land surface temperature and evapotranspiration with crop models, AI and data assimilation to compare management options. These examples illustrate the approach rather than prescribe a narrow project portfolio. The role is cross-cutting: the selected scientist will work with domain experts, build on existing digital twin activities in urban, coastal and agricultural systems, and explore synergies with distributed sensing, IoT and satellite-enabled connectivity. Awareness of the European digital-twin and data-space ecosystem will help position developments for interoperability and collaboration. Relevant initiatives include Destination Earth (DestinE), ESA Digital Twin Earth and EO Digital Twin Components, as well as EU-funded ecosystem and biodiversity digital-twin projects such as TerraTwin and BioDT. Complementary initiatives, including the European Green Deal Data Space and the Common European Agricultural Data Space, provide a framework for interoperable and trusted data sharing across stakeholders. jobs.title: Associate Professor or Assistant Professor in Anatomy (m/f)
jobs.description: Associate Professor or Assistant Professor in Anatomy(Valid from 06/11/2026 to 23/04/2027) Language: English (UK)Location Esch-sur-AlzetteCountry: Luxembourg Organisation data: Department of Health, Medicine and Life SciencesJob Number: UOL08595Contract Type: Professorial - PermanentSchedule Type: Full TimeWork Hours 40.0 Hours per WeekExpected Start Date: 01/10/2027 Job (internal): Assistant ProfessorJob Level: MonolevelRole Type: Open PositionExpertise: ProfessorsFunctions: Associate / Assistant Professor Position: 50024306 About usThe University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.The Faculty of Science, Technology and Medicine (FSTM) at the University of Luxembourg contributes multidisciplinary expertise in the fields of Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences and Medicine.Through its dual mission of teaching and research, the FSTM seeks to generate and disseminate knowledge and train new generations of responsible citizens in order to better understand, explain and advance society and the environment we live in. Within the FSTM, the Department of Health, Medicine and Life Sciences (DHML) coordinates all teaching programmes in life in sciences, medicine, nursing, radiology and midwifery. The department's research combines basic and translational, molecular and computational approaches, with a particular focus on cancer biology, while also encompassing clinical research in human health and disease.The DHML cooperates with the national health care centers and leading international biomedical research institutions. As medicine and health are strategic priorities for the University of Luxembourg, the department is actively expanding its education and research activities in these fields, providing exceptional opportunities for medical and biomedical initiatives. Your roleThe successful candidate will coordinate anatomy teaching within the University's Bachelor of Medicine programme and contribute to teaching in other health and life sciences programmes. Working closely with colleagues across the University, they will contribute to an integrated and cohesive learning experience for students and to the continued development of the University's anatomy curriculum.The position offers a unique opportunity to collaborate with local and international partners in developing and implementing innovative, state-of-the-art approaches to anatomy education. These may include virtual dissection tools, 3D anatomical models, such as Anatomage® and virtual anatomy platforms, and other digital learning resources, to provide students with comprehensive and engaging learning opportunities.The recruited candidate will have access to state-of-the-art infrastructures within the university, including a simulation unit equipped with an anatomy suite. They will also be responsible for coordinating dissection courses and practical anatomy sessions, including the procurement of virtual tools and teaching specimens, in collaboration with medical institutions and partner universities. Research portfolio: the candidate has an internationally recognised research profile and is expected to develop ambitious research activities in line with the strategic priorities of the university. The latter include cancer research, neurosciences, data-driven health sciences, digital biology, and medicine.The ideal candidate has a medical background with relevant clinical experience and a commitment to integrating clinical perspectives and applications into anatomy education to enhance the practical, real world application aspect of anatomy courses. The possibility of a clinical activity will be decided on a case-by-case decision. Non-medical profiles with a strong affinity and expertise in anatomy will be considered as well. For further information about the role, please contact: Prof. Pascal Stammet, Study Programme Director of the Bachelor of Medicine, Email: pascal.stammet@uni.luYour profile• PhD in a medicine related field and/or MD diploma• Experience in the teaching of human anatomy, ideally in a variety of curricula in medicine, life sciences and for health care professions at undergraduate and graduate levels• Commitment to interdisciplinary and innovative teaching that integrates anatomy with histology and embryology• Experience or familiarity with modern teaching tools such as virtual dissection platforms, 3D modelling, and other digital resources• Solid track record in clinical and/or biomedical research within a related domain• Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with the ability to build and foster academic partnerships, particularly with existing collaborators at partner universities and institutions• Physician candidates should have clinical/medical activity Language requirements:The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired on this position must have an excellent command of English and either French or German. The University encourages its staff to learn the other language and provides access to language courses to this end. We offer• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs How to applyApplications should contain:• Cover letter, to be addressed to to Serge Haan, Head of DHML• CV, including any periods of absence from work such as family-related leave and career breaks.• Short description of profile, key achievements and impact, summarizing main publications, projects, teaching expertise and accomplishments in knowledge transfer relevant to this role (1-3 pages).• Statement of planned research, teaching and other activities at the University of Luxembourg (1–3 pages).• Lists of publications, research projects, PhD theses supervised and subjects taught.• Names, contact information and current position of 3 referees who can, upon request, provide an assessment of the application. Please indicate their relationship to you.We encourage early application. Applications are only accepted online through the HR system. The position will be unposted on 06.01.2027, after which no further applications can be submitted. Applications will be handled in strict confidence.General Information: • Reference: UOL08595 (to be mentioned in all correspondence)• Publication date: -• Contract Type: Professorial - Permanent . This position is offered at the Assistant Professor or Associate Professor level, depending on qualification. Both positions are tenured.• Working Hours: Full Time 40.0 Hours per Week• Location: Belval Campus• Planned starting date: 01/10/2027 or as soon as possible thereafterDiversity and gender equality:The University of Luxembourg embraces inclusion, diversity and gender equality as essential for academic excellence. We are fully committed to removing discriminatory barriers in recruitment and career progression and to advance gender balance among academic staff. Should candidates present equivalent CVs, preference will be given to female candidates in all departments where gender parity is not yet achieved.

jobs.description: Description de tâches:Planning Digitalization Project ManagerAbout RotarexSince 1922, Rotarex has been a global leader in cylinder valves, pressure regulators and equipment for all gas applications. Rotarex is a trusted partner across a wide range of industries, including semiconductors, medical, research, automotive, food processing, fire protection, butane/propane and many others.With nearly 2,000 highly motivated and qualified employees across a global network, Rotarex works every day to meet the needs of its customers and industries. offer a modern, innovative and comfortable working environment for our employees.Your missionAs Planning Digitalization Project Manager, you will lead cross-functional projects and improvement initiatives across Planning and Material Management, with a focus on digitalization, automation, inventory optimization and Supply Chain performance.You will coordinate stakeholders across functions and sites, manage projects from definition through implementation, and support the Head of Planning & Material Management on transversal topics, operational priorities and departmental improvement initiatives.Your missions will include the following:Project Management & Digital Transformation• Lead cross-functional Planning projects from definition to implementation, ensuring scope, milestones, Chain processes, identify performance gaps and define pragmatic improvement roadmaps based on business priorities• Define project KPIs, quantify expected benefits and monitor delivery of improvements in service, lead time, inventory, productivity and process reliability• Prepare business cases, project reviews, management presentations and decision-support analyses for Supply Chain initiatives• Coordinate project stakeholders across functions and sites, ensuring clear governance, communication, escalation and decision-makingDigitalization, Automation & Artificial Intelligence• Identify, assess and implement automation opportunities for repetitive and non-value-added activities, using conventional digital solutions and Artificial Intelligence where relevant• Support the deployment, optimization and adoption of Supply Chain systems and digital tools, with a strong focus on SAP-based planning and material management processesPlanning & Inventory Management• Lead projects related to inventory and stock management, including segmentation, inventory policies, parameter optimization, stock reduction and service-level improvement• Support standardization and harmonization of Planning and Material Management processes, methods and best practices across the organization Stakeholder Coordination & Department Support• Act as a key support to the Head of Planning & Material Management for transversal topics, operational priorities and department improvement initiatives• Support the coordination of the Planning & Material Management team when required, including follow-up of priorities, actions and complex operational issues• When formally delegated, represent the Head of Planning & Material Management in operational meetings, coordinate priorities and ensure continuity of day-to-day management activities during absences• Progressively develop the capability to represent the department and ensure management continuity during the absence of the Head of Planning & Material Management, within the defined delegation framework• Own assigned Supply Chain projects and improvement initiatives from project definition through implementation and stabilizationYour profileProject Management & Supply Chain• Strong project management capabilities, from project framing and business case definition through implementation, change management and benefit tracking• Strong understanding of end-to-end Supply Chain processes, with particular knowledge of production planning, material management, procurement, inventory and manufacturing interfaces• Strong understanding of inventory management principles, including segmentation, safety stock / buffer strategies, inventory optimization and service-level trade-offs• Ability to analyze complex Excellent organizational and project coordination skills• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities• Proactive, pragmatic interest in digitalization, automation and Artificial Intelligence• Ability to adapt communication from operational teams to senior management• High level of autonomy, reliability and confidentialityProfessional Experience• Significant experience in Supply Chain, operations, project management or continuous improvement within a manufacturing environment• Proven experience in jobs.title: Senior Relationship Manager / Developer - New Resident Desk (m/f)
jobs.description: Senior Relationship Manager / Developer - New Resident Desk (M/F)Luxembourgreq1196BIL is a leading player in Luxembourg's financial market. Founded in 1856 as the country's first bank, BIL has contributed significantly to the development of Luxembourg's social and economic landscape. It is an opportunity to help build and shape a growing business, expand BIL's reach within Luxembourg's international community and directly contribute to the growth of our Wealth Management franchise.Your next challenge:• Develop new relationships with international private clients, entrepreneurs, executives and business owners relocating to Luxembourg.• Building strong relationships with relocation firms, tax advisers, lawyers, real estate professionals, financial intermediaries and other centres of influence.• Identifying new business opportunities and maintaining an active and sustainable client development pipeline.• Building long-term relationships based on trust and a strong understanding of clients' financial and wealth management needs.• Supporting clients through the key financial decisions associated with relocating to Luxembourg.• Delivering tailored wealth management solutions across investments, wealth planning, life insurance, financing and succession planning.• Working closely with investment specialists, wealth planners, credit experts and other business lines to provide clients with a comprehensive service.• Take part in organizing and representing BIL at relevant client events, networking initiatives, seminars and industry gatherings to strengthen our network and develop new business opportunities.• Contributing to the continued development of the New Resident Desk and helping shape its future growth strategy.• Ensuring disciplined follow-up of prospects, opportunities and commercial activities through the Bank's CRM tools.Your skills: • You have at least 7–10 years of professional experience in banking, including significant experience developing relationships with high-net-worth private clients.• You have a strong network of private clients, entrepreneurs and financial intermediaries, ideally within Luxembourg's international community.• You have excellent knowledge of the products and services relevant to private clients and financial intermediaries in Luxembourg, including investments, life insurance, wealth planning solutions and credit financing.• You demonstrate strong commercial drive, an entrepreneurial mindset and a genuine ability to develop and grow a business.• You have a proven ability to build long-term relationships and generate new business opportunities.• You hold a university degree in finance, economics or a related field.• You are highly client- and results-oriented, with a rigorous, organised and methodical approach to business development and client relationship management.• You enjoy working as part of a team in a dynamic and evolving environment and are motivated to contribute to its success.For this position, we are particularly interested in candidates with strong connections to Nordic and international English-speaking communities.Fluency in English is essential. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience. BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all. Other documents will be collected, to the extent legally permitted, to perform background checks.

conduire de la catégorie B (la possession du permis de conduire de la catégorie C et du Code 95 pourra constituer un avantage).• Avoir accompli une formation de base dans un service d'incendie ou sauvetage pourra constituer un avantage.Préférence pourra être donnée à un candidat pouvant se prévaloir d'une expérience professionnelle pratique dans l'entretien des bâtiments et alentours.Missions :• Être responsable de l'entretien, de la maintenance et des dépannages de tous les bâtiments communaux ;• Contrôler et inspecter les équipements de sécurité (extincteurs, trousses de premiers secours, défibrillateurs, détecteurs de fumée) et observer les exercices d'évacuation ;• Vérifier les serrures, ainsi que les batteries et le bon fonctionnement des systèmes d'accès (p.ex. système « Salto ») ;• Relevé des compteurs d'énergies ;• Assurer le suivi et la surveillance des systèmes d'alarme anti-intrusion, des alarmes d'incendie (BMA) et des détecteurs de fumée;• Être disponible à intervenir en cas de déclenchement des systèmes d'alarme dans un des bâtiments communaux.• Organiser et accompagner les contrôles réglementaires de sécurité (p.ex. jobs.description: Die Stadtverwaltung Grevenmacher stellt für das städtische Freibad einen Arbeitsnehmer (m/w/d) mit manueller Tätigkeit im Beruf „instructeur de natation“ mit CATP / DAP ein.Arbeitsvertrag: unbefristet.Beschäftigungsgrad: 100%.Einstellung: ab März 2027Einstellungsbedingungen:–      Staatsangehöriger eines Mitgliedstaates der EU;–      Sprachkenntnisse in Luxemburgisch, Deutsch und Französisch;–      Besitz der zivilen und politischen Rechte;–      Führerschein der Klasse B;–      CATP / DAP im Beruf „instructeur de natation“ (oder ein vom Ministerium für Erziehung und Berufsausbildung als gleichwertig anerkanntes ausländisches Diplom)Der Kandidat muss im Besitz eines Meisterbriefes als geprüfter Meister für Bäderbetriebe sein. Aufgaben:–      Überwachung der Schwimmbecken;–      Kontrolle und Wartung aller sich im Freibad befindlichen technischen Anlagen;–      Außerhalb der Freibadsaison hat der Arbeitnehmer jede ihm übertragene aufgetragene Arbeit zu verrichten, seinen Kräften und Fähigkeiten entsprechende andere Aufgaben anzunehmen und diese gewissenhaft und ordnungsgemäß auszuführen, auch wenn diese nicht in seinen direkten Arbeitsbereich fallen.Der Schöffenrat hat das Recht, den Arbeitsnehmer je nach den Erfordernissen der Verwaltung in jeder Abteilung der Stadt Grevenmacher einzusetzen.Während der Freibadsaison sind die täglichen und wöchentlichen Arbeitszeiten mittels eines vom Schöffenkollegium aufgestellten Dienstplans geregelt. Des Weiteren wird Urlaubsanträgen während der Freibadsaison nur in Ausnahmefällen stattgegeben.Außerhalb der Freibadsaison sind die Arbeitszeiten von 7.00 Uhr bis 12.00 Uhr und von 13.00 Uhr bis 16.00 Uhr.Beizufügende Unterlagen:–      Bewerbungsschreiben;–      Ausführlicher Lebenslauf mit Foto;–      Kopie des CATP / DAP- Diploms / des Meisterbriefes;–      Geburtsurkunde (nicht älter als 2 Monate);–      Auszug aus dem Strafregister (nicht älter als 2 Monate)–      Passfoto–      Kopie eines Ausweisdokumentes;–      Kopie des Führerscheins.Unvollständige Bewerbungen werden nicht berücksichtigt Beschäftigungsbedingungen und Vergütung:Spätestens bei Dienstantritt muss der Kandidat die für die Ausübung seines Amtes erforderliche körperliche Eignung nachweisen. Die körperliche Eignung wird vom Arbeitsarzt auf Antrag der Gemeindeverwaltung festgestellt.Die Feststellung der körperlichen Untauglichkeit durch den Arbeitsarzt, auch nachdem der betreffende Arbeitnehmer seine Arbeit aufgenommen hat, führt zur Auflösung des Arbeitsvertrags.Die Einstellung erfolgt durch Unterzeichnung eines unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrages nach den Bestimmungen des Kollektivvertrages der Stadt Grevenmacher.Die ersten drei Monate ab dem Datum des Dienstantritts gelten als Probezeit.Der Arbeitnehmer wird in die ME-Laufbahn (Gehaltsgruppen 6, 7 und 8) des Kollektivvertrags für die Angestellten der Stadt Grevenmacher eingestuft.Die ersten zwei Jahre ab dem Datum der Einstellung sind grundsätzlich eine Einarbeitungszeit und werden auf der Grundlage der ersten Stufe der ME-Laufbahn (147 Indexpunkte – 3.684,87.-€, bezahlt).Nach einer positiven Beurteilung am Ende der Einarbeitungszeit wird die endgültige Laufbahn des Beschäftigten unter Berücksichtigung der Vordienstzeit festgelegt.Je nach Berufserfahrung kann der Schöffenrat beschließen, die Einarbeitungszeit zu verkürzen oder ganz darauf zu verzichten.Der Arbeitnehmer hat Anspruch auf eine Kompensationsprämie (13 Indexpunkte – 325,87.-€), eine Essenszulage (11 Indexpunkte – 275,74.-€) und Kleidergeld (2 Indexpunkte – 50,13.-€). Gegebenenfalls erhält der Arbeitnehmer eine Familienzulage von 29 Indexpunkten – 726,95.-€.Das Gehalt wird zu Beginn des Folgemonats gezahlt, für den das Gehalt fällig ist, spätestens jedoch am 5. des Monats.Eine Jahresendzulage wird zusammen mit dem Dezembergehalt gezahlt.Verschiedenes:Der Arbeitnehmer wird bei der Caisse Nationale de Santé und der Caisse Nationale d'Assurance Pension angemeldet.Die Kandidaten werden gebeten Ihre Bewerbung bis spätestens Dienstag, den 1. Dezember 2026 über die Plattform „Skeeled“ (www.grevenmacher.lu – Veröffentlichungen – Jobs) einzureichen. Die Personalabteilung steht Ihnen für weitere Auskünfte gerne zur Verfügung:Tel.: 75 03 11 -2021 (Frau Steffen) oder -2031 (Herr Lanser)E-Mail: personnel@grevenmacher.lu

jobs.title: Directeur Général Adjoint (h/f/d)
jobs.description: Directeur Général Adjoint (H/F/D) CDI - Temps plein - Luxembourg (Strassen) Réf. : AeS/DGA Rejoignez l'Agence eSanté L'Agence eSanté, agence nationale des informations partagées dans le domaine de la santé, joue un rôle central dans la transformation numérique du système de santé luxembourgeois. Elle développe et opère les services qui permettent aux patients et aux professionnels de santé d'échanger et de partager les données de santé en toute sécurité : dossier de soins partagé, réseau sécurisé HealthNet, annuaires nationaux des patients et des professionnels, carnet de vaccination électronique, messagerie sécurisée, échanges transfrontaliers de données de santé, entre autres. Les années à venir sont décisives : la mise en oeuvre du règlement européen sur l'Espace européen des données de santé (EHDS) et le développement de la nouvelle génération du dossier de soins partagé s'accompagnent d'une forte croissance de l'Agence et de ses effectifs. L'Agence eSanté recrute un(e) Directeur Général Adjoint. Directement rattaché(e) au Directeur Général et membre du Comité de Direction, vous contribuez au pilotage et au développement de l'Agence. Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les autres membres de la Direction, les différentes fonctions de l'Agence et ses instances de gouvernance, notamment le Président du Conseil de gérance. Votre mission En tant que Directeur Général Adjoint, vous accompagnez le Directeur Général dans la direction, le pilotage et le développement de l'Agence et contribuez à la mise en oeuvre de ses orientations stratégiques. Membre du Comité de Direction, vous participez à la gouvernance de l'Agence, préparez les décisions et arbitrages et accompagnez les transformations organisationnelles nécessaires à son développement. Vous pilotez les fonctions support de l'Agence (ressources humaines, finances, secrétariat, qualité et organisation, juridique, conformité, marchés publics, formation et formation continue, contrats ainsi que communication), veillez à la performance et à la cohérence des dispositifs transverses et représentez l'Agence dans le cadre des délégations qui vous sont confiées. Vos principales responsabilités • Contribuer à la mise en oeuvre des orientations stratégiques et au développement de l'Agence, en accompagnant le Directeur Général dans la définition des priorités et leur déclinaison opérationnelle, • Participer à la gouvernance de l'Agence, conseiller le Directeur Général, préparer les décisions et arbitrages soumis aux instances compétentes et veiller au suivi de leur mise en oeuvre, • Assurer le secrétariat du Conseil de gérance et de l'Assemblée générale : préparation des séances et des dossiers, rédaction des procès-verbaux et relevés de décisions, suivi de l'exécution des décisions, • Superviser les programmes et projets de transformation organisationnelle conduits pour le compte du Comité de Direction, en veillant à leur avancement, à leurs moyens et à la préparation des décisions nécessaires, • Piloter les fonctions placées sous votre responsabilité, garantir la cohérence de leurs activités et veiller à la disponibilité et à l'utilisation optimale des ressources de l'Agence, • Contribuer aux orientations budgétaires et financières et piloter la préparation, l'exécution et le suivi budgétaire annuel et pluriannuel dans le cadre des responsabilités déléguées, • Veiller à la cohérence des politiques, processus et dispositifs de gouvernance interne et superviser les dispositifs de contrôle et de conformité relevant de votre périmètre, dans le respect des responsabilités et de l'indépendance des fonctions compétentes, • Piloter la performance et la maîtrise des risques relevant de votre périmètre, en coordonnant les démarches d'audit, de certification et d'amélioration continue avec les fonctions compétentes, • Favoriser la coopération entre les fonctions et contribuer, aux côtés du Directeur Général, à la préparation et à la conduite du dialogue social, • Manager et développer les responsables placés sous votre autorité, renforcer leurs compétences managériales et promouvoir une culture de responsabilité, de coopération et de remontée précoce des difficultés, • Représenter l'Agence auprès des autorités et partenaires institutionnels dans le cadre de vos délégations et assurer la suppléance du Directeur Général conformément aux dispositions applicables. Votre profil Vous êtes titulaire d'une formation supérieure de niveau Master ou équivalent en management, administration publique, économie, gestion, finances, droit, politiques publiques, ingénierie, gouvernance des organisations ou dans un domaine équivalent. Vous justifiez : • d'au moins 10 années d'expérience dans des fonctions de direction, de management senior ou de pilotage de fonctions support, • d'une expérience confirmée dans le management de managers et le pilotage de plusieurs fonctions support ou domaines de responsabilité transverses, • d'une expérience solide en gouvernance organisationnelle, en conseil à une Direction Générale et en préparation de décisions stratégiques, • d'une expérience dans le pilotage budgétaire et financier, la conduite de transformations organisationnelles et les relations avec des autorités ou partenaires institutionnels. Une expérience dans le secteur public, parapublic, de la santé ou dans un environnement fortement réglementé constitue un atout. Une bonne connaissance du secteur de la santé, de ses acteurs et de son environnement institutionnel et réglementaire, ou la capacité à l'acquérir rapidement, constitue également un atout. Compétences recherchées • Solide maîtrise des principes de gouvernance, des processus décisionnels et du pilotage stratégique d'une organisation, • Expérience confirmée dans la direction et la coordination de fonctions pluridisciplinaires et dans la gestion des ressources humaines, financières et organisationnelles, • Bonne maîtrise de la gestion budgétaire et financière, des marchés publics nationaux et européens, de la gestion contractuelle et des enjeux juridiques et réglementaires, • Maîtrise des dispositifs de pilotage de la performance, de contrôle interne, de gestion des risques et de conformité, • Capacité à conduire des transformations organisationnelles, à faire évoluer les processus et à accompagner le changement, • Leadership confirmé dans le management de managers, le développement des compétences et la mobilisation d'équipes pluridisciplinaires, • Bonne compréhension des environnements institutionnels et capacité à conseiller la Direction Générale, à préparer des arbitrages complexes et à représenter l'organisation auprès d'interlocuteurs de haut niveau, • Pratique avancée des outils numériques et de l'IA générative pour accroître votre efficacité et celle de vos équipes, dans le respect des exigences de sécurité et de confidentialité. Qualités personnelles • Leadership, sens des responsabilités et capacité à fédérer autour d'objectifs communs, • Vision stratégique, esprit d'analyse et capacité à prendre du recul, • Courage décisionnel, indépendance de jugement et capacité à assumer les arbitrages, • Diplomatie, sens de l'écoute et capacité à développer des relations de confiance, • Pragmatisme, orientation résultats et capacité à agir dans des situations complexes ou sensibles, • Exemplarité, intégrité, loyauté institutionnelle et engagement au service de l'intérêt général. Langues • Luxembourgeois : niveau C1 minimum, • Français : niveau C1 minimum, • Anglais : niveau C1 minimum, • Allemand : niveau B1 minimum. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Rejoindre l'Agence eSanté, c'est contribuer à la transformation numérique du système de santé luxembourgeois et participer au développement d'une organisation investie d'une mission d'intérêt général. jobs.title: Kreftsykepleier i hjemmebaserte tjenester
jobs.employer: BÆRUM KOMMUNE HJEMMEBASERTE TJENESTER BEKKESTUA DISTRIKT AVD STABEKK
jobs.description:
Kan du tenke deg en meningsfull jobb hvor du gjør en forskjell for mennesker i en sårbar livssituasjon?

Med hjemmet som førstevalg skal vi sikre at flere innbyggere opplever trygghet og mestring i eget hjem. Det handler om å gi innbyggere støtte, tjenester og veiledning slik at de kan bo trygt hjemme, mestre hverdagen og opprettholde best mulig helse og selvstendighet.

To av våre kreftsykepleiere gjennomfører master i kreftsykepleie. I den forbindelse har vi behov for en vikar i 100% stilling i perioden januar til og med juni 2027. Senere oppstart, og kortere engasjement er mulig. 

Teamet består av kreftsykepleiere og palliativ sykepleier, med ansvar for oppfølging av kreftpasienter i hjemmet i samarbeid med hjemmesykepleien. Hovedfokus er kartlegging, forebygging og lindring av fysiske og psykiske symptomer, koordinering av tjenester, omsorg ved livets slutt samt ivaretakelse av pårørende. Dette innebærer tett samarbeid med andre helseinstanser, sykehus, fastlege og kreftkoordinator.

 Arbeidstiden er dagtid mandag til fredag med fleksitid.

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Fysisk eller digital oppfølging av kreftpasienter i hjemmet
  • Tilrettelegge tverrfaglige tjenester sammen med pasienten for å sikre ivaretakelse av brukermedvirkning
  • Forebygge og lindre plagsomme symptomer ut ifra fysisk, psykisk, sosial, åndelig og eksistensielle behov frem til livets slutt
  • Utøve etisk forsvarlig sykepleie med vekt på den sykes selvbestemmelse og integritet slik at de opplever trygghet og verdighet
  • Ivareta de pårørendes behov for støtte, omsorg og veiledning og tilby etterlattesamtaler
  • Delta på fagmøter og rapporter hvor kreftpasienten er i fokus 
  • Jobbe med fagutvikling og økt samarbeid mellom de ulike nivåene i kreftomsorgen
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Onkologisk sykepleier eller sykepleier med videreutdanning i palliasjon (HPR-nummer registreres i CV)
  • Søkere fra land utenfor Skandinavia må ha bestått norsk på minimum nivå B2, skriftlig og muntlig
  • Krav til førerkort klasse B
Personlige egenskaper
  • Du trives i tverrfaglig samarbeid, og gjør gode vurderinger i faglige utfordringer
  • God evne til koordinering og samhandling i tverrfaglig samarbeid
  • Empatisk og en god relasjonsbygger
  • God bidragsyter til et godt arbeidsmiljø både kollegialt og faglig
  • Evner å jobbe selvstendig
  • Har kjennskap til digitale løsninger

Personlig egnethet vektlegges

Vi tilbyr
  • En meningsfull jobb hvor du gjør en forskjell for mennesker i en sårbar livssituasjon
  • Et sterkt fagmiljø med engasjerte kollegaer som vil dele av sin erfaring og kompetanse
  • En meningsfull jobb som du kan være stolt av
  • Offentlig tjenestepensjon
Gyldig politiattest iht. helse- og omsorgstjenesteloven § 5-4 må fremlegges før tiltredelseKontaktinformasjonEmilie Vestgren, Tjenesteleder, 48270248 ArbeidsstedRingstabekkveien 105 1356 Bekkestua Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Bærum kommune Referansenr.: 5212927187 Stillingsprosent: 100% Vikariat Startdato: 04.01.2027 Sluttdato: 25.06.2027 Søknadsfrist: 09.12.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sammen skaper vi et godt og inkluderende samfunn for over 130 000 innbyggere, både i dag og i årene som kommer. Vi skaper rammer som bidrar til at de aller minste kan leke og lære og at de som trenger en hjelpende hånd får en hverdag preget av mestring, mening og verdighet. Vi gjør et bredt spekter av arbeidsoppgaver, og felles for oss alle er at vi får tillit og myndighet til å påvirke vår egen arbeidshverdag for å skape et samfunn som er godt å leve i. Hos oss kan du bli med og sette spor. 

 

Etter søknadsfristens utløp vil det utarbeides offentlig søkerliste. Ber du om å bli unntatt fra denne listen, må det grunngis i søknadsportalen. Begrunnelsen vil bli vurdert i forhold til offentlighetsloven § 25, jfr §11. Hvis ditt ønske ikke imøtekommes, vil du få mulighet til å trekke søknaden før offentliggjøring.

 

Før ansettelse i Bærum kommune skal identitet dokumenteres og oppholdstillatelse være gyldig.

jobs.description: Permanent contract | BelvauxAre you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact. Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/ How will you contribute?This position is for a scientist to contribute to the core mission of the Catchment and Eco-hydrology group within the Environmental Modelling and Sensing unit. Research will investigate processes controlling behavior of Earth's Critical Zone, with an emphasis on understanding dependencies and feedbacks between the hydrologic cycle and ecosystems. We seek a scientist dedicated to integrating novel empirical observations and theory to answer questions motivated by pressing societal needs related to natural resources, and relevant to both the global scientific community and applied practitioners who manage those natural resources. The successful candidate will be a key member of an interdisciplinary and collaborative research group. The successful candidate is expected to develop an internationally recognized research program in ecohydrology, specifically in one of the following research areas:1. Tracers of eco-hydrologic processes. Research developing and applying innovative tracer approaches to understand water dynamics and associated biogeochemical processes across the soil–plant–atmosphere continuum. Building on existing strengths and infrastructure in the group, particular interest lies in stable isotope approaches that integrate environmental and eco-hydrological information using hydrological, plant physiological, or biogeochemical measurements.2. Small-catchment eco-hydrology. Research investigating interactions among vegetation, water dynamics, and biogeochemical processes, especially in forested headwater catchments. Particular interests include plant and ecosystem responses to hydrological extremes such as droughts and floods; thresholds and tipping points in vegetation and catchment functioning; and ecohydrological controls on the cycling and transport of carbon, plant nutrients, and pollutants.  Is Your profile described below? jobs.description: Company description:.Job description:          What you will do?   As Senior Sales Manager BESS – Germany & Central Europe, you will drive our growth by developing the German market, converting complex opportunities and building long-term customer and partner relationships. Reporting to the Head of Sales EU & International, you will work closely with Volvo Energy’s commercial and technical teams to: •    Build and convert the BESS pipeline in Germany, with responsibility for selected Central European markets.•    Execute account and market plans, delivering sales volume, profitability and pipeline-quality targets.•    Commercialize BESS solutions and services for Commercial & Industrial, EV charging and selected utility-scale applications.•    Take direct responsibility for originating, developing and closing complex BESS sales, from initial customer engagement through tendering, negotiation, contracting and delivery handover.•    Coordinate internal specialists and external partners to create competitive customer solutions.•    Shape customer offerings, business models, pricing, financing options, partnerships and commercial agreements.•    Build senior relationships with customers, developers, utilities and channel partners across the region.   Your future team Join a close-knit, international team building a new business within Volvo Group. We combine the pace, ownership and entrepreneurial mindset of a start-up with the reach, expertise and stability of a global organization. You will work across sales, sales engineering, product, operations, finance and legal in a culture of collaboration, trust, accountability and initiative.   This is how you day will look like as Senior Sales Manager BESS A typical day focuses on visiting customers, understanding their needs and challenges, and using your market knowledge and experience to identify opportunities and create value. You’ll discuss proposals, develop solutions together, and lead negotiations through to signed agreements. Alongside your customer work, you’ll help shape the business direction and bring colleagues together to turn ideas into action.        Who are you?   You are a commercially driven BESS professional who builds markets and trusted customer relationships, taking ownership from first contact to signed contract. You bring:  •    A proven track record of originating, developing and closing BESS sales or project opportunities in Commercial & Industrial, EV charging or utility-scale applications.•    Strong commercial understanding of BESS, supported by technical knowledge of grid connection, electrical infrastructure, system design, project development and contracting.•    Experience with German or DACH energy-market customers and procurement processes, including RFIs, RFQs, RFPs, tenders, negotiations and contract award.•    Understanding of BESS business models and value streams, including ancillary services, energy arbitrage, peak shaving, flexibility and revenue stacking.•    Professional fluency in German and English, with the ability to lead commercial and technical discussions in both languages.•    A relevant university degree—or equivalent professional experience—in energy, engineering, business or commercial management.•    Strong commercial judgement, drive and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to manage several opportunities and travel regularly within Germany and Central Europe.     What’s in it for you?   Help shape sustainable energy solutions while developing your career in an international environment. We offer:   •    An attractive package with fixed salary and performance-related variable compensation.•    A company car under the applicable company car policy.•    Mobile working in line with company policy and business requirements.•    Autonomy to shape our BESS business in Germany and Central Europe.•    International collaboration and development opportunities across Volvo Group.   Location and working model: Based at Volvo Group Trucks Central Europe GmbH in Ismaning, near Munich, with mobile working in line with company policy and business requirements.       Ready for the next move?   Ready to help shape Volvo Energy’s BESS business in Germany and Central Europe? We would be pleased to hear from you.We value diverse perspectives and encourage you to apply if you are motivated by creating customer value and contributing to the energy transition—even if your experience does not cover every area listed.    Feel free to contact me if you have further questions    Hiring Manager: Belén Neira, Head of Sales EU & International  Preferred start date: January 2027Application deadline: 3 December 2026   We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.   As part of the recruitment process, a background check as well as alcohol and drug testing may be conducted. You will be informed if applicable.    We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.
