jobs.title: Eventansvarlig
jobs.description:
Vil du skape opplevelser som gjestene snakker om lenge etter at de har reist hjem?

SkiStar Trysil er Norges største skidestinasjon og en ledende helårsdestinasjon for aktive opplevelser. Gjennom hele året skaper vi arrangementer, aktiviteter og møteplasser som bidrar til å gi våre gjester minner for livet. Nå søker vi en engasjert, strukturert og kreativ Eventansvarlig som vil være med å utvikle og gjennomføre arrangementer som styrker SkiStars posisjon og skaper økt verdi for både gjester, samarbeidspartnere og destinasjonen.

Som Eventansvarlig får du det overordnede ansvaret for planlegging, utvikling og gjennomføring av arrangementer og aktiviteter i SkiStar Trysil. Du vil være en nøkkelperson i arbeidet med å utvikle destinasjonens event- og aktivitetstilbud gjennom hele året, fra idé til gjennomføring og evaluering.

Stillingen er organisert under Gjestearena i SkiStar Trysil, men innebærer et tett samarbeid med SkiStars konsept- og eventavdeling. Du vil også rapportere til SkiStars konsept- og eventansvarlig i spørsmål som omhandler arrangementer og konseptutvikling. Vi ser etter deg som trives med både strategiske oppgaver og operativ gjennomføring, og som motiveres av å skape gode opplevelser for gjester, kollegaer og samarbeidspartnere.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Planlegge, utvikle og gjennomføre arrangementer gjennom hele året
  • Lede prosjekter knyttet til arrangementer og aktiviteter
  • Utvikle nye konsepter og opplevelser i samarbeid med kommersiell avdeling
  • Koordinere bemanning, logistikk og gjennomføring
  • Utarbeide prosjektplaner, kjøreplaner og risikovurderinger
  • Samarbeide med markedsavdelingen om synlighet og markedsføring
  • Følge opp sponsorer, samarbeidspartnere og leverandører
  • Samarbeide tett med interne avdelinger og andre forretningsområder
  • Bidra til sikker gjennomføring av arrangementer gjennom beredskapsplanlegging og HMS-arbeid
  • Ansvar for budsjettoppfølging, evaluering og rapportering
  • Utvikle og vedlikeholde aktivitets- og arrangementskalender
  • Bidra til utvikling av eksponeringsflater som arenaområder, skjermer og boards
  • Delta i strategisk utviklingsarbeid for destinasjonens aktivitets- og eventtilbud

Du er en engasjert og positiv person som får ting til å skje. Du kombinerer kreativitet og initiativ med struktur, detaljfokus og høy gjennomføringsevne. Du tar ansvar, er pålitelig og jobber selvstendig, samtidig som du bygger gode relasjoner og samarbeider godt med andre. Du kommuniserer tydelig og trygt, og har evnen til å motivere og skape entusiasme rundt deg. Med et kommersielt blikk og fokus på gjesteopplevelsen ser du nye muligheter og trives i et miljø med høyt tempo, mange kontaktflater og varierte arbeidsdager.

Vi ser gjerne at du har:

  • Høyere utdanning innen eventledelse, prosjektledelse, markedsføring, reiseliv, destinasjonsutvikling eller lignende
  • Relevant erfaring kan kompensere for formell utdanning
  • Erfaring med prosjektledelse og gjennomføring av arrangementer
  • Erfaring fra reiseliv, opplevelsesnæring, idrettsarrangementer eller lignende
  • Erfaring med budsjettarbeid og økonomioppfølging
  • Erfaring med koordinering av flere interessenter og samarbeidspartnere
  • God forståelse for arrangementsplanlegging og eventproduksjon
  • Kunnskap om HMS, risikovurderinger og sikkerhetsarbeid
  • God digital kompetanse og erfaring med prosjekt- og planleggingsverktøy
  • Forståelse for kommersiell utvikling og verdiskapende gjesteopplevelser

Krav

  • Førerkort klasse B
  • Flytende norsk eller svensk, muntlig og skriftlig
  • God muntlig og skriftlig engelsk
  • Fleksibilitet til å arbeide kvelder, helger og høytider ved behov
  • Evne til å håndtere perioder med høyt arbeidspress
  • Du er en god representant for SkiStars verdier og kultur

Hos SkiStar blir du en del av et selskap som skaper minnerike opplevelser for tusenvis av gjester hvert år. Du får muligheten til å påvirke utviklingen av Trysil som helårsdestinasjon og jobbe tett med dyktige kollegaer på tvers av organisasjonen.

Vi tilbyr:

  • En sentral rolle i utviklingen av SkiStar Trysils arrangementer og aktiviteter
  • Stor mulighet til å påvirke og utvikle nye konsepter
  • Et engasjert arbeidsmiljø med høy kompetanse
  • Varierte arbeidsdager i en av Nordens sterkeste destinasjonsorganisasjoner
  • Personalfordeler gjennom SkiStar
  • Muligheten til å jobbe med arrangementer innen ski, sykkel, friluftsliv og opplevelser

Stillingen er en fast stilling, med oppstart så snart som mulig eller etter avtale.

Intervjuer gjennomføres fortløpende, og stillingen kan bli tilsatt før søknadsfristen utløper.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Att få jobba med minnesvärda fjällupplevelser året runt tycker vi är det bästa som finns!

Vår personal är vår absolut största tillgång. Ett gemensamt engagemang och en strävan efter att skapa en bra fjällupplevelse för våra gäster är en stor del av vår framgång. Hos oss kan du vara dig själv och ha kul, samtidigt som du levererar ett betydande resultat tillsammans med fantastiska kollegor.

På SkiStar är vi fler än 700 helårsanställda som tillsammans jobbar med bland annat försäljning, ekonomi, drift, aktiviteter, It, administration, logiförmedling, fastighetsservice och marknadsföring. Under vintersäsong har vi dessutom över 2700 säsongsanställda.

jobs.title: Persoonlijk begeleider die gelooft in verbinding boven protocollen
jobs.description:
Grensarbeid zoekt voor Stichting Wonen Plus een persoonlijk begeleider die gelooft in verbinding boven protocollen.

Op onze locatie in Brunssum werk je met cliënten met meervoudige en complexe problematiek. Cliënten die je uitdagen met gedrag dat schuurt, weerstand oproept en zich vaak herhaalt. Dan is de keuze: snel ingrijpen met kort resultaat of investeren in de lange termijn? Wij kiezen het laatste. De weg wijzen in plaats van cliënten afwijzen. Daar hebben de cliënt én de samenleving veel meer aan. Want het gedrag van deze cliënten is een uiting van iets veel diepers. En dat gedrag is dus zelden het goeie kompas voor je handelen. Zij hebben iets anders nodig. En jij hebt de nieuwsgierigheid, het geduld en de creativiteit om daar op een positieve manier mee aan de slag te gaan.

Daarbij kun je bij ons terugvallen op verbinding in plaats van op protocollen. Verbinding met de cliënt, met je collega’s én met jezelf. Dáár vind je het vertrouwen en de veiligheid om te doen wat nodig is. Je werkt intensief samen in een groot, multidisciplinair team en kunt tegen een stootje. Want we zijn net zo eerlijk en nieuwsgierig naar onszelf als naar onze cliënten. Steeds vragen we ons af: wat kunnen wij doen om ander gedrag te stimuleren? Waarmee stoppen we om bepaald gedrag niet meer te triggeren? En dat werkt. Iedere dag zien we dat gedrag verandert. Stap voor stap maar duurzaam.

Dit ga je doen:

· Dagelijkse praktische en psychosociale begeleiding van cliënten: structuur bieden, ondersteuning en activering. Geen behandeling.

· Omgaan met complex gedrag, zoals grensoverschrijdend of crisisgevoelig gedrag

· Uitvoeren van en bijdragen aan begeleidingsplannen

· Ondersteunen bij wonen, financiën, dagbesteding en sociale contacten

· Rapporteren in het cliëntdossier en resultaten zichtbaar maken

· Bijdragen aan een veilige omgeving voor cliënten, collega’s én jezelf

Wij vragen:

· Minimale opleiding is MMZ4 of soortgelijk

· Je hebt ervaring of affiniteit met mensen met complexe problematiek

· Je durft te werken zonder vangnet van strikte regels of straffen

· Je kunt reflecteren op je eigen handelen en dat van het team

· Je staat stevig in je schoenen en kunt samenwerken in een groot, divers team

· Je gelooft, net als wij, dat cliënten meer zijn dan hun gedrag

· Je bent uiterst zorgvuldig in het signaleren van veranderingen in gedrag of stemming, bij de uitvoering van begeleidingsplannen en voor de dossiervoering

jobs.title: Har du ledige ettermiddager/helger og ønsker en fleksibel deltidsjobb?
jobs.description:
Jeg er en aktiv og glad gutt på 11 år som trenger assistent i hverdagen min. Har allerede ett team med assistenter, men søker nå flere assistenter til mitt hverdags-helt team. Jeg er utviklingshemmet, uten verbalt språk, men gjør meg forstått hvis du er litt tålmodig. Jeg trenger kontinuerlig tilsyn, og trenger assistent som passer på meg så familien min får avlastning. Jeg bor sammen med mamma, pappa og mine to søstre i Ytre Arna. Det er mamma som er arbeidsleder i ordningen min, og det viktigste for meg og familien min er at du er glad i barn, og har ekstra kjærlighet og omsorg å gi. Du trenger ikke helse eller sosialfaglig bakgrunn for å bli ansatt, da arbeidet er knyttet til å bistå i hva vi enn finner på som familie. Kjemi er viktig, og vi legger stor vekt på trivsel og på ett godt arbeidsmiljø.

Jeg er veldig glad i sang og musikk, og jeg elsker å være ute å leke på lekeplassen, disse, og hoppe på trampoline ute i hagen vår. Har årskort på Flipzone trampolinepark, så der drar jeg ofte og hopper på trampoliner. Jeg liker fart og spenning, og elsker å suse rundt på den flotte elektriske tandemsykkelen min, sykler gjerne en tur for å kjøpe is. Er også glad i å dra på McDonalds og kjøpe milkshake. Det å kunne dra å bade i basseng er noe av det kjekkeste jeg vet, håper du også er glad i å bade i basseng. Det hender også at jeg reiser på ferie eller helgeturer med familien min, og jeg håper du vil være med oss på reiser.

Selv om jeg liker å ha det gøy har jeg også behov for hjelp til dagligdagse ting som gjør at jeg kan leve en så normal hverdag som mulig. Det er ting som personlig stell, og måltider (alt dette vil du får opplæring i). Jeg ser for meg at du er en åpen, lojal og fleksibel person, og det er supert om du er litt selvgående. Litt enkle oppgaver i huset kan forekomme, men for det meste har vi det travelt og har ikke tid til slikt. Vi søker nå en ny tilkallingsassistent som har mulighet til å ta vakter ved behov eller i ferieavvikling.

Hva kan vi tilby deg som assistent?

  • Ett godt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø
  • God opplæring og assistent kurs som trygger deg i assistent-rollen
  • En meningsfull jobb i ett givende yrke
  • Mulighet til å påvirke arbeidsdagen din, delta på forskjellige aktiviteter
  • En fleksibel jobb som passer godt ved siden av studier
  • Konkurransedyktig lønn   

Arbeidet vil foregå i hovedsak på ettermiddag/kveld i ukedager (klokken 16.15-20.00) og langvakter i helger.

Ikke nøl med å søke. Mamma og jeg ser frem til å høre fra akkurat deg. Aktuelle kandidater kontaktes fortløpende.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. Nysgjerring på hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss? Les mer på vår karriereside: https://prima-assistanse.no/karriere/jobbe-som-bpa-assistent/

jobs.title: Työpäällikkö, Uudenmaan kunnossapitourakat
jobs.description: Etsimme työpäällikköä Uudenmaan alueelle. Tässä roolissa vastaat alueesi infran toimivuudesta, turvallisuudesta ja elinkaaren hallinnasta sekä johdat urakoita suunnitelmallisesti ja tavoitteellisesti.Minkälaiseen rooliin ja tiimiin olisit tulossa?Työpäällikkönä johdat urakoiden kokonaisuuksia suunnittelusta toteutukseen sekä varmistat, että työ sujuu aikataulussa, budjetissa ja laatuvaatimusten mukaisesti. Toimit esihenkilönä oman alueesi henkilöstölle ja osallistut aktiivisesti myyntityöhön ja asiakkuuksien kehittämiseen.Työsuhde on vakituinen ja alkaa viimeistään 1.1.2027. Työsopimuspaikka on Helsinki, Vantaa tai sopimuksen mukaan.Tehtäväsi keskeiset vastuualueet tiivistetysti:- Urakoiden suunnittelu, toteutuksen johtaminen ja raportointi- Aikataulujen, budjetin, laadun ja turvallisuuden seuranta ja hallinta- Kassavirran ja laajuusvaatimusten varmistaminen- Resurssi- ja osaamistarpeiden määrittely urakoihin- Esihenkilön tehtävät rekrytoinnista työsuhteen päättymiseen- Asiakkuuksien hoito ja myyntityö: tunnistaminen, tarjouslaskenta ja sopimusten solmiminen- Viestintä ja yhteydenpito sisäisiin ja ulkoisiin sidosryhmiinMiten onnistut parhaiten tehtävässä?Meillä menestyminen rakentuu arvojen mukaiselle toiminnalle: rehdisti, yhdessä, uudistuen ja menestyen. Arkemme valinnat vaikuttavat suoraan siihen, miten ihmiset liikkuvat, elävät ja viihtyvät ympäristössään, siksipä teknisen osaamisen lisäksi tarvitsemme myös kykyä nähdä infran inhimillinen merkitys.Tehtävässä onnistuaksesi tarvitset:- Soveltuvan teknisen koulutuksen- Vähintään viiden vuoden kokemuksen vastaavista tehtävistä- Kokemusta kunnossapidosta, rakentamisesta ja projektinhallinnasta- Suunnitelmallisuutta ja tulosorientoitunutta toimintatapaa- Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoaLisäksi arvostamme vahvoja vuorovaikutus-, neuvottelu- ja yhteistyötaitoja. Olet verkostoituva ja tavoitteellinen ammattilainen, joka ymmärtää infran rakentamisen ja kunnossapidon kokonaisuudet ja niiden vaikutuksen ihmisten arkeen.Lupaamme, että DestiallaDestialla pääset tekemään työtä, jolla on merkitys ihmisten arjessa. Rakennamme ja ylläpidämme infraa sen koko elinkaaren ajan yhdessä eri alojen osaajien kanssa tiimeissä, joissa jokaisen työpanos on tärkeä. Meillä voit kehittää osaamistasi ja rakentaa urapolkuasi omaan suuntaasi myös kansainvälisesti osana Colas-konsernia. Kehitämme jatkuvasti mittauspuolen tekemistämme ja käytössämme on monipuolisesti eri teknologiaa. Kollegasi ovat kokeneita alan ammattilaisia, jotka sparraavat mielellään.Haluamme, että Destialle on helppo hakea erilaisista taustoista käsin. Kohtelemme toisiamme yhdenvertaisesti ja arvostavasti, ja uskomme, että parhaat ratkaisut syntyvät, kun ihmiset saavat olla työssään omia itsejään ja tuoda esiin erilaisia näkökulmia. Kannamme vastuuta ihmisistä, ympäristöstä ja yhteiskunnasta arjen teoissa. Vastuullisuus näkyy meillä siinä, miten teemme töitä, huolehdimme toisistamme ja kehitämme infraa, joka palvelee ihmisiä pitkälle tulevaisuuteen. Meille tärkeintä on, että nämä lupaukset näkyvät myös destialaisten omissa kokemuksissa joka päivä. [Lue lisää vastuullisuudesta ja tavastamme toimia nettisivuiltamme](https://destia.fi/tietoa-meista/vastuullisuus/).Kiinnostuksesi herättyä toimi näinHae meille työkaveriksi työpaikkailmoituksen kohdasta "Hae tähän työpaikkaan", ja kerro vapaamuotoisesti osaamisestasi ja toiveistasi CV:n ja hakemuskirjeen muodossa. Seuraathan sähköpostiasi, sillä saat meiltä viestejä haun etenemisestä säännöllisesti. Haastattelut aloitamme usein jo hakuajalla sopivien ehdokkaiden kanssa. Lisätietoja tehtävästä ja Destialla työskentelystä antaa työpäällikkö Eero Mikkola, 0400 607 267 tai eero.mikkola@destia.fi.HenkilöstöedutTyön vastapainoksi, työssä viihtymiseksi ja kokonaisvaltaisen hyvinvoinnin tukemiseksi Destia tarjoaa työntekijöilleen mm. seuraavia etuja:- ePassi: hammaslääkäri-, hieronta-, liikunta-, työmatka-, lounas- ja kulttuurietu (400e/v.)- Lounasetu ei sisälly 400 euroon, vaan on oma etunsa. Luomme hyvän yhteiskunnan perustaa suunnittelemalla, rakentamalla ja ylläpitämällä huomisen liikenne- ja energiainfraa. Teemme sen noin 1 900 destialaisen ainutlaatuisella infran tajulla. jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Description & Expectation:

Quadsat is looking for an experienced Product Manager to join the R&D team and take a key role in shaping and driving our defence product portfolio.

You will join the R&D organisation and work at the intersection of technology, customers, and business. The role combines strategic product management, defining product direction, priorities, positioning, and roadmap, with the operational responsibility of turning that direction into clear development priorities and ensuring progress across the organisation.

Our defence products combine RF sensing payloads, drone-based operations, mission control software, signal processing, geolocation algorithms, and operator-facing workflows into integrated solutions for the detection, analysis, and geolocation of RF emitters.

You will work closely with engineering, commercial teams, partners, and end users to understand operational needs, translate market and customer insight into product priorities, manage and communicate the product roadmap, and help drive development from early concepts through product releases and continued improvement.

This is a role for someone who enjoys moving between the big picture and the detail: understanding where the product needs to go, while also staying close enough to development, customers, and delivery to help make it happen.

For this role it is a requirement that you can confirm that you are eligible to be security cleared by the Danish Defense Intelligence Service.

Responsibilities:

Your main responsibility will be to take end-to-end ownership of product development and evolution. You will:

  • Own and drive product roadmaps aligned with Quadsat's strategy, market opportunities, and customer needs.
  • Translate customer, operational, and commercial input into clear product priorities and development initiatives.
  • Drive development from concept through implementation, validation, release, and continued improvement.
  • Maintain an overview of scope, timelines, dependencies, risks, and progress, and communicate product status clearly across the organisation.
  • Work closely with engineers and technical leads to understand feasibility, effort, and realistic timelines for new capabilities and customer requests.
  • Collaborate with the R&D Director on prioritisation, resource planning, and allocation of engineering capacity across product lines.
  • Facilitate collaboration across R&D, Business Development, Marketing, Production, Quality, and other key stakeholders.
  • Stay close to customers, partners, and the defence industry, working with the commercial organisation to understand emerging needs and translate them into product direction.

The role offers significant ownership and the opportunity to influence both what we build and how we bring it to market, while remaining closely involved in the technical development required to make it happen.

Knowledge & Skills:

We envision that you have a bachelor’s or master’s degree in an engineering field, combined with strong practical experience in a similar role as a product or project manager.

In addition, you bring:

  • Experience translating customer or market needs into technical products and development priorities.
  • Experience within product management, technical product management, technical project management, or a similar role.
  • Experience from the defence industry or another mission-critical technical domain.
  • A strong technical understanding and the ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary engineering teams.
  • Fluency in English (both written and oral).

Our Dynamic Work Environment:

Quadsat is at an exciting stage of our growth journey where you can make a meaningful impact with your work, and directly influence the development of advanced solutions. You will join a diverse team of innovative colleagues who are passionate about working with new technology development. Our work environment is characterised by a high degree of openness, a flat management structure, and a strong sense of community where we work closely together on tasks.

You will be part of a driven engineering team across software, RF, robotics, and product development, with opportunities for professional growth, increased responsibility, and close involvement in real product innovation. We value initiative, collaboration, high-quality engineering, and people who want their work to matter beyond the codebase.

Contact & Questions:

This hiring is being managed in collaboration with our external recruitment partner, ESBEES. For questions reach out to Søren Bøge Sørensen by mail: sbs@esbeesheadhunting.com or by phone: +45 20 27 46 66.

jobs.title: Bor du i Åkersberga? Hemfrid söker en erfaren barnpassare för extrajobb!
jobs.description: Hemfrid söker erfaren barnpassare till tvillingar i Danderyd!Har du erfarenhet av att ta hand om små barn och trivs med att skapa en trygg, rolig och stimulerande vardag? Då kan det här vara det perfekta extrajobbet för dig!Hemfrid är Sveriges största företag inom hemstädning. Vi hjälper våra kunder med tjänster i hemmet såsom städning, fönsterputs, flyttservice, barnpassning och mycket annat.Just nu söker vi en trygg, omtänksam och erfaren barnpassare till en familj i Danderyd som behöver hjälp med sina två tvillingar på 10 månader. Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av små barn, gärna från förskola, och som känner dig bekväm med att ta hand om två små barn samtidigt.ArbetsbeskrivningSom barnpassare hos oss får du ett meningsfullt extrajobb där du hjälper en familj att skapa en trygg och fungerande vardag.Familjen har två tvillingar som är 10 månader gamla och fortfarande är hemma på dagarna. Eftersom uppdraget gäller två tvillingar lägger vi extra stor vikt vid din erfarenhet och förmåga att hantera flera behov samtidigt.Vi ser gärna att du:    Har erfarenhet av barnpassning av spädbarn och små barn, gärna under 2 år.    Har erfarenhet av att ta hand om tvillingar eller flera små barn samtidigt – detta är särskilt meriterande.    Gärna har arbetat inom förskola eller som barnskötare.    Är trygg med rutiner såsom matning, blöjbyten, vila och lek.    Talar och förstår svenska flytande.    Kan arbeta minst en gång i veckan, helst på förmiddagar men även eftermiddagar kan fungera.    Bor i eller nära Danderyd, alternativt har goda möjligheter att ta dig dit regelbundet.Vi lägger stor vikt vid din personlighet, erfarenhet och förmåga att skapa trygghet för både barnen och deras föräldrar.Vi erbjuder    Ett flexibelt extrajobb, perfekt för dig som studerar eller vill arbeta deltid.    Möjligheten att arbeta regelbundet med samma familj och bygga en trygg relation med barnen.    Ett meningsfullt arbete där du gör skillnad i en familjs vardag.    Timanställning med OB-tillägg (kvällar, helger och storhelger).    Kollektivavtal och goda anställningsvillkor.Vill du bli en del av Hemfrid? 💙Älskar du att arbeta med små barn och har erfarenheten som krävs för att ta hand om två små tvillingar? Då vill vi gärna höra från dig!Välkommen med din ansökan redan idag!Har du frågor om tjänsten eller vår rekryteringsprocess? Kontakta oss gärna på HR@hemfrid.se.Vi genomför alltid en bakgrundskontroll innan anställning.

jobs.title: RF Systems Architect
jobs.description:
Description & Expectation

Quadsat is looking for an experienced RF Systems Architect to join the RF team working on SpectraLoc, our defense product for detection, analysis, and geolocation of RF emitters.

This role will focus on RF front-end architecture, coherent receiver design, RF chain optimization, PCB design and layout, measurement integrity, and the continued productization of SpectraLoc. You will help strengthen the RF hardware foundation needed for robust product performance, certification readiness, and future next-generation RF architectures.

SpectraLoc combines RF sensing payloads, drone-based operations, mission control software, signal processing, geolocation algorithms, and operator-facing workflows into one integrated product. You will work closely with engineers spanning from RF, DSP, software, embedded, and FPGA specialist, with your primary focus being to improve RF system quality, hardware robustness, and the measurement integrity of the sensing chain.

For this role it is a requirement that you can confirm that you are eligible to be security cleared by the Danish Defense Intelligence Service.

Responsibilities:

Your main responsibility will be to develop, improve, and mature RF hardware and RF system architectures that support reliable RF sensing, geolocation, and future coherent receiver capabilities.

You will:

  • Design, develop, and optimize RF front-end architectures for RF sensing and geolocation applications.
  • Contribute to coherent receiver design, multi-channel RF architectures, and future direction-finding capabilities based on phase-coherent RF measurements.
  • Design and improve RF chains, including filtering, amplification, frequency conversion, gain distribution, dynamic range, noise figure, linearity, and sensitivity trade-offs.
  • Support PCB design and layout for RF circuits, including component selection, schematic design, layout review, signal integrity, grounding, shielding, and manufacturability.
  • Improve measurement integrity across the RF sensing chain by identifying and reducing sources of uncertainty, drift, phase error, loss, interference, leakage, and calibration sensitivity.
  • Plan and perform RF measurements, verification, and troubleshooting using relevant RF test equipment such as spectrum analysers, VNAs, signal generators, power meters, and related tools.
  • Work with DSP and software engineers to ensure that RF hardware behavior, calibration data, and system limitations are understood and properly reflected in algorithm development and product performance.
  • Support product robustness, certification readiness, and design-for-manufacturing activities by improving RF hardware quality, documentation, repeatability, and testability.
  • Provide technical leadership within RF systems and hardware, helping raise the quality of Quadsat’s RF design, validation methodology, and overall sensing performance.

Knowledge & Skills:

We envision that you have a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, RF Engineering, Microwave Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field, combined with strong practical experience in RF hardware development for RF sensing, SDR, radar, electronic warfare, SATCOM, aerospace, telecom, test and measurement, or other advanced RF systems.

More important than the exact degree is that you have hands-on experience designing, validating, and improving RF systems where measurement quality, robustness, and system performance matter.

In addition, you bring:

  • Strong practical experience with RF front-end design, RF chain architecture, and RF hardware development.
  • Experience with RF circuit design and PCB design/layout for high-frequency systems.
  • Solid understanding of RF system trade-offs, including gain, noise figure, dynamic range, linearity, filtering, frequency conversion, phase noise, spurious signals, leakage, and sensitivity.
  • Practical experience with RF measurement, verification, debugging, and calibration using professional RF test equipment.
  • Understanding of coherent RF systems, including phase stability, synchronization, channel matching, LO distribution, timing effects, and calibration considerations.
  • Familiarity with antenna interfaces, propagation effects, polarization, multipath, and how RF hardware behavior affects sensing and geolocation performance.
  • Ability to define test methods, performance metrics, acceptance criteria, and validation approaches for RF hardware and RF sensing systems.
  • Experience collaborating with DSP, software, embedded, FPGA, mechanical, robotics, and product teams to turn RF hardware concepts into robust product capabilities.
  • A proactive mindset, strong ownership, and the ability to work independently while staying aligned with broader product and engineering priorities.

It would be highly advantageous if you also have experience with electronic warfare, radar systems, SIGINT, RF surveillance, phased arrays, coherent multi-channel receivers, interferometry, monopulse tracking, beamforming, calibration of RF sensing systems, MIL-STD certification, environmental robustness, SDR platforms, or transitioning RF hardware from prototype into production.

Our Dynamic Work Environment:

Quadsat is at an exciting stage of our growth journey where you can make a meaningful impact with your work, and directly influence the development of advanced solutions. You will join a diverse team of innovative colleagues who are passionate about working with new technology development. Our work environment is characterised by a high degree of openness, a flat management structure, and a strong sense of community where we work closely together on tasks.

You will be part of a driven engineering team across software, RF, robotics, and product development, with opportunities for professional growth, increased responsibility, and close involvement in real product innovation. We value initiative, collaboration, high-quality engineering, and people who want their work to matter beyond the codebase.

Contact and Questions:

This hiring is being managed in collaboration with our external recruitment partner, ESBEES. For questions reach out to Søren Bøge Sørensen by mail: sbs@esbeesheadhunting.com or by phone: +45 20 27 46 66.

jobs.title: Saksbehandler i barnevernstjenesten
jobs.description:
Ønsker du å bidra til et godt oppvekstmiljø for barn og unge gjennom barnevernstjenesten i Tromsø kommune?Hvis du trives i en hektisk og uforutsigbar arbeidshverdag, er selvstendig, liker å jobbe i team samt er løsningsorientert, er det nettopp deg vi søker!Vi er stolte av vårt inkluderende og støttende arbeidsmiljø, og ser etter deg som vil bidra med både faglig kompetanse og godt humør. Vi verdsetter samarbeid, faglig utvikling og en arbeidshverdag preget av trygghet. Vi ønsker en stabil person med tilstedeværelse for å fremme dette. Du vil få god opplæring, veiledning og mulighet til å utvikle deg faglig – både individuelt og i team. Arbeidet krever evne til å planlegge og strukturere egen arbeidshverdag, samtidig som du må være fleksibel og håndtere uforutsette situasjoner for familier i en vanskelig livssituasjon.Vi har ledig:

To 100 % vikariat, med ønske om snarlig oppstart med varighet ut august. Oppstart etter avtale.

Intervju er planlagt i uke 50.Vil du være med på laget? Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg.

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Saksbehandling av barnevernssaker etter lov om barnevernstjeneste.
  • Håndtere akuttsaker og bistå den øvrige barnevernstjeneste i akuttarbeid.
  • Mottak og behandling av alle bekymringsmeldinger til barneverntjenesten.
  • Betjene vakttelefonen med råd- og veiledning til samarbeidspartnere og privatpersoner.
  • Representere barnevernstjenesten i saker for nemd og rettsinstanser.
  • Reisevirksomhet i forbindelse med plasseringer må påregnes.
  • Bidra til et trygt og positivt arbeidsmiljø.
  • Endring i ansvars- og arbeidsoppgaver må påregnes.
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Høyere utdannelse på minimum bachelornivå, barnevernspedagog eller sosionom.
  • Nødvendig med svært gode norsk muntlig og skriftlig framstillingsevne.
  • Sertifikat klasse B, manuell.

Søkere med annen relevant høyere utdanning i kombinasjon med relevant erfaring vil bli vurdert.

Det vil bli lagt vekt på:

  • Høyere relevant videreutdanning
  • Erfaring fra arbeid med barn, unge og familier.
  • Erfaring og kompetanse fra arbeid med akutte situasjoner.
  • Erfaring og kompetanse på identifikasjon av risiko, beskyttelsesfaktorer og familiens egne ressurser.
  • Kunnskaper og ferdigheter på barnevernsfaglig metodikk og forvaltning.
  • Flerkulturell forståelse og kompetanse.
  • Gode kommunikasjonsferdigheter og evne til samhandling med barn, familier og samarbeidspartnere. 
Personlige egenskaper
  • Du er god på å bygge relasjoner og behandler de rundt deg med respekt.
  • Du trives med å jobbe selvstendig, men også i team.
  • Du er fleksibel, omstillingsdyktig og har samarbeidsevner.
  • Du ønsker å bidra til et godt arbeidsmiljø, stabilitet og tilstedeværelse.
  • Du er positiv og har godt humør.
  • Du har god gjennomføringsevne, struktur og fremdrift i arbeidet.
  • Du har faglig og etisk refleksjon.

Personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt.

Vi tilbyr
  • Selvstendige-og teamoppgaver med faglige og gode utviklingsmuligheter.
  • Inkluderende og godt arbeidsmiljø.
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger.
  • Bedriftshelsetjeneste.
  • Velferdsordninger.
  • Mulighet for trening i arbeidstiden.
  • Mulighet til å påvirke egen turnus i kalenderplan.Stillingen avlønnes etter Hovedtariffavtalen KAP. 4 Stillingskode 6508 og 7534 Lønnsramme C. 545 400- 639 900 per. år. Tverrfaglige spesialister Lønnsramme 586 400-673 200,- per. år.  20 000,- for fullført relevant mastergrad, alternativt ett års utdanning med 60 stp som helårsmodul. Forholdsmessig uttelling for utdanning av kortere varighet. Henholdsvis: kr 15 000,- for 45 stp. Kr 10 000,- for 30 stp. Kr 5000,- for 15 stp. Andre variable tillegg ift til turnusarbeid.

Annet:

  • Tilsetting skjer i henhold til gjeldende lover, reglementer og tariffavtaler.
  • Vi gjør oppmerksom på at søkere kan føres opp på offentlig søkerliste selv om søkeren har bedt om anonymitet. Dette blir du i så fall varslet om.
  • Attester og vitnemål legges ved søknad før intervju.
  • Minimum to referanser registreres på forespørsel etter intervju.
  • Søknad sendes elektronisk via Webcruiter.
  • Ved tilsetting må gyldig politiattest iht. Barnevernloven§ 6-10 første ledd, Barnevernsloven § 12-11 første ledd, jf. forskrift om politiattest etter barnevernsloven § 1 og § 5 første ledd, jf. politiregisterloven§ 39 første ledd fremlegges.Har du spørsmål om stillingen så ta kontakt med avdelingsleder på barnevernsvakta, Monica Dalan eller teamleder Carina Gabrielsen.
KontaktinformasjonMonica Dalan, Avdelingsleder barnevernvakta, +47 94 87 22 31, monica.dalan@tromso.kommune.no Carina Gabrielsen, Teamleder, + 47 48 28 92 12 ArbeidsstedMellomvegen 110 9006 TROMSØ Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Tromsø kommune Referansenr.: 5212880669 Stillingsprosent: 100% Vikariat Startdato: 01.01.2027 Søknadsfrist: 03.12.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Barneverntjenesten i Tromsø er Nord-Norges største barnevern med ca 100 årsverk. Tjenesten er delt inn i seks avdelinger, administrasjon, fag og utvikling, mottak/barnevernsvakt, undersøkelse og tiltak, omsorg og ressurs. Tjenesten har en enhetsleder, en nestleder og seks avdelingsledere.

Barnevernsvakta har 10,2 årsverk fordelt på hel- og deltidsstillinger, inkludert teamleder og avdelingsleder. Ansatte jobber tredelt turnus, og må til enhvertid være forberedt på å håndtere komplekse og utfordrende saker. Barnevernsvakta ivaretar akuttberedskapen for barn og unge, og utenfor ordninær arbeidstid ansvarlig for akuttberedskap for Storfjord, Balsfjord og Karlsøy kommune. jobs.title: SpinDrive: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: **Type:** Full-time, permanent**Location:** Lapinlahdenkatu 16, 00180 Helsinki**Application deadline:** 3.12.2026Are you a Mechanical Engineer ready to take ownership of design projects and develop energy-efficient technology for high-speed rotating machinery? Join SpinDrive!**What will you be doing?**SpinDrive is looking for a Mechanical Engineer to join its growing mechanical design team in Helsinki. In this role, you will design and develop mechanical components for active magnetic bearing systems used in high-speed rotating machinery, such as compressors, turbines, and electric motors. You will also be responsible for integrating these systems into customers' equipment, ensuring that the designs meet their technical requirements.You will typically work on several projects at different stages, from initial design to prototyping and production support. You will collaborate closely with mechanical, electrical, and control engineers, as well as suppliers and manufacturing partners. As part of a small team, you will have considerable ownership of your designs and the opportunity to see how they perform in practice.**Main tasks:**- Designing and integrating mechanical components for active magnetic bearing systems, including rotors, stators, bearing housings, backup bearings, and sensor mounts. - Creating and maintaining 3D CAD models, manufacturing drawings, and technical documentation in product data management (PDM) systems. - Performing mechanical calculations and analyses, including tolerance stack-ups, interference fits, structural integrity, and thermal behaviour. - Supporting rotordynamic analysis, balancing requirements, prototype testing, manufacturing, assembly, and troubleshooting. - Collaborating with multidisciplinary engineering teams, suppliers, and customers to ensure designs meet technical requirements and project objectives. **What makes you a great fit?**We are looking for a hands-on mechanical engineer who enjoys solving technical challenges and turning engineering concepts into manufacturable solutions. You have already gained relevant experience in mechanical design and are familiar with rotating machinery.You have strong analytical skills, pay close attention to detail, and can manage your work effectively and independently while enjoying collaboration with colleagues from different technical backgrounds. Above all, you are motivated to deepen your expertise in mechanical engineering and contribute to the development of innovative industrial technology.**We require you to have:**- A bachelor's or master's degree in mechanical engineering or a related field - Hands-on experience in mechanical design, preferably involving rotating machinery - Proficiency in 3D CAD software, such as Autodesk Inventor or SolidWorks, and experience preparing manufacturing drawings - Solid knowledge of mechanical design principles, machine elements, and tolerance analysis (including GD&T) - Good English communication skills **We consider as an asset:**- Experience designing high-speed rotating machinery or components for turbomachinery - Understanding of rotordynamics, vibration, balancing, or active magnetic bearing systems - Experience with finite element analysis (FEA) and structural or thermal simulations - Knowledge of design for manufacturing and assembly (DFM/DFA), manufacturing processes, or prototype testing **SpinDrive offers you:**- The opportunity to own mechanical designs from concept to manufacturing and see your engineering decisions become real products - A chance to deepen your expertise in advanced rotating machinery and active magnetic bearing technology alongside experienced engineers - Meaningful work developing energy-efficient industrial solutions that help customers reduce friction, maintenance needs, and environmental impact - A growing international cleantech environment where your ideas can influence products, processes, and your future career opportunities - Flexible hybrid working arrangements and the opportunity to participate in the company's growth through a stock option program **Practicalities:**This is a permanent, full-time position in which you will be employed directly by SpinDrive. Start time in the role is as soon as possible in early 2027. The role will be located in Helsinki, and we hope you are able to work at the office at least a few days per week as part of a hybrid model. Salary in this position is 4000-5500 €/month (gross), depending on the level of your experience, and will be negotiated individually. In addition to your salary, the compensation package includes stock options, allowing you to share in the benefits of SpinDrives growth.

jobs.description: Välkommen till Alingsås! Som medarbetare i vår kommun har du alla möjligheter att vara med och utveckla verksamheten och din arbetsplats. Vi ansvarar också för att ha uppsökande insatser.Du och dina kollegor arbetar tillsammans med att skapa en vardag för klienterna där inflytande och delaktighet är det centrala i det vardagsnära arbetet. Att stärka den enskildes egna resurser och möjligheter till förändring är andra nyckelord som genomsyrar vårt arbete. Du ska i din roll vara nyfiken, prestigelös, ta initiativ och sätta igång aktiviteter för att uppnå resultat.Verksamheterna är bemannande dygnet runt.Arbetstiden är förlagd till dag-, kvälls- och helg.KVALIFIKATIONERSkallkrav:    • Utbildad socialpedagog eller har annan utbildning som bedöms likvärdig    • Erfarenhet av socialt arbete med vuxna med psykisk ohälsa, skadligt bruk/beroende eller samsjuklighet    • B-körkortFör att lyckas i rollen är du trygg, stabil och har självinsikt. Du har intresse, vilja och förmåga att hjälpa andra och anstränger dig för att leverera lösningar.För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du ser teamarbete och samverkan som en förutsättning för att lyckas i arbetet. Du skapar delaktighet och stärker individens egna resurser genom kreativa lösningar. Haemme asiakkaallemme ajoneuvoasentajaa kokoaikaiseen työsuhteeseen Vaasaan.

Nopeasta reagointikyvystään ja laadukkaasta kiinteistöpalvelustaan tunnettu yritys etsii nyt tiimin vahvistukseksi kokenutta ja ammattitaitoista ajoneuvoasentajaa.

jobs.title: Sykepleier/Vernepleier - Dagtid + hver 4. helg.
jobs.employer: ÅLESUND KOMMUNE BU- OG AVLASTNING ADMINISTRASJON
jobs.description:
Spesialisert fagmiljø innen tvungen omsorgVi søker to stedlige ansvarlige i 100 % med arbeid på dagtid i uke, samt langvakt hver fjerde helg (torsdag-søndag) til et tiltak for gjennomføring av tvungen omsorg. Som stedlig ansvarlig får du det daglige faglige ansvaret i tiltaket og en sentral rolle i å sikre kvalitet, sikkerhet, behandling og omsorg for tjenestemottakeren. Tiltaket har en bemanning på 3:1 på dagtid, noe som gir gode rammer for målrettet miljøterapeutisk arbeid, faglig refleksjon og tett oppfølging. Du vil arbeide i nært samarbeid med St. Olav og Sentral fagenhet for tvungen omsorg, som har det overordnede fagansvaret, og bidra til utvikling av kunnskapsbaserte tjenester med høy faglig standard. Arbeidssted er Ørskog.

Ålesund kommune arbeider etter veilederen «Gode helse- og omsorgstjenester til personer med utviklingshemming» og er i gang med implementering av Positiv atferdsstøtte (PAS). Vi ønsker medarbeidere som ser verdien av persontilpassede tjenester, selvbestemmelse, inkludering og høy faglig kvalitet, og som ønsker å omsette disse verdiene til praksis i møte med mennesker hver dag.

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Sikre at TM får nødvendig helsehjelp og tjenester av god kvalitet i tråd med gjeldende lover, avtaler og retningslinjer.
  • Utføre observasjon, kartlegging, iverksetting av tiltak og dokumentasjon i pasientjournal (Helseplattformen).
  • Legemiddelhåndtering.
  • Ha løpende oversikt over tjenestemottakers funksjon, behov, utvikling og risikoforhold.
  • Sørge for at tiltakets planer, prosedyrer og dokumentasjon er oppdaterte og i samsvar med gjeldende krav.
  • Ha lokalt ansvar for at sikkerhetsrutiner og risikoreduserende tiltak etterleves.
  • Foreta fortløpende vurderinger av sikkerhet, samfunnsvern og behov for tilsyn i samarbeid med fagenheten.
  • Vurdere og planlegge aktiviteter utenfor boligen sammen med ansvarlig fagrådgiver.
  • Sørge for at avvik, sikkerhetshendelser, uønskede hendelser eller brudd på samfunnsvern meldes umiddelbart til fagenheten.
  • Påse at det ikke anvendes ulovlig tvang, og at eventuelle tvangstiltak gjennomføres i samsvar med gjeldende regelverk.
  • Utarbeide halvårsrapporter, årsrapporter og øvrig nødvendig dokumentasjon.
  • Koordinatoransvar iht kommunens retningslinjer.
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Sykepleier/Vernepleier med godkjent autorisasjon. Helsefagarbeider med godkjent fagbrev kan søke og bli vurdert.
  • Relevant erfaring fra arbeid med personer med kognitive funksjonsnedsettelser, alvorlige atferdsvansker og/eller personer omfattet av særreaksjoner.
  • Relevant videreutdanning innen veiledning, psykisk helsearbeid, miljøterapi, sikkerhet eller tilsvarende.
  • Erfaring med risikovurdering, tverrfaglig samarbeid og koordinering
  • Kjennskap til regelverk knyttet til tvungen omsorg og særreaksjoner.
  • God muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne. Krav om norsk språkferdighet tilsvarende B2 muntlig og skriftlig (Europarådets nivåskala – CEFR).
  • Ved ansettelse kreves politiattest, MRSA- og TBC-egenerklæringer.
  • Aktuelle kandidater må ha norsk personnummer eller gyldig D-nummer og formidle dette til arbeidsgiver i god tid før oppstart i jobben.
  • Det forutsettes at den som skal ansettes kan bekrefte sikker identitet i form av gyldig pass (internasjonalt) eller nasjonalt ID-kort (EU/EØS).
  • Det kreves også at personlig BankID eller ID-porten kan benyttes som alternativ innlogging mot ulike digitale løsninger ved behov (Helseplattformen, OTTO-app).
  • Førerkort klasse B.
Personlige egenskaper
  • Høy grad av faglig integritet og ansvarlighet.
  • Gode samarbeids- og relasjonelle ferdigheter.
  • Evne til å arbeide strukturert, selvstendig og målrettet.
  • God rolleforståelse og evne til å håndtere komplekse problemstillinger.
  • Trygghet i krevende situasjoner og god beslutningsevne.
  • Menn oppfordres til å søke.
Vi tilbyr
  • En interessant arbeidshverdag med varierte og utfordrende oppgaver.
  • Faglig påfyll og mulighet for videreutdanning etter virksomhetens behov.
  • Lønn og arbeidsvilkår etter gjeldende tariff.
  • Pensjonsordning i henhold til tariff.
  • Bedriftshelsetjeneste.
  • IA-bedrift.
  • Gratis parkering.
  • God offentlig transport.
KontaktinformasjonSilje F. Midthjell, Avdelingsleder, 951 47 889, Silje.Midthjell@alesund.kommune.no Eirik Frøystad, Verksemdsleiar, 416 25 242, eirik.froystad@alesund.kommune.no ArbeidsstadØyravegen 11 6240 Ørskog Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgivar: Ålesund kommune Referansenr.: 5200977116 Stillingsprosent: 100% Fast Søknadsfrist: 29.11.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Ålesund kommune er den største kommunen mellom Bergen og Trondheim, og et regionsenter for Nordvestlandet. Kommunen har rundt 58.000 innbyggere. Området rundt byr på rike muligheter for et aktivt friluftsliv for alle, jakt og fiske, og kommunen har et rikt og blomstrende kultur- og næringsliv. Ålesund er en universitetsby og har landets største universitet, NTNU.

Kommunen er en stor arbeidsgiver med sine over 4.500 dyktige og engasjerte medarbeidere som utfører viktige samfunnsoppdrag. I det daglige arbeidet vektlegger vi verdiene våre: åpen, engasjert og modig. Visjonen for kommunen er «nasjonal slagkraft, regional attraktivitet og lokal identitet».

Ønsker du en meningsfylt jobb med varierte og utfordrende oppgaver, er Ålesund kommune et spennende alternativ.

jobs.title: Tour Guide – Voss & the Fjords of Western Norway - Summer 2027
jobs.description:
Trade a life of hustle and bustle for a summer in the Norwegian fjords and mountains. Meet guests from around the world, join our friendly international team and gain valuable experience while exploring spectacular landscapes, small communities and some of Norway’s most beautiful destinations.

Hva vi ser etter Who We Are Looking For

If you are curious, service focussed, reliable and enjoy working closely amongst a team of individuals who enjoy connecting with people and working in a dynamic environment, then we are very interested in talking to you.

Requirements:

  • Fluency in English and at least one, of the following languages: German, Spanish, Italian, French, Norwegian, Dutch or Chinese. Portuguese can also be an advantage. Proficiency in two or more of these languages in addition to English is considered a strong advantage.

  • If you are not a Norwegian citizen, you must be an EU/EEA citizen or already have a valid Norwegian work permit.

  • Interest in Norwegian history, culture, and nature.

  • Guide Certification (or willingness to obtain one).

  • Strong and demonstrable verbal communication skills are a huge advantage

  • An experienced team player

Not Certified Yet?

As a part of our quality guarantee to our clients, our guides must hold at minimum a Guide Certification ensuring high professional standards. Several certification options are available in Norway.

We work together with and recommend the Guide Academy Certification Programme , which includes an engaging online course (completed remotely) and an intensive on-site training session in Voss starting April the 12th 2027.

No prior guiding experience is required, only passion and enthusiasm!

We sponsor the certification fee for candidates who commit to working a full season exclusively with Voss og Fjordane Guideservice.

Arbeidsoppgaver

What is working as a Guide in the Voss area like?

As a Tour Guide, you'll lead guests through some of Western Norway's most spectacular fjord and mountain landscapes.

Assignments range from scenic coach and fjord tours to ferry excursions, walking tours and hikes. You'll lead groups of up to 50 guests, share local stories and culture, and take responsibility for creating a safe, engaging and memorable experience.

The job is dynamic: schedules can change, and some tours will be repeated throughout the season. But every group is different, and there are also opportunities to work from other ports and experience more of Western Norway.

Vi tilbyr What We Offer

  • An international job in the heart of Fjord Norway - Experience a more authentic side of Norway, living and working among fjords, mountains, traditional villages and small local communities. Voss gives you a quieter base close to nature, while your assignments take you through some of Western Norway's most attractive destinations.

  • A seasonal job with variety - Most assignments take place between May and mid-October, with additional guiding opportunities from April and into the later part of the year.

  • Guaranteed minimum seasonal income - More predictability while still retaining the variety and flexibility that comes with guiding.

  • Professional training and certification sponsorship - We'll help you gain professional qualifications and can sponsor your Guide Certification, including visits to destinations and venues throughout the region when you commit to a full season with us .

  • Fair working conditions - We focus on creating a sustainable, inclusive and positive working environment. We provide full paid training on company specific procedures, tour logistics and guest service standards,

  • Explore more of Fjord Norway - Your workplace extends far beyond Voss, with opportunities to guide in Flåm, Eidfjord, Ulvik, Vik, Odda, Rosendal and other destinations across the region. Assignments outside our normal region come with higher pay and paid travel time.

  • Opportunities to grow - Guiding can be a first step into a wider career in tourism, hospitality and destination development.

Support with finding accommodation

Moving to Voss? We help make the move easier by arranging accommodation for most of our seasonal guides. This is subject to availability and at the guide's own expense. We can also provide guidance if you prefer to find your own place.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

About Voss og Fjordane Guide Service

The first official private guide service in Norway, with over 38 years of experience, Voss og fjordane Guideservice has a team of over 40 guides dedicated to creating exciting and meaningful experiences for guests visiting the fjord and mountain region of Western Norway.

Our philosophy is simple: when our guides are enthused, our guests will be as well -- enthusiasm is, after all, contagious! We spend much time developing and nurturing our team, ensuring that each guide can be a trusted leader, an exciting storyteller, a proud ambassador of the fjord region culture and a collaborative and engaging team member.

We deliver over 3,000 assignments every year, collaborating with over 90% of the cruise calls in some of the most beautiful cruise destinations in the country.

Our aim is to be the best we can be, and to get better every day!

Mulighed for at blive en del af en virksomhed i udvikling.

jobs.title: Vi søger 2 erfarne malere til længerevarende vikariat – opstart hurtigst muligt

Du bliver en del af et byggeprojekt, hvor der arbejdes med færdiggørelse og aflevering af nybyggede lejligheder. Vi søger derfor malere, der har øje for detaljerne, leverer et flot resultat og kan arbejde selvstændigt.

Arbejdsopgaver

  • Malerarbejde i nybyggede lejligheder

  • Fugning og afsluttende fugearbejde

  • Klargøring og færdiggørelse af lejligheder til aflevering

  • Finisharbejde og udbedring af mindre fejl og mangler

  • Diverse forefaldende maleropgaver

Vi forventer, at du

  • Har solid erfaring med professionelt malerarbejde

  • Gerne har erfaring fra nybyggeri, fugning og afleveringsopgaver

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og kvalitetsbevidst

  • Er mødestabil, fleksibel og ansvarsbevidst

  • Har gode danskkundskaber, både mundtligt og skriftligt

  • Kan starte med kort varsel

Vi tilbyder

  • Et længerevarende vikariat med mulighed for forlængelse efter nytår

  • Gode arbejdsforhold og spændende opgaver

  • En fast kontaktperson hos FIRMAVIKAR

  • Mulighed for flere opgaver gennem FIRMAVIKAR efterfølgende

Praktiske oplysninger

Antal stillinger: 2

Opstart: Mandag den 23. november 2026

Varighed: Foreløbigt frem til nytår med forventning om fortsættelse i 2027

Ansættelsesform: Fuldtidsvikariat

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja Kankaanpäähän
jobs.description: Lähihoitaja, tule osaksi Kankaanpään Alinaa vakituiseen, kokoaikaiseen työhön!Kotipalvelumme tuovat helpotusta arkeen. Autamme ikääntyneitä ja muita apua tarvitsevia elämään itsenäisesti ja turvallisesti omassa kodissaan, tarjoten kotihoitoa, apua arjen askareissa, kotisairaanhoitoa ja ennen kaikkea läsnäoloa. Perheille olemme luotettava tukiverkko, kun arjessa tarvitaan tukea. Olemme palvelleet asiakkaitamme Satakunnan alueella vuodesta 2023.**Työnkuvaus**Työnkuva kohdentuu lähinnä asiakkaamme henkilökohtaiseen avustamiseen koulumaailmassa, mutta myös muihin tehtäviin kotihoidossa. Työ on vakituinen ja töitä on tarjolla kokoaikaisesti. Työtä tehdään meillä kahdessa vuorossa ja pitää sisällään myös viikonloppuvuoroja.Työ käynnistyy sopimuksen mukaan.**Mitä toivomme sinulta**- Lähihoitajan tutkintoa ja lääkelupien teoriaosuuden ajantasaisuutta - Hyvää suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista osaamista - B-ajokorttia sekä oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta - Positiivista ja itsenäisesti toimeen tarttuvaa otetta asiakastyöhön - Kykyä toimia tiimin jäsenenä - Tuntemus diabeteksesta ja tukiviittomista katsotaan eduksi. **Miksi sinun kannattaa hakea osaksi Kankaanpään Alinaa?**- Pääset tekemään oman osaamisesi mukaista työtä ja kehittämään osaamistasi työskentelyn kautta. - Saat laadukkaan ja kattavan perehdytyksen työhösi sekä monipuolisen asiakaskunnan. - Työtyytyväisyys Alinassa on huippuluokkaa: työtyytyväisyyden keskiarvo oli 4,3/5 vuonna 2025. Työkyky koettiin hyväksi 8,6/10 ja stressitaso matalaksi 2,2/5. Mikäli tämä voisi olla seuraava työpaikkasi, täytä hakemus ja hae työpaikkaa tiimistämme. Työhön valitulta henkilöltä tarkistetaan rikosrekisteri ennen palkkausta.Haluatko tietää lisää meistä? Löydät lisätietoa **täältä**.Alina on valtakunnallinen ketju, joka työllistää jo 350 alan ammattilaista. Paikallisia Alina-yrityksiä on jo yli 40 eri puolilla Suomea. Yhdeksän kymmenestä asiakkaastamme suosittelisi Alinaa tuttavilleen, ja työtyytyväisyytemme sai arvosanaksi 4,39/5 vuonna 2025.Alina on osa **Norlandiaa**, joka tarjoaa innovatiivisia ja monipuolisia hyvinvointi- ja terveyspalveluita kaikille vauvasta vaariin sekä nelijalkaisille ystävillemme. Suomessa Norlandian toimintoihin kuuluvat hoivakodit YHDESSÄ palvelukortteleissa, Tampereella sijaitseva potilashotelli, Norlandia Päiväkodit ja Aberia.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing solutions for the most demanding environments. Our technology detects the earliest signs of failure in critical assets – from high-voltage energy infrastructure to subsea and defense applications – and gives our customers precise, real-time data they can act on.

As Senior Product Marketing Manager you will build a deep understanding of the end-to-end solutions (hardware and software) across all of Underwater Security (our OptiBarrier and OptiArray product lines and our software platform), and of the markets and customers they serve. You turn that understanding into clear positioning, compelling value propositions and go-to-market plans that help our sales teams win.

Optics11 is in its scale-up phase, and product marketing in Underwater Security is starting from a basic level. You will build the product marketing function from the ground up: you set up the frameworks, processes and tools it needs, while delivering tangible commercial results along the way. You start as an individual contributor, with the opportunity to grow a small product marketing team over time.

You will be part of the Product team in Underwater Security and work closely with our solutions Product Managers for hardware and software, Sales, Business Development, Marketing, Application Engineering, Customer Projects and R&D teams.

No two weeks will look the same. You might analyze a competitor’s new seabed monitoring system, sharpen the value proposition for an anti-submarine warfare (ASW) tender, work on the launch of a new software release, train the sales team on a new product narrative, or help prepare a customer demo for a tradeshow such as UDT or Euronaval. You will own how our products are positioned, launched and sold in the market, support pricing decisions, and make sure your market insights support Optics11 product decision making.

Within your first 6–12 months, you will have evolved the foundations of product marketing in Underwater Security: clearly defined target segments and buyer personas, a positioning and messaging framework per product line, a competitive intelligence baseline, a repeatable launch process and a first sales enablement toolkit. Your work will sharpen our market focus, improve our win rate and help Optics11 scale its solutions commercially in demanding, high-stakes markets. 

Responsibilities:

  • Build the product marketing function by setting up the frameworks, processes, templates and tools for positioning, launches, competitive intelligence, sales enablement and product marketing analytics, tracking pipeline contribution and win rates, and scaling them as the organization grows.

  • Define target markets and commercialization plans by analyzing market size, trends, buying contexts and customer needs across mission profiles such as anti-submarine warfare (ASW), intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (ISR) and critical underwater infrastructure (CUI) protection, prioritizing segments and use cases with Product Management and Business Development, and defining go-to-market approaches, channels and partnerships per segment (e.g. with prime contractors and system integrators).

  • Lead competitive intelligence and market monitoring by tracking competitors, technologies, programs and tenders, running win/loss analyses, and sharing actionable insights with Product Management to shape strategy, roadmap and business cases.

  • Own product positioning, messaging and value propositions by developing clear, differentiated propositions per product line and segment, and translating technical capabilities into operational and commercial value for defense partners and clients.

  • Support Product Management on pricing and packaging by providing market, competitor and customer insights for pricing decisions on products and end-to-end solutions, and aligning price positioning with Sales.

  • Plan and execute product launches by introducing a launch process scaled to the size of each release, coordinating launch readiness across Product, Sales and Support, and providing product messaging, content and launch input to the Marketing team.

  • Enable sales and ensure commercial readiness by creating sales narratives, pitch decks, battlecards, objection handling and training, preparing customer demos, collateral and tender input with Tech Sales & Bid Management and Application Engineering, and supporting Sales, Business Development and Marketing in key opportunities, tenders and trade shows.


Requirements:

  • Master’s degree in marketing, business or engineering.

  • 5+ years of experience in product marketing for technical B2B or B2G solutions, preferably combining hardware and software (platform) products in defense or another industrial high-tech / high-compliance environment with long, complex sales cycles such as tenders and partner-led sales.

  • Proven experience building product marketing from the ground up in a scale-up: hands-on, pragmatic and entrepreneurial, setting up processes, frameworks and tools with limited resources while delivering results.

  • Demonstrable experience in defining value propositions, positioning and go-to-market plans, and executing them through launches and sales enablement.

  • Ability to quickly understand complex technology and translate it into clear, credible customer value.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills at operational and management level.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, capable of presenting to technical, commercial and executive audiences.

  • Proficiency in CRM and marketing automation tools such as HubSpot, and in analytics for funnel and performance reporting.

  • Willingness to travel, including to customers and international trade shows; driver’s license B (or international equivalent).

  • Ability to pass a background / security screening by the Dutch AIVD/MIVD, as you will be working with clients in the defense industry.

Nice to Have :

  • Experience in ASW, ISR or CUI-related defense technology markets, or with underwater acoustics, is a big plus.

  • Experience with defense procurement, tenders and export-controlled products.

  • Understanding of pricing and packaging for hardware, software and recurring-revenue (license or subscription) models.

  • Experience working with prime contractors and system integrators.

  • Proficiency in tools such as Jira Product Discovery, Confluence, Miro, PowerBI.

  • Proficiency in Dutch language is a plus

Screening

You will work with clients in the defense and security sectors. Obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD, the Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service, is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. We will explain the process and guide you through the applicable requirements.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Towed Array Solutions)
jobs.description:
Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing systems for the most demanding environments. Our technology detects the earliest signs of failure in critical assets – from high-voltage energy infrastructure to subsea and defense applications – and gives our customers precise, real-time data they can act on. 

As Senior Product Manager Towed Array Solutions you join our towed array product group as its second Product Manager, as we expand the team to keep pace with our current growth. You will initially focus on the Submarine and Special Warfare Support Vessel (SSV) domain, working closely with the Product Manager UxV, and build a deep understanding of the towed array systems and solutions we supply to our defense partners and clients, and of the anti-submarine warfare (ASW) and intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (ISR) missions they support.

You are responsible, from a product point of view, for bringing towed array solutions for your domain to market end to end from the in-water array to dry-end interrogator hardware, edge processing and integration on the host platform. You own the product strategy, roadmap and lifecycle for your domain within the shared towed array roadmap and shape the end-to-end solution together with the Product Manager UxV Solutions and the Senior Product Manager Software Solutions, who owns the software and platform capabilities that support it. You apply and further strengthen our product discovery and delivery ways of working for your domain.

You will be part of the Product team in Underwater Security and work closely with the Product Managers for UxV, Software, OptiBarrier and Deployment Solutions, Product Marketing, System Architecture, R&D, Engineering, Data Science, Sales, Customer Projects and Application Engineering teams.

Within your first 6–12 months, you will have defined a clear, evidence-based SSV strategy and roadmap aligned with the overall towed array roadmap, assumed full Product ownership of SSV-related programs, and aligned hardware, software and commercial teams on the most important capabilities. Your work will expand our capacity to serve customers and programs in parallel, reduce uncertainty and strengthen investment decisions, helping Optics11 bring scalable, commercially strong solutions to customers operating in demanding, high-stakes defense environments.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the SSV domain strategy by defining the direction for towed array solutions in your domain, aligned with the overall towed array product group strategy, identifying customer problems and market opportunities, and balancing near-term opportunities with long-term company goals.

  • Lead customer and market discovery by developing a deep understanding of operational use cases, mission profiles and buying contexts, validating direction with navies, primes, partners and system integrators, and synthesizing feedback from trials and deployed systems.

  • Own the SSV roadmap and end-to-end solution definition within the shared towed array roadmap by defining the capabilities required to address validated needs, balancing improvements, new functionality and technology evolution, and aligning software and platform requirements with the Senior Product Manager Software.

  • Provide product design authority by ensuring hardware concepts, architecture choices and development decisions remain aligned with the Underwater Security product vision and strategy throughout the product lifecycle, together with System Architecture team.

  • Develop business cases and commercial input by defining success measures, commercial objectives and pricing for your domain, providing evidence for portfolio investment decisions, and working with Product Marketing on market insights, positioning, value propositions and launch readiness.

  • Bring solutions to market end to end by driving productization, defining qualification and certification requirements at product and solution level (with Systems Engineering and System Architects defining them at engineering level), integration on host platforms and market introduction, including service and through-life support concepts together with Customer Projects and Application Engineering.

  • Coordinate the product core team by working with Systems Engineering on requirements and feasibility, Product Ownership and Technical Project Managers on executable increments, and Project Management on customer integrations and delivery; align priorities, platform choices and shared components with the Product Manager UxV; and align Sales, Business Development, Customer Projects and Engineering around progress, quality and outcomes to ensure we deliver on our roadmap commitments.


Requirements:

  • Master’s degree in engineering (e.g. electrical, mechanical, physics or acoustics), product development or a related technical field.

  • 5+ years of experience in hardware product management, with a proven track record of bringing hardware-based systems or end-to-end solutions to market in defense or another industrial high-tech / high-compliance environment.

  • Strong understanding of complex systems combining sensors, electronics and software, and of how hardware, edge processing and software platforms come together in one solution.

  • Experience with the full hardware lifecycle: from requirements and development through qualification, production and market introduction to through-life support and ILS.

  • In-depth knowledge of product management and strategy methodologies, with demonstrable experience in defining product strategy and creating complete business cases.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills at operational and management level.

  • Critical thinking, adaptability and a problem-solving mindset to creatively address user and customer pain points.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, capable of conveying product decisions and roadmaps to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Willingness to travel, including to customers and sea trials; driver’s license B (or international equivalent).

  • Ability to pass a background / security screening by the Dutch AIVD/MIVD, as you will be working with clients in the defense industry.

Nice to Have :

  • Experience with sonar, towed arrays or underwater acoustics, ideally in ASW or ISR applications, is a big plus.

  • Experience with naval surface vessel programs, ideally submarine or special warfare support missions.

  • Experience with defense procurement, naval platform integration and export-controlled products.

  • Experience with fiber optic sensing technology.

  • Proficiency in tooling such as Jira / Jira Product Discovery, Confluence, BigPicture, JAMA Connect, Siemens Polarion, Miro and PowerBI.

  • Proficiency in Dutch language is a plus.

jobs.title: Junior Account Executive
jobs.description:
We help churches develop. Behind every church are people who give their time and heart to their community, and we want to make their work easier. Our software brings administration and communication together in one platform, so there’s less time for paperwork and more time for people.

More than 10,000 churches across Europe work with ChurchDesk, and together with Hagru we’re now growing fast in the Netherlands. Our Groningen team is at the heart of that growth, and we’re looking for someone who wants to grow with it.

Is this you?
You’ve just graduated or are about to, or you have your first work experience behind you. You love talking to people, you’re curious, and you want a job where you learn fast and see the results of your work. You don’t need years of sales experience. We’ll teach you how to sell. What we’re looking for is your energy, your curiosity and your drive to grow.

About your new role

  • Open doors: You reach out to churches and congregations across the Netherlands that don’t use ChurchDesk or Hagru yet.

  • Start real conversations: You learn about their daily work, their challenges and their plans, and show them how our platform can make life easier.

  • Own the process: You guide churches from the first conversation all the way to signing, and you hand them over smoothly to onboarding.

  • Present with confidence: You present ChurchDesk to church councils, staff and volunteers, online and in person.

  • Build relationships: You become a trusted partner in the Dutch church landscape and build relationships that last.

  • Learn every day: With training in consultative selling and your own coach, you’ll quickly develop into a confident sales professional.


  • A degree (or soon one) in any field, for example business, communication, theology or social sciences, or first work experience in a people-facing role.

  • First sales or customer experience is a plus, for example from a student job, an internship or a study association, but it’s not a must.

  • You’re outgoing, enjoy talking to new people and don’t give up easily.

  • You’re structured, take ownership and like working towards clear goals.

  • Fluent Dutch and good English, plus strong communication skills in conversations and in writing.

  • A connection to church life, whether through your own church, volunteering or a student association, is a real plus.

What We Offer

  • A great start to your career: Training in consultative selling and a dedicated coach who helps you grow.

  • Real responsibility from day one in a growing international tech company.

  • Open feedback culture: We’re transparent, supportive and learn from each other.

  • 30 days of vacation, because rest matters.

  • Trust and flexibility: We focus on results, not on counting hours, with a Scandinavian focus on balance.

  • Fancy a change of scenery? Visit our offices in Copenhagen, Berlin or Oslo, with travel and expenses covered.

  • Unforgettable team experiences: company events, sailing trips in Croatia, ski trips and visits to our Berlin office.

  • A diverse team of different nationalities, ages and backgrounds, and a great office crew in Groningen.

Ready to start?
Apply with your CV. A cover letter is optional, but we’d love to hear in a few lines why you want to start your career in sales with us. We look forward to meeting you!

About ChurchDesk

At ChurchDesk, we believe that the church plays an important role in society. Our platform is used by thousands of congregations to organise their work, improve communication with members, reach more people, and unlock new ways of fundraising.
Our customers are part of one of the largest and oldest institutions in the world: the Church. It is undergoing significant change to prepare for the future — and we are here to support that transformation. For churches across Europe, it is crucial to work more efficiently and stay connected to their members and communities.

ChurchDesk has been around for more than 15 years — evolving from a startup into an international company serving customers across Europe. And we’re just getting started!

We actively live our values in our daily work:

#challenge: We challenge ourselves — and our customers — to continuously improve. We work like a professional sports team: with ambition, discipline, and strong team spirit.

#dogoodbusiness: Doing good business is a marathon, not a sprint. It requires endurance, quality, and integrity — every single day.

#jointheride: The journey matters just as much as the destination. Be part of it, celebrate successes — and have fun! We value being together, especially in the office.

jobs.title: Stage E-commerce & Influencer Marketing (NL/BE), fulltime, start januari/februari 2027
jobs.description:
Wil je zien wat jouw ideeën doen voor een merk waar jonge ouders dol op zijn? Bij Petite Amélie zie je meteen het resultaat van je werk. Je zet bijvoorbeeld een samenwerking op met een Nederlandse influencer, of je bouwt een landingspagina voor een campagne, en je ziet direct wat het oplevert. Je haalt bij ons niet alleen koffie: vanaf dag één draai je volwaardig mee in ons marketing- & e-commerceteam, met de Nederlandse en Belgische markt als jouw terrein.

Over Petite Amélie

Wij ontwerpen en produceren meubels, accessoires en speelgoed voor baby- en kinderkamers, en jonge ouders in heel Europa zijn er dol op. We groeien snel, met webshops in Nederland, België, Frankrijk, Duitsland en het Verenigd Koninkrijk. Vanuit ons kantoor in Weesp (15 minuten met de trein vanaf Amsterdam Centraal) werken we met zo’n 30 collega’s aan het merk.

Wat ga je doen?

Ons team beheert de webshops en alle online kanalen. Organische groei en sterke content staan centraal. Je kiest samen met je begeleider waar je de nadruk op legt, op basis van je leerdoelen en interesses:

  • Influencers & samenwerkingen: je zoekt passende influencers en contentmakers in Nederland en België en neemt zelf contact met ze op. Je zet samenwerkingen op, zoals productgifting, contentdeals en campagnes, en je onderhoudt de relaties.

  • Content & social: je maakt content voor Instagram, TikTok en Pinterest en doet community management.

  • Campagnes & landingspagina’s: je helpt campagnes uitvoeren en bouwt en werkt aan pagina’s die converteren.

  • Webshop & merchandising: je bepaalt mee hoe producten in de shop worden gepresenteerd.

  • SEO & CRO: je zoekt uit waarom bezoekers wel of niet kopen, en wat we daaraan kunnen verbeteren.

  • Data & onderzoek: je rapporteert over e-commerce-KPI’s en doet marktonderzoek naar nieuwe kansen.

Aan het eind van je stage heb je echte resultaten en een eigen netwerk om te laten zien, en daarmee val je bij je volgende werkgever meteen op.

Wie zoeken we?

Dit heb je echt nodig:

  • Je studeert bedrijfskunde, marketing, communicatie, economie of iets vergelijkbaars, op hbo- of wo-niveau, en je stage is onderdeel van je opleiding (met stageovereenkomst).

  • Je bent fulltime beschikbaar voor minimaal 6 maanden, vanaf januari of februari 2027.

  • Je woont in Nederland.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands, en je Engels is goed.

Dit maakt je een goede match:

  • Je pakt dingen zelf op, bent nieuwsgierig en denkt commercieel.

  • Je vindt het leuk om mensen te benaderen en relaties op te bouwen.

  • Je hebt oog voor design, interieur en esthetiek.

  • Je werkt nauwkeurig en graag samen.

Herken je jezelf niet in elk punt? Solliciteer toch. Enthousiasme en leergierigheid wegen voor ons zwaar.

Benefits

Dit bieden wij:

  • Een stagevergoeding van €650 per maand

  • Een OV-reisproduct of reiskostenvergoeding, en een laptop van de zaak

  • Persoonlijke begeleiding van een vaste begeleider uit het team

  • Praktijkervaring in de hele e-commerce-mix: influencer marketing, social, community management, merchandising, webshopbeheer, analytics, SEO en CRO

  • Een warm, enthousiast team waarin je werk echt impact heeft, en waar we successen graag samen vieren

Klaar om ons te komen versterken?

Stuur je CV en vertel ons kort wie je bent. Je kunt een motivatie schrijven, maar je mag jezelf ook voorstellen met een reel, story of een ander creatief format. Dat vinden we leuk, maar het is niet verplicht.

Zo verloopt het: binnen een week hoor je van ons. Daarna volgt een (video)kennismaking met je toekomstige begeleider, en je hoort snel of je in januari of februari kunt starten.
