jobs.title: PYP Coordinator & Concept-Based Inquiry Instructional Leader
jobs.description: Are you an experienced PYP educator who is passionate about concept-based inquiry, collaborative professional learning and helping teachers strengthen their practice?The International School of Helsinki is seeking a dedicated and collaborative **PYP Coordinator & Concept-Based Inquiry Instructional Leader** to join our vibrant IB World School.This is a full-time, permanent position combining PYP programme coordination with hands-on instructional coaching. Working in partnership with the PYP Directors, the successful candidate will support the ongoing development of the Primary Years Programme while working alongside teachers to strengthen high-quality, inclusive and inquiry-driven teaching and learning.The role offers an opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to curriculum development, teacher professional growth and student learning within a collaborative international school community.**Key Responsibilities Include:**- Coordinate and support the implementation, review and ongoing development of the IB Primary Years Programme, in partnership with the PYP Directors and in alignment with IB philosophy, standards and practices. - Serve as the school's PYP liaison with the International Baccalaureate, coordinating programme communications, documentation, evaluation processes and follow-up. - Facilitate the ongoing development of the Programme of Inquiry, curriculum documentation and collaborative planning processes, strengthening conceptual progression, curriculum coherence and authentic transdisciplinary learning. - Coordinate and support the planning and implementation of the PYP Exhibition, promoting student inquiry, agency, reflection and meaningful action. - Plan and facilitate professional learning and parent workshops in collaboration with the PYP Directors, responding to programme priorities and the needs of teachers and families. - Work alongside teachers through instructional coaching, collaborative planning, classroom observation, co-teaching, modelling and reflective professional dialogue. - Support teachers at different stages of their PYP journey through differentiated coaching approaches that foster trust, professional curiosity, reflection and continuous growth. - Strengthen concept-based and inquiry-driven teaching and learning, supporting teachers in developing conceptual understanding, purposeful inquiry, student agency, intentional teaching and responsive differentiation. - Collaborate with homeroom and specialist teachers to develop authentic transdisciplinary connections while respecting the integrity of individual disciplines. - Support the development of effective assessment practices, including success criteria, formative assessment, student reflection, feedback and the use of evidence to inform teaching and learning. - Promote inclusive and multilingual approaches to teaching and learning that recognise and value students' diverse identities, languages, experiences and needs. - Partner and collaborate with the PYP Directors, MYP and DP Instructional Leaders and teaching teams to identify shared pedagogical priorities, coordinate professional learning and support coherent approaches to curriculum, instruction and assessment across the PYP and beyond. - Uphold the school's commitment to student wellbeing, child protection and safeguarding, following all relevant policies and reporting procedures. **What We Offer**This role provides meaningful opportunities to impact quality of learning, collaboration and contribution within a vibrant international learning community. At ISH, our values of Care, Curiosity, Courage and Connection shape how we learn, work and grow together. We offer competitive compensation, professional development opportunities and a supportive environment where colleagues are encouraged to collaborate, inquire, take initiative and contribute to our shared commitment to high-quality teaching and learning.**Salary:**Compensation is determined by qualification and years of relevant experience, aligned with the ISH Teachers Salary scale + leadership stipend. For candidates meeting the minimum qualification with 5 years experience, the monthly salary is 4600 €.**Qualifications & Experience**- A recognised teaching qualification and a university degree in elementary or primary education, or a closely related field. - A minimum of five years of successful teaching experience within the IB Primary Years Programme. - Demonstrated expertise in concept-based and inquiry-driven teaching and learning, with a strong understanding of PYP curriculum, assessment and programme requirements. - Experience in PYP programme coordination, curriculum development, collaborative planning and facilitating professional learning. - Demonstrated ability to coach, guide and support colleagues through modelling effective practice, co-teaching, feedback and reflective professional dialogue. - Strong interpersonal, communication and organisational skills, with the ability to build trusting, collaborative professional relationships. - Understanding of multilingual development and experience supporting students learning in second or additional languages. - Experience working within international school communities, with strong intercultural awareness and a commitment to inclusion and diversity. - Excellent spoken and written English. - Preferred experience using Toddle to support collaborative planning, curriculum documentation, assessment and reporting is desirable. - A reflective, flexible and collaborative approach, with the initiative and commitment to contribute positively to ongoing school improvement. **Child Protection & Safeguarding** ISH is committed to the highest standards of safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people. Successful candidates will be asked to sign the schools Child Safeguarding Code of Conduct, and will need to pass background checks, including police clearance and reference verification.**Employment Start Date**- August, 2027

jobs.title: Arts met maatschappelijke impact

Ben jij arts en op zoek naar een maatschappelijk relevante rol waarin je de mens achter de diagnose centraal stelt? Dan is dit misschien wel iets voor jou? In deze functie combineer je medische expertise met advisering over werk, participatie en levenskwaliteit. Je werkt in een vast ritme, zonder wachtdiensten, met ruimte voor verdieping, samenwerking en ontwikkeling.

Als arts ondersteun je mensen die geconfronteerd worden met ziekte of beperking. Je helpt hen – vanuit medische en maatschappelijke invalshoeken – om opnieuw richting te geven aan hun leven en werk. Je onderzoekt in hoeverre iemand (weer) kan deelnemen aan het arbeidsproces en formuleert onderbouwd verslag dat recht doet aan de individuele situatie én aan de maatschappelijke kaders.

Je werkt multidisciplinair samen met collega-artsen, verpleegkundigen, arbeidsdeskundigen en andere professionals. Je leert kijken naar mogelijkheden in plaats van beperkingen. Daarbij leg je verbanden tussen medische problematiek, werkomstandigheden, sociale factoren en wet- en regelgeving.

Wat deze functie uniek maakt

  • Breed en afwisselend werkveld: je beoordeelt cliënten met uiteenlopende aandoeningen en achtergronden.

  • Tijd en diepgang: je hebt voldoende tijd per casus en werkt niet onder productiedruk.

  • Maatschappelijke impact: je draagt bij aan duurzame re-integratie en rechtvaardige inzet van publieke middelen.

  • Opleiding & ontwikkeling: je volgt een interne basisopleiding in het vak arbeid en gezondheid, met mogelijkheid tot specialisatie (vervolgopleiding wordt gefinancierd)

  • Empathisch

Chauffeur\-euse \- Collecte textile
===================================

La Coordination Textile Genevoise (CTG) est une association à but non lucratif réunissant quatre organisations caritatives : Caritas, la Croix\-Rouge genevoise, le Centre Social Protestant et Emmaüs Genève. Avec plus de 350 conteneurs et 2'300 tonnes de textiles collectées chaque année, la CTG contribue au développement d'une économie circulaire à Genève. Dans le cadre de l'internalisation de ses activités de collecte, elle recherche un·e :

**Chauffeur·euse – Collecte textile (80\-100 %)**
----------------------------------------------------

### **Votre mission**

Rattaché·e au responsable logistique et opérations, vous participez quotidiennement à la collecte des textiles usagés dans les conteneurs répartis sur l’ensemble du canton de Genève. Vous assurez la conduite du véhicule utilitaire dans le respect des règles de sécurité routière et, en collaboration avec votre binôme, la collecte et la manutention des sacs de textiles, ainsi que leur acheminement vers les points de déchargement. Vous participez au suivi des itinéraires et des données de collecte à l’aide d’une application mobile. Vous veillez au bon déroulement des tournées et à la qualité du service rendu. En fonction de vos compétences et des besoins opérationnels, vous pourrez également être amené·e à participer à des interventions d’entretien et de maintenance du réseau de conteneurs.

### **Vos principales tâches**

* Transport : conduire le véhicule utilitaire dans le respect du code de la route et des règles de sécurité.
* Collecte et manutention : vider les conteneurs, charger et décharger les sacs de textiles.
* Suivi des tournées : respecter les itinéraires planifiés en coordination avec votre binôme et contribuer au suivi des collectes à l’aide d’une application mobile.
* Entretien et sécurité : veiller au bon état du véhicule, des conteneurs et du matériel, ainsi qu’à la propreté des emplacements, et signaler toute anomalie.
* Travail d'équipe : collaborer avec votre binôme et respecter les procédures de travail et de sécurité.
* Missions complémentaires : selon vos compétences et les besoins du service, participer à l'entretien, à la réparation et au déplacement des conteneurs, ainsi qu'à certaines tâches de coordination opérationnelle.


### **Votre profil**

* Permis de conduire de catégorie B valable en Suisse et expérience dans la conduite de véhicules utilitaires, notamment en milieu urbain.
* Une expérience dans la collecte, la livraison, la logistique ou la manutention est souhaitée.
* Bonne condition physique permettant une manutention régulière et répétée.
* Maîtrise du français à l’oral et à l’écrit (niveau B1 minimum requis).
* Aisance avec les outils numériques (smartphone, application de suivi des tournées).
* Ponctualité, fiabilité, autonomie et sens des responsabilités.
* Esprit d'équipe, rigueur et respect des consignes de sécurité.
* Intérêt pour une activité à impact social et environnemental.
* Des compétences pratiques en entretien ou en maintenance constituent un atout.


### **Conditions du poste**

Nous vous proposons un poste de terrain au sein d'une association engagée dans le réemploi et la valorisation des textiles, avec une activité concrète au service de l'économie circulaire genevoise.

* Lieu de travail : Plan\-les\-Ouates (GE), tournées dans tout le canton.
* Organisation : travail principalement en binôme, du lundi au vendredi.
* Taux d'activité : 80\-100 %.
* Contrat : durée maximale (CDMax) d'un an, potentiellement renouvelable.
* Entrée en fonction : dès le 1er mars 2027\.
* Délai de candidature : 9 décembre 2026\.


La CTG s'engage en faveur de l'égalité des chances et de l'inclusion. Intéressé·e ? Nous nous réjouissons de recevoir votre dossier de candidature (CV, lettre de motivation, certificats de travail et attestations de formation) exclusivement via Jobup.

jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Domain Architect Finance &amp; Supply Chain--- Domain Architect Finance \& Supply Chain========================================vVARDIS is a Swiss\-based oral health company founded by Dr. Haley and Dr. Goly Abivardi, dentists, innovators, and award\-winning entrepreneurs. vVARDIS is the result of a combined 30 years of dental and entrepreneurial experience, and 20 years of laboratory and clinical research paired with the creative vision of its founders. At vVARDIS, we are committed to delivering innovative solutions that enhance oral health and well\-being, inspired by the vision of our founders to foster preventive rather than reparative dentistry. At the heart of our Company lies its patented, revolutionary biomimetic peptide technology. Scientifically proven in over 200 publications, this unique technology can treat early caries through enamel regeneration, offering a non\-invasive, pain\-free solution for patients of all ages. Our portfolio includes oral health products for dental professionals, patients, and consumers, all based on our proprietary technology.We value our people and believe in fostering a positive and collaborative work environment, grounded in our core values of innovation, excellence, integrity, and empathy.We are located in Zug, Switzerland, with operations in Europe and the US. Join us on this exciting journey. **Purpose:**As Domain Architect Finance \& Supply Chain, you will own the design and governance of our ERP landscape across Finance and Supply Chain. You will translate business needs into scalable, compliant solutions, challenge designs where needed, and ensure changes meet both operational and regulatory requirements. Working across Finance, Supply Chain, QA/RA, IT and external partners, you will help build an ERP environment that is reliable, controlled and ready to scale with vVARDIS.**Key responsibilities*** Own the ERP requirements. Turn what Finance and Supply Chain ask for into clear, prioritized requirements with acceptance criteria, and say no when a request would break a control or the design.* Act as the design authority. Every change from a partner, developer or internal team passes your review before it goes live.* Get Finance, Supply Chain, QA/RA (Quality Assurance / Regulatory Affairs) and IT to agree on one target design and roadmap.* Steer our implementation partners: scope, estimates, change requests and delivery quality. Accept work against criteria, not against effort spent.* Own SOX (Sarbanes\-Oxley) IT general controls in the ERP: change management, segregation of duties in security roles, and key reports finance can rely on.* Keep GxP\-relevant ( Practice regulations) processes validated. Take a risk\-based approach under GAMP 5 ( Automated Manufacturing Practice) with records that meet EU GMP ( Manufacturing Practice) Annex 11 and FDA 21 CFR Part 11\.* Make sure Microsoft’s mandatory service updates go through regression testing without weeks of manual revalidation.**Required Qualifications \& Experience*** You have led D365 Finance and Supply Chain, or a comparable ERP, as an architect, solution lead or lead consultant, and have defended at least one SOX or GxP audit.* You know Finance and Supply Chain processes well enough to challenge a partner’s design, from purchase to payment and from receiving goods to the close.* You can spot a change that runs without errors but posts to the wrong ledger account or bypasses an approval.* You write requirements a partner can’t misread, and acceptance criteria they can’t argue with.* You can hand an inspector the validation evidence for any change in minutes, because the process produced it, not because someone assembled it for the audit.* You use AI tools in your daily work, for example to analyse requirements, review configuration or draft test cases, and know where they need a human check.* You can tell a partner their estimate is wrong without starting a war.* You work fluently in English.**Key Competencies / Soft Skills*** Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives, processes and deadlines while maintaining alignment with other dependencies on priorities and expected deliverables* Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to documentation and record\-keeping, with ownership of the accuracy and completeness of work* Clear and concise written and verbal communication, with strong listening skills and the ability to clarify requirements and expectations before proceeding* Openness to feedback, with the ability to translate it into practical improvements and adapt working methods when needed* A diplomatic and collaborative approach to cross\-functional work, with the ability to influence without direct authority and follow up effectively with process owners* Proactive and able to work independently, while recognizing when to seek guidance, flag risks, or escalate issues* Sound judgment and a constructive approach to problem\-solving, with the ability to consider different perspectives, raise concerns, and follow through on agreed decisions and actions* An analytical mindset, with the ability to interpret data and translate it into meaningful metrics and actionable insights* Adaptability to changing priorities and business or regulatory requirements, while maintaining quality and a continuous improvement mindset**Your Personality*** You like order. A vague requirement or a change without test evidence bothers you until it’s fixed.* You own outcomes, not tasks. When a partner delivers the wrong thing, you fix the process that let it happen, not just the ticket.* You’re structured without being bureaucratic. A control has to protect something real, or you argue to remove it.* You hold your position with a partner, the CFO or QA when the evidence supports you, and you change it when it doesn’t.* You learn fast and enjoy it, whether it’s a new regulation, a Microsoft release or a process you’ve never seen.* You know your work ends up in a product patients use and in numbers the auditors sign. That’s why you do it right, not why you’re nervous about it.**Apply**No cover letter. Send one page about an ERP change you steered from request to go\-live. Tell us how you defined and accepted it, which control or validation step you built in, and how you handled a change or design that presented a compliance or audit risk.![vVARDIS AG]()* vVARDIS AG  Gubelstrasse 24  6300 Zug*jidc6017f9jm jit1147jm jiy26jm

jobs.title: Macro Commodities Options Strategist
jobs.description: OverviewBalyasny Asset Management (BAM) is seeking a highly sophisticated, buy-side-proven Options Strategist to join a macro portfolio management team based in Switzerland.ResponsibilitiesTrade Execution: Partner directly with the Portfolio Manager to translate high-conviction macro, commodity, and equity views into highly efficient options and derivatives structures. Experience executing sector baskets & determining optimal trade structures (e.g., spreads, outrights) to maximize capital efficiency and convexity.Greeks Optimization: Systematically monitor and manage the portfolio's options-specific risks, with a rigorous focus on theta bleed/decay, volatility surface dynamics, and trade timing.Downside & Tail-Hedging: Design, implement, and run robust tail-hedging and downside-protection frameworks. Ensure the portfolio is structurally insulated against tail risk, correlation breakdowns, and extreme market shocks.Portfolio Construction: Proactively identify and monitor "blind spots" within the book, including hidden factor exposures, correlation breakdowns under stress, and liquidity gaps across various market regimes.Drawdown Management: Formulate and manage drawdown mitigation processes, ensuring the net directionality of the book is dynamically adjusted and protected during periods of heightened volatility or performance drawdowns.Cross-Asset Market Trade Idea Generation: Help generated high quality, high conviction trade ideas across sectors and asset classes; Equities, Commodities, and FX to identify relative-value & directional opportunities.RequirementsOptions & Volatility Expertise: An exceptional understanding of option pricing, volatility dynamics, and derivatives structures. While cross-asset options experience is highly preferred (specifically straddling Equities, Commodities, and Precious Metals), we are open to specialists from any asset class who demonstrate world-class derivatives expertise.Seasoned Buy-Side Experience: The ideal candidate must possess significant, battle-tested hedge fund or proprietary trading firm experience. You must have lived through multiple market cycles, navigated severe drawdowns, and structurally managed risk in real-world, high-stress environments.Portfolio Construction & Risk Analytics: Strong quantitative capabilities with the ability to model complex, multi-asset portfolios, identify liquidity gaps, and stress-test assets during correlation breakdown periods.PM Collaboration: Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills. You must be able to challenge assumptions, present complex risk trade-offs to the Portfolio Manager, and work hand-in-hand to optimize the book's risk-reward profile.Education: A degree in Finance, Mathematics, Economics, Accounting or a related discipline; or advanced degree a plusLocation: Ideally based in, or willing to relocate to Zug or Geneva, Switzerland.What We OfferCompetitive compensation, inclusive of performance-based bonuses.Comprehensive benefits package.Pathways for professional growth and career development.A dynamic and supportive work environment where innovation and creativity are encouraged.Opportunity to be part of building a great business where your efforts are recognized and valued.

jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Fund Operations Specialist (Alternative Investments) 80-100%--- Fund Operations Specialist (Alternative Investments) 80\-100%=============================================================**About PG3**PG3 AG is the family office of the Partners Group founders and was established in 2013\. As a FINMA regulated asset manager, we manage a range of niche investment strategies for our founders and investors. We focus on uncorrelated returns which ensure material diversification both in terms of underlying sectors and investment structures. **About the role**PG3 AG is looking for a **Fund Operations Specialist (Alternative Investments)**to join our Fund Operations team in Baar, ZG (Switzerland), on an 80\-100% basis. In this role, you will take ownership of the accounting and fund administration of a diverse portfolio of investment products throughout their lifecycle. Your responsibilities will include supporting fund launches, restructurings and wind\-downs, as well as overseeing ongoing accounting, NAV preparation, financial reporting and operational monitoring. You will work closely with internal teams and external service providers to ensure accurate seamless execution and high stakeholder satisfaction. The Fund Operations team manages a broad mandate across alternative (insurance finance, legal finance, royalty finance) and traditional asset classes, including equities and credit. You will be part of a collaborative and entrepreneurial environment, contributing to both strategic and operational initiatives. Key Responsibilities: * Support day\-to\-day financial administration and accounting of investment funds and related entities including all fund transactions (subscriptions, redemptions, capital calls, distributions, loans and FX transactions).* Review and reconcile quarterly NAV calculations, including cash balances, investment positions, financial transactions and management and performance fee calculations.* Coordinate with external fund administrators, AIFMs, custodians, banks, auditors and other service providers in reconciling portfolio and cash flows of investment positions.* Monitor fund liquidity, cash flows, loans and settlement processes.* Maintain accurate fund records, transaction documentation, and operational databases.* Coordinate annual auditsand liaise with external auditors, fund administrators, and other service providers on accounting\-related matters, providing supporting documentation.* Assist with new fund launches, restructurings, investments, disposals and liquidations.* Support the onboarding and ongoing administration of investors, assisting with periodic KYC refreshes, FATCA/CRS reporting and other compliance\-related information requests.* Execution of investment reporting with precision and timeliness* Provide support across our middle\- and back\-office functions.* Application of regulatory and legal knowledge in daily operations **About you**We are looking for a proactive, detail\-oriented self\-starter who thrives in a dynamic and multicultural environment. You should be motivated by high standards, eager to take ownership, and comfortable navigating complexity. Ideally, you bring: * University degree (or equivalent qualification) in business administration, finance or economics* At least 2 years of relevant experience in fund accounting, fund administration, asset management, accounting or financial advisory* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities within tight deadlines* A collaborative mindset with a willingness to go the extra mile* Exhibit accuracy, efficiency, independence, and a strong sense of responsibility* Excellent communication skills in English ( is a plus)* A keen interest in alternative investments and exposure to the full investment lifecycle Please submit your complete application, including a CV, cover letter, relevant certificates, and references. ![PG3 AG]()* PG3 AG  Unternehmer\- 3  6340 Baar*jid83909c0jm jit1147jm jiy26jm

jobs.title: Senior System Engineer
jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Senior System Engineer--- Senior System Engineer======================Senior System Engineer (80–100 %)-----------------------------------Bei exaSys betreust du unsere KMU\-Kunden gemeinsam mit deinen Kolleginnen und Kollegen. Ihr plant die Einsätze vor Ort, bereitet Installationen vor und unterstützt euch bei komplexen Störungen. Bei ausgewählten Kunden übernimmst du den technischen Lead.### Deine Aufgaben* Du besprichst mit dem Kunden, welche Änderungen anstehen und was Vorrang hat. Kundeneinsätze und Wartungsfenster stimmst du mit ihm und dem Operations\-Team ab.* Du besuchst Kunden vor Ort, installierst Arbeitsplätze, Server und Netzwerkgeräte und begleitest Migrationen bis zur Übergabe an die Anwender.* Viele unserer Kunden betreiben Windows Server mit eigener Active\-Directory\-Domäne. Du administrierst Domänencontroller, pflegst Gruppenrichtlinien und stellst Anwendungen über Remote Desktop Services (RDS) bereit. In hybriden Umgebungen betreust du auch die Anbindung des lokalen Active Directory an Microsoft 365\.* Du virtualisierst Server mit Proxmox, konfigurierst OPNsense\- und pfSense\-Firewalls und verbindest Standorte per VPN. Je nach Kundenbedarf setzt du weitere Open\-Source\-Lösungen ein.* Du setzt vorgegebene Sicherheitsmassnahmen um, etwa Netzwerksegmentierung, Mehrfaktor\-Authentifizierung und Endpoint\-Schutz. Anschliessend prüfst und dokumentierst du die Umsetzung.* Bei Störungen grenzt du mit deinen Kolleginnen und Kollegen die Ursache ein. Du hältst den Kunden auf dem Laufenden und dokumentierst die Lösung für das Team.### Das bringst du mit* Eine Informatikausbildung oder vergleichbare Praxis sowie mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in der technischen Betreuung von KMU\-Kunden.* Du hast fundierte Praxiserfahrung mit Windows Server, Active Directory, Gruppenrichtlinien und RDS. Auch mit DNS, DHCP, Virtualisierung, Firewalls, VLANs und VPNs kennst du dich aus.* Ein sicheres, verbindliches Auftreten. Auch bei einem Ausfall bleibst du ruhig und erklärst der Geschäftsleitung wie den Anwendern verständlich, was als Nächstes passiert.* Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse.* Du bist mindestens 30 Jahre alt. Für Kundeneinsätze sind ein Führerausweis der Kategorie B und ein eigenes Auto zwingend.### Von Vorteil* Praktische Erfahrung mit Proxmox VE, OPNsense oder pfSense. Erfahrung mit Linux, weiteren Open\-Source\-Lösungen oder der Automatisierung mit PowerShell oder Ansible ist ebenfalls willkommen.### Das bieten wir dir* Du hast kurze Entscheidungswege und kannst dich bei der einer passenden Lösung direkt mit unseren Technikern und Entwicklern austauschen.* Wir betreiben eigene Rechenzentren. Auch das BGP\-Routing und die Vergabe von IP\-Adressen liegen bei uns. Wenn dich der Rechenzentrumsbetrieb interessiert, kannst du dort an Projekten mitarbeiten.* Sechs Wochen Ferien, flexible Arbeitszeiten, eine grosszügige Spesenregelung und Parkplätze am Standort Wolfhausen.![exaSys AG]()* exaSys AG  Lochrütistrasse 18  8633 Wolfhausen*jid8a4a867jm jit1147jm jiy26jm

Un/une Expert comptable, directeur /directrice de succursale
============================================================

### Introduction

A‑CAP RH est un cabinet suisse de conseil RH basé en Suisse romande, spécialisé dans le recrutement, le conseil stratégique, la médiation et la gestion des conflits. Nous avons le plaisir d'accompagner notre client dans le cadre de sa recherche d' un/une Expert comptable, directeur/directrice de succursale pour piloter une activité comptable et assurer son développement.

### Vos responsabilités

Vous prenez en charge la direction de la succursale, de la qualité des prestations comptables à la relation avec les clients et les parties prenantes. Vous combinez expertise technique, responsabilité opérationnelle et leadership entrepreneurial.

* Superviser la tenue de la comptabilité, les clôtures, les comptes annuels et les déclarations fiscales afin de garantir des informations financières fiables et conformes aux exigences applicables.
* Conseiller les clients sur leur organisation financière, leurs obligations comptables et leurs décisions de gestion afin de leur apporter des solutions adaptées.
* Contrôler les processus comptables et mettre en place des méthodes de travail efficaces afin d’améliorer la qualité, la fiabilité et la rentabilité des prestations.
* Coordonner les activités de la succursale et collaborer avec les interlocuteurs internes et externes afin d’assurer une exécution fluide des mandats.
* Diriger et développer l’équipe de la succursale, en répartissant les responsabilités, en accompagnant la progression professionnelle et en favorisant un haut niveau de performance.
* Manager l'équipe, renforcer l'esprit d'équipe et fidélisation des collaborateurs
* Piloter les objectifs commerciaux et financiers de la succursale, suivre les budgets et les résultats afin de soutenir une croissance durable.
* Développer les relations avec les clients, les partenaires et les autres parties prenantes afin de renforcer la présence de la succursale et d’identifier de nouvelles opportunités.


### Votre profil:

Nous recherchons une personne capable d’allier maîtrise de la comptabilité, vision de direction et sens du service. Votre profil vous permet de prendre des décisions, de structurer les activités et de représenter la succursale avec assurance.

jobs.title: AML Manager
jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: AML Manager---AML Manager===========  **Description**   **LGT Group**, a private wealth management group owned by the Princely House of Liechtenstein, is present in more than 20 locations throughout Europe, , America and the Middle East, employing approximately 3,000 people. **LGT Fund Managers (Ireland) Limited** provides fund administration services to mainly private equity funds and currently employs over 50 people.The Company is seeking to appoint a highly motivated, Dublin\-based AML Manager with responsibility for operational delivery, stakeholder management, change ownership and team management. The AML Manager will oversee the daily operational deliverables of the Dublin AML team and work closely with their peer in our Luxembourg office to ensure alignment and consistent quality of service. This is an exciting opportunity to lead a growing team of 10 employees, reporting directly to the local Head of Unit. The role is critical to ensuring the effective delivery of AML operational activities, including investor onboarding, periodic reviews, screening, transaction monitoring and associated financial crime controls across the business.Induction training will be provided, in addition to compulsory AML/KYC training and optional development opportunities. Additional role\-specific training will be delivered in\-house by peers, the line manager and senior management.  **specification**:*       **Operational Delivery**: Ensure strong control environment across investor onboarding, periodic reviews, screening, transaction monitoring and other tasks. Act as check for all relevant tasks;*       **Leadership \& Team Development**: Manage and coach direct reports, build the leadership pipeline, and implement structured training and knowledge\-sharing initiatives. Oversee performance reviews and manage team capacity, resource allocation and succession planning to support delivery of operational and strategic objectives.;*       **Client \& Stakeholder Management**: Act as a senior escalation point for team matters, maintain service levels and client satisfaction, and partner with stakeholders on roadmap initiatives;*       **Audits \& Inspections**: Support ad hoc and planned reviews by regulators, internal audit, compliance testing, ISAE 3402 and other assurance activities.*       **Process Improvement**: Identify and deliver improvements with regard to workflow design, technology and automation;*       **Risk Management and Ownership**: Manage and control risks within the AML unit. Contribute to updates for AML procedures, checklists and process documents;*       **Education**: Stay up to date with AML regulations, industry developments and best practices;*       **Governance**: Prepare and present management information where required. **Requirements***      Business\-related third\-level qualification;*      8\-10 years' experience in fund administration, investor onboarding and financial crime compliance;*      Experience leading AML teams, managing complex escalations and cases;*      Completed professional qualification, such as LCI, CAMS, Professional Certificate in Financial Crime Prevention, Professional Certificate in Digital Risk, AML and Financial Crime Prevention, or equivalent;*      Proven experience leading teams of 5 or more people;*      Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills;*      Central Bank of Ireland inspection and/or audit experience preferred but not necessary;*      Client\-facing experience;*      Change management experience. **Benefits**:*       **Hybrid Working Arrangement**: Following successful completion of the probation period, you will work three days per week in the office with colleagues and have the option to work two days per week from home;*       **Generous Employees Benefits Package**: performance related bonus plan, pension plan, life assurance, long term illness benefit, on\-site gym, subsidised lunches;*       **Professional Development**: Your professional and personal development is important to us. We offer internal and external training aligned with business needs, with opportunities to further develop or English language skills where relevant;*       **Diverse Culture**: A culture of mutual respect, teamwork and appreciation awaits you at LGT Capital Partners, where you can make a meaningful impact;*       **Commitment to ESG**: Our long\-term perspective is shaped by the values of the Princely Family. Sustainability is central to how we act in business and in private life,and has been a key focus since 2002;*      We are proud to be owned by the Princely Family of Liechtenstein, and our successful company is strongly inspired by their entrepreneurial approach. **Contact Information**  If you are interested in becoming an integral part of a successful alternative investment management team in an international, multicultural working environment we will be pleased to get to know you soon.  For further information please contact us.Human ResourcesLGT Fund Managers (Ireland) Ltd.Contact: ![LGT Capital Partners AG]()*** ![LGT Capital Partners AG]()***jidc3f9637jm jit1147jm jiy26jm

jobs.title: Legal Counsel
jobs.description: Legal CounselPurpose of the role Serve as the primary legal advisor to VAT’s global Supply Chain and Procurement organization, providing pragmatic and commercially focused legal support across the entire supplier relationship lifecycle. The role supports VAT in securing reliable, competitive and legally robust supply arrangements while identifying and managing contractual, commercial and compliance risks. It acts as a business partner to Supply Chain, enabling commercially sound decisions rather than merely providing contract review.Responsibilities:  *  Act as the primary Legal &amp; Compliance contact for Global Supply Chain Management and Procurement, providing pragmatic and commercially focused advice across the supplier relationship lifecycle  *  Draft, review and negotiate international supply-chain contracts, including master supply agreements, purchasing terms, long-term and capacity agreements, consignment and inventory arrangements, tooling, logistics, services, development agreements and NDAs  *  Advise on key contractual and commercial matters, including pricing, forecasts, volume and purchase commitments, capacity, delivery, lead times, quality, warranty, liability, indemnities, intellectual property, termination and continuity of supply  *  Support strategic sourcing, supplier selection, dual-sourcing, localization, outsourcing and other strategic Supply Chain initiatives  *  Advise on critical supplier situations and manage related claims and disputes, including shortages, capacity constraints, price increases, delivery failures, quality issues, supplier distress, breach notices, contractual remedies, settlements and termination  *  Protect VAT’s intellectual property, know-how, drawings, specifications, tooling, equipment and materials, and advise on relevant supply-chain compliance matters, including anti-corruption, competition law, sanctions and export controls, responsible sourcing and supplier compliance requirements  *  Develop and maintain standard agreements, contractual fallback positions and procurement playbooks, and provide practical contracting training to Supply Chain and ProcurementQualifications:   *  Law degree from a recognized university; bar admission is an advantage  *  Ideally 5–8+ years of relevant legal experience gained in-house and/or with a commercial law firm  *  Strong experience in international B2B commercial contracts, supplier negotiations and cross-border matters  *  Experience supporting Procurement, Supply Chain, Manufacturing or Operations  *  Experience in the semiconductor, semiconductor equipment, advanced manufacturing, machinery, automotive or comparable technology industry is strongly preferred  *  Good understanding of contractual intellectual-property protection; experience with complex supplier disputes and critical supply situations is an advantage  *  Fluent English and German with excellent drafting and negotiation skills; other languages are advantageousKey Competencies:  *  Strong commercial judgment and ability to balance legal risk with operational and business requirements  *  Excellent negotiation and contract-drafting skills  *  Pragmatic, solution-oriented and able to provide clear recommendations under time pressure  *  Strong ownership and ability to independently lead complex supplier matters  *  Ability to build trusted relationships with Procurement, Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering and Quality  *  Comfortable operating in an international, cross-functional and technology-driven environment; high ethical standards and integritySuccess in the RoleSuccess means that Legal is recognized as a proactive Supply Chain business partner that helps VAT secure supply, protect its technology and commercial interests, manage supplier risks early and establish robust, scalable contractual standards across the global supplier base.

jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Director, Global Alliances - Biosimilars &amp; Biologics (m/f/d)--- Director, Global Alliances \- Biosimilars \& Biologics (m/f/d)==============================================================At Abbott, we're committed to helping people live their best possible life through the power of health. For more than 125 years, we've brought new products and technologies to the world in nutrition, diagnostics, medical devices and branded generic pharmaceuticals that create more possibilities for more people at all stages of life. Today, 114,000 of us are working to help people live not just longer, but better, in the more than 160 countries we serve. Abbott’s Established Pharmaceuticals Division (EPD) is looking to recruit a **Director, Global Alliances \- Biosimilars \& Biologics (m/f/d)**------------------------------------------------------------------ *Based at the EPD HQ in Basel, Switzerland* **Primary Function:** Lead the strategic management of Global Biosimilars \& Biologics alliances with EPD licensing partners, serving as the primary interface to ensure strong collaboration, effective governance, and successful execution of supply and commercialization agreements across global EPD markets. Support the identification and negotiation of new licensing opportunities that enhance the biosimilars pipeline and advance the EPD Biologics growth strategy. Responsible for maximizing partnership value, managing alliance performance, and coordinating cross\-functional efforts to deliver business objectives and contractual commitments. **Core Responsibilities** Alliance Management \& Strategic Partnerships* Serve as the primary relationship manager and executive point of contact for strategic biologics/biosimilars, ensuring effective communication, alignment, and collaboration across all relevant functions within EPD and partner organizations.* Build, maintain, and expand strategic alliances with external partners to maximize the value of existing licensing agreements and support long\-term portfolio expansion across global EPD markets.* Establish robust governance frameworks with partners, including regular business reviews, joint steering committees, and performance monitoring to ensure successful execution of partnership objectives.* Lead the management of partner relationships, proactively identifying opportunities, mitigating risks, and resolving issues to ensure sustainable and mutually beneficial collaborations. Business Development \& Licensing* Provide leadership in alliance management, business development, and partnership strategy to support the growth objectives of the EPD Global Biologics portfolio.* Support the execution of the Global Biologics strategy by identifying, evaluating, and engaging high\-quality developers and partners, and by negotiating and executing licensing agreements in collaboration with License \& Acquisitions (L\&A) and other key stakeholders.* Identify unmet business needs and portfolio gaps that can be addressed through strategic partnerships, licensing opportunities, acquisitions, or other external collaborations.* Lead and support partner evaluations, due diligence activities, business case development, and internal approval processes for licensing\-in opportunities.* Identify and execute new business development opportunities by coordinating cross\-functional requirements, business case submissions, governance approvals, and contract negotiations. Portfolio Growth \& Commercial Execution* Drive the expansion of the Global Biologics portfolio by securing partnerships that strengthen the pipeline and support EPD's long\-term Biologics growth strategy.* Develop and maintain strategic sourcing partnerships across Europe, , , Latin America, and other key regions to ensure sustainable access to Biologics and Biosimilars.* Define and implement annual business plans with strategic partners to support country and regional growth objectives, product launches, and portfolio optimization.* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure successful execution of all licensing, supply, commercialization, and development agreements. Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Governance* Lead coordination across global, regional, and local functions to ensure alignment on partnership priorities, contractual commitments, and business objectives.* Drive continuous improvement and optimization of partnership agreements by identifying opportunities for enhanced commercial value, operational efficiency, and strategic collaboration.* Partner closely with Commercial, Supply Chain, Regulatory, Medical, Finance, Legal, and Market Access teams to ensure seamless execution of alliance objectives.* Ensure internal stakeholders remain aligned throughout the lifecycle of each partnership, facilitating effective decision\-making and issue resolution. Financial \& Operational Performance* Lead commercial and supply negotiations with partners to secure competitive pricing and sustainable business terms while maximizing partnership value.* Monitor alliance performance against contractual obligations, financial targets, and strategic objectives, ensuring timely identification and resolution of issues.* Ensure successful end\-to\-end execution of partnership agreements through structured relationship management and performance tracking.* Maintain awareness of external industry, market, regulatory, and competitive developments that may impact partnership strategies and business opportunities. Executive Communication \& Reporting* Provide regular updates to senior leadership on alliance performance, business development opportunities, pipeline progress, strategic risks, and key partnership initiatives.* Develop executive\-level recommendations and action plans to support decision\-making and maximize the value of strategic partnerships.* Ensure transparent communication and stakeholder engagement throughout all stages of business development, licensing, and alliance management activities. Launch \& Execution Support* Collaborate closely with Global NPI Launch / teams and Portfolio team to ensure organizational readiness and smooth execution of licensing and commercialization agreements.* Support the resolution of operational, commercial, and strategic challenges that may arise during the implementation and lifecycle management of partnerships. **Supervisory/Management Responsibilities*** The position is directly responsible for the Global Alliance Manager Biosimilars* The position also supports different functions within EPD and the partner to ensure the strategic and tactical activities are accomplished. Key internal functions where this position must coordinate are, but not only limited to: Commercial, Marketing, Market access, I\&D, Operations, L\&A, Regulatory, Medical, and Legal IP **Position Accountability/Scope*** Accountability to maintain relations with key partners in Europe, LATAM, and Asian countries, counted of \+5 companies **Profile Requirements** **Education*** A degree in Business Administration, Marketing/ , or similar. **Experience \& Skills*** 10\+ years of industry experience, preferably within a Business Development role or related commercial function.* Strong negotiation and influencing skills, with the ability to perform effectively in a fast\-paced, high\-pressure environment; willingness to travel frequently.* Proven track record of successfully negotiating strategic partnerships and managing alliances, with demonstrated success in driving transactions through to deal closure.* Knowledge of the biosimilar and biologics market landscape, including key industry stakeholders and potential partners, would be considered a strong advantage.* Fluency in English is required; proficiency in Spanish would be an advantage. Follow your career aspirations to Abbott for diverse opportunities with a company that can help you build your future and live your best life. Abbott is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to employee diversity.Connect with us at , on Facebook at and on X @AbbottNews and @AbbottGlobal.![Abbott AG]()* Abbott AG  Hegenheimermattweg 127  4123 Allschwil*jid70c32e1jm jit1147jm jiy26jm

jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Global Associate Director, Patient Strategy &amp; Partnerships--- Global Associate Director, Patient Strategy \& Partnerships===========================================================Description**Global Associate Director, Patient Strategy \& Partnerships** **Abbott \| Established Pharmaceuticals Division** **Make a Meaningful Difference for Patients Worldwide** At **Abbott**, we believe people can live fuller lives through better health. Every day, our medicines and technologies help millions of people around the world manage health conditions, overcome barriers to care, and achieve better outcomes. Within our **Branded Generics** business, we provide trusted, high\-quality medicines to more than 18 million people daily across Latin America, \-Pacific, , and other emerging markets. Our portfolio spans areas including **Women's Health, Gastroenterology, Cardiometabolic Health, CNS \& Pain, and Respiratory Care**, helping address some of healthcare's most pressing needs. We are looking for a collaborative, purpose\-driven leader to help strengthen the voice of patients across our organization and create meaningful partnerships that improve patient experiences and outcomes globally.**About the Opportunity** As **Global Associate Director, Patient Strategy \& Partnerships**, you will play a key role in shaping how Abbott listens to, learns from, and collaborates with patients and patient organizations around the world.This is a unique opportunity to build and evolve a global patient engagement capability, connecting patient insights with strategic decision making across Medical Affairs, Market Access, Regulatory Affairs, Public Affairs, and Commercial teams. You will work with colleagues across regions and functions to ensure patient perspectives help inform healthcare solutions, policy discussions, evidence generation, and access initiatives. Most importantly, you will help create lasting partnerships that improve outcomes for patients and communities. **What You'll Do** **Shape Abbott's Global Patient Strategy*** Develop and advance a patient\-centered engagement strategy across the organization* Help integrate patient perspectives into business, medical, and access decisions* Advise senior stakeholders on evolving patient needs, healthcare trends, and opportunities to improve patient experiences* Promote patient trust as a cornerstone of responsible healthcare leadership **Build Meaningful Partnerships*** Develop and nurture relationships with patient organizations, advocacy groups, and patient leaders* Create long\-term collaborations around education, support programs, evidence generation, and healthcare improvement initiatives* trust\-based partnerships that create shared value for patients and healthcare systems **Bring Patient Insights into Action*** Establish approaches to gather and translate patient insights into meaningful recommendations* Partner with Medical Affairs and Market Access teams to ensure patient experiences inform evidence generation and value\-based initiatives* Help strengthen understanding of real\-world patient challenges and outcomes **Support Advocacy and Healthcare System Improvement*** Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders on patient\-centered policy and advocacy initiatives* Contribute to discussions that improve access to care and reduce barriers to treatment* Help elevate the patient voice within healthcare ecosystems globally **Drive Excellence and Capability Building*** Develop frameworks, guidance, and best practices for patient engagement across Abbott* patient\-centered ways of working across teams and regions* Support colleagues in building capabilities and confidence in patient partnership approaches **Act as an Ambassador for Patient\-Centered Healthcare*** Represent Abbott at industry meetings, scientific congresses, and patient advocacy forums* Help strengthen Abbott's reputation as a trusted partner within the patient community* Share insights and best practices that advance patient engagement across the broader healthcare landscape **What You'll Bring** We're interested in individuals who are passionate about improving patient outcomes and building collaborative partnerships. You may be a great fit if you bring a combination of the following:* 5\+ years of relevant experience in Patient Engagement, 10\+ years of leadership experience in Medical Affairs, Market Access, Public Affairs, Advocacy or related healthcare disciplines.* Strong experience in oncology, biologics/biosimilars, policy, HTA and external stakeholder engagement. Demonstrated success influencing complex global organizations and external healthcare ecosystems.* Proven track record in external stakeholder management and partnership building.* Experience in complex matrixed global health care organizations.* Excellent communication, storytelling, facilitation, and executive presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex contexts into simple messages* Fluency in English required; additional languages are a plus. **Additional experience in oncology, biosimilars, health policy, HTA, or healthcare advocacy is valued but not essential.****Why Abbott?** At Abbott, you'll have the opportunity to:* Help shape a growing global patient engagement capability* Build partnerships that genuinely improve patients' lives* Collaborate with colleagues across countries, cultures, and disciplines* Work for a company committed to inclusion, diversity, and purpose\-driven innovation* Grow your career while making a meaningful impact on healthcare worldwide **Interested?**If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply, even if your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed. We recognize that great candidates bring diverse experiences, perspectives, and career journeys, and we'd love to learn more about yours.![Abbott AG]()* Abbott AG  Hegenheimermattweg 127  4123 Allschwil*jid3260872jm jit1147jm jiy26jm

Project Manager IT – Infrastructure \& Cloud
==============================================

### Qui sommes\-nous ?

INGINIA est un intégrateur suisse spécialisé dans les infrastructures IT, le Cloud et la cybersécurité.

Nous accompagnons nos clients dans la transformation, la modernisation et l'exploitation de leurs systèmes d'information, à travers cinq domaines d'expertise :

* Managed Services
* Data Center \& Infrastructure
* Cloud
* Cybersecurity
* Consulting \& Audits


Entreprise à taille humaine, nous privilégions l'expertise technique, la proximité avec nos clients et la qualité des services délivrés.

Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités, nous recherchons un **Project Manager IT** pour piloter nos projets d'infrastructure et accompagner nos clients dans leurs transformations technologiques.

### Votre mission

En tant que Project Manager IT, vous êtes responsable de la planification, de la coordination et de la bonne exécution des projets confiés à INGINIA.

Vous intervenez sur des projets variés : déploiement d'infrastructures Datacenter, modernisation des environnements IT, migrations Cloud, virtualisation, réseaux et cybersécurité.

Véritable chef d'orchestre, vous assurez la coordination entre nos clients, nos équipes d'ingénierie, nos partenaires technologiques et notre direction.

**Votre objectif : livrer des projets de qualité, dans les délais et les budgets convenus, tout en garantissant la satisfaction de nos clients et la rentabilité des prestations.**

### Vos responsabilités

**Gestion et pilotage des projets**

* Prendre en charge les projets dès leur lancement et jusqu'à leur clôture.
* Définir les périmètres, livrables, plannings, budgets et jalons.
* Élaborer et maintenir les plans projets et tableaux de bord.
* Identifier les risques, anticiper les difficultés et proposer des mesures correctives.
* Assurer le suivi régulier de l'avancement et le respect des engagements contractuels.
* Piloter plusieurs projets simultanément en maintenant une vision claire des priorités.
* Organiser les phases de recette, de validation et de clôture des projets.


**Coordination des ressources et des équipes techniques**

* Coordonner les interventions des ingénieurs et des partenaires externes.
* Définir les besoins en ressources en collaboration avec la Direction Opérationnelle.
* Organiser et suivre les activités techniques nécessaires à la réalisation des projets.
* Veiller au respect des standards techniques et des processus internes.
* Collaborer avec le CTO pour les choix d'architecture et les validations techniques.
* Garantir une transmission structurée des environnements livrés vers les équipes de Services Managés (Build to Run).


**Relation client et communication**

* Être l'interlocuteur principal du client durant toutes les phases du projet.
* Organiser et animer les séances de lancement, de coordination et de suivi.
* Rédiger les procès\-verbaux, comptes rendus et rapports d'avancement.
* Communiquer de manière transparente et proactive sur les délais, les risques et les éventuelles difficultés.
* Gérer les attentes des clients et maîtriser les évolutions du périmètre contractuel.
* Entretenir une relation de confiance avec les interlocuteurs techniques et décisionnels.


**Suivi financier et rentabilité**

* Assurer le suivi des budgets, des coûts et des marges de chaque projet.
* Contrôler les heures consommées et les comparer aux estimations initiales.
* Identifier rapidement les écarts budgétaires et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives.
* Gérer les demandes de changement de périmètre et leurs impacts financiers.
* Collaborer avec l'administration pour le suivi de la facturation et des jalons contractuels.

### Vos compétences

Vous vous reconnaissez dans les qualités suivantes :

Vous maîtrisez parfaitement le français et disposez d'un bon niveau d'anglais professionnel, à l'oral comme à l'écrit.

La connaissance de l'allemand constitue un atout.

### Ce que nous vous offrons

Ingénieur Systèmes Microsoft – Core Engineering (L2/L3\)
============================================================

### Qui sommes\-nous ?

INGINIA est un intégrateur suisse spécialisé dans les infrastructures IT, le Cloud et la cybersécurité.

Nous accompagnons nos clients dans la transformation, la modernisation et l'exploitation de leurs systèmes d'information, à travers cinq domaines d'expertise :

* Managed Services
* Data Center \& Infrastructure
* Cloud
* Cybersecurity
* Consulting \& Audits


Entreprise à taille humaine, nous privilégions l'expertise technique, la proximité avec nos clients et la qualité des services délivrés.

Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités de Services Managés, nous recherchons plusieurs nouveaux talents pour renforcer notre équipe **Core Engineering**.

### Votre mission

En tant qu'Ingénieur Systèmes Microsoft, vous intégrez notre équipe Core Engineering et intervenez sur des infrastructures critiques et des environnements clients variés.

Votre rôle couvre deux domaines complémentaires :

**BUILD – Projets et intégration**

* Participer à la conception et à la réalisation de projets d'infrastructure Microsoft.
* Déployer, configurer et migrer des environnements Windows Server, Active Directory et Microsoft 365\.
* Réaliser des projets de virtualisation, de consolidation et de modernisation des infrastructures.
* Participer aux évolutions d'architecture et aux migrations de plateformes.
* Assurer la mise en production, les tests de validation et la documentation technique.
* Garantir une transition structurée des projets vers les équipes d'exploitation.


**RUN – Exploitation et support avancé L2/L3**

* Assurer le support technique avancé sur les infrastructures de nos clients.
* Prendre en charge les incidents complexes escaladés par le ServiceDesk et l'Operations Control.
* Diagnostiquer les dysfonctionnements, identifier leurs causes racines et mettre en œuvre des solutions durables.
* Réaliser les opérations de maintenance, de patching et les changements d'infrastructure.
* Participer à l'amélioration de la disponibilité, des performances et de la sécurité des environnements.
* Contribuer à la standardisation des infrastructures et à l'amélioration continue de nos services.
* Maintenir une documentation technique rigoureuse et partager vos connaissances avec les autres équipes.


### Votre profil

Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme d'ingénieur, d'un Bachelor en informatique, d'un CFC d'informaticien ou d'une formation équivalente.

Vous justifiez idéalement d'au moins **3 à 5 ans d'expérience** dans l'administration et l'ingénierie de systèmes Microsoft, avec une expérience significative dans des environnements de production.

Vous appréciez autant la réalisation de projets techniques que la résolution d'incidents complexes.

Vous êtes autonome, rigoureux et capable d'intervenir sur des infrastructures critiques, tout en privilégiant le travail d'équipe et la satisfaction client.

### Vos compétences techniques

**Environnement Microsoft – Compétences essentielles**

* Excellente maîtrise de Windows Server et de ses principaux rôles et services.
* Administration et troubleshooting Active Directory (AD DS), GPO, DNS et DHCP.
* Bonne maîtrise de Microsoft Entra ID, des identités hybrides et des mécanismes d'authentification.
* Connaissance des infrastructures PKI, des certificats et des services RADIUS/NPS.
* Administration de Microsoft 365 et des environnements hybrides.
* Connaissances d'Exchange Online et des mécanismes de messagerie.
* Administration et maintenance de bases de données Microsoft SQL Server : installation, configuration, sauvegardes, restauration et notions de performance.
* Bonnes connaissances de PowerShell pour l'administration et l'automatisation des tâches.


**Virtualisation et infrastructures Datacenter**

* Expérience pratique sur au moins une des plateformes de virtualisation suivantes :VMware vSphere / ESXi / Proxmox VE / Vates XCP\-ng / Xen Orchestra/ Huawei DCS / Microsoft Hyper\-V
* Compréhension des architectures de virtualisation, de haute disponibilité et de stockage partagé.
* Expérience des migrations de machines virtuelles et des évolutions de plateformes.
* Connaissance des technologies de stockage SAN/NAS et des protocoles iSCSI, NFS et Fibre Channel.


**Citrix – Virtualisation des postes et applications**

* Connaissance des environnements Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops.
* Compréhension des architectures VDI et VDA (Virtual Desktop / Virtual Desktop\&App).
* Administration et troubleshooting des infrastructures Citrix.
* Connaissance des composants Delivery Controller, StoreFront, VDA et des mécanismes de publication des applications et desktops.


**Sauvegarde, disponibilité et sécurité**

* Bonne compréhension des stratégies de sauvegarde et de restauration des systèmes.
* Expérience avec des solutions de sauvegarde telles que Veeam, Vinchin ou équivalentes.
* Connaissance des mécanismes de haute disponibilité et de Disaster Recovery.
* Maîtrise des bonnes pratiques de sécurisation et de durcissement des environnements Windows.
* Compréhension des principes de gestion des vulnérabilités, de patch management et de protection des identités.


**Réseaux – Connaissances transversales**

* Bonne compréhension des protocoles TCP/IP, VLAN, routage, DNS et DHCP.
* Capacité à diagnostiquer des problèmes de connectivité réseau.
* Connaissance des principes de firewalling, VPN et segmentation réseau.


Une expertise avancée en routing/switching n'est pas requise pour ce poste.

### Compétences complémentaires appréciées

Les expériences suivantes constituent des atouts supplémentaires :

* Microsoft Azure et architectures hybrides.
* Microsoft Intune et gestion des postes de travail.
* Microsoft Defender for Endpoint et solutions de sécurité Microsoft.
* Automatisation par PowerShell, scripting ou Infrastructure as Code.
* Supervision et monitoring des infrastructures.
* Expérience dans un environnement MSP (Managed Services Provider) ou chez un intégrateur IT.
* Participation à des projets de migration d'infrastructures ou de consolidation de Datacenters.
* Certifications Microsoft, VMware, Citrix ou équivalentes.


### Vos qualités personnelles

Au\-delà de vos compétences techniques, nous recherchons avant tout un collaborateur fiable, engagé et appréciant le travail collectif.

Vous vous reconnaissez dans les qualités suivantes :

* **Autonomie et responsabilité :** vous savez prendre en charge une problématique technique et la mener jusqu'à sa résolution.
* **Esprit d'analyse :** vous cherchez à comprendre les causes des incidents plutôt qu'à simplement en traiter les symptômes.
* **Rigueur :** vous accordez de l'importance à la qualité des interventions, à la documentation et au respect des procédures.
* **Esprit d'équipe :** vous partagez vos connaissances et contribuez à la progression collective.
* **Orientation client :** vous êtes à l'aise dans les échanges avec les clients et savez communiquer clairement sur des sujets techniques.
* **Stabilité et gestion des priorités :** vous savez garder votre calme et travailler méthodiquement, même dans des situations exigeantes.
* **Curiosité technique :** vous aimez apprendre et découvrir de nouvelles technologies.


Vous maîtrisez le français et disposez d'un bon niveau d'anglais technique, à l'oral comme à l'écrit.

### Ce que nous vous offrons

* Une activité technique variée, associant projets d'infrastructure et exploitation avancée.
* Des environnements clients diversifiés et des technologies de pointe.
* Une entreprise suisse à taille humaine, où vos compétences et vos propositions sont réellement prises en considération.
* Une collaboration directe avec des ingénieurs expérimentés et notre direction technique.
* Une organisation privilégiant l'autonomie, la responsabilisation et la confiance.
* Des possibilités de formation, de certification et d'évolution professionnelle.
* L'opportunité de participer activement à l'évolution de nos offres et de nos standards techniques.


### Conditions de candidature

jobs.title: Creator Marketing Lead
jobs.employer: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
jobs.description: Job DescriptionAre you passionate about creator culture, social-first content and the role creators play in shaping how brands connect with audiences? We’re looking for a Creator Marketing Lead, focusing on social and creative Strategy to help shape and elevate how we approach creator marketing across markets. In this role, you’ll combine the full scope of a Creator Marketing Lead with particular depth in social culture, creator-led marketing and creative strategy. You’ll bring a strong point of view on what makes creator content relevant, distinctive and effective, translating audience insights, cultural shifts and social behaviors into creator strategies and campaigns. You’ll work in Creator Marketing, under Creative Studios, work with local market teams and strategic functions to strengthen our creator marketing approach, ensuring our work is culturally relevant, creatively strong and connected to broader brand and business priorities.  WHAT YOU’LL DO As Creator Marketing Lead, you’ll lead creator marketing across assigned markets while championing social-first and creative strategic thinking within the wider Creator Marketing team. You’ll translate strategic priorities and audience insights into clear creator recommendations, campaign approaches and activation plans, while supporting teams in delivering high-quality creator work at scale. You will:     Shape quarterly creator marketing strategies, priorities and budget allocation across assigned markets or areas.     Work closely with markets to identify opportunities and translate them into relevant creator activation plans.     Shape creator recommendations, briefs, campaign approaches and creative direction through a social-first lens.     Bring audience insights, creator culture, platform behaviours and emerging content trends into strategic and creative decision-making.     Lead and guide Creator Marketing Specialists and Coordinators in campaign execution and delivery.     Oversee campaign execution, budget management, performance and stakeholder alignment across assigned initiatives.     Partner closely with the Creative Strategist and other strategic functions across Creative Studios to ensure creator initiatives are rooted in audience insight, cultural relevance and strong creative direction.     Ensure creator marketing initiatives connect with broader brand, creative and business objectives while remaining authentic to creators and their audiences.     Identify emerging creator, platform and cultural opportunities and translate them into actionable recommendations for the team.     Develop and evolve creator marketing best practices, frameworks and ways of working that strengthen quality and consistency across markets.     Act as a subject matter expert for social-first creator marketing, continuously helping evolve and future-proof our approach.      WHO YOU ARE We’re looking for an experienced creator marketing professional who combines strategic thinking with a strong creative instinct and a deep understanding of social culture. You understand the creator landscape beyond individual campaigns. You’re curious about how audiences behave, how creator and platform cultures evolve and why certain ideas resonate. You can turn those insights into clear strategies, creative recommendations and relevant creator activations. At the same time, you have the operational and leadership capabilities required of a Creator Marketing Lead. You’re comfortable setting direction, managing priorities and budgets, guiding teams and influencing stakeholders across functions and markets. We are looking for people with:     Extensive experience within creator or influencer marketing, with a strong track record of developing and leading creator marketing initiatives at scale.     Deep understanding of social platforms, creator culture, audience behaviours and evolving content trends.     Proven experience shaping creator strategies, campaign approaches, creative recommendations and briefs.     A strong social-first mindset and the ability to assess what makes creator content culturally relevant, authentic and effective.     Strong strategic planning and prioritisation skills, with the ability to translate insights and strategy into clear activation plans.     Experience managing budgets, priorities and performance across multiple initiatives or markets.     Excellent stakeholder management skills and confidence working across senior, cross-functional and international teams.     Experience leading, coaching or guiding specialists and coordinators in campaign delivery.     The ability to balance creative ambition, audience relevance and brand objectives with strong operational delivery.     A collaborative, curious and proactive approach, with a clear point of view and the confidence to challenge, influence and continuously raise the quality of creator marketing work. WHO WE ARE  H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. jobs.title: Digital Design Lead - Digital Journey
jobs.employer: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
jobs.description: Job DescriptionWHAT YOU’LL DO As Design Lead within Digital Journey, you will shape and manage the end-to-end customer journeys across H&M’s digital channels. You will turn customer insights, user and commercial data into a clear view of the holistic experience, shared priorities across areas and product teams, and measurable outcomes. You will connect the product, design, tech, marketing, retail tech and customer service teams that shape every step of the journey, and manage journeys as living systems.     Establish and drive the vision, goals, roadmap and priorities for customer journeys in line with H&M’s customer and business strategy.     Prioritise improvements to the customer journey and be accountable for journey maps and service blueprints developed together with relevant roles.     Combine customer feedback, research, behavioural data and commercial performance to identify pain points and opportunity spaces, and prioritise improvements with evidence.     Support the definition of journey metrics and KPIs with relevant stakeholders, linking customer outcomes to business value.     Run effective journey governance with clear roles, regular check-ins and early resolution of overlapping or conflicting initiatives.     Coordinate product, design, tech, marketing, retail tech and customer service teams so that changes across channels fit together.     Work with data and tech teams to connect data and tools, enabling continuous monitoring of journey performance.     Partner with design and research to test and iterate solutions, and with orchestration teams to deliver more personalised customer interactions.     Build journey-management capability through shared practices and clear communication.     Demonstrate the business value of journey improvements by connecting them to outcomes such as revenue, churn and repeat purchase.     Align each product team’s contribution with the holistic customer journey and support personalisation of the H&M digital experience. Work closely with Product Managers and Area Business Managers on this.  WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH You will be part of Digital Product Design and work broadly work across product, digital design, technology, marketing, retail tech, customer service, data, analytics and research. The role requires close partnership with senior stakeholders and teams across H&M to create shared direction, resolve dependencies and ensure that improvements across channels deliver one coherent customer experience. You will report to the Journey Manager and, while your organisational home is Design, your scope and collaboration will span the functions that shape the end-to-end customer journey. WHO YOU ARE We are looking for people with…     A background within in customer experience, service design or product management. Experience from other relevant disciplines, such as marketing, technology or data and analytics, is a plus, ideally within a large international organisation.     Proven experience managing end-to-end customer journeys or services across multiple channels, touchpoints and teams.      Experience building journey-management capability in organisations through coaching, training, playbooks, frameworks, practices or communities.     Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence and align product, technology, marketing and other teams without direct authority.     Hands-on experience in journey mapping and service blueprinting, ideally across both digital and physical touchpoints.     Experience combining qualitative research, journey analytics, behavioural data, commercial data and voice-of-customer insight.     Experience defining metrics that connect customer experience with business results such as revenue and churn.     Experience with journey-management tools, data integration, governance and ways of working across siloed teams in agile organisations. We will give special consideration to candidates with experience using AI tools to build, visualise and analyse journeys.     Experience building evidence-based business cases and prioritising journey pain points and opportunities. And people who are…     Customer-centric and able to balance customer needs with product and business goals.     Collaborative and influential, with the ability to create shared direction across functions and levels of seniority.     Clear and transparent communicators who use evidence to make complex topics understandable.     Curious, proactive and open to experimentation, new tools and changing ways of working.     Accountable and action-oriented, with a focus on quality, follow-through and continuous improvement.     Resourceful problem-solvers who can navigate ambiguity, resistance and competing priorities.  Additional InformationWho We AreH&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.   We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.   This role is based out of Stockholm, Sweden. For this we role are unable to provide relocation assistance or visa sponsorship. Applicants must have existing work authorization for the country in which the role is located.  Why You'll Love Working Here At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories and ARKET. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits.
