jobs.title: Researcher in Biometric Security and Anti-Fraud Technologies
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You can find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WWHqR5i1FHE&feature=youtu.beAbout the Job

The Department of Information Security and Communication Technology (IIK) at NTNU Gjøvik has a vacancy for a Researcher in Socio-Technical Fraud Systems. 

The position is for an intended period of 24 months and is part of SAFE – Secure Anti-Fraud Excellence Center, funded by Sparebankstiftelsen Hedmark and SpareBank 1 Østlandet in collaboration with NTNU and industry partners.The researcher will be a key member of WP1 and lead its socio-technical analysis of financial fraud, hosted at CCIS, NTNU Gjøvik. WP1 examines vishing and safe-account fraud and a proposed extension to investment fraud. It distinguishes technical authentication and payment confirmation from legally valid consent.

The research reconstructs how fraud unfolds across channels, while focusing detection and intervention on evidence actually visible to the bank between customer authentication and payment authorisation. Off-bank calls, screen sharing and remote-access activities are described where case sources support them, but are not assumed to be observable by the bank.

The work draws on public decisions of Finansklagenemnda, court judgments, and anonymised or otherwise lawfully accessible cases from SAFE’s banking partners. Results feed into cognitive experiments (WP2), detection research (WP3), scientific publications and a policy white paper.Center for Cyber and Information Security (CCIS) at NTNU will host the SAFE Project.Your immediate leader is head of department.

Duties of the position
  • Build a systematically coded corpus of fraud cases from public decisions and lawfully accessible bank material, using a shared template and a cross-channel timeline.
  • Develop evidence-based fraud scripts for vishing and safe-account fraud and, subject to scope confirmation, investment fraud, including interim inputs for WP2.
  • Map each fraud stage, the channels involved, signs of real-time guidance, and what is actually observable by the bank between authentication and payment authorisation.
  • Identify legitimate customer activities with similar bank-visible patterns, to support realistic false-alarm testing without using victim characteristics as automatic detection features.
  • Study intervention points and fraudster adaptation, including cases where the bank suspects fraud but the customer rejects warnings; help plan a tabletop session with a banking partner.
  • Analyse legal, ethical and governance conditions for collecting, using and sharing fraud-related signals, including privacy, bank confidentiality and interbank cooperation.
  • Examine the conditions for transaction warnings, delays, refusals and escalation, with attention to customer consent, liability and loss allocation.
  • Assess payee verification and, in investment-fraud cases, checks of providers against Finanstilsynet’s register and market warnings; distinguish these from bank-account verification.
  • Provide fraud scripts and realistic look-alike scenarios to WP2 and observability findings, intervention points and lawful-signal constraints to WP3.
  • Prepare WP1 deliverables, scientific publications and a policy white paper, and present findings to the SAFE Advisory Board and project partners.
  • Contribute, where relevant, to SAFE continuing education (EVU), project reporting and research proposal development.
Required selection criteria
  • A master’s degree (120 ECTS or equivalent) or a PhD in information security, socio-technical systems, criminology, information systems, law and technology, or a closely related field.
  • Documented experience with systematic analysis of qualitative material, such as case files, legal decisions, interviews or incident reports, using a coding scheme or structured method.
  • Knowledge of social engineering and fraud in digital channels, such as vishing, authorised push payment fraud or investment fraud.
  • Understanding of digital banking and payment processes, including authentication, payment initiation and customer interaction channels.
  • Ability to recognise legal, ethical and data-protection questions and work with relevant specialists on their implications for fraud prevention research.
  • Reading comprehension of Norwegian or another Scandinavian language sufficient to analyse Norwegian case material and legal decisions.
  • Good written and spoken English and the ability to prepare clear, well-structured research reports.
Preferred selection criteria
  • A PhD in a relevant field, or research experience after completion of the master’s degree.
  • Experience in applied research projects involving banks, financial crime specialists or regulatory and legal experts.
  • Experience in crime script analysis, situational crime prevention, socio-technical analysis, or process and threat modelling.
  • Knowledge of Norwegian or EU rules on payment services, data protection, bank confidentiality or financial crime prevention.
  • Experience in fraud prevention, anti-money laundering, compliance or incident handling in the financial sector.
  • Experience in planning and facilitating interviews, workshops or tabletop exercises with practitioners.
  • Relevant scientific publications or reports on fraud, cybercrime or socio-technical security.
  • Skills in structuring and analysing data, for example using Python, R or NVivo.
  • Spoken Norwegian or another Scandinavian language for cooperation with partner banks.
Personal characteristics
  • Highly motivated for applied and collaborative research with financial-sector partners.
  • Analytical, structured and precise in the handling of research evidence and sources.
  • Discreet and reliable in handling confidential case material and working across disciplines.
  • Self-driven, communicative and able to deliver to agreed deadlines.
  • Personal suitability will be emphasized.
We offer
  • Exciting and stimulating research tasks in a strong international academic environment
  • Active collaboration with leading industrial and research partners in Norway and abroad.
  • A professional and inclusive work environment.
  • Favorable terms in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund
  • Employee benefits at NTNU
Salary and conditions

As a researcher (code 1108/1109) you are normally paid from gross NOK 580 000– NOK 750 000 per annum before tax, depending on qualifications and seniority. As required by law, 2% of this salary will be deducted and paid into the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund.

The engagement is to be made in accordance with the regulations in force concerning State Employees and Civil Servants, and the acts relating to Control of the Export of Strategic Goods, Services and Technology. Candidates who by assessment of the application and attachment are seen to conflict with the criteria in the latter law will be prohibited from recruitment to NTNU. 

The intended appointment period is 24 months. Starting date at the latest: 1st April 2027.  Please note that loss of external funding is considered equivalent to loss of work assignments, see §19 (1) of the public Employees act. In the event of dismissal by the employer, the notice period is according to §22 (1) of the Public Employers Act. 

It is a prerequisite that you can be present at and accessible to the institution on a daily basis. After the appointment you must assume that there may be changes in the area of work.

About the application

Your application and supporting documentation must be in English. 

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in  English. 

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

If, for any reason, you have taken a career break or have had an atypical career and wish to disclose this in your application, the selection committee will take this into account, recognizing that the quantity of your research may be reduced as a result.

Your application must include:

  • Motivation letter describing your interest in SAFE and socio-technical research on financial fraud (maximum one page).
  • CV and relevant certificates.
  • Transcripts, diplomas and diploma supplements for completed degrees (BSc, MSc and, where applicable, PhD).
  • Master’s thesis or equivalent substantial research work, plus up to three other relevant scientific publications or reports.
  • A short statement (1–2 pages) explaining your experience with case-based analysis and how you would map a fraud scenario across channels, distinguish bank-visible evidence from external context, and identify legal or ethical constraints.
  • Names and contact information of at least two referees.

It is important that you both document and reflect on your competence. You are encouraged to use the NTNUs competence matrix as a guide for  documentation of your competence.

In the evaluation of which candidate is best qualified, emphasis will be placed on education, experience and personal and interpersonal qualities. Motivation, ambitions, and potential will also count in the assessment of the candidates. Open scientific practice will be recognized.

Your application will be considered by a committee at the department. Candidates of interest will be invited to an interview.

General information

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse, and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals.   

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education.  

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability, and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time. 

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. 

As an employee at NTNU, you must continually maintain and improve your professional development and be flexible regarding any organizational changes.

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you want to reserve yourself from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the reservation is not accepted.

For the sake of transparency, candidates will be given expert evaluations of their own and other candidates. As an applicant you are considered part of the process and are stipulated by rules of confidentiality. 

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Prof. Raghavendra Ramachandra, email: raghavendra.ramachandra@ntnu.no . If you have questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact HR Katrine Rennan, e-mail: katrine.rennan@ntnu.no .

Application deadline: 31.12.2026.

Gjøvik is historically an industrial city linked to its location by Lake Mjøsa. Today, the region is known for high-tech companies that supply products to the automotive industry, the defense sector and international markets, among others. NTNU collaborates with many sectors, both in the private sector and public enterprises and services in information security, technology, design, logistics and health.

The city is large enough to have an active and varied cultural offer, safe local communities with kindergartens, schools and sports. It is easy to seek out nature for activities both summer and winter. 

 

 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

NTNU - knowledge for a better world

The Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) creates knowledge for a better world and solutions that can change everyday life.

Department of Information Security and Communication Technology

Research is vital to the security of our society. We teach and conduct research in cyber security, information security, communications networks and networked services. Our areas of expertise include biometrics, cyber defence, cryptography, digital forensics, security in e-health and welfare technology, intelligent transportation systems and malware. The Department of Information Security and Communication Technology is one of seven departments in the Faculty of Information Technology and Electrical Engineering .

Les besoins des clients peuvent ainsi être rapidement transformés en solutions opérationnelles.La demande est en forte croissance. jobs.title: ZELFSTANDIG WERKENDE KOKS I
jobs.description:
Eethuis Milobi in Breda is niet zomaar een restaurant. Het is een plek waar smaak, kwaliteit en gastvrijheid samenkomen in een gezellige en dynamische omgeving. Al jarenlang verwelkomen wij gasten die op zoek zijn naar authentieke, ambachtelijke Chinese en Surinaamse gerechten met een moderne twist. Met onze focus op versheid, vakmanschap en ingrediënten van hoge kwaliteit zorgen wij ervoor dat iedere maaltijd een bijzondere beleving wordt.

In ons team staan samenwerking, respect en betrokkenheid centraal. Samen creëren wij dagelijks een warme sfeer voor onze gasten én voor elkaar. Wij zijn op zoek naar enthousiaste collega’s die, net als wij, passie hebben voor de Chinese en Surinaamse keuken en willen bijdragen aan het succes van ons restaurant.

Ben jij een gepassioneerde kok, of wil je het vak graag leren? Dan is Eethuis Milobi in Breda de perfecte plek voor jou. Of je nu al ervaring hebt in de horeca of juist de kans zoekt om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen, bij ons krijg je de ruimte om te groeien, te leren en je talenten te laten zien. Wij bieden een uitdagende werkomgeving waar geen dag hetzelfde is en waar we samen streven naar kwaliteit, gastvrijheid en uitmuntendheid. Wat neem je mee als kok? 1. Jouw taken pakket bestaat uit het verrichten van voorbereidende werkzaamheden waaronder het wassen van groente, snijden en fileren van vis, het snijden van lam en rundvlees voor het maken van verschillende gerechten met een keukenteam dat bestaat uit ongeveer 3 collega’s met aan het hoofd de chefkok, 2. Bereiden en maken van de gerechten en uitvoeren van tussentijdse kwaliteit- als hygiënische controles, 3. Gereed maken en controleren van gerechten voor uitgifte van gerechten waarna de bedieningsmedewerkers deze kan overnemen voor het plaatsen bij warmhoud rechaud, 4. Plannen van de dagelijkse werkzaamheden en bestellen van voedingsmiddelen en andere voorraadaanvullingen bij vaste leveranciers en controleren van bestelde voedingsmiddelen, 5. Toezien op de werkzaamheden van de hulpkracht(en), geven van aanwijzingen en instructies, 6. Dagelijks voor sluiting het schoonmaken van de eigen werkomgeving, keukenapparatuur en -machines en het assisteren van de eventueel aanwezige keukenhulp bij het geheel schoonmaken van de keuken als het opslaan van geleverde goederen, 7. Bijdragen aan kwaliteit en optimalisatie en aanpassing van menukaarten als het uitwerken van receptuur en bereidingsinstructies.

  • Gewenste functie-eisen zijn MBO-3 of vergelijkbare opleiding met kennis van basis kooktechniek.
  • Een goede teamspeler die zich flexibel opstelt en beschikt over goede communicatievaardigheden.

jobs.title: Principal Pre-Commissioning Engineer
jobs.description:
Location: Lysaker, Norway (with a planned move to Kongsberg)Business Unit: EMS / Engineering (I&C)Contract Duration: 6 monthsExpected Start Date: 1 December 2026Application Deadline: 20 November 2026

About the Role

Are you an experienced Pre-Commissioning Engineer with strong expertise in subsea pipelines and umbilical systems?

We are seeking a senior engineer to provide technical expertise across subsea pre-commissioning projects, tenders, studies and offshore operations. You will focus on pipeline and umbilical testing, engineering assurance and execution planning, contributing throughout the project lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and review pre-commissioning philosophies, procedures and execution strategies.

  • Lead engineering activities covering FCG, hydrotesting, leak testing, flushing, dewatering, drying and preservation.

  • Define pigging strategies, including pig selection, configuration, pressure requirements and contingency plans.

  • Specify temporary equipment requirements, including pumps, filtration units, tanks, compressors and testing equipment.

  • Review pipeline and subsea designs, subcontractor procedures, methodologies and proposed equipment spreads.

  • Develop umbilical testing procedures covering electrical, fibre-optic and hydraulic systems, including continuity, insulation resistance, OTDR and pressure testing.

  • Evaluate test results and support system acceptance and handover.

  • Coordinate technical interfaces with Umbilical, SPS, Controls, Installation and offshore teams.

  • Provide engineering support during project preparation, mobilisation and offshore execution.

  • Support vessel-based operations, troubleshoot technical issues and assess operational and test data.

  • Conduct technical reviews, risk assessments and readiness assessments.

  • Provide technical assurance for assigned scopes, review critical deliverables and support the qualification of equipment and methods.

  • Contribute to tenders and studies through execution concepts, scope definition, equipment specifications, man-hour estimates and technical evaluations.

  • Provide input on vessel selection, deck requirements, schedules and offshore duration.

  • Guide and mentor engineers while contributing to procedures, technical tools, documentation and lessons learned.

Qualifications and ExperienceMust-Have Requirements

  • BSc or MSc in Mechanical, Marine, Subsea, Offshore, Petroleum Engineering or a related discipline.

  • Relevant experience in subsea and pipeline pre-commissioning engineering.

  • Strong hands-on expertise in:

    • Flooding, Cleaning and Gauging (FCG) and pigging.

    • Hydrotesting, pressure testing and subsea leak testing.

    • Pipeline dewatering and drying.

    • Electrical, fibre-optic and hydraulic umbilical testing.

  • Experience developing offshore procedures and performing engineering calculations.

  • Experience with pre-commissioning equipment spreads, including pumps, filtration systems, compressors and testing equipment.

  • Experience across project execution and tenders/FEED.

  • Good knowledge of applicable DNV requirements and industry practices.

  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

  • Strong technical judgement, problem-solving and communication skills.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

  • 10+ years of relevant subsea and pipeline pre-commissioning experience.

  • Offshore and vessel-based pre-commissioning execution experience.

  • Experience providing technical guidance and mentoring to engineering teams.

  • Fluency in Norwegian, both written and spoken.

Sperton is a global recruitment and consulting company with offices across Europe, Asia and the Americas. We help organisations find and engage skilled professionals through flexible recruitment, consulting and global mobility solutions.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer
jobs.description:
About the position

A permanent position as Senior engineer (position code 1181) is available at The Department of Physics, University of Oslo.

Starting date as soon as possible. 

Place of work is Department of Physics at Blindern, Oslo.

Job description and work tasks

The Electronics section has seven academic positions (two full-time and five part-time) and two technical positions. The research activity is currently largely related to projects in medical technology, particularly those using methods based on impedance spectroscopy. The successful candidate may also provide technical support for new research activities in electronic components and neuromorphic electronics, especially related to electrical characterization, measurement setups, and laboratory infrastructure. 

Together with the Department of Informatics, the section is responsible for a study program in electronics, informatics, and technology. The academic staff are therefore responsible for several courses in electronics and sensor technology and also contribute to teaching basic physics courses. The section’s staff are also involved in the supervision of students at both master’s and doctoral level. 

The engineering position is intended to support both the research and teaching activities in which the section is involved. 

The tasks connected to teaching will primarily involve training and assisting master’s and PhD students in the use of specialized measuring instruments and software. 

Part of the position also involves organizing the section’s student laboratories. This includes testing of hardware and software, as well as other typical engineering tasks related to the day to-day operation of the laboratories.

What skills are important in this role?

Qualification requirements:

The minimum educational requirement is a master’s degree (or equivalent) in electronics/electrical engineering. In addition, the candidate must have experience with: 

  • Instrumentation, measurement systems, and laboratory work 
  • Impedance spectroscopy and interpretation of bioimpedance data 
  • Programming in Python and MATLAB, or equivalent 
  • Finite element modelling, e.g. COMSOL Multiphysics 
  • Good oral and written English skills

The following qualifications are strongly desirable and will be emphasized in the evaluation process: 

  • Research experience, preferably demonstrated through a PhD degree 
  • Use of various sensors for monitoring food quality, such as colorimetry, pH measurements, and NIR spectrometry 
  • Electrical characterization of semiconductor devices or other electronic components, preferably including low-current and/or pulsed measurements 
  • Automation and integration of laboratory instruments and measurement systems 
  • Technical supervision of students
What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • A service minded attitude 
  • Ability to work independently 
  • Ability to work precisely in a structured and solution-oriented manner and swiftly adapts to new tasks 
  • Good communication and collaboration skills 
  • Positive attitude and the ability to handle hectic periods 
  • Have a safety-oriented attitude

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal skills.

We can offer you
  • A pleasant and stimulating work environment
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.  A workplace with good development and career opportunities.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities
  • Salary in position as Senior Engineer, position code 1181 in salary range NOK 700 000 – 775 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2% is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund
We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We especially encourage women to apply.We hope you will apply for the position with us.

How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter with a statement of motivation
  • CV (complete overview of education and work experience)
  • Copies of educational certificates and transcript of records
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (names, relation to candidate and telephone number)

Your CV must be entered in Jobbnorge’s CV form and cannot be submitted only as an attachment. This requirement is intended to ensure correct documentation and record-keeping in accordance with the Public Administration Act, Section 15.

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.

Formal regulations

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

The research at the Department of Physics covers a broad range of subfields within physics and technology: From space research to medical physics. A good proportion of the research is interdisciplinary, and conducted in close cooperation with collaborators in Norway and abroad. Education and teaching are other essential activities. We offer a broad range of courses, and the Department is involved in several study programmes at bachelor’s and master’s level. Some of the best lecturers in Norway are amongst our employees, and we are proud of our prizewinning teaching and learning environment. The Department has 200 employees, of which 50 are permanent scientific positions. On a yearly basis 20 students complete their Ph.D. and 50 finish their M.Sc. degree.

Animé par des valeurs de Responsabilité, d'Audace, de Respect et d'Excellence, le groupe place l'expérience client au cœur de ses priorités et poursuit son développement avec l'ambition d'offrir une qualité de service constante « dans l'exceptionnel comme dans le traditionnel ». jobs.title: Bli vår nye mekaniker i Ålesund – frihet, faglige utfordringer og et rått team!
jobs.description:
Er du en dyktig mekaniker som brenner for at maskiner skal fungere 100 %, yte maksimalt og se skikkelige ut? Motiveres du av varierte dager, god tillit og friheten til å legge opp din egen hverdag slik at arbeidet flyter best mulig? Da vil du trives hos oss i Cramo.

 

Hos oss blir du ikke bare en som skrur, du får det reelle ansvaret for at utleieparken i Ålesund spiller på lag. Verkstedet og maskinparken blir ditt stolte ansvarsområde, hvor du får styre prosessene, planlegge kapasiteten og ta de faglige avgjørelsene som utgjør en forskjell. Du får en nøkkelrolle med stor handlingsfrihet, samtidig som du blir en del av et uformelt og faglig sterkt team som deler erfaringer og mener at god humor er like viktig som godt håndverk.

 

Hva tilbyr vi deg?

Vi vet at en avdeling kun fungerer bra når folk trives. Derfor legger vi alt til rette for en forutsigbar og god hverdag med lavt stressnivå, selv når det koker litt ekstra.

 

  • Stor tillit og faglig eierskap: Du får styre hverdagen din i stor grad selv og ta avgjørelser som påvirker driften direkte.
  • Et sterkt fagmiljø å sparre med: Du står aldri alene! Teamet i Ålesund, sammen med erfarne mekanikere i resten av regionen, samarbeider tett og deler gladelig av sin erfaring.
  • Gode betingelser: Konkurransedyktig lønn, attraktiv bonusordning og solid pensjons- og forsikringspakke.
  • Balanse og trivsel: Vi har fokus på trivsel og at du har det bra både på og utenfor jobb. Du får støtte til trening og én betalt frivillighetsdag i året.
  • Uformell kultur: En «klart vi kan»-holdning med rom for god humor og høyt under taket.

 

Hva innebærer rollen hos oss?

Som mekaniker hos Cramo i Ålesund tar du styringen over arbeidshverdagen. Du sørger for at maskinene våre er funksjonelle, godt vedlikeholdt og fremstår visuelt flotte for kundene våre.

 

Dine viktigste oppgaver vil være:

  • Helhetlig eierskap til maskinparken: Feilsøking, service, reparasjoner og klargjøring før, under og etter utleie.
  • Styre kapasitet og innkjøp: Du vurderer arbeidsmengden fortløpende. Ved topper, servicer eller årskontroller har du mandat til å koordinere med eksterne leverandører/mekanikere.
  • Prosess- og kostnadskontroll: Du styrer hele reparasjonsløpet fra feilsøking til registrering og kostnadsføring på serviceordre, slik at drift kan fakturere reelle reparasjonskostnader videre.
  • Verksteddrift: Holde orden i delebestillinger, optimalisere verksteddriften og redusere antall maskiner som står «nede».
  • Utrykninger og feltoppdrag: Noen dager jobber du på verkstedet, andre dager drar du ut til kunden og blir helten som løser utfordringene på stedet.

 

 

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi leter ikke etter en superhelt som kan alt fra dag en, men etter deg som brenner for mekaniker faget, liker å ha oversikt og har god teknisk forstand. Du stolt av jobben du gjør, enten du løser en kompleks feilkode eller sørger for at en maskin ser skinnende ny ut for neste kunde.

 

Det er ideelt om du har:

  • Fagbrev innen anleggs-, landbruks- eller industrimekanikk, elektro (Gr. L) eller et annet relevant mekanisk fag.
  • …men har du lang, praktisk erfaring og en "skru-hjerne" som løser det meste? Søk likevel! Hos oss veier reell kompetanse, faglig engasjement og rett innstilling veldig høyt.
  • Førerkort klasse B (har du BE eller truckførerbevis er det en fin bonus. Har du det ikke, så finner vi ut av det sammen).

  • Grunnleggende digitale ferdigheter og gode norskkunnskaper.

     

Du er en vi passe sammen med dersom du:

  • Motiveres av tillit og frihet under ansvar, og liker å ha kontroll på egne prosjekter og kostnader.
  • Trives med at det koker litt ekstra i ny og ne, men mestrer kunsten å holde hodet kaldt slik at det aldri oppleves som uoversiktlig stress.
  • Er en utpreget lagspiller som bryr seg om kollegene sine, sprer god stemning i kaffepausene og skaper en trygg, inkluderende arbeidsplass.

 

Klar for nye utfordringer?

Send oss en søknad eller ta kontakt for en uforpliktende prat om rollen! Vi gleder oss til å bli kjent med deg.

 

 

 

 

For mer informasjon eller spørsmål, kontakt oss på:

Mail: Richard.taylor@randstad.noMobil: 982 95 163

For å søke:Registrer din CV online på www.randstad.no og søk på denne stillingen.

  • Søknadsfrist - Senest 16.11.26. (Ansettelse kan bli gjort før frist)

Alle søkere vil få svar og blir kontaktet.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Cramo er et av Norges ledende utleieselskaper innen maskiner, utstyr og modulbygg for bygg, anlegg, industri og offentlig sektor. Vi har over 30 avdelinger, mer enn 300 ansatte og er sertifisert innen kvalitet, miljø og arbeidsmiljø (ISO 9001, 14001 og 45001).

Siden 2020 har Cramo vært en del av Boels Rental, en av Europas største og mest fremtidsrettede 

aktører innen utleiebransjen. Dette gir oss et solid apparat i ryggen og gode forutsetninger for videre utvikling.

I vår avdeling jobber vi målrettet for å levere de beste løsningene i markedet, med høy aktivitet, tett samarbeid med både små og store kunder, og et fremoverlent arbeidsmiljø preget av kontinuerlig utvikling og varierte arbeidsoppgaver.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Cloud Partner Integrations
jobs.description:
About the team

Most providers make customers migrate their data to them. We're doing the opposite: bringing ClickHouse Cloud into the environments our customers already trust, so their data stays useful right where it lives.

Those environments come in a few shapes. Some are major cloud data platforms that run ClickHouse as a native service, so customers get it without leaving the tool they already use. Some are BI and visualization tools that need ClickHouse to show up as a fast, first-class data source behind their dashboards. And some are developer and data platforms we connect through marketplaces and identity federation with a couple of clicks or agentic calls. Every integration is unique, but the goal is the same every time: ClickHouse should feel like a first-class citizen in every environment.

The craft is finding the patterns underneath different integrations. As one of the first backend engineers, you'll help shape the technical defaults for this team. You'll have end-to-end ownership, but you'll also work inside the constraints of platforms you don't own: thin documentation, unfamiliar deployment topologies, and timelines governed by partner approval cycles. A lot of the challenge is engineering across trust boundaries you don't fully control.

You won't be doing it alone. You'll work closely with your engineering manager, the product manager, a growing team, and experienced engineers across the broader org. If that sounds like your kind of challenge, let's talk.

What you'll do

You'll own an integration end to end: the design, the code, and the production system that keeps running after launch. The patterns you set there become defaults the rest of the team builds on.

Day to day, that looks like:

  • Owning the architecture: auth and identity flows, multi-tenancy, how data moves and where it's allowed to live, performance, and what happens in production

  • Running what you build. Which means owning the infrastructure, CI, deployment, observability behind it and on-call

  • Working on top of external platforms you can't change, and being straight about which risks are yours to manage and which aren't

  • Partnering closely with the internal teams whose services you depend on: iterating on product requirements, agreeing on interfaces and protocols, and proactively finding ways to keep moving

About you

These are the attributes of someone who will perform well in this role:

  • 8+ years building software, with a good chunk of it on data-heavy or integration-flavored systems

  • Preferably proficient in TypeScript or Go or comfortable contributing to each

  • Solid backend and systems instincts. You can reason about deployment topology, multi-tenancy, and data movement, and you're comfortable owning architectural tradeoffs you'll have to live with later

  • You've worked with modern auth protocols, service principals, and identity federation, and you know how to get it right across a trust boundary

  • You've built on someone else's platform and know what that's actually like: incomplete docs, unintended breaking changes, etc.

  • You're comfortable in ambiguity. You can ship before the spec is finished, make sensible calls under uncertainty, and flag the decisions that'll be hard to undo to your team before we bake them in.

  • You're good with other engineers. Much of the work runs through teams you don't own, and you earn their trust by how you think, not just what you commit.

  • You're mainly a backend engineer, but you're comfortable enough to touch a modern React app

  • You use AI tools well and honestly. Reach for Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or whatever helps, and be clear about where you did and didn't

  • You write well. Most of how we coordinate happens async in chats, design docs and RFCs

Nice to have

None of these are required, but any of them would be a bonus:

  • Close familiarity with a major cloud data or analytics platform ecosystem

  • Real depth in auth and identity federation, or experience building to a partner's security review, marketplace requirements or certification requirements

  • Hands-on experience designing multi-tenant SaaS platforms, or the isolation and deployment topology behind them

  • Working knowledge of ClickHouse, or another columnar / OLAP engine

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

Equal Opportunity & Privacy

ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Please see here for our Privacy Statement.

Compensation: $155K – $238K • Offers Equity • Multiple Ranges

  • US General • $155K – $215K • Offers Equity

Meillä tehdään ihan tavallisia töitä, poikkeuksellisen hyvässä tiimissä. Tavallisuus ei ole tylsää, vaan sitä arkea ja välillä myös juhlaa, mitä haluamme asiakkaillemme luoda. Myyjänä tehtäviisi kuuluu asiakaspalvelun lisäksi monipuolisesti kaupan eri työtehtävät, kuten kuorman purkaminen, kassatyöskentely ja veikkausmyynti sekä sosiaaliseen mediaan sisällön tuottaminen ja julkaisu. Työ sisältää aamu-, ilta- ja viikonlopputyötä.Tehtävät ovat vakituisia ja osa-aikaisia (vähintään keskimäärin 25 h/viikko). Voit myös halutessasi tehdä lisätyötä Osuuskauppa Maakunnan muissa yksiköissä.Etsimme joukkoomme kahta (2) reippaalla tekemisen meiningillä ja positiivisella asenteella työtään tekevää tiimityöntekijää. Kaupallinen koulutus antaa pohjan työlle, mutta ennen kaikkea arvostamme aitoa halua sekä innokkuutta oppia uutta.Osuuskauppa Maakunnassa huolehditaan työntekijöiden hyvinvoinnista ja työturvallisuudesta: Meillä on poikkeuksellisen kattavat henkilöstöedut, kuten alennukset S-ryhmän kaupoissa, ravintoloissa ja hotelleissa. Käytössäsi ovat laajat työterveyshuollon palvelut, vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutus, mahdollisuus henkilöstörahastoon sekä ePassin tuoma tuki liikuntaan, kulttuuriin ja hyvinvointiin.Panostus henkilöstön hyvinvointiin näkyy myös tunnustuksina: Osuuskauppa Maakunta on tänä vuonna palkittu Suomen Innostavimmat työpaikat -kilpailun keskisuurten yritysten sarjassa, sijoituksen perustuessa henkilökunnan työtyytyväisyyskyselyn tuloksiin.Palkka perustuu kaupan alan työehtosopimukseen ja on kokemusvuosiin perustuen 10,68–14,93€/tunti. Vuorotyössä peruspalkan päälle maksetaan ilta-, lauantai- ja sunnuntai -lisät. Meillä työryhmillä on myös mahdollisuus tulospalkkioon, joka voi olla jopa 1 €/tehty työtunti.Lisätietoja antaa marketpäällikkö Tarja Vimpari p. 01076 36528Hae pian, viimeistään 6.12.2026Osuuskauppa Maakunta on kainuulaisten asiakasomistajien omistama alueosuuskauppa. Toimialamme ovat päivittäis- ja erikoistavarakauppa, liikennekauppa sekä matkailu- ja ravitsemiskauppa. Myyntimme v. 2025 oli 265 milj. euroa ja työllistämme Kainuussa noin 500 ihmistä.

jobs.title: Gulvsliber / Floor sanding specialist
jobs.description:
SEE ENGLSIH VERSION BELOW

GulvKanonen ApS arbejder med gulvafslibning og efterbehandling af trægulve. Vi udfører mange forskellige gulvopgaver for privatekunder, og derfor sørger vi nu en ny gulvmand til vores team af dygtige medarbejdere.

Har du erfaring som gulvsliber og ønsker at arbejde i en tempofyldt virksomhed? Så er dette job lige noget for dig!

Om jobbet:

Hos GulvKanonen kommer du til at arbejder med afslibning, polering og efterbehandling af trægulve (normale efterbehandlinger , som lak, lud, olie og sæbe)

Du får stillet firmabil til rådighed og kommer typisk til at køre alene. Alle opgaver er hos private kunder og af forskellige karakter. Derfor kommer du heller ikke til at arbejde med de samme opgaver hver eneste dag.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har minimum 2 års erfaring inden for gulvafslibning

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt, struktureret og effektivt

  • Arbejdstiden er i tidsrummet 07.00-15.00

  • Har kørekort B

  • Er serviceminded og pålidelig

  • Sætter en ære i flor og veludført arbejde

Vi tilbyder:

  • God fast løn

  • Frihed under ansvar

  • En god arbejdsplads

  • Firmabil til arbejdsbrug

  • Maskiner og værktøj til arbejdsopgaver

  • Arbejdstøj

Lyder stillingen som gulvsliber interessant, eller har du spørgsmål? Så er du meget velkommen til at kontakte os på mail info@gulvkanonen.dk

Send din ansøgning og dit cv på mail og skriv "Gulvsliber" i emnefeltet. Samtaler afholdes løbende med ansættelse hurtigst muligt.

 

ENGLISH

GulvKanoen ApS works with floor sanding and finishing of wooden floors. We perform many different floor jobs for private customers, and we are now looking for a new floor sanding specialist for our team of skillede employees.

Do you have experience with floor sanding and would like to work in a busy company? Then this is the job for you!

About the job:

At GulvKanonen, you will be working with floor sanding and finishing of wooden floors (standard finishing, such as varnish, lye, oil, and soap).

A company car will be provided for you, and you will typically be driving on your own. Alle jobs take place at privat customers,, and the jobs vary much so you will not be experiencing the same jobs day after day.

We expect that you:

  • Have at least 2 years of experience with floor sanding

  • Can work independently, structured, and efficiently

  • Working hours are from 07.00-15.00

  • Have driving licence B

  • Are service-minded and dependable

  • Take pride in well-performed results

We offer:

  • A good, fixed salary

  • Freedom with reponsibility

  • A good workplace

  • Company car (work-related driving)

  • Machines and tools for all tasks

  • Work clothes

Send you application and your resume via mail and write "Floor sanding specialist" in the subject line. Interviews are conducted regularly with hiring as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Transportkoordinator
jobs.description:
Transport Coordinator

We are looking for a responsible, flexible, and service-minded Transport Coordinator to join our team in Denmark.

The position combines transport coordination, administrative duties, customer service, driving vehicles, and general vehicle management. The successful candidate must be willing to perform both office-based and practical tasks as part of daily operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan and coordinate daily transport activities, driving schedules, and driver assignments.

  • Drive company vehicles including transporting customers.

  • Handle daily communication, queries, complaints, and operational issues with customers, drivers, and ride-hailing platforms.

  • Manage driver and vehicle accounts, registrations, documentation, and follow-ups with transport platforms.

  • Handle trip-related disputes, payment issues, cancellations, and customer feedback.

  • Maintain transport records, schedules, reports, and other administrative documentation.

  • Ensure company vehicles are clean and ready for operation, including regular interior and exterior cleaning.

  • Check vehicles for general condition, cleanliness, fuel levels, and report any defects or maintenance requirements.

  • Assist with vehicle servicing, inspections, car washes, vehicle transfers, and other practical assignments.

  • Perform general administrative and operational tasks as required.

Requirements

  • Valid driving licence and good driving experience.

  • Willingness to drive company vehicles as part of daily work.

  • Good communication and customer service skills.

  • Basic computer skills and knowledge of office software.

  • Good organizational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks.

  • Maintain accounting and book log for the activities.

  • Good English communication skills. Danish is an advantage.

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

We Offer

  • Stable and professional working environment.

  • Full-time employment.

  • Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience.

  • Varied responsibilities combining administration, driving, and transport operations.

  • Opportunities for professional development.

 

Transportkoordinator

Vi søger en ansvarsbevidst, fleksibel og serviceminded transportkoordinator til vores team i Danmark.

Stillingen kombinerer transportkoordinering, administrative opgaver, kundeservice, kørsel og generel håndtering af virksomhedens køretøjer. Den rette kandidat skal være indstillet på både kontorarbejde og praktiske opgaver som en del af den daglige drift.

Arbejdsopgaver og ansvarsområder

  • Planlægning og koordinering af daglige transportopgaver, kørselsplaner og chaufførfordeling.

  • Køre erhvervsmæssig persontransport herunder transport af kunder.

  • Daglig kommunikation og håndtering af forespørgsler, klager og driftsmæssige problemer fra kunder, chauffører og kørselsplatforme.

  • Administration af chauffør- og køretøjskonti, registreringer, dokumentation og opfølgning på transportplatforme.

  • Håndtering af tvister vedrørende ture, betalingsproblemer, aflysninger og kundefeedback.

  • Vedligeholdelse af transportregistre, kørselsplaner, rapporter og anden administrativ dokumentation.

  • Sikring af, at virksomhedens biler er rene og klar til brug, herunder regelmæssig indvendig og udvendig rengøring.

  • Kontrol af bilernes generelle stand, renlighed og brændstofniveau samt rapportering af fejl og behov for vedligeholdelse.

  • Hjælp med serviceeftersyn, syn, bilvask, flytning af køretøjer og andre praktiske opgaver.

  • Vedligeholdelse af regnskabsregistreringer og kørsels- og aktivitetslog for transportaktiviteterne.

  • Udførelse af øvrige administrative og driftsmæssige opgaver efter behov.

Kvalifikationer

  • Gyldigt kørekort og god køreerfaring.

  • Villighed til at køre erhv. Persontransport som en del af det daglige arbejde.

  • Gode kommunikations- og kundeserviceevner.

  • Grundlæggende IT-færdigheder og kendskab til almindelige kontorprogrammer.

  • Gode organisatoriske evner og evne til at håndtere flere opgaver samtidigt.

  • Evne til at føre regnskabsregistreringer og aktivitetslog.

  • Gode engelskkundskaber. Dansk er en fordel.

  • Evne til at arbejde selvstændigt og som en del af et team.

Vi tilbyder

  • Et stabilt og professionelt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Fuldtidsansættelse.

  • Konkurrencedygtig løn efter kvalifikationer og erfaring.

  • En alsidig stilling med administrative opgaver, kørsel og transportdrift.

  • Muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling.

jobs.title: Electrical Project Manager for Data Center, Industrial and Building Services Projects, AINS group, Espoo
jobs.description: Welcome to AINS Group, a forward-thinking engineering and consulting company specialising in the built environment. jobs.title: Head Baker Wanted – Night Production
jobs.description:
Head Baker Wanted – Night Production

Helges Ost & Bageri ApS

We are looking for a skilled and responsible Head Baker to lead and coordinate our night-time bakery production and supervise the bakery team.

About the position

As Head Baker, you will be responsible for the daily night production, ensuring that our products meet our quality standards and that production runs efficiently and smoothly.

You will take an active part in the production while supervising and coordinating the work of other bakery employees. You will be responsible for daily task allocation, staff scheduling and ensuring that the team performs its duties correctly and efficiently.

Your responsibilities

Leading and coordinating daily night-time bakery production.

Actively participating in baking bread, rolls and other bakery products.

Supervising bakery employees and ensuring that tasks are performed correctly and according to established standards.

Planning staff schedules and coordinating shift coverage.

Distributing daily tasks and monitoring employee performance.

Training and guiding bakery employees in production methods, quality standards and daily routines.

Maintaining consistent product quality and ensuring compliance with recipes and production procedures.

Ensuring efficient workflows and timely completion of production.

Monitoring compliance with hygiene, food safety and workplace safety procedures.

Maintaining cleanliness and order in the bakery.

Reporting operational issues and staffing needs to management.

We expect you to

Be a qualified baker or have solid professional experience in bakery production.

Have experience supervising or coordinating the work of other employees.

Be capable of organising staff schedules and daily production tasks.

Have strong leadership and communication skills.

Be able to work independently and take responsibility for the daily production and team.

Have a strong focus on quality, craftsmanship and efficiency.

Be reliable, well-organised and able to work efficiently in a busy environment.

We offer

A permanent position of 37 hours per week.

A responsible, hands-on supervisory role with a high degree of independence.

Responsibility for coordinating the night production and supervising the bakery team.

Salary based on qualifications and experience.

The opportunity to become an important part of a dedicated bakery team.

Does this sound like the right opportunity for you? We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Vil du kombinere salg, kundekontakt og interesse for lastebilbransjen
jobs.description:
Den beste feilen er den som aldri oppstår. For kundene våre handler en lastebil om langt mer enn transport. Den skal starte hver dag, levere som planlagt og være på veien når kunden trenger den. Når service, kontroller eller nødvendige reparasjoner blir utsatt, kan det raskt føre til driftsstans og unødvendige kostnader.I Norsk Scania ønsker vi å være i forkant. Derfor ser vi nå etter en Account Manager, Rolling Fleet som vil bidra til å utvikle kundeoppfølgingen vår, identifisere nye salgsmuligheter og sørge for at kundene får mest mulig ut av kjøretøyene sine.Dette er en spennende mulighet for deg som trives med kundekontakt, motiveres av salg og liker å finne løsninger som skaper verdi for både kunden og Scania.Om rollenSom Account Manager Rolling Fleet får du en sentral rolle i oppfølgingen av våre eksisterende kunder og deres kjøretøy.Ved hjelp av kunde- og kjøretøydata skal du identifisere behov, se salgsmuligheter og tilby løsninger som bidrar til økt oppetid og en mer effektiv drift for kundene våre.Du vil ha tett dialog med kundene og samarbeide med våre verksteder, kundemottakere og salgsorganisasjonen for å sikre at behov blir fulgt opp og omgjort til konkrete salg og verkstedoppdrag.Dette er en spennende rolle for deg som vil kombinere salg, relasjonsbygging og interesse for transportbransjen.ArbeidsstedStillingen vil ha kontorsted ved et av våre Scania-anlegg på Østlandet. Vi er fleksible når det gjelder lokasjon, og endelig arbeidssted avtales i løpet av rekrutteringsprosessen.Hvem ser vi etter?Vi ser etter deg som trives med kundekontakt, er nysgjerrig på kundens behov og motiveres av å skape resultater.Vi tror du vil trives i rollen dersom du:
  • Liker å bruke telefonen som arbeidsverktøy og ta initiativ til kundedialog.
  • Har interesse for lastebiler, transportbransjen og kundens drift.
  • Er god til å bygge relasjoner og skape tillit.
  • Har et kommersielt blikk og ser muligheter for mersalg.
  • Jobber strukturert og samarbeider godt med andre.
  • Har konkurranseinstinkt og motiveres av å nå mål.
Du har gjerne erfaring fra salg, kundeservice, verksted eller transportbransjen. Relevant utdanning er positivt, men ikke avgjørende.For oss er motivasjonen din, evnen til å skape gode kunderelasjoner og viljen til å lære minst like viktig som hva som står på CV-en.Hva kan vi tilby deg?Hos Norsk Scania blir du en del av et solid, internasjonalt selskap med dyktige kolleger og et stort engasjement for både kunder og medarbeidere.Vi tilbyr deg:
  • En spennende og variert rolle med mulighet til å påvirke kundeopplevelsen og salgsresultatene.
  • Muligheten til å bidra til å utvikle vår kundeoppfølging.
  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte og kompetente kolleger.
  • Gode muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling.
  • Årlige sosiale sammenkomster og aktiviteter som skaper samhold og trivsel.
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser og gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger.
Klar for å bli en del av Scania?Vi ser etter deg som ikke bare ser en lastebil, men også mulighetene som ligger i å holde den på veien.Hos oss får du bruke din kommersielle teft, bygge sterke kunderelasjoner og bidra til løsninger som gjør en forskjell for kundene våre.Høres dette ut som noe for deg? Da håper vi du sender oss en søknad!Har du spørsmål om stillingen, er du velkommen til å kontakte Christoffer Hermann, regionsdirektør for Region Øst Nord, på telefon 993 32 778.Søknadsfrist: Onsdag 9. desember 2026.Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg!

Chceš byť sestra, ktorá je rešpektovaná a má hlavnú rolu v zdravotníckom tíme? Príď k nám do Domu RAFAEL, radi Ťa privítame!
Momentálne otvárame pracovné miesto pre sestry.

V Dome RAFAEL poskytujeme starostlivosť podľa charakteru ochorenia a stavu pacienta/klienta v:
- Dome ošetrovateľskej starostlivosti:
Ošetrovateľská starostlivosť a rehabilitácia na lôžku následne po pobyte v nemocnici alebo ako prevencia podpory a uchovania zdravia.
- Špecializovanom zariadení:
Celoročná starostlivosť o ľudí s demenciou, s chorobou Alzheimerovho typu, Parkinsonovou chorobou alebo neurodegeneratívnymi ochoreniami.
- Hospici:
Zdravotná starostlivosť pre pacientov v terminálnom štádiu, predchádzanie komplikáciám, zmierňovanie bolesti a utrpenia spojeného s pokročilým štádiom choroby.Výhody:Čo je u nás inak ?
- moderné, čisté a príjemné pracovné prostredie, príležitosť na osobnostný rast a sebarealizáciu,
- máme snahu vytvoriť priateľský kolektív, ktorý si bude vzájomne nápomocný.
Čo ešte ponúkame ?
- prácu na plný pracovný úväzok v 12-hodinových denných a nočných službách,
- relevantnú mesačnú mzdu, ktorá sa pohybuje mierne vyššie ako v podobných zariadeniach v Bratislave,

Čo ponúkame navyše ?
- zohľadnenie vzdelania,
- preplácanie prípadných nadčasov,
- zabezpečenie ubytovania,
- po skončení skúšobnej doby odmeny, osobné ohodnotenie, ošatné, multisport karta, masáže,
- príspevok na stravu alebo možnosť stravovať sa priamo v Dome RAFAEL,
- v rámci permanentného vzdelávania usporadúvame kreditované odborné semináre pre sestry priamo u nás v Dome RAFAEL grátis.
A ako bonus v službe chutná kávička.

jobs.title: Opatrovatelia a asistenti v zariadeniach pre staršie osoby a osoby so zdravotným postihnutím
jobs.description:
- Poskytuje prijímateľom sociálnej služby každodennú opatrovateľskú starostlivosť, praktickú podporu a primeraný dohľad podľa ich individuálnych potrieb, schopností a aktuálneho zdravotného stavu, pričom podporuje čo najvyššiu možnú mieru ich samostatnosti.
- Poskytuje pomoc, podporu alebo dohľad pri sebaobslužných činnostiach, najmä pri osobnej hygiene, starostlivosti o ústnu dutinu, vlasy a nechty, obliekaní, obúvaní, stravovaní, pitnom režime, vyprázdňovaní a používaní inkontinenčných a kompenzačných pomôcok.
- Poskytuje pomoc pri mobilite, chôdzi, vstávaní, líhaní, presunoch a polohovaní a vykonáva ďalšie opatrovateľské opatrenia v rozsahu svojej odbornej spôsobilosti, individuálnych potrieb prijímateľa a pokynov oprávneného odborného pracovníka.
- Pri poskytovaní starostlivosti volí najmenšiu potrebnú mieru pomoci; činnosť, ktorú prijímateľ nezvládne ani s primeranou podporou, vykoná v potrebnom rozsahu a prijímateľa pritom zapája podľa jeho možností, rešpektuje jeho tempo, voľbu, súkromie a dôstojnosť.
- Sleduje telesný, psychický a emočný stav prijímateľa a zmeny významné pre poskytovanie starostlivosti; závažné alebo neobvyklé zistenia bezodkladne oznamuje príslušnému odbornému zamestnancovi alebo nadriadenému a zaznamenáva ich podľa interných postupov.
- V rozsahu svojej odbornej spôsobilosti, zaškolenia, poverenia a interných postupov vykonáva alebo asistuje pri meraní základných fyziologických funkcií, podporuje dodržiavanie liečebného režimu a poskytuje pomoc pri užívaní liekov iba v rozsahu dovolenom právnymi predpismi a internými postupmi.
- Pripravuje prijímateľa na lekárske vyšetrenie a podľa potreby ho sprevádza na vyšetrenie, ošetrenie alebo inú zdravotnú službu.
- Pri bezprostrednom ohrození života alebo zdravia poskytuje prvú pomoc v rozsahu svojej odbornej prípravy, privolá odbornú pomoc alebo záchrannú zdravotnú službu a postupuje podľa interných krízových a bezpečnostných postupov.
- Podporuje prijímateľa pri bežných činnostiach spojených s vedením domácnosti, najmä pri plánovaní a realizácii nákupu, príprave a podávaní jedla, umývaní riadu, upratovaní, vetraní, starostlivosti o lôžko a bielizeň, triedení odpadu a bezpečnom používaní domácich spotrebičov; ak prijímateľ činnosť nezvládne, vykoná ju v potrebnom rozsahu.
- Zabezpečuje primeranú čistotu, hygienu, poriadok a bezpečnosť spoločných priestorov komunitnej domácnosti v rozsahu pracovných úloh a interných postupov, vrátane hygienickej manipulácie so stravou, bielizňou, riadom a opatrovateľskými pomôckami.
- Podporuje prijímateľa pri bežnom živote v komunite a podľa jeho individuálnych potrieb ho sprevádza pri nákupoch, návšteve úradov, pošty, banky, zdravotníckych zariadení, školy, práce, kultúrnych, športových, voľnočasových a iných bežných aktivitách.Výhody:- osobné príplatky
- finančný príspevok na stravu

jobs.title: Praktické sestry (zdravotnícki asistenti)
jobs.description:
Zdravotnícky asistent v zariadení opatrovateľskej služby vykonáva základné ošetrovateľské, asistentské a administratívne činnosti s uplatňovaním primárnej, sekundárnej a terciálnej prevencii. Pracovné činnosti vykonáva na zverenom úseku práce.
	Zabezpečuje plánované výkony základnej ošetrovateľskej starostlivosti v jednotlivých fázach ošetrovateľského procesu pri uspokojovaní bio - psycho – sociálnych potrieb klienta v spolupráci so sestrou. Pracuje formou pozorovania a zbierania informácií

-	Vykonáva ošetrovateľské úkony v kompetencii praktickej sestry
-	Zodpovedá za objednávanie liekov a zdravotníckych pomôcok
-	Vedie zdravotnú dokumentáciu v systéme Caresse
-	Zastupuje vedúcu zdravotného úseku v čase jej neprítomnosti
-	Zabezpečuje dodržiavanie bezpečného prostredia klienta a ochranu intimity pri poskytovaní základnej starostlivosti
-	Zabezpečuje hygienu prostredia vrátane dezinfekcie zdravotníckych pomôcok,  manipuluje s čistou a znečistenou bielizňou
-	Vykonáva prvú pomoc podľa svojich odborných schopností a zabezpečuje ďalšiu odbornú pomoc
-	Vykonáva hygienickú starostlivosť o pacienta (celkový kúpeľ, starostlivosť o ústnu dutinu, vlasy, nechta) a vykonáva starostlivosť o lôžko
-	Vykonáva činnosti na prevenciu vzniku syndrómu z imobility ( polohovanie, starostlivosť o pohybový režim pacienta) , vykonáva starostlivosť o kožu
-	Aplikuje zábaly, obklady, liečivé kúpele, aplikuje teplé a studené procedúry, lieky na kožu a telových dutín, podáva klystíry, zhotovuje bandáž dolných končatín, pripravuje obväzové materiály
-	Podáva stravu, sleduje príjem potravy a tekutín – zaznamenáva
-	zabezpečuje starostlivosť o vyprázdňovanie hrubého čreva a močového mechúra, stará sa o zavedené permanentné močové katétre, sleduje bilanciu tekutín
-	Vykonáva meranie a záznam fyziologických funkcií pacientov
-	Zaznamenáva zrealizované výkony do dokumentácie klienta
-	Plní pokyny svojho nariadeného 
-	Vykonáva manuálne činnosti v súvislosti s transportom zomretého pacienta
-	Dodržiava pracovnú disciplínu, etický kódex sestry, dôvernosť informácií v súvislosti s pracovným výkonom, hájenie prác klienta v rámci zariadenia

Hľadáme skúseného a technicky zdatného kolegu na pozíciu výrobný majster – zástupca vedúceho prevádzky, ktorý bude zodpovedný za organizáciu, riadenie a kontrolu výrobných a opravárenských činností v oblasti železničného opravárenstva.

Hľadáme človeka s prirodzenou autoritou, praktickými skúsenosťami zo strojárskej výroby alebo údržby, schopnosťou viesť tím a záujmom o zvyšovanie efektivity, kvality a produktivity práce.     Aktívne zavádzanie a udržiavanie princípov Lean managementu, 5S a štandardizácie práce.

    Identifikácia plytvania, úzkych miest a príležitostí na zlepšenie výrobných procesov.

    Sledovanie produktivity, kvality, plnenia plánov a efektívnosti výroby.

jobs.title: Pánski a dámski krajčíri, kožušníci a klobučníci
jobs.description: Hľadáte prácu, kde sa vaša precíznosť premení na jedinečné módne kúsky? Pre úspešnú slovenskú módnu návrhárku hľadáme šikovnú a detailne orientovanú krajčírku, ktorá má vášeň pre módu a nebojí sa krajčírskeho remesla na najvyššej úrovni.Ak radi pracujete s kvalitnými materiálmi a chcete vidieť výsledky svojej práce na prehliadkových mólach či exkluzívnych klientoch, poďte pracovať do nášho ateliéru!Náplň práce: v čom budete vynikať?•    Kompletné šitie modelov (od spoločenských šiat až po limitované každodenné kolekcie) podľa návrhov a strihových predlôh.•    Práca s luxusnými a jemnými materiálmi (hodváb, čipka, vlna, satén).•    Úprava a dopasovanie modelov priamo na mieru zákazníčkam počas skúšok.•    Spolupráca s módnou návrhárkou pri realizácii nových nápadov a detailov.•    Ručné práce a precízne finálne úpravy (našívanie aplikácií, gombíkov, začisťovanie). Čo od vás očakávame?•    Vzdelanie alebo prax v odbore (vyučenie v odbore krajčír/ka alebo preukázateľné skúsenosti so šitím).•    Skúsenosť s prácou v módnom ateliéri alebo so zákazkovým šitím (veľkou výhodou).•    Znalosť technológie šitia a ovládanie priemyselných šijacích strojov (overlock,rovnosteh)•    Zmysel pre detail, presnosť a trpezlivosť – každý steh u nás musí byť dokonalý.•    Flexibilita a cit pre estetiku. Čo vám ponúkame?•    Inšpiratívne prostredie moderného a kreatívneho módneho ateliéru.•    Práca na jedinečných projektoch, žiadna stereotypná pásová výroba.•    Prístup k najnovším módnym trendom a exkluzívnym materiálom.•    Flexibilný pracovný čas (podľa dohody).•    Motivujúce finančné ohodnotenie závislé od vašich skúseností a kvality odvedenej práce.•    Zamestnanecká zľava na modely z našej dielne.Miesto výkonu práce: Rimavská SobotaDruh pracovného pomeru: TPP / Skrátený úväzokMzdové podmienky: Dohodou (v závislosti od skúseností)

jobs.title: Čašníci a someliéri
jobs.description:
V Strachan Resorte v Ždiari nespájame len tradičnú goralskú pohostinnosť s prémiovou kvalitou, ale vytvárame pre našich hostí zážitky. Naša reštaurácia je známa skvelou gastronómiou, rodinnou atmosférou a dychberúcimi výhľadmi na Belianske Tatry. Hľadáme do nášho tímu profesionála, pre ktorého nie je gastronómia len prácou, ale srdcovou záležitosťou.

Náplň práce:

Profesionálna a ústretová obsluha hostí v reštaurácii.

Aktívny predaj našich špecialít, prémiových vín a destilátov (radi ťa do všetkého zasvätíme).

Prestieranie stolov, udržiavanie čistoty a poriadku na rajóne.

Práca s pokladničným systémom a hotovosťou/terminálom.

Komunikácia s kuchyňou s cieľom zabezpečiť plynulý servis.

Reprezentovanie dobrého mena Strachan Resortu úsmevom a proaktívnym prístupom.Výhody:ubytovanie

jobs.title: Pracovníci v oblasti predaja inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
V zime máme pre vás pripravenú pracovnú pozíciu, pri ktorej sa budete stretávať so zákazníkmi, ktorí si prišli aktívne zašportovať a oddýchnuť si na lyžiach, snowboarde alebo sa vybrať na skialp. Vašou úlohou bude poradiť im s výberom výstroje, ktorá je pre nich vhodná, a správne ju nastaviť. Aj v požičovni u nás vládne skvelá nálada, pretože práve tá je naším hlavným meradlom pri výbere správnych kolegov na všetky pozície v rezorte. Ak teda radi pomáhate ľuďom, máte zmysel pre precíznosť a spĺňate parameter „vždy dobrá nálada", berieme vás medzi nás.

Náplň práce:

požičiavanie a servis lyžiarskej výstroje a športových potrieb,

aktívny predaj a komunikácia s klientmi,

práca s peniazmi a registračnou pokladňou,

kontrola kvality a poškodenia výstroje s následným zabezpečením opravy, servisu, prípadne vyradenia.

Ak chcete stráviť zimu na horách, medzi ľuďmi, ktorí majú lyžovanie v krvi, tešíme sa na Vás.Výhody:ubytovanie

Hľadáme šikovného a spoľahlivého kuchára/kuchárku s vášňou pre gastronómiu, ktorý/á by chcel/a pôsobiť v úspešnom tíme reštaurácie Medvedí brloh. Reštaurácia sa nachádza priamo pod svahom Ski Centra Strachan v Ždiari, v malebnom prostredí pod hrebeňom Belianskych Tatier, v celodrevenej stavbe s prvkami pôvodnej goralskej architektúry a s terasou s výhľadom na okolité končiare. Cez deň je Medvedí brloh obľúbeným miestom na dobré jedlo, večer sa však mení na miesto veľkej zábavy, pravidelne tu organizujeme akcie so známymi DJmi.

Čo u nás budete robiť:

Príprava a výdaj jedál podľa jedálneho lístka, ktorý spája tradičné slovenské špeciality (halušky, pirohy) s modernými jedlami ako domáce burgre či pizza

Príprava sezónnych a regionálnych špecialít z kvalitných surovín

Práca v tíme profesionálnych kuchárov pod vedením skúseného šéfkuchára.

Pracovná doba:

Pracovné zmeny: krátky/dlhý týždeň alebo podľa dohody

Ak vás baví varenie, dobrá atmosféra a chcete byť súčasťou tímu obľúbenej reštaurácie priamo pod svahom, kde sa cez deň varí a večer tancuje, tešíme sa na Vás.Výhody:ubytovanie

jobs.title: Inštruktori a cvičitelia športových rekreačných aktivít
jobs.description:
Predstavte si, že nastúpite do tímu 30 mladých ľudí a vašou najťažšou pracovnou úlohou bude... nájsť si medzi nimi nových kamarátov a kolegov. Cez deň budete v Ski school Strachan učiť ľudí prvé (alebo posledné pred pádom) oblúky na lyžiach či snowboarde, a večer, keď sa lekcie skončia, sa z vás aj z celého personálu Strachan Resortu stanú hviezdy parketu, teda skôr stola, v Medveďom brlohu.

Inštruktorom lyžovania alebo snowboardingu sa môžete stať aj bez skúseností, po kurze, na ktorý vám finančne prispejeme, pretože veríme, že najlepšia motivácia je zalyžovať si zadarmo na svahoch Ski centra Strachan aj Ski centra Strednica (a nie len teoreticky vedieť, kde je tá modrá zjazdovka). Máte radi voľnosť a flexibilitu? Do práce vás u nás nikto naháňať nebude, k nám sa chodí s nadšením, a to je presne to, čo na vás naši hostia uvidia už na prvom kruhu.

Zamestnanecké výhody a benefity:

práca v tíme mladých ľudí, s ktorými sa dá prežiť aj lyžovačka, aj afterpárty,

jobs.title: Merchant Risk Analyst
jobs.description:
Build with us
Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.
Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow – with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable.
With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions.
We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of.
Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.

Your impact

This is a high-impact role where you directly protect Mollie's financial stability and reputation. As an Merchant Risk Analyst, you are the first line of defense, proactively monitoring merchant activity to identify and mitigate patterns indicative of fraud or financial crime. This work is critical to safeguarding our platform integrity, ensuring our merchants and customers can trust Mollie as a secure and reliable payments provider.

You will be expected to conduct proactive and reactive fraud investigations, moving beyond simple alert validation to interpret complex fraud scenarios and uncover emerging risks. Your analysis and recommendations will directly shape cross-team decision-making across compliance, operations, and fraud strategy, positioning you as a trusted Subject Matter Expert.

If you are driven to continuously challenge existing practices, propose improvements to our fraud-prevention frameworks, and want to master the craft of financial crime analysis, you will be key to strengthening our overall risk resilience and staying ahead of evolving threats in the payments landscape.

What you'll ship

  • Detect and investigate fraud risks through proactive monitoring, deep data analysis, and event-driven reviews of merchant activity.

  • Mitigate financial losses by validating, escalating, and actioning fraud alerts promptly to protect platform integrity.

  • Deliver clear, actionable recommendations for mitigation strategies based on your interpretation of complex fraud scenarios and typologies.

  • Drive continuous process improvement by proactively proposing enhancements to our fraud-prevention frameworks, tools, and processes.

  • Serve as a Subject Matter Expert, advising internal and external stakeholders on emerging fraud trends, typologies, and compliance standards.

What you'll bring

  • Hands-on experience in fraud detection, investigations, or financial crime analysis.

  • Strong data analysis skills and the proven ability to interpret complex transaction patterns and identify anomalies.

  • Knowledge of payment systems, merchant risk, fraud typologies, and relevant regulatory requirements.

  • Proficiency with fraud monitoring tools, case management systems, or relevant dashboards.

  • Clear and effective communication skills to articulate complex scenarios and mitigation strategies to cross-functional and external teams.

  • A proactive, detail-oriented approach that thrives in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment.

Base location for this role can be either Amsterdam or Maastricht.

Grow your way

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy

If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.

jobs.title: Senior Treasury Specialist
jobs.description:
Build with us

Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.

Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow – with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable. With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions.

We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of.

Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.

Your impact

As a Treasury Specialist at Mollie, you play a critical role in managing our cash, banks, foreign currency positions and investments. You also actively support the design and roll out of our Financial Services products.

You're not just part of the CFO team. You're an integral part of the Financial Services Domain, and you're responsible for driving product improvements across multiple problem spaces, from Cash Management and Reporting to Banking Interactions. You bring a strong understanding of cash management, FX and investments, plus great drive and strong analytical skills.

 

This role suits you if you're not afraid of hands-on work and you also want to work on new strategic initiatives and product development in a fast-paced environment. You'll join our Merchant Finance and Treasury Team in Amsterdam.

What you'll ship

  • Cash management activities that run smoothly, alongside better reporting and forecasting processes.

  • Mollie's excess cash and multi-million investment portfolio, managed to get the most out of our money.

  • Policies and procedures on Treasury and Financial Risk topics, developed and kept up to date.

  • Uncovered FX risk positions identified, with clear recommendations on how to manage them.

  • A banking infrastructure built and optimised for efficient, cost-effective payments.

  • Company-wide growth projects and projects across domains, including new products and payment methods, that help Mollie build first class finance and treasury products for our customers.

  • A treasury management system developed further, to support more automation of our Treasury operations.

What you'll bring

  • At least 5 years of relevant Treasury experience, with knowledge of international cash management, forecasting, foreign exchange management and internal controls.

  • An advanced degree, preferably in Finance or Business Administration, a comparable study, or demonstrably a comparable level of knowledge and thinking.

  • You like to get things done and bring energy to solve problems for our customers and internal stakeholders. You're proactive, analytical and take strong ownership.

  • A mindset that looks for solutions, and the ability to come up with new ideas to improve our products and services.

  • You're a confident communicator with excellent spoken and written English. You can align and influence stakeholders across Finance, Product and the wider business, and explain complex treasury topics clearly to non-specialists.

  • You enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting less experienced colleagues, and you're comfortable contributing to domain-wide knowledge sharing.

Grow your way

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.
