jobs.title: Senior HR Business Partner
jobs.description:
Legal AI is zo goed als de kennis erachter. Bij Lefebvre Sdu bouwen we al 200 jaar aan die kennis. Dag in, dag uit. Wet voor wet. Woord voor woord. Andere legal AI-tools draaien op onze data en software. Als Nederlands hart van Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider in juridische en fiscale kennis, ontwikkelen we bovendien ons eigen platform: GenIA-L, waarop juristen en fiscalisten niet zomaar een antwoord krijgen, maar een antwoord waar ze hun naam onder durven te zetten. Meer dan 75.000 professionals werken er dagelijks mee, goed voor ruim 100 miljoen euro ARR in Europa. We zoeken een Senior HR Business Partner die ons team door een verandertraject begeleidt en adviseert.

HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT

Lefebvre Sdu transformeert van uitgever naar techbedrijf. Nergens is dat zo voelbaar als in ons product team. De mensen die hier werken bouwen het platform waarop onze AI-revolutie draait, en ze doen dat terwijl de organisatie om hen heen verandert. 70 mensen nu, vacatures open, en een opdracht die elke maand groter wordt. Jij bent de HR Adviseur die dit team begeleidt. Niet op afstand, maar als iemand die begrijpt wat er speelt, de juiste vragen stelt en mensen vooruit helpt. Dit ga je doen:

  • Jij bent de HR-partner van het team dat onze transformatie mogelijk maakt. Wat hier speelt is direct voelbaar in de hele organisatie.

  • Je begeleidt managers en medewerkers in het content, tech- en IT-team op alle HR vraagstukken, van instroom tot ontwikkeling.

  • Je signaleert wat er speelt in het team en vertaalt dat naar concrete HR-interventies die werken.

  • Je adviseert managers bij veelvoorkomende thema’s rondom leiderschap, performance en talent development.

  • Je draagt actief bij aan de cultuurverandering die bij deze transformatie hoort.

  • Je werkt nauw samen met je collega HR Adviseurs en de Head of People aan de verdere opbouw van het people team.


DIT ZOEKEN WIJ

Je bent een HR professional die begrijpt hoe tech & product teams werken. Je weet wat er speelt als een organisatie snel groeit en van richting verandert. Je bent niet bang om moeilijke gesprekken te voeren en weet hoe je mensen vooruit helpt zonder ze te verliezen. Je bent praktisch, direct en houdt van een omgeving die nog niet af is.

  • Je hebt minmaal 5 jaar relevante HR-ervaring, bij voorkeur in een tech- of IT-omgeving, en weet hoe je in die context het verschil maakt.

  • Je begrijpt de dynamiek van snelgroeiende teams en bent gewend om managers te adviseren over leiderschap, teamdynamiek en prestatieontwikkeling.

  • Je hebt ervaring met performance management en weet hoe je dat praktisch inricht voor mensen die nooit eerder in een gestructureerde cyclus hebben gewerkt.

  • Je hebt meegebouwd aan een salarishuis of vergelijkbare HR-structuur en snapt hoe je dat bespreekbaar maakt in een organisatie.

  • Je hebt affiniteit met cultuurtrajecten en leiderschapsprogramma's en denkt mee over hoe die eruit moeten zien bij Lefebvre Sdu.

  • Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.

HIER TEKEN JE VOOR

Je komt binnen in een organisatie die hard groeit en volop in beweging is. Het tech, content en IT-team dat jij begeleidt staat middenin die beweging: veertig mensen, tien open stoelen en een opdracht die elke maand groter wordt. Jij bent de HR-partner die hen daarin niet volgt, maar voorgaat.

  • Een plek waar je vanaf dag één invloed hebt op de mensen, de cultuur en de groei van een van de snelst groeiende teams van Lefebvre Sdu.

  • De kans om samen te werken met een nieuw leadership team dat hun baan in big tech bewust inruilde voor de kans om hier iets te bouwen wat er nog niet was.

  • Salaris tot €6.000 per maand voor 36 uur per week.

  • Een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 4% en winstdeling tot 6%.

  • 23 vakantiedagen en een persoonlijk keuzebudget van 12%, waarvan 8% vakantiegeld en 4% vrij inzetbaar. 

  • Een goede pensioenregeling via PGB, inclusief aanvullende partnerverzekering.

  • Een reiskostenvergoeding van €0,25 per kilometer of een OV-vergoeding, en we bieden een aantrekkelijke fietsregeling. Voor medewerkers met een reisafstand van minder dan 10 km of meer dan 60 km hebben we een aangepaste regeling.

  • 3 dagen per week op kantoor in Den Haag, op loopafstand van station Voorburg. De rest van de week waar je het beste werkt.

  • Ruimte om te groeien. In je vak, in je rol, in de organisatie.

MEER WETEN?

Wij vertellen je graag alles over ons team en de rol. Stuur jouw cv en je hoort binnen 2 werkdagen van ons. Eerst nog wat vragen? App of bel Irene via +31 6 348 97 120.

Kampcontracten duren meestal zo'n 8 weken tussen juni en augustus. Waarom Work Play USA? Het is een leuke, spannende en lonende manier om je zomervakantie door te brengen. Je ontmoet nieuwe mensen van over de hele wereld, geeft les in de sport waar je een passie voor hebt en beleeft elke dag plezier. Oh, en je krijgt een mooi kleurtje!

jobs.title: Retain Young Temporary Workers
jobs.description: And How Can You Retain Young Temporary Workers? 19-10-2026 Written by: Sude Tomak Young employees have become an essential part of the logistics, production and horticulture sectors. Yet many employers find it challenging to retain Gen Z workers. Young people tend to change jobs more frequently and have different expectations of their employers. But does this mean they are less loyal? Not necessarily. Above all, they want clear expectations, to feel valued and to have opportunities to develop their skills. Job Security, Salary and Personal Attention A good salary remains important. According to Deloitte's 2026 global survey, the cost of living is a major concern for Gen Z. Young people are therefore looking for more than just an enjoyable job. They also want financial security and stability. However, it is about more than money. Gen Z values employers who listen to them, make clear agreements and pay attention to their personal circumstances. Personal Support Makes the Difference At OPUS, we see how important personal contact is. That is why we stay in regular contact with our employees, not only when they start a new job, but also throughout their employment. How is the job going? Are there any problems? And what can we do to help someone move forward? These conversations help us understand what is happening and allow us to provide support more quickly. Practical matters also deserve attention. For example, we help employees find suitable transport options and support them with questions about their work and personal circumstances. Sometimes it is the small things that make a big difference in how someone experiences their job. Opportunities to Grow Gen Z wants to move forward. Young people value opportunities to learn new skills and build a future. At OPUS, we therefore also focus on professional development. This could include obtaining a forklift or reach truck certificate or taking a Dutch language course. By doing...

jobs.title: Cloud Architect
jobs.description:
About Vitestro

Founded in 2017 in Utrecht, Vitestro is pioneering the future of blood collection with the Aletta® Autonomous Robotic Phlebotomy Device™ (ARPD™). This groundbreaking medical device combines advanced multi-modal imaging (near-infrared, ultrasound, and Doppler ultrasound) with robotics and AI to perform the entire diagnostic blood draw procedure autonomously.

 

By addressing critical healthcare staffing shortages and improving patient experience, Vitestro is transforming one of the most common and essential medical procedures. With more than 130 team members and growing rapidly, we are scaling our impact. As we placed our first devices with customers, we are now expanding our team to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability.

 

At Vitestro, we are committed to continuous innovation and improvement.

We are looking for a Cloud Architect to shape and implement Vitestro's cloud platform with a clear, pragmatic technical direction. Our infrastructure runs on AWS and supports mission-critical, regulated medical device software. Vitestro is also realizing its first integration with Laboratory Information System (LIS) over the cloud, and delivering that connection is a core part of this role. We need someone who translates real operational and business constraints into working systems — someone whose first instinct is "what does this actually need to do, reliably and affordably," not "what's the most sophisticated way to solve this."

You will join the Platform & Connectivity team and build alongside its cloud, backend, and DevOps engineers. This is an individual-contributor technical leadership role, not a people-management position — you carry the architectural vision and build it hands-on with the team, rather than designing something for others to execute.

If you'd rather ship a solid, working solution than iterate endlessly toward a theoretically ideal one, and you have a track record of keeping cloud costs under control at scale, you'll thrive in this role.

First months at Vitestro

In your first months, you get to know our cloud platform, the device connectivity and the team. You review the current architecture, its costs and its production-readiness, and identify where the biggest risks and quick wins are. You take ownership of the cloud architecture for our first LIS integration, and you agree with the team on the first architectural standards for observability, logging and infrastructure as code.

This is what success looks like:

After 12 months, our first LIS integration runs reliably in production, with monitoring, alerting and failure handling in place. Cloud costs are predictable and under control, and key architectural decisions and trade-offs are recorded. The team uses shared patterns instead of reinventing solutions, and is confident running production systems as we move from pre-market to post-market.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Set the technical direction for our AWS-based cloud platform and build it hands-on with the team — weighing cost, operability, and production-readiness as first-class concerns, not afterthoughts

  • Own the cloud architecture of Vitestro's first LIS integration over the cloud: secure, reliable, and traceable data exchange between our platform and the hospital laboratory

  • Choose solutions on their merits rather than defaulting to the most AWS-native option — including other clouds, self-hosted tooling, or dedicated infrastructure when that's genuinely the better fit

  • Take implementations from a working prototype to something that's production-ready — monitoring, alerting, and failure handling included. You bring experience with production systems and advise the team on how to navigate from pre-market to post-market stages.

  • Establish architectural standards and patterns so similar problems (e.g. observability, logging, data pipelines) get solved consistently instead of reinvented each time

  • Keep cloud costs in check as part of everyday engineering decisions, catching expensive mistakes before they show up on an invoice

  • Balance short-term solutions driven by business needs and deadlines against the long-term architecture: make each trade-off explicit, record it, and plan the path from the tactical fix to the durable solution

  • Diagnose and resolve production issues across the cloud platform from logs, metrics, and traces


What You’ll Bring:

  • Deep, hands-on production experience with AWS at scale — not certification-level familiarity, but real experience with what breaks and what gets expensive as usage grows

  • Proven experience running production systems end to end, from design and release through monitoring and incident response, and the ability to advise a team that is new to production

  • Genuine experience building outside an AWS-only mindset — another cloud, self-hosted/open-source alternatives, or dedicated/on-premise infrastructure — enough to make an informed trade-off, not just AWS as the only tool you reach for

  • A track record of finishing what others started: turning a partial or unstable implementation into something genuinely reliable in production

  • Strong Infrastructure as Code practice (Terraform, OpenTofu, Pulumi, or AWS CDK) as the authoritative source of environment configuration

  • Comfortable operating in a regulated, security-conscious environment where architecture decisions have compliance implications

  • Familiarity with AWS cost structure, along with the ability to factor in cost-related considerations when designing infrastructure

  • Professional English; Dutch is a plus

Nice to have:

  • Experience specifically with observability/logging platforms at scale (e.g. OpenSearch, Grafana/Loki stacks, or equivalent) — bringing an implementation to production-hardened state, not just standing it up

  • Experience in medical device, healthcare, or another regulated industry

  • Familiarity with multi-tenant, per-customer cloud architectures (e.g. isolated accounts or workloads per client/region)

  • Experience in a startup or scale-up environment

How We Work

At Vitestro, ownership is not a slogan - it is an expectation. We trust people to take responsibility, make decisions, and drive work forward.

We believe breakthroughs happen when talented people combine dedication, accountability, and teamwork. That means:

  • We take initiative rather than wait for direction.

  • We focus on execution and delivering results.

  • We proactively remove blockers and help each other succeed.

  • We challenge ideas, not people.

  • We continuously learn, improve, and raise the bar.

  • We celebrate team success over individual heroics.

We move fast, but we do so thoughtfully. We care deeply about quality because the technology we build ultimately impacts patients and healthcare professionals.

If you are looking for an environment where you can make a significant contribution, take ownership of meaningful work, and be surrounded by highly motivated colleagues, we'd love to meet you.

What we offer 

  • Competitive salary including a pension plan

  • 25 days of annual leave (full-time position)

  • A high-skilled team based in Utrecht

  • Frequent out-of-work team activities and an annual company weekend away

  • A training budget

  • The chance to help shape the new niche of autonomous medical robotics

We’re big fans of working from the office – this is where team spirit comes alive. At the same time, we offer flexibility, allowing up to two (out of 5) days of working from home for those who prefer it. 

Are you excited? 

We totally understand that and so are we! By joining us, you can play an active role in changing the future of health care. Excited to join our revolution? Then we’d love to hear from you! 

If you think you've got what it takes, but you don't meet all the requirements - we still recommend you apply. We would love to learn about your interest and experience and consider if you can be a good fit for Vitestro. Nobody is a perfect fit, and we welcome applications with imperfections. We offer a learning environment where we grow together!

jobs.description: As a SAP Logistics Consultant (m/w/d) in Hamburg, you will contribute to a large-scale SAP implementation within logistics and supply chain operations. jobs.description: The GFZ Helmholtz Centre for Geosciences is one of the world's leading institutions in the field of geosciences. As part of the Helmholtz Association, Germany's largest research organisation, we address global challenges such as natural hazards, climate change and the sustainable use of resources. In doing so, we combine cutting-edge research with social relevance. Our international staff - around 1,200 employees and approx. 500 guests - work in a multidisciplinary way and with a unique infrastructure to research the dynamic processes of the Earth system. Our vision: "Taking the pulse of our Earth to safeguard a habitable planet."For the EU-funded project UPLIFT in section4.3 Geoenergy (https://www.gfz.de/en/section/geoenergy/overview) (department 'Geosystems (https://www.gfz.de/en/departments/geosystems) '), we are looking for a:Research scientist (f_m_x) – Geothermal Reservoir StimulationReference Number 11660UPLIFT (https://uplift-horizon.eu/) brings together key European Enhanced Geothermal System (EGS (https://www.geothermie.de/bibliothek/lexikon-der-geothermie/e/egs) ) industry and research institutions to demonstrate, at Czechia's leading energy research site RINGEN, how water-only multi-stage hydraulic shear stimulation treatments can be efficiently implemented in metamorphic basement rocks in Europe, while reducing technical, social, and environmental risks.A central focus is the development and application of adaptive stimulation designs that use real-time seismic and hydraulic data to improve treatment efficiency and safety. The project will also investigate micro-turbine drilling as an alternative to conventional perforation techniques to improve reservoir access. Laboratory experiments will assess the self-propping behaviour of European basement rocks and benchmark their stimulation response against acid- and proppant-based methods. Water-only and proppant-based stimulation treatments will also be compared at the Bedretto Underground Laboratory. In parallel, the project will develop high-fidelity, physics-based digital twins to guide stimulation design, alongside fast surrogate models to support real-time operational decision-making. The stimulation activities are supported by high-resolution, real-time seismic monitoring, conventional and adaptive traffic light systems, and social science research.As a postdoctoral researcher, you will play a central role in planning, supervising and analysing the adaptive multi-stage hydraulic stimulation treatments at the RINGEN EGS site in Litoměřice, Czechia. This position offers the opportunity to connect advanced research with field operations and contribute directly to developing efficient, safe geothermal stimulation technologies.Your responsibilities:- Co-lead the hydraulic stimulation and well test activities at the Litoměřice EGS site- Analyse stimulation and well test data to compare and understand the hydraulic and seismic response of metamorphic basement rock to different stimulation methods and injection protocols, including adaptive injection strategies- Contribute to detailed operational planning and the preparation of tender documents- Contribute to the techno-economic assessment of different stimulation methods and their implications for EGS development- Publish your findings in peer-reviewed journals and communicate them at scientific conferences and to non-scientific stakeholdersAbout You:Essential Qualifications:- A Master's degree (or equivalent) and a PhD (or equivalent industry experience) in reservoir/petroleum engineering, drilling/completion engineering, geophysics, geothermal energy, applied geosciences, or equivalent- Research or industry background in Enhanced Geothermal Systems, well stimulation or induced seismicity- Well test analysis- Proficiency in spoken and written EnglishDesirable Qualifications:- German or Czech language skills are useful, but not required- Strong motivation and creativity, combined with an independent, structured, reliable and results-oriented working attitude- Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with interdisciplinary project partners, the scientific community, engineers, and non-technical stakeholdersStart date: 1st February 2027Fixed-term: 36 MonateSalary: Die Stelle ist nach TVöD Bund mit der Entgeltgruppe 13 bewertet. Die Eingruppierung erfolgt nach den tariflichen Bestimmungen und den entsprechenden persönlichen Voraussetzungen.Working hours: Vollzeit (derzeit 39 h/Woche); die Stelle ist grundsätzlich teilzeitgeeignet.Place of work: PotsdamWhat we offer:- Ambitious and varied tasks in a dynamic and international research environment- State-of-the-art equipment- Public service benefits- Extensive training opportunities- Professional career advice offered by our in-house Career-Centre- Flexible working hours and conditions- Support with finding a good work-life balance offered by benefit@work- Institute day-care centre on site- Working at the Albert Einstein Science Park on the Telegrafenberg in Potsdam- Workplace within walking distance of Potsdam main train station, or just a short ride on the shuttle busHave we piqued your interest?If so, we look forward to receiving your application by 13th December 2026. Please use our online application form only.Required documents: letter of motivation, CV, grades/certificatesThe GFZ actively promotes diversity and equal opportunities. We explicitly welcome applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of ethnic and social origin, nationality, gender, sexual orientation and identity, religion/belief, age, and physical or neurodiverse abilities.“Diversity in perspectives” is one of GFZ's core values. As an integral part of supporting diversity at our centre, we actively promote women in science and in leadership positions. To know more about our Diversity policies, contact the diversity team. If you need more information about our gender equality policies, please do not hesitate to contact our Equal Opportunities Officer (https://www.gfz.de/en/career/the-gfz-as-an-employer/employee-representation) and check our Equal Opportunities Plan & Cascade Model (https://www.gfz.de/en/career/the-gfz-as-an-employer/equal-opportunities) .We look forward to applications from people who enjoy working in diverse teams, where everyone feels respected and valued and can fully develop their own talents. Applicants with severe disabilities and equalised persons will receive preferential consideration if equally qualified.Data protection information for applicants (https://www.gfz.de/en/career/job-offers#c95430)In case of any further queries regarding the field of activity, please contact Prof. Dr. Hannes Hofmann (hannes.hofmann@gfz.de) via email. If you have any general questions about the application process, please contact our recruiting team at our phone number +49 (0) 331-6264-28787.

jobs.title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer – Azure, Active Directory & Hybrid Infrastructure (m/f/d) (IT-Systemadministrator/in)
jobs.description: Salary: €60,000–80,000 gross per year, depending on experience | Permanent | Immediate start | Remote within Germany or Switzerland (proximity to our Bexbach site is a plus)You want full ownership of a group's Azure and hybrid environment: not just tickets, but the architecture, the governance, and the direction it takes? Then help shape the infrastructure behind an international niche world leader in Omega-3 technology.Why join us?- Real ownership: You shape our Azure and hybrid infrastructure, drive technical decisions and take responsibility for its future development.- Remote-first: Work remotely from Germany or Switzerland, with occasional visits to our Bexbach site and other group locations.- International collaboration: Join a small, hands-on Group IT team working closely with security, application teams and IT colleagues across our global sites.- Meaningful transformation: Play a key role in consolidating acquired IT environments and building a consistent, secure and scalable global infrastructure.- Growth opportunities: Benefit from individual career and development opportunities in an internationally operating company.About us – in briefHeadquartered in Bexbach, Germany, KD Pharma Group is a mid-sized, internationally active company and one of the world's few manufacturers of Omega-3 concentrates with a purity of up to 99.5%.Our expertise is built on a dedicated focus on Omega-3 fatty acid research, advanced purification technologies and manufacturing. With facilities and operations across Europe, the Americas and Asia-Pacific, we serve customers worldwide.Following a period of international growth through acquisitions, our focus is now on integrating and modernizing our IT environments to create a consistent, secure and scalable global infrastructure.Your Role – What You'll OwnYou will take hands-on ownership of our Azure and hybrid infrastructure, helping us move from independently managed site environments towards a standardized and centrally governed global IT platform.Working closely with the Group Director of IT, our security function, application development team and local IT colleagues, you will combine technical architecture with practical implementation.Your Responsibilities- Infrastructure rationalisation: Simplify our distributed server estate, both on-premises and in Azure. Retire or replace unsupported systems, consolidate infrastructure and reduce technical debt across our sites.- Active Directory & identity: Drive the consolidation and modernization of our Active Directory environments. Manage hybrid identity across Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID, including directory synchronization, Conditional Access and Multi-Factor Authentication.- Azure platform: Design, operate and continuously improve our Azure and hybrid environment, covering compute, networking, storage and core infrastructure services. Provide the application development team with the environments they need.- Device management: Manage devices and applications across the group through Microsoft Intune, establishing consistent configuration, enrollment and security policies across all sites.- Application delivery: Evaluate and implement the right delivery method for each application, starting with reducing our reliance on Azure Virtual Desktop.- Governance and cost management: Establish clear Azure standards, policies and resource tagging. Ensure transparency of cloud spending and continuously optimize infrastructure costs.- Resilience and monitoring: Ensure backup, disaster recovery and monitoring solutions are reliable, regularly tested and provide early warning of potential issues.- Security partnership: Work closely with our security function to strengthen infrastructure security, implement appropriate controls, maintain patch compliance and resolve identified vulnerabilities.- Infrastructure modernization: Review our existing infrastructure and determine which workloads should remain on-premises, move to Azure or be decommissioned.What You BringWe are looking for a hands-on infrastructure specialist who can independently manage and improve complex Microsoft environments. You combine strong technical expertise with the ability to drive infrastructure improvements across multiple locations.Must-have – Essential RequirementsThe following skills and experience are essential for this position:Azure & Hybrid Infrastructure- Strong hands-on experience designing, operating and maintaining Microsoft Azure infrastructure, including compute, networking (VNets, NSGs, VPN Gateway and ExpressRoute) and storage.- Proven experience managing on-premises Windows Server environments alongside Microsoft Azure in a hybrid infrastructure.- Practical PowerShell scripting skills for automation, administration and infrastructure management.Infrastructure Modernization- A proven track record of rationalizing infrastructure and reducing technical debt, including server consolidation, migration projects and replacing unsupported systems.- Strong Windows Server administration skills, including server lifecycle management, upgrades and migrations.- Practical experience with Hyper-V and/or VMware virtualization environments.Identity & Access Management- Strong knowledge of Microsoft Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID in hybrid environments.- Practical experience with identity synchronization, Conditional Access and Multi-Factor Authentication.- Experience managing and improving identity security and access controls.Endpoint Management- Hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune in enterprise environments, including device enrollment, configuration policies and application deployment.Resilience, Security & Monitoring- Practical experience with enterprise backup, disaster recovery and infrastructure monitoring solutions, ideally Azure Backup, Azure Site Recovery and Azure Monitor.- Experience implementing infrastructure security improvements, including privileged access management, patch management, system hardening and vulnerability remediation.Communication & Collaboration- Confidence working independently and across international teams and locations.- Ability to explain technical concepts and architectural decisions to non-technical stakeholders.- Good written and spoken English. German is an advantage.- Willingness to travel occasionally to our Bexbach site and other group locations.Please note: This is a specialized infrastructure engineering role requiring proven hands-on experience with Azure, hybrid Microsoft environments and infrastructure modernization. The mandatory requirements listed above are essential for this position. Candidates without practical experience in these core areas are unlikely to be considered.Nice-to-have – Additional ExperienceThe following skills are beneficial but not essential:- Active Directory domain or forest consolidation and migration projects.- Azure Virtual Desktop, particularly migrating users and applications to alternative delivery methods.- Azure governance and cost management, including Azure Policy, resource tagging and Microsoft Cost Management.- Azure Arc for managing on-premises servers.- Working knowledge of Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Defender for Identity or Microsoft Sentinel.- Experience supporting application development teams, e.g. Azure App Service, Azure DevOps or GitHub.- Infrastructure as Code (IaC), such as Bicep or Terraform.- Experience working in regulated environments, preferably pharmaceutical manufacturing or GxP.- Microsoft certifications such as AZ-104, MD-102 or SC-300.Your First 12 MonthsYour initial focus will be on delivering measurable improvements across our global infrastructure:- Assess and develop a roadmap for standardizing our Azure and hybrid infrastructure.- Review and rationalize our existing server environments, replacing unsupported systems and reducing technical debt.- Review our Active Directory and hybrid identity architecture and initiate consolidation where required.- Strengthen centralized endpoint management through Microsoft Intune.- Establish consistent Azure governance, resource standards and cost transparency.- Improve infrastructure security, monitoring, backup and disaster recovery.- Evaluate application delivery solutions and reduce unnecessary reliance on Azure Virtual Desktop.What We Offer- Remote-first working: Work remotely within Germany or Switzerland, with occasional visits to our Bexbach site.- Competitive compensation: Annual gross salary of €60,000–80,000, depending on experience.- Additional payments: Christmas and vacation bonuses.- Company pension scheme: Support for your long-term financial security.- Career development: Individual training and development opportunities in an internationally operating company.- Employee benefits: Free water and coffee, as well as company products at employee prices.- Team culture: Regular team events and opportunities to connect with colleagues across the group.Location: Remote within Germany or Switzerland (Bexbach proximity is a plus)Start date: As soon as possible⏳ Employment type: Permanent, full-timeReady to Shape Our Global IT Infrastructure?We are looking for someone who wants to take ownership, make things better and deliver real technical improvements.Send us your application – no perfectly polished cover letter required. We are interested in your experience, your technical expertise and what you can bring to our team.We look forward to hearing from you!

Neue regulatorische Anforderungen hast du dabei immer im Blick.- **Prozesse neu denken: ** Ein neues Produkt braucht schlanke Prozesse, und die entwickelst du mit. Du bringst dein Fachwissen in die Gestaltung des AVD ein, erkennst Optimierungspotenziale und machst Abläufe, die heute noch manuell laufen, fit für die Automatisierung. jobs.title: Postdoctoral Researcher (f/m/d)  in Conservation Genetics and Genetic Monitoring (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description: Postdoctoral Researcher (f/m/d) in Conservation Genetics and Genetic MonitoringSenckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN) , headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is seeking to fill the following position in the Department of Genomic Biomonitoring at the Senckenberg Research Institute and Natural History Museum Frankfurt, starting as of 01.02.2027:**Postdoctoral Researcher (f/m/d) in Conservation Genetics and Genetic Monitoring ****(Full-Time / Part-Time)**Location: FrankfurtEmployment scope: Full-Time / Part-Time options are availableType of contract: Temporary, limited to 2 yearsRemuneration: Collective agreement of the state Hesse (TV-H) / E13The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level.The city of Frankfurt, where the Senckenberg Society was originally founded, hosts the organization’s central administrative services along with two research institutes housing extensive scientific collections and one of Senckenberg’s most renowned institutions, the Senckenberg Natural History Museum Frankfurt. Senckenberg is as much a part of the city’s identity as its skyline and its traditional apple wine.Genetic diversity is a fundamental component of biodiversity, providing the evolutionary potential that allows species and populations to adapt to environmental change. Yet genetic diversity is declining and remains comparatively underrepresented in biodiversity monitoring and policy. At the Genomic Biomonitoring Lab at Senckenberg, we work to address that gap and are seeking a postdoctoral researcher to join us in that aim.The position will focus on how genetic diversity can be measured, monitored and incorporated into practical conservation. This spans from species-level applications to national and international biodiversity policy. The researcher will contribute to ongoing projects on endangered and threatened species where genomics is needed to support management or can be used for monitoring. At the international scale, there is scope to investigate how genetic diversity can be incorporated into global biodiversity frameworks and assessments.We are looking for a researcher who is excited to help shape this emerging research area. The postdoctoral researcher will have the opportunity to develop new research questions and projects under our shared research programme. We are particularly interested in candidates who combine deep scientific curiosity with a motivation to translate ideas into practical conservation impact. Experience working in conservation genetics or genomics is thus essential.Your tasks- Conduct high-quality research on conservation genomics, genetic monitoring and integration of genetic diversity into policy.- Develop and apply approaches for monitoring and protecting genetic diversity in wild populations in Germany and at focal international sites.- Work on connecting genetic diversity with national and international policy.- Collaborate with researchers, conservation organisations, and other stakeholders.- Publish findings in high-quality peer-reviewed journals and present results at international conferences.- Communicate research findings to non-academic audiences, including through policy briefs and communication with conservation managers, and policymakers.- Supervise BSc and/or MSc thesis students.- Help develop international funding proposals for genetic diversity protection and monitoring.Your profile- A PhD in population/conservation/evolutionary genomics or a related field.- At least one year of postdoctoral research experience.- Hands-on experience with genomic datasets.- Experience in conservation biology and biodiversity protection, including collaboration with conservation practitioners, managers, or policy makers.- A strong publication record appropriate to your career stage.Desirable skills- Excellent scientific writing and communication skills in English.- Experience or a strong interest in developing research proposals and securing third-party funding.- A collaborative, collegial and well-organised approach to research and teamwork.We offer- access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations- an attractive job within the inspired and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution- flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement – company pension planSenckenberg is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our staff and welcome every application from qualified candidates, irrespective of ethnic or cultural origin, age, gender, ethnic or cultural origin, religion or belief, age, sexual identity or and ideology, sexual orientation and identity or disability. Applicants with a severe disability will be given special consideration in case of equal suitability. Senckenberg actively supports the compatibility of work and family and places great emphasis on an equal and inclusive work culture.Senckenberg is certified under the audit berufundfamilie programme and is committed to promoting a better work-life balance.How to apply?Please upload your applicationelectronically as a single PDF by 05.12.2026, containing:- A letter of motivation (1-2 pages), including clear explanations about your interest in the position and an outline of how your experience fits the research programme.- CV and publication list.- PhD certificate.- Contact details for two academic refereesPlease upload your application by clicking on the "Apply Online" button in the bottom of this announcement. Applications via email cannot be considered.ContactSenckenberg Gesellschaft für NaturforschungSenckenberganlage 2560325 Frankfurt am MainFor specific questions about this role, please contact Prof. Dr. Deborah Leighat deborah.leigh@senckenberg.de

jobs.title: Network Engineer / IT-Netzwerkspezialist (m/w/d) – WAN & Standortvernetzung (Netzwerkadministrator/in)
jobs.description: Du sorgst dafür, dass Unternehmen verbunden bleiben. Wir sorgen dafür, dass du den passenden Job findest.Ein Netzwerk ist für dich mehr als ein paar Switches, Router und blinkende LEDs? Du weißt, wie man Standorte zuverlässig miteinander verbindet, Netzwerkstrukturen optimiert und auch bei komplexen Herausforderungen den Überblick behält?Dann könnte diese Position genau dein nächster Karriereschritt sein!Für ein etabliertes, deutschlandweit tätiges Unternehmen mit einer vielseitigen IT-Landschaft suchen wir einen Network Engineer / IT-Netzwerkspezialisten (m/w/d), der die standortübergreifende Netzwerkinfrastruktur aktiv mitgestaltet und weiterentwickelt.Dich erwartet eine spannende Mischung aus Netzwerktechnik, modernen WAN-Technologien, Projektarbeit und der Zusammenarbeit mit externen Providern.Deine Aufgaben - Hier kommt dein Netzwerk-Know-how ins Spiel- Standorte verbinden: Du planst und realisierst WAN-Anbindungen für neue und bestehende Unternehmensstandorte und begleitest die Umsetzung bis zur erfolgreichen Inbetriebnahme.- Netzwerke weiterentwickeln: Du sorgst für eine stabile, sichere und leistungsfähige Vernetzung der Standorte und optimierst bestehende Netzwerkstrukturen.- Den gesamten Lifecycle begleiten: Ob neue Standorte, Erweiterungen, Bandbreiten-Upgrades, Providerwechsel oder Standortumzüge - du koordinierst die technischen Maßnahmen.- Provider steuern: Du bist technischer Ansprechpartner für Telekommunikationsanbieter und externe IT-Dienstleister und begleitest die Bereitstellung neuer Verbindungen.- Technologien einsetzen: Du arbeitest mit modernen Netzwerkarchitekturen und Technologien wie WAN, LAN, WLAN, SD-WAN, Routing und Switching.- Projekte vorantreiben: Du unterstützt bei Infrastrukturprojekten, entwickelst technische Standards weiter und bringst eigene Ideen zur Optimierung ein.- Qualität sicherstellen: Du prüfst neue Standortanbindungen, begleitest technische Abnahmen und sorgst für eine reibungslose Übergabe in den produktiven Betrieb.Dein Profil - Das bringst du mit- Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration, ein IT-Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.- Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Netzwerkadministration oder im Bereich IT-Netzwerkinfrastruktur.- Fundierte Kenntnisse in WAN, LAN, WLAN, Routing, Switching, TCP/IP und VLAN.- Kenntnisse im Bereich SD-WAN und moderner Standortvernetzung.- Idealerweise hast du bereits Unternehmensstandorte angebunden und mit Telekommunikationsprovidern zusammengearbeitet.- Du gehst technische Herausforderungen strukturiert an und findest auch bei komplexeren Netzwerkproblemen passende Lösungen.- Du arbeitest gerne eigenverantwortlich, kommunizierst sicher und behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Projekten den Überblick.- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse.- Führerschein der Klasse B sowie die Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Dienstreisen.Wichtig: Du musst nicht jede Technologie bis ins kleinste Detail beherrschen. Entscheidend sind deine fundierten Netzwerkkenntnisse, praktische Erfahrung und die Motivation, dich fachlich weiterzuentwickeln.Deine Benefits - Das erwartet dich- Sicherer Arbeitsplatz: Unbefristete Festanstellung in einer wirtschaftlich breit aufgestellten Unternehmensgruppe.- Attraktive Vergütung: Ein leistungsgerechtes Gehaltspaket, das zu deiner Erfahrung und Qualifikation passt.- Spannende IT-Projekte: Abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben in einer standortübergreifenden IT-Infrastruktur.- Weiterbildung: Umfangreiche Qualifizierungsangebote und individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.- Strukturierte Einarbeitung: Ein persönlicher Ansprechpartner und ein durchdachter Einarbeitungsplan erleichtern dir den Einstieg.- Gesundheitsförderung: Betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement und weitere Angebote.- Mobilität: Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket sowie attraktive Fahrrad- und PKW-Leasingangebote.- Mitarbeitervorteile: Corporate Benefits, Mobilfunk- und DSL-Vergünstigungen sowie attraktive Hotelrabatte.- Teamkultur: Kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld, gemeinsame Veranstaltungen und regelmäßige Teamevents.Klingt nach deinem nächsten Netzwerkprojekt?IHR ANSPRECHPARTNERFühlen Sie sich angesprochen?Dann senden Sie uns Ihre aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (in einer PDF-Datei) an Christian Peters christian.peters@griepenstroh.com oder über unsere Connect-Plattform. Wir bitten um die Angabe Ihres möglichen Beginns und Ihrer Gehaltsvorstellungen.Ist diese Stelle nichts für Sie? Dann vernetzen Sie sich gerne mit uns über unsere Connect-Plattform, sodass Sie immer über unsere aktuellen Vakanzen auf dem Laufenden gehalten werden können.

jobs.title: Recepcionista (Empfangskraft)
jobs.description: RecepcionistaDescripción de la empresaNuestro corazón es turquesa.Trabajar para Motel One es como estar en casa de un amigo, donde el reconocimiento y el apoyo gozan de la máxima importancia y las cualidades personales son bien acogidas. Sus responsabilidades también incluirán las siguientes:- Atender a nuestros huéspedes, incluyendo la realización del check-in y check-out- Revisar y procesar reservas, sobrerreservas y otras opciones- Gestionar la facturación, incluida la gestión de pagos, así como transacciones y cobros en efectivo- Realizar tareas organizativas y administrativas en el front-office y back-office (por ejemplo, gestión de ausencias, respuesta a correos electrónicos)- Adquirir conocimientos interdepartamentales sobre nuevas áreas de actividad mediante el trabajo en nuestros equipos multiculturalesBenefits:- Bonus program: The better the guests rate their stay, the higher the bonus!- Make an international career: Discover a variety of career opportunities in our hotels nationally and internationally, or join one of our numerous new openings.- Staff discounts: Benefit from attractive staff rates in all of our hotels throughout Europe and the USA.- Develop personally and professionally: With an extensive onboarding, annual trainings and coaching at our One University, you will hit the ground running.- Celebrate together: Whether it's a summer party, holiday party or our annual international soccer tournament - we celebrate successes together with the team.RequisitosTanto si es un profesional del mundo de los hoteles como si está cambiando de carrera profesional, ¡estamos seguros de que su perfil encajará en nuestra empresa! ¡La personalidad y los dotes de anfitrión son nuestra prioridad! También tendrá que reunir los siguientes requisitos:- Tener formación en el sector de los hoteles y/o tener experiencia profesional en la industria hotelera/catering o estar buscando un cambio de carrera profesional- Tener un excelente sentido de la calidad y el servicio, así como dotes de anfitrión y pasión por la industria hotelera- Ser una persona abierta y comunicativa y tener un sólido dominio del inglés- Ser una persona a la que le guste trabajar en equipo y que esté dispuesta a proporcionar asistencia en todos los departamentos: ¡en Motel One, los objetivos son conjuntos, así que nos ayudamos entre todos!

jobs.title: Project Engineer, Electrical Systems
jobs.description:
For our client, we are looking for a Project Engineer to join a highly skilled engineering team working with advanced power generation and energy solutions. This role focuses on generator protection and excitation systems, offering an excellent opportunity to build expertise in a specialized and growing area of the energy sector.

Note! This application is only for individuals already residing in Finland, and relocation is not possible.

You will participate in customer projects throughout their lifecycle, from engineering and system configuration to testing and commissioning. Working alongside experienced specialists, you will gradually take on broader technical responsibility and contribute to developing customer-specific solutions.

The position offers a combination of office-based engineering work and practical field activities at customer sites. As your expertise grows, you will also support technical discussions with customers and contribute to solution development activities.

Key Responsibilities:
· Engineering, configuration, and documentation of generator protection and excitation systems.
· Supporting testing, factory acceptance testing (FAT), installation, and commissioning activities.
· Participating in commissioning assignments and technical troubleshooting at customer sites.
· Collaborating closely with project managers, engineers, suppliers, and customers to deliver high-quality technical solutions.
· Providing technical input for solution design and supporting sales and customer-facing activities when needed.

Requirements:
- B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Power Engineering, or a related field
- Experience in electrical engineering, power generation, industrial automation, commissioning, or similar technical environments
- Good understanding of electrical power systems and interest in energy production technologies
- Experience with engineering, configuration, testing, or commissioning activities
- Knowledge of generator protection systems, protection relays, excitation systems, or power plant environments is considered an advantage
- Familiarity with electrical design tools is beneficial
- Strong communication and teamwork skills with a proactive, customer-oriented mindset
- Willingness to travel approximately 30 days per year, mainly within Finland and Northern Europe

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)
- Do you have a Bachelors or Masters degree in Electrical, Automation or Power Engineering?*
- Do you have 2+ years of hands-on experience with electrical engineering, power systems, industrial automation, or commissioning activities?*
- Have you worked with generator protection systems, protection relays, excitation systems, or similar technologies?

Please apply with your updated CV, that clearly demonstrates your skills and experience relevant to this role.

Location: Vaasa (hybrid, minimum 1 day/week onsite)
Start: January 2027
Duration: Long-term assignment (12-month contracts, expected to continue for several years)
Allocation: 100 %
Languages: Fluent Finnish and English; Swedish is a plus

We offer you: We offer a versatile assignment where every day is different and interesting. We also offer a very competitive salary and good employee benefits.

Are you interested in becoming a part of our dynamic team? The position will be filled as soon as a suitable person is found, so please be quick and submit your application! 

Please include your salary expectation in your application. For more information, contact Kimmo Kärsämä, tel. 050 412 7500, kimmo.karsama@lokki.fi 

Explore Lokki, through our blog and website: https://www.lokki.fi/  .

Lokki Henkilöstöpalvelut Oy (Finnish for Seagull Recruitment Services) has been active in providing recruitment services since 2005 and we belong to The Private Employment Agencies Association HPL. Our vision is to provide the best customer experience with our reliable, humane and effortless service around Finland. Our most important asset is a person who, as we know, thrives in a reliable and supportive atmosphere. At Loki you will be supported by your own human resources consultant throughout your employment relationship. At Lokki, we believe in a partnership achieved as a result of flexible service. Explore us and our vacancies: https://www.lokki.fi/.

You can also find us on Facebook and Instagram.

jobs.description:

They are not looking for a traditional process engineer, but an experienced integration designer who understands the complete process and piping system built around an industrial heat pump and has a hands-on approach to taking technology from concept to implementation.

Responsibilities:
 Design and implement integration solutions related to industrial heat pumps.
 Develop industrial heat recovery solutions and assess how recovered heat can be used efficiently.
 Design solutions where recovered energy is converted back into useful use.

 Strong experience in industrial processes, energy or heat pump solutions.

jobs.title: CX Systems & Automation Lead
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As our CX Systems & Automation Lead, you'll own the systems that power Notion's global support organization. Reporting to the Head of AMER & EMEA Direct Support, you'll administer and evolve our CX tools (Zendesk, Decagon, and Assembled) as Notion scales, and help decide what our stack looks like next. This is a hands-on individual contributor role: you'll work closely with CX leadership to shape our systems strategy, then design, build, and ship it yourself.



This role is based in our San Francisco office. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Own administration and architecture of our Helpdesk and CX platforms, design and build routing, automations, macros, SLAs, permissions, customizations, and third-party integrations, and set best practices for how they're used

 - Partner with CX leadership to shape our CX systems strategy and roadmap, then lead delivery from design through implementation, including running system RFPs when needed and advising on the impact of changes on teams, workflows, and customers

 - Partner with our AI team to configure, maintain, and improve our AI support agents, including knowledge inputs, guardrails, and performance tracking, and help CX leaders decide where automation should and shouldn't handle customer conversations

 - Own change management for CX systems, from prioritizing requests to sandbox testing, release planning, access controls, data privacy (e.g., GDPR, PII handling), and communicating changes to global teams

 - Partner with our global (AMER, EMEA, APAC, & Vendor) CX team to be the point of contact for our CX tool stack

 - Partner with CX leaders to drive tool-related reporting and data visibility

 - Identify, diagnose, and resolve issues that arise with CX tooling systems

 - Maintain up-to-date documentation for our CX tools, including key decisions, major changes, and the business reasons behind routing and automation choices




SKILLS YOU'LL BRING

 - You have 7+ years of relevant experience, ideally in SaaS or AI, with deep hands-on administration of an enterprise helpdesk or CRM (e.g., Zendesk, Salesforce Service Cloud, Fin); experience running or migrating between platforms is a plus

 - You're comfortable with APIs, webhooks, and SQL, have built custom integrations, and have partnered with technical teams to deploy AI agents in a support environment; scripting (JavaScript or Python) or integration tools (e.g., Workato, Zapier) are a plus

 - You're as comfortable in a strategy discussion as in the admin console, and you've personally built the configurations and integrations you've recommended

 - You have experience supporting cross-functional programs that relate to CX, operations, engineering, and enablement

 - You can translate business needs and strategy into technical deliverables and clear roadmaps, and keep leaders and stakeholders aligned on status, milestones, and risks

 - You have a metrics mindset: you measure success by outcomes and have built dashboards that tell a clear story with KPIs

 - You have a scaled approach to tool management & implementation

 - You thrive in ambiguity and can manage technical and administrative work independently as priorities change



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $179,000 - $200,000 per year.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Senior / Staff Software Engineer, Connectors Platform
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Connectors let Replit’s agents and applications securely access the tools and data people already use. Behind every connection are hard systems problems: whose identity is being used, what they’re allowed to access, how credentials stay valid, and how those guarantees hold across services and execution environments.



We’re looking for a Senior or Staff Software Engineer with deep experience in authentication, authorization, security, and distributed systems to own this foundation. You’ll build and operate the infrastructure that makes connections work reliably across Replit’s projects, agent conversations, and environment builds.



This is a hands-on engineering role, not a security advisory position or a job focused on adding individual integrations. You’ll trace behavior across service boundaries, make architectural decisions, ship production changes, and simplify an evolving platform. Success means connections are secure and reliable end to end, and the team can confidently build on the systems you own.



YOU WILL

 - Own authentication and authorization across the connection lifecycle. Design how users, agents, applications, and services establish identity, receive access, and act on behalf of others.

 - Build reliable credential infrastructure. Handle OAuth flows, token refresh, revocation, reauthorization, and secure credential storage, including concurrency and partial failures.

 - Make connections work across the platform. Follow requests through application services, credential proxies, agent execution, and environment builds, preserving security guarantees at every boundary.

 - Design and operate distributed systems. Improve service-to-service communication, tenant isolation, failure recovery, and observability across shared and isolated deployments.

 - Handle provider-specific constraints without compromising the platform. Account for differences such as user versus bot credentials, token limits, and source-control authentication.

 - Lead safe migrations and reduce technical debt. Replace fragile or duplicated paths with clearer ownership and simpler designs while keeping existing customer workflows working.

 - Raise the team’s technical judgment. Explain system behavior clearly, lead design discussions, mentor engineers, and partner with security, infrastructure, and product teams.



EXAMPLES OF WHAT YOU COULD DO

 - Fix a token-refresh race that causes connections to fail when multiple services use them concurrently.

 - Trace an authorization failure from an agent request through the credential proxy to the provider, then address the underlying design problem.

 - Design a connection lifecycle that behaves consistently across projects, conversations, and environment builds.

 - Migrate customers to a stronger identity and authorization model without disrupting their applications.

 - Remove legacy connection paths and add end-to-end tests that make future changes safer.



REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

 - Deep hands-on experience with authentication and authorization systems, including OAuth 2.0, access scopes, credential lifecycles, and trust boundaries.

 - Strong distributed systems fundamentals, including concurrency, consistency, retries, idempotency, and partial failure.

 - Experience designing, shipping, and operating production backend infrastructure with meaningful security and reliability requirements.

 - Ability to understand an unfamiliar system end to end and debug failures across multiple services and third-party APIs.

 - A track record of owning complex changes through design, implementation, rollout, and production validation.

 - Pragmatic engineering judgment: you improve existing systems incrementally, reduce unnecessary complexity, and know when a provider-specific exception is justified.

 - Clear technical communication and a willingness to help other engineers develop deeper systems understanding.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience with service identity, delegated access, token federation, or credential-management infrastructure.

 - Experience with multi-tenant isolation, enterprise governance, or customer-managed cloud deployments.

 - Experience migrating authentication or authorization systems while preserving existing customer access.

 - Experience leading cross-team architectural work and mentoring engineers.



BONUS POINTS

 - Familiarity with emerging cross-app access standards such as Cross-App Access (XAA), as well as OAuth 2.0 token exchange, OpenID Connect, and identity federation.

 - Experience designing developer-facing APIs, SDKs, or connector-authoring tools.

 - Familiarity with AI agent tool execution or Model Context Protocol (MCP).

 - Experience supporting integrations with complex authentication behavior, including collaboration tools and source-control providers.




LOCATION

This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

jobs.title: CNC Machinist
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced CNC Milling Machinist to join our client's team in Turku.

You will work with Haas CNC milling machines, primarily 3-axis and 4-axis machining centres, with 5-axis experience considered an advantage.

Production mainly involves small parts, individual components and small batches, requiring precision, independence and strong programming skills.

Programming is primarily done directly at the machine control panel. CAM programming is also occasionally used.


Requirements

 * Proven experience in CNC milling and machine programming.
 * Experience with Haas controls and programming directly at the machine.
 * Experience operating 3-axis and 4-axis CNC milling machines.
 * Ability to read and interpret technical drawings.
 * Ability to independently set up, program and operate CNC machines.
 * Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
 * Good Finnish or English communication skills.
 * Experience with CAM programming and 5-axis machining is a plus.

We offer:

 * Varied CNC machining tasks

canteen that offers a weekly breakfast and lunch menu as well as drinks and snacks.Discretionary quarterly and annual performance sharing plan.Annual sports grant.A mobile phone as well as a mobile jobs.title: DEKO søger en CNC-operatør
jobs.description:
Har du erfaring med CNC-bearbejdning og lyst til at arbejde med moderne produktion? Vil du være en del af en virksomhed, hvor kvalitet, samarbejde og udvikling er i fokus?

DEKO søger en CNC-operatør, der skal arbejde med programmering, opsætning og drift af moderne 5-aksede CNC-maskiner i en højteknologisk produktion.

Om jobbet

Som CNC-operatør hos DEKO bliver du en del af et stærkt produktionsteam, hvor du arbejder med avanceret bearbejdning af aluminiumprofiler til blandt andet karme og døre. Du får en alsidig hverdag med moderne produktionsudstyr, varierende opgaver og mulighed for løbende faglig udvikling.

Dine opgaver:

  • Programmering og opsætning af 5-aksede CNC-maskiner

  • Drift og overvågning af produktionen med fokus på kvalitet og præcision

  • Visuel kvalitetskontrol af emner

  • Optimering og vedligeholdelse af produktionsprocesser

  • Sikring af levering i den rette kvalitet og til aftalt tid

  • Samarbejde med kolleger på tværs af produktionen

  • Deltagelse i en rotationsordning mellem flere arbejdsstationer

Din profil:

  • Du har erfaring som CNC-operatør – evt. uddannet industritekniker

  • Du har gerne erfaring med 3- eller 5-aksede CNC-maskiner

  • Du kan læse tekniske tegninger og arbejde præcist efter mål

  • Du har en god teknisk forståelse og sans for kvalitet

  • Du er fortrolig med IT som en naturlig del af produktionen

Vi tilbyder:

  • Grundig oplæring i produkter, maskiner og arbejdsprocesser

  • Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med dygtige og engagerede kolleger

  • Gode muligheder for både faglig og personlig udvikling

  • Sociale aktiviteter og et stærkt sammenhold

  • Attraktive ansættelsesvilkår i en virksomhed med fokus på kvalitet og udvikling

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig

Hvis du er klar til at blive en del af DEKO og bidrage med din erfaring inden for CNC-bearbejdning, så send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt til ja@deko.dk.

Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler, hvor du vil få mange flere informationer og detaljer om stillingen. Ansættelsen sker ligeledes løbende.

Om DEKO

DEKO er en familieejet virksomhed, hvor det familiære og høj performance går hånd i hånd. Her er kort vej fra idé til handling, og nye initiativer bliver mødt med nysgerrighed frem for bureaukrati. Vi tror på, at udvikling kræver mod til at prøve nye ting, og at man lærer mere af at forsøge end af at lade være.

Vi har i mere end 50 år udviklet produkter til indvendigt byggeri og er i dag en af Skandinaviens førende leverandører af glasvægge samt en af Danmarks største tømrer- og snedkervirksomheder inden for indretning af kontor-, erhvervs- og institutionsbyggeri

jobs.title: Driftsleder/Supervisor til produktionen i Birkerød
jobs.description:
Der søges på vegne af vores samarbjedspartner i Birkerød (ENGLISH VERSION BELOW)

Vi er en dansk scale-up i Nordsjælland, der udvikler, producerer og sælger hampbaserede produkter. Vi arbejder med hele processen fra råvare til færdigt produkt og står overfor at udvide med egne produktionsfaciliteter, så vi kan lancere nye produktkategorier og skalere produktionen.Hverdagen er præget af høje krav til kvalitet, sporbarhed, dokumentation og stabile processer.

Om rollen

Vi søger en supervisor, der kan få den daglige drift i produktionen til at hænge sammen. Du skal skabe overblik på gulvet, følge op på opgaverne og være med til at sikre, at produktionen kører som den skal.

Det er en hands-on rolle, hvor du både deltager i arbejdet og har ansvar for den daglige koordinering i produktionen. Du bliver en vigtig del af teamet under Operationschefen og får en central rolle i at holde flow, kvalitet og fremdrift i hverdagen.

Personaleansvar er ikke et krav, men du skal have erfaring med arbejdsledelse eller daglig supervision i en produktionsvirksomhed.

Dine primære opgaver

  • Sikre den daglige koordinering og arbejdsfordeling i produktionen

  • Følge op på, at opgaver bliver løst korrekt og til tiden

  • Holde overblik over flowet på linjerne og reagere hurtigt ved stop, afvigelser eller flaskehalse

  • Deltage aktivt i produktionen, herunder betjening og overvågning af produktions- og fillingsprocedurer

  • Sikre hygiejne, sporbarhed og dokumentation på batch-niveau

  • Udføre og følge op på in-process-kontroller samt sikre, at kvalitetsdata er opdateret i de digitale systemer

  • Bidrage til orden, rengøring, first-level vedligehold på linjerne

  • Samarbejde tæt med lager og logistik om råvareflow og færdigvareafhentning

  • Være med til at forbedre arbejdsgange og skabe mere struktur i takt med, at produktionen udvikler sig

Din profil

  • Du har erfaring fra fødevare-, kosmetik-, pharma- eller anden procesindustri

  • Du har erfaring med arbejdsledelse, koordinering eller daglig supervision i en produktion

  • Du er vant til at arbejde struktureret og holde overblik i en travl hverdag

  • Du har fokus på kvalitet, renlighed og det at følge procedurer

  • Du kan læse og skrive dansk og/eller engelsk

  • Du er tryg ved at arbejde i digitale systemer og kan lære nye processer og værktøjer

  • Du tager ansvar, når noget skal løses, og bidrager naturligt til, at hverdagen fungerer

Vi tilbyder

  • En central rolle i den daglige drift af produktionen

  • Fast daghold med mulighed for fleks efter aftale

  • Grundig oplæring, inkl. træning i vores principper

  • Konkurrencedygtig løn samt frokostordning, pensionsordning og arbejdsgiverbetalt sundhedsforsikring

  • Mulighed for at vokse i takt med, at vi skalerer nye linjer og automatiserer processer

Ansøgning

Send CV og kort motiveret ansøgning til job@chc.dk snarest og senest d. 27. november 2026. Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler. Har du spørgsmål, så ring til 71 99 19 55 eller skriv til km@chc.dk.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Production Supervisor – Hands-on Role

Location: Birkerød, North Zealand, Denmark

Recruitment on behalf of our partner company in Birkerød.

We are a Danish scale-up based in North Zealand, developing, manufacturing and selling hemp-based products. We manage the entire process, from raw materials to finished products, and are preparing to expand our operations with our own production facilities. This will allow us to introduce new product categories and increase production capacity.

Our daily operations require high standards of quality, traceability, documentation and process consistency.

About the Role

We are looking for a Production Supervisor who can help keep our daily production operations running smoothly. You will coordinate work on the production floor, follow up on tasks and help ensure that production runs efficiently and according to plan.

This is a hands-on position, combining active participation in production with responsibility for day-to-day coordination and supervision.

You will work as part of the team reporting to the Head of Operations and play an important role in maintaining production flow, quality and progress.

Formal line management or personnel responsibility is not required, but you must have experience supervising, coordinating or leading daily work in a manufacturing environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate daily production activities and allocate tasks across the production team.

  • Follow up to ensure tasks are completed correctly and on schedule.

  • Monitor production flow and respond quickly to interruptions, deviations and bottlenecks.

  • Participate directly in production, including operating and monitoring production equipment and filling processes.

  • Ensure hygiene, traceability and batch-level documentation.

  • Perform and follow up on in-process quality checks, ensuring that quality data is accurately recorded in our digital systems.

  • Maintain good housekeeping, cleaning routines and first-level equipment maintenance on the production floor.

  • Work closely with warehouse and logistics colleagues to coordinate raw material supply and the movement of finished goods.

  • Help improve workflows and establish more structured processes as production expands.

Your Profile

  • You have experience in food manufacturing, cosmetics, supplements, pharmaceuticals or another process-based manufacturing industry.

  • You have previous experience with production-floor supervision, work coordination or day-to-day production leadership.

  • You work in a structured manner and can maintain an overview in a busy production environment.

  • You understand the importance of quality, cleanliness and following established procedures.

  • You can read and write in Danish and/or English.

  • You are comfortable using digital systems and willing to learn new processes and tools.

  • You take responsibility, solve problems when they arise and actively contribute to keeping daily operations running smoothly.

What We Offer

  • An important role in the daily operation and development of our production facilities.

  • Fixed daytime working hours, with flexibility by agreement.

  • Thorough onboarding and training, including training in our operational principles and procedures.

  • Competitive salary, a company lunch scheme, an employer pension scheme and employer-paid private health insurance.

  • Opportunities to develop professionally as we expand production lines and introduce further automation.

How to Apply

Please send your CV and a short cover letter to job@chc.dk as soon as possible and no later than the 27th of November 2026.

We review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.

If you have any questions about the position, please call +45 71 99 19 55 or email km@chc.dk.

We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.title: Myyntiedustaja (kodinturvaratkaisut)
jobs.description: **Haluatko myyntityön, jossa päiväsi eivät kulu kylmäsoittoihin tai asiakkaiden perässä juoksemiseen? Etsimme nyt myynti- ja turvaratkaisujen asiantuntijoita rooliin, jossa tärkein tehtäväsi on auttaa asiakkaita suojaamaan kotinsa ja yrityksensä Verisuren palveluilla.****Jos nautit tavoitteellisesta myynnistä, kaupan syntymisen tunteesta sekä asiakaskohtaamisista,rooli on juuri sinua varten.**Myynti ja turvaratkaisujen asiantuntijanamme et lähde liikkeelle tyhjästä. Jokaiselle päivällesi rakennetaan valmiiksi laadukkaita myyntimahdollisuuksia sovittujen asiakastapaamisten, nykyasiakaskäyntien sekä huoltojen ja asennusten kautta. Tavoitteena on yksinkertaisesti luoda mahdollisimman paljon onnistuneita kohtaamisia ja kauppoja.Tarjoamme sinulle 1500 € kuukausittaisen pohjapalkan, kannustavan palkkiomallin sekä Suomen tunnetuimman ja luotetuimman turvapalvelun myytäväksesi. Kun vahva brändi, toimiva konsepti ja jatkuva asiakasvirta yhdistyy, sinulle syntyy erinomaiset mahdollisuudet vaikuttaa omalla tekemiselläsi ansiotasoosi.**Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**- **Varma pohjapalkka & motivoivat komissiot:** Tarjoamme sinulle **jatkuvan pohjapalkan 1500€/kk** sekä kannustavat ja motivoivat komissiot: uusista hankituista asiakkaista saat keskimäärin n. **300-400€ myyntikomission.** - **Lämpimät asiakaskohtaamiset:** Varmistamme sinulle riittävästi monipuolisia myynniin mahdollisuuksia niin valmiiksi sovittujen asiakastapaamisten kuin nykyasiakkailla tapahtuvien käyntien muodossa. - **Perehdytyksen, jota on hiottu yli 30 vuoden ajan:** Olemme kehittäneet koulutustamme sekä perehdytystämme pitkään, joten saat käyttöösi vinkit, neuvot ja tuen, joiden avulla onnistumisesi on vain sinusta itsestäsi kiinni. - **Autoetu:** Saat käyttöösi auton, jolla ajat niin työ- kuin vapaa-ajallasi. - **Eteneminen**: Kaikki myynnin esihenkilömme ovat aloittaneet myyjinä. Saat konkreettisen mahdollisuuden rakentaa uraasi eteenpäin. Sales Manager Naneten tarinaan pääse tutustumaan urasivujemme blogiosiosta (www.verisure.fi/ura). - **Best Place to Work sertifioidun organisaation.** Sijoituimme Suomen keskisuurten yritysten sarjassa parhaimpien joukkoon. Katso urasivujemme blogiosiosta (www.verisure.fi/ura) myyjiemme kokemuksia Verisurella työskentelemisestä. **Mitä päiväsi myynti- ja turvaratkaisujen asiantuntijana tarkemmin pitää sisällään?**Tyypillinen työpäiväsi alkaa esimerkiksi klo 10:00 tapaamisella, jossa asiakas odottaa sinua luoksensa. Onnistut tapaamisella vakuuttamaan hänet palvelusta, ja pääset sopimaan järjestelmän asennuksen heti huomiselle. Jatkat tästä päivääsi toisen asiakkaasi luokse, jossa suoritat hänen järjestelmänsä huollon. Järjestelmän huollon yhteydessä tarjoat parasta mahdollista palvelua ja selvität, onko asiakkaalla muita suojaamista kaipaavia kohteita, tai mahdollisesti tuttuja, joille hän haluaisi palvelua suositella.Päiväsi jatkuu mökkikohteella, jonne toteutat asennuksen, jonka olit sopinut viime viikolla turvattuasi ensin asiakkaan kotikohteen. Asennusten ja huoltojen yhteydessä kontaktoit myös lähialueen talot kartoittaaksesi uusia mahdollisia asiakkaita.Viikkosi koostuu monipuolisesti erilaisista kohtaamisista niin uusien kuin nykyisten asiakkaiden kanssa, sisältäen tapaamisia, asennuksia, huoltoja ja lähialueen suoraa asiakaskontaktointia. Tärkein tehtäväsi on siis toteuttaa mahdollisimman monen uuden kodin ja yritystilan suojaaminen Verisuren palvelulla.**Työaikasi on pääsääntöisesti ma–pe klo 10:00–18:00.** Työ on aktiivista kenttätyötä, joten tiimipalavereja ja koulutuksia lukuun ottamatta toimit pääsääntöisesti kentällä asiakkaidesi luona.**Voisiko tämä olla sinun seuraava uramahdollisuus?**Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää vahvaa motivaatiota tavoitteellista myyntityötä kohtaan sekä erinomaisia vuorovaikutustaitoja. Aiemmat näytöt suoramyynnin parista katsotaan eduksesi, mutta ne eivät ole välttämättömyys. Työssä tehtävät asennukset ja huollot eivät vaadi aiempaa kokemusta, sillä koulutamme sinut niihin.**Tehtävässä edellytämme sinulta:**- Ajokorttia: Tarvitset B-kortin (manuaali) ja täysikäisyyttä. - Sujuvia vuorovaikutustaitoja suomen kielellä. - Pystyt työskentelemään joustavasti arkisin 10:00-18:00 välillä. - Tausta: Edellytämme on nuhteetonta rikostaustaa (edellytys turvasuojaajakortille). **Kun kyse on työpaikasta, melko hyvä ei riitä. Parasta olla Verisure.**Jos uusi myyntiroolimme sytytti kiinnostukseksi, klikkaa linkkiä, jätä CV sekä yhteystietosi, jonka jälkeen olemme sinuun yhteydessä. Paikat täytetään heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä.Lisätietoja tehtävästä voit tarvittaessa tiedustella rekrytiimiltä sähköpostitse osoitteesta rekry@verisure.fiKatso tulevien kollegoidesi ajatuksia urasivuiltamme ja lisätiedot sosiaalisesti mediasta Instagramista & TikTokista @verisurelaiset.

jobs.title: Chauffør til DinnerdeLuxe i Odense Øst
jobs.description:
