jobs.title: Chef, Restaurant Aihki, Pyhätunturi, Finnish Lapland
jobs.description: **Join the team at Restaurant Aihki in Pyhätunturi!**We are looking for a **Chef** to join Restaurant Aihki for the winter season 2026 - 2027, as part of Sunday Morning Resort in Pyhätunturi, Finnish Lapland.Restaurant Aihki is known for its high-quality modern Nordic cuisine, where pure, locally sourced ingredients take centre stage. Our restaurant has twice been recognised among **Finland's Best Restaurants** by _Kauppalehti Optio_ (2022 & 2023, rating 16+).As a Chef at Restaurant Aihki, you will work as part of our professional kitchen team and take an active role in daily food preparation and service. You will work with high-quality ingredients and help ensure that every dish leaving the kitchen meets Aihki's high standards.This position is ideal for a chef with a few years of professional kitchen experience who is looking to develop their skills in a high-quality restaurant environment. Experience in à la carte, fine dining or Nordic cuisine is considered an advantage, but most importantly, we are looking for a professional attitude, a strong team spirit and a genuine passion for great food.**Your responsibilities include:**- Preparing and presenting dishes according to Restaurant Aihki's standards - Working across different kitchen stations during daily service - Preparing and handling ingredients - Following Aihki's recipes, procedures and quality standards - Ensuring the quality, proper storage and rotation of ingredients - Following kitchen hygiene, food safety and self-monitoring procedures - Keeping your workstation clean, organised and ready for service - Working closely with the rest of the kitchen and front-of-house teams **We are looking for someone who has:**- Approximately 2-3 years of professional kitchen experience - A relevant culinary qualification or equivalent practical experience - Experience in an à la carte restaurant; fine dining or Nordic cuisine experience is considered an advantage - Strong fundamental cooking skills and an interest in high-quality ingredients - An organised, responsible and proactive approach to work - The ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced kitchen environment - Good teamwork and communication skills - Good spoken English; Finnish and other languages are considered an advantage - Motivation to learn and continue developing professionally - Above all, a positive attitude and genuine passion for high-quality food **We offer you:**- The opportunity to work in one of Finland's highly regarded restaurants - The opportunity to develop your skills in modern Nordic cuisine - An inspiring working environment surrounded by the beautiful landscapes of Pyhätunturi, Finnish Lapland - The support of a welcoming, professional and international team - Comprehensive onboarding before your employment begins - The possibility of staff accommodation close to the workplace - Comprehensive occupational healthcare and local employee benefits - Access to shared company season passes for Pyhä Ski Resort - Employee benefits for selected activities - The opportunity to work for a Sustainable Travel Finland certified company - An excellent location close to Pyhä Ski Resort and local services - A competitive salary based on your experience and skills, with the MARA collective agreement as the basis for salary **Employment**The position begins in **mid-November 2026** and continues until the **end of March 2027**.This is a **full-time seasonal position**, approximately **40 hours per week**, with two days off per week. Shifts are mainly scheduled in the afternoon and evening.Working a winter season in Pyhä also means experiencing the Arctic winter, snowy fells and the unique atmosphere of Finnish Lapland right outside your workplace.**About us****Sunday Morning Collection is a Finnish family-owned tourism company** offering high-quality accommodation, dining and activity experiences in the breathtaking surroundings of Pyhä-Luosto National Park.Sustainability is at the heart of what we do. jobs.title: Drømmer du om et sabbatår i udlandet i 2027? Vi betaler din flybillet hvis du vil afsted i jan-feb 2027 - Book et kald idag.
jobs.description:
Drømmer du om et sabbatår i udlandet? Vi betaler din flybillet hvis du vil afsted i jan-feb 2027.

Et sabbatår i udlandet er for mange en livsforandrende oplevelse. Du får mulighed for at arbejde i et nyt land, møde mennesker fra hele verden, udvikle dig personligt og styrke dit CV med international erfaring. Men det, som de fleste ikke ved, er hvor tidligt processen faktisk bør starte.

Hvis du drømmer om at rejse ud i januar 2027, så er det allerede nu, du skal tage de første skridt. De bedste jobmuligheder, de mest stabile projekter og de mest attraktive destinationer bliver nemlig fyldt langt før afrejse. Samtidig tager det tid at finde det rette match, gennemføre interviews og få styr på alle praktiske detaljer.

Hvorfor starte processen nu – hvis du vil afsted i januar 2027?

1. Du får adgang til de bedste stillinger

Virksomhederne vi samarbejder med rekrutterer løbende, og mange stillinger bliver besat flere måneder før opstart. Starter du processen nu, øger du chancen for at få præcis den rolle og det land, du ønsker.

2. Du sikrer en glidende overgang efter studiet

Når du starter i god tid, kan du planlægge dit sabbatår uden tidspres. Du får ro til at afslutte dit studie, nyde efteråret og samtidig være klar til at rejse ud i januar — uden at skulle haste gennem interviews og praktiske forberedelser.

3. Vi kan matche dig med den helt rigtige virksomhed

Vi arbejder ikke med “første og bedste” løsning. Vi matcher dig med virksomheder, der passer til dine ønsker, dine styrker og dine mål for sabbatåret. Det kræver tid — og det er en klar fordel at starte før alle andre.

4. Du får fuld rådgivning hele vejen

Fra første samtale til du står på flyet, hjælper vi dig med:

  • Jobmuligheder

  • Kontrakt og løn

  • Bolig og økonomi

  • Kultur og hverdagsliv

  • Interviewforberedelse

  • Praktiske forhold som bank, skat og relocation

Jo tidligere du starter, desto mere ro og overblik får du.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

Du kan se hele oversigten her: https://www.jobhuntworldwide.com/sabbataar-udlandet-gode-tips

Kort sagt får du:

  • Gratis og uforpligtende samtale

  • Hjælp til at finde det rette job i udlandet

  • Professionel interviewforberedelse

  • Rådgivning om bolig, økonomi og kontrakt

jobs.title: Academic Coordinator for the EUROfusion Project
jobs.description:
SDU Center for Large Structure Production (LSP), part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute (MMMI) at University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for one funded Academic Staff position, to be project administrator for the EUROfusion project. The temporary position will be vacant from 1 January 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter, until 31 December 2027. Main work location is Odense/Denmark at SDU and Odense Havn (Odense Port).

Work environment

The candidate will be part of SDU Center for Large Structure Production (LSP). LSP’s central ambition is to provide a physical “go-to” lab for companies in the sectors maritime, construction and energy to carry out research, development, and testing of novel solutions in the production of large structures, such as buildings, ships and offshore platforms. In this context, the candidate is expected to work closely with our industrial partners on application-oriented use cases, while helping to commission and operate the unique set of equipment of the center. 

LSP is closely working together the companies at Odense Havn and similar partners making large structures across Denmark and Europe. LSP is integrated with the Odense Robotics Cluster involving startups and established companies in robotics. We are a team of currently about 24 researchers, engineers and PhD students, specialized in robot solutions involving modelling, simulation, and control of advanced robot technologies (systems and services) for application-oriented industrial applications. 

Our group is involved in a variety of national and European projects and features a strong network of academic and industrial partners. We solve challenging research problems derived from real-life challenges by implementing novel robot solutions. We value teamwork, professional diligence, enthusiasm for robotics and the drive to adopt new skills and extended responsibilities. We offer an open, international team, with flexible work organization and support for individual development.

Job description

The candidate will be project administrator for the EUROfusion project. Jointly, and together with the rest of the team around this project, this goes for other institutes and departments of SDU TEK together with partners from ITER and EUROfusion. 

Profile and requirements

The candidate is expected to have the following qualifications:

  • Good communication and collaborative skills

  • Good English and Danish skills, both written and spoken

  • Can work independently and have a good overview

  • IT skills and being good at developing and maintaining procedures

  • Background in engineering will be useful, e.g. involving handling of 3D models

Contact information

For further information, please contact Professor Christian Schlette via email (chsch@mmmi.sdu.dk) or on LinkedIn (www.linkedin.com/in/christian-schlette/).

Application deadline: November 30, 2026 at 23:59 o'clock. 

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

"Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.”

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out. 

You can only apply for the position at – https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu. 

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

jobs.title: Associate Professors in AI Engineering
jobs.description:
SDU Centre for Industrial Software in Sønderborg, part of the Software Engineering units at SDU situated at the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for one or more positions within AI Engineering. The positions are open from beginning of 2027, and the specific start date will be agreed with the successful candidates. 

The application deadline is December 7, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET).

 

What we offer

With a position at SDU, you will:

  • be part of one of our dynamic research centres with both a national and international profile, while working in areas of tremendous potential and societal relevance;

  • join collaborations across the university, as well as with national, international, and industrial research partners;

  • help establish joint innovation projects in close collaboration with industry and the local society;

  • help build up the research and educational environment;

  • contribute to the teaching programmes in Software Engineering at the highest level for undergraduate and graduate students at SDU;

  • join a harmonious workplace environment that is conducive to productivity, promotes creativity, and rewards and recognizes individuals and group achievement;

  • have the opportunity to live and work in one of the happiest countries in the world that also offers excellent and free health and education systems.

 

What we expect

The focus of the SDU Centre for Industrial Software is research and education in software engineering, embedded systems, cyber-security and AI engineering. We see these areas complementing each other to make way for the engineering of the next generation of reliable, intelligent and embedded software solutions. We are particularly interested in software operated in real life, systems that adapt at runtime, span embedded devices, edge infrastructure and the cloud, that people work with and trust, and that increasingly answer to regulation. This includes understanding how new technologies change the engineering of products and software infrastructures.

The positions are open in any of the AI engineering research areas of interest to the centres, which include:

  • AI Engineering (e.g. multi-modal machine learning)

  • AI integration in mobile, wearable and embedded platforms

  • Human-AI collaboration in the context of mobile, wearable and embedded platforms

  • Domain-oriented AI Engineering (e.g., medical, energy or manufacturing).

 

Who we are looking for

We expect applicants to hold a PhD in artificial intelligence, software engineering, computer science or a closely related discipline. For associate professors we expect a research and teaching record corresponding to several years of independent work after the PhD, including documented teaching and supervision experience.

We are looking for candidates who have demonstrated research excellence appropriate to their career stage, who show a clear path towards an independent and internationally recognised research programme, and who are able and willing to contribute to competitive national and international funding applications. We also expect an interest in working across disciplines, in supervising students and junior researchers, and in teaching and advising in software engineering at all levels.

We particularly welcome applications from candidates who publish in leading venues in the field. If your work is more domain oriented and you therefore publish in leading venues within a specific domain, you are also very welcome to apply.

Fluency in English is required. Knowledge of Danish is not a requirement, and successful applicants will be offered Danish language courses.

 

Workplace description

The University of Southern Denmark

The University of Southern Denmark is one of the youngest universities in Denmark, founded in 1966. The university is founded around the goal of providing the right knowledge at the right time to support society. The university targets major, complex societal problems of a cross-disciplinary nature such as climate, welfare, health and technology, tackling these in collaboration across faculties.

The Faculty of Engineering

The Faculty of Engineering is driven by the urge to create value for and with society, by curiosity and by the will to create that which only a few could imagine would be possible. Through research, education and collaboration, it is the ambition of the faculty to nurture talent, address challenges, create possibilities, and promote sustainable development. The faculty is strongly engaged with national and international industries and organizations over a broad range of technical domains.

The Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute

The Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute is an internationally recognized institute, which has maintained a leading position in robotics for more than three decades. The department is the 2nd largest department at SDU, with more than 230 staff members and 1500 students. The institute has over the last decades expanded its activities in interactive technologies, artificial intelligence, and software engineering including building several strong research centres at the SDU campuses in Odense, Sønderborg and Vejle. Thereby, the institute today covers a wide range of areas in robotics, software, AI, and applied informatics.

Get a glimpse of (work)life through the eyes of some of our many excellent researchers at SDU in Sønderborg.

 

Curious?

If you are interested in learning more about the positions, please contact:

  • Torben Worm (Head of Centres): tow@mmmi.sdu.dk

  • Mikkel Baun Kjærgaard (Vice-Head of Centres): mbkj@mmmi.sdu.dk

If you experience technical problems, please contact hcm-support@sdu.dk.

 

Application procedure

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and an application must include: 

  • Cover letter.

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (copy of original and official English translation).

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Up to five most relevant publications to the position.

  • A research statement.

  • Teaching Portfolio documenting teaching, learning, and supervision qualifications and approach. Any format is acceptable; see the Faculty's teaching portfolio page for inspiration.

  • Up to three reference letters may be included (optional).

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included (optional).

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration no.) must be crossed out. All PDF files must be unlocked and allow binding and may not be password protected.

UPLOAD GUIDE: Cover letter shall be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae shall be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max. 5 MB). All other documents shall be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max. 10 files of max. 50 MB per file).

 

The application deadline is December 7, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET).

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an associate professor is permanent.

Employment as an associate professor requires academic qualifications at PhD level as well as scientific and teaching qualifications commensurate with the position as an associate professor. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for associate professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

 

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.title: Postdoc in Mechatronic Design for Remotely Operated Vehicles
jobs.description:
Centre for Industrial Mechanics (CIM), part of the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites application for an 18-month postdoc position within Mechatronic Design for Remotely Operated Vehicles (ROVs). The position is available from March 2027, and the specific start date will be agreed upon with the successful candidates.

 

What we offer 

Successful candidates will join an interdisciplinary engineering research environment at SDU Sønderborg and contribute to the development of ROVs and associated subsea mechatronics. The work combines engineering design, numerical modelling, prototyping, fabrication, integration, and experimental validation in laboratory and marine environments.

The positions offer opportunities to:

  • Develop and evaluate mechatronic components, subsystems, and integrated ROV platforms.

  • Design underwater actuation mechanisms, transmissions, structural components, and pressure-resistant enclosures, including sealing and mechanical interfaces.

  • Integrate underwater sensors, actuators, embedded electronics, and control hardware.

  • Perform CAD modelling, engineering analysis, simulations, design optimisation, and prototype fabrication.

  • Conduct laboratory and field testing to improve the performance, reliability, and robustness of subsea mechatronic technologies.

  • Publish research in international scientific journals and conferences, collaborate with research partners, and contribute to student supervision where relevant.

 

What we expect 

Applicants must hold a PhD degree in mechatronics, mechanical engineering, robotics, marine engineering, or a closely related discipline at the time of employment. We seek motivated researchers with strong mechatronic design skills and hands-on experience in developing, integrating, and testing electromechanical systems.

Applicants should have demonstrated expertise in mechatronic design and practical experience in several of the following areas:

  • Mechanical and mechatronic design, including actuation, transmissions, structural design, and electromechanical integration.

  • CAD and engineering modelling or analysis, such as finite element analysis, multibody dynamics, or related methods.

  • Integration of sensors, actuators, embedded electronics, and control hardware.

  • Rapid prototyping, additive manufacturing, machining, assembly, and experimental development.

  • Experimental testing, instrumentation, data acquisition, system characterisation, and troubleshooting.

  • Basic programming and control using tools such as Python, C/C++, MATLAB/Simulink, or ROS/ROS 2.

Experience in subsea engineering, ROV development, underwater actuation, pressure-resistant enclosures, waterproofing, sealing, or marine instrumentation is an advantage but not a requirement. Applicants should have a publication record appropriate to their career stage, sound scientific judgement, good written and spoken English, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively.

 

Workplace description 

The positions will be based at the Centre for Industrial Mechanics (CIM), Department of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, Faculty of Engineering, University of Southern Denmark, in Sønderborg. The research environment brings together expertise in mechanical engineering, mechatronics, modelling, control, and experimental engineering.

Get a glimpse of (work)life through the eyes of some of our many excellent researchers at SDU in Sønderborg.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application.

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

  • Complete list of publications highlighting the publications most relevant to the position.

  • A research statement.

  • References/reference letters may also be included.

  • Documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is December 10, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert or assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as a postdoc is temporary for an initial 18-month period, and the preferred start date is from March 2027. Extension may be possible depending on available funding. 

Employment as a postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time of registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

jobs.title: Assistant/Associate Professor (tenure-track) in Microeconomics
jobs.description:
About the position

NHH in Bergen, Norway, invites applicants for a tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor position for seven years in Microeconomics at the Department of Economics.The department has around 50 faculty members and 30 PhD students. It offers an international research environment with a large share of young faculty. The successful candidate will join the Micro research group at the department, a strong academic community with an extensive international network. We expect the candidate to be an active member of the Micro group and to contribute to strengthening the group’s activities, which currently span fields such as industrial organisation, environmental economics, public economics, and microeconomic theory.Other core fields at the department include behavioural economics, development economics, economic history, labour economics and macroeconomics.The department is particularly committed to providing a stimulating and supportive environment for young faculty and offers a dedicated young faculty development programme. For more information, visit our webpage.We are seeking a highly talented candidate with a key interest in microeconomics. A successful candidate should have a strong publication record and/or highly promising work in the pipeline and should also be an excellent teacher with good skills in communicating insights from microeconomics to students. The successful candidate should preferably be able to teach microeconomic theory at all levels. Outreach to society and dissemination of research are also of importance for the position. 

To be qualified for the tenure-track position, it should not be more than five years since the PhD degree was achieved (may be extended, for example in connection with statutory leave). For candidates undertaking the PhD, the expected completion of the PhD thesis should be no later than the date of commencement.The position will involve a competitive teaching load, which also includes some graduate student supervision and administrative duties. Faculty members at NHH are expected to be good teachers. NHH offers the opportunity to participate in a program for university pedagogy, and candidates hired for tenure-track position as Assistant Professor must take one basic module of the program during the fixed-term period. Candidates hired for the tenure-track position as Associate Professor, who cannot document at least 200 hours of pedagogical coursework at the time of promotion to a permanent position, must complete this program within two years.NHH values effective communication and expects our faculty to have good language skills in both English and Norwegian. Candidates hired for a tenure-track position as Assistant Professor are required to master proficiency in Norwegian at the B2 level (The Common European Framework) within three years of appointment to a permanent position. Candidates hired for a tenure-track position as Associate Professor are required to master proficiency in Norwegian at the B2 level within three years of appointment to the tenure-track position. NHH offers courses in Norwegian for employees who may not initially have Norwegian or another Scandinavian language proficiency.The position is based in Bergen, Norway.

NHH offers
  • Annual salary of NOK 726 200 – 784 000 (Assistant Professor) or NOK 784 000 – 840 700 (Associate Professor), depending on the level of competence/length of service. The salary may be adjusted during 2027.
  • An academically stimulating working environment.
  • A favorable membership in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK) and good welfare benefits such as parental leave.
  • Research funds for travel and conference participation, and a bonus system for publication in top international journals (up to NOK 200 000).
  • Female associate professors appointed to permanent academic positions may apply for research leave (sabbatical) with half the standard accrual period, in accordance with NHH’s applicable guidelines. This will apply for the first two years of research leave.

Note that public health care, public schooling for children, and most other public services are free in Norway. The city of Bergen has a mild and coastal climate and offers rich opportunities for cultural and outdoor activities as well as a family-friendly environment (explore visitnorway.com). NHH offers dedicated support to international employees. More information about relocation and onboarding services is available on our Onboarding Services webpage.

General information

The appointee must comply with the guidelines that apply to the position at any time. NHH emphasises diversity and encourages qualified candidates to apply for the position regardless of gender, age, disability and cultural background.In the assessment of applicants, international experience and qualifications will be emphasised. For the sake of gender balance at NHH, female applicants will be given preference in the event of equivalent qualifications among candidates. The application should contain details of the applicant's scientific and pedagogical education and work experience. In addition, the applicant should provide a teaching statement, which also includes an overview and assessment of the applicants' teaching experience. The application package, including a CV, certificates with grades, a maximum of 5 published or unpublished research papers (for the position of Assistant Professor) or a maximum of 10 published or unpublished research papers (for the position of Associate Professor), a complete list of published papers and papers in the pipeline, and any other relevant documentation, should be submitted through the Jobbnorge online portal. To open the application, please click 'Apply for this job'. For English version, go to the menu at the top right side. 

Three reference letters (in PDF) must be submitted by the referees directly to NHH at hr-references@nhh.no by latest 22 December 2026. As part of the recruitment process, a background check may be conducted with the candidates' consent. In accordance with §25 (2) of the Freedom of Information Act, information about applicants may be made public even if they have requested not to have their names entered on the list of applicants. Applicants will be notified if their request is not granted. Enquiries about the position may be directed to:

  • Lars Sørgard, Head of Department, email: lars.sorgard@nhh.no
  • Morten Sæthre, Professor, email: morten.saethre@nhh.no
  • Mette Soltvedt, Administrative Coordinator, email: mette.soltvedt@nhh.no

The deadline for applications is 22 December 2026. This date also applies to the submission of publications/written work.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

NHH Norwegian School of Economics is one of the leading business schools in Europe. We have an internationally recognised research environment and collaborate with 195 universities and business schools worldwide. NHH is the first choice for students who want to study business administration in Norway. Our activities are characterised by high quality, strong ethical standards, and a collective drive for common goals. 

In close partnership with the business community and society, we generate and disseminate new knowledge and create value for a sustainable future. NHH is located in the city of Bergen and has around 3,750 students and 455 employees.

jobs.title: Etsimme talvikaudelle tarjoilijaa Sodankylän hotellikohteisiimme
jobs.description: Haluaisitko mahtavaan työporukkaan töihin Sodankylään - tuletko meidän tarjoilijaksi? Peerâ Hotels & Cottages operoi kahta hotellikohdetta Sodankylässä, uutuuttaan hohkavaa Hotel Sodankylää sekä Hotel Karhua.Kauppa käy kuin siimaa ja nyt olisi yhden rautaisen ammattilaisen mentävä paikka täytettävänä!Oletko huippuluokan tekijä? Anna sen näkyä Peerâssa – etsimme ammattitaitoista tarjoilijaa talvikaudelle 2026–2027!Meillä talvikausi häämöttää jo edessä. Tarjolla on tehokas rupeama keskellä Lappia, Sodankylässä. Työt alkavat heti ja jatkuvat maaliskuun 2027 loppuun saakka, täydellä tuntimäärällä. Hyvälle tekijälle voi hyvinkin löytyä töitä myös pidemmäksi aikaa.Ja mikä parasta? Asunto järjestyy kauttamme, ja työmatkatkin hoituvat sisätiloja pitkin! Ei tarvitse aamuisin kaivaa autoa hangesta tai taistella Lapin pakkasissa työpaikalle.Millaisiin hommiin pääset?Haemme osaavaa ja oma-aloitteista tarjoilijaa monipuoliseen ravintolaympäristöön, jossa palvellaan asiakkaita buffet-, à la carte- ja tilausravintolatoiminnassa.Työpäiväsi voivat sisältää niin kansainvälisten matkailijaryhmien ruokailuja, à la carte -tarjoilua, buffetpalvelua kuin kokous- ja juhlatilaisuuksiakin.Talvella meillä riittää vauhtia ja vilskettä, joten etsimme tekijää, joka nauttii kiireisestä ravintolaympäristöstä, hallitsee oman tonttinsa ja osaa pitää hymyn kasvoillaan myös silloin, kun salissa tapahtuu paljon.Tämä paikka on ammattilaiselle, joka osaa tarttua toimeen, ottaa vastuuta ja pitää langat käsissään! Me kaikki olemme tulleet tänne töihin Peerâ Perkele -asenteella, kyvyllä saattaa asiat loppuun sekä taidolla tasapainottaa työ ja vapaa-aika.Missä pääset työskentelemään?Meillä on Sodankylässä kaksi hotellia: uutuutta hohkaava Hotel Sodankylä sekä Hotel Karhu.Yhteensä meiltä löytyy 168 hotellihuonetta, kaksi aamiaisravintolaa, à la carte- ja buffet-ravintolat, kokous- ja juhlapalvelutiloja sekä Wellness & Spa -osasto. Palveluita siis moneen lähtöön E75-tien varrella!Ympärillä elämää kihisevä, väkevä Sodankylä – ei kaikille, mutta joillekin kaikki!Talvikausi on meillä ehdoton huippusesonki, mutta toimintamme pyörii ympärivuotisesti. Siksi hyvälle ammattilaiselle voi löytyä jatkoa myös talvisesongin jälkeen.Mitä odotamme sinulta?- Vankkaa kokemusta ravintolan salityöskentelystä ja ammattitaitoista tarjoiluosaamista. - Buffet-, à la carte- ja tilausravintolatoiminnan hallintaa. - Kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn ja vastuunkantoon. - Reipasta, oma-aloitteista ja asiakaslähtöistä työotetta. - Hyviä yhteistyötaitoja ja valmiutta toimia kiireisessä ravintolaympäristössä. - Suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa asiakaspalvelutilanteissa. Muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi. - Voimassa olevia anniskelu- ja hygieniapasseja. Meillä pääset multitaskaamaan ja haastamaan itseäsi myös perinteisen mukavuusalueesi ulkopuolella – turvallisesti ja työkavereiden tukemana.Arvostamme itsenäistä suoriutumista ammattitöistä sekä sitä, että vapaapäivinä osaat ladata akkusi ja tulla taas pirteänä töihin.Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?- Täydet työtunnit heti työsuhteen alusta maaliskuun 2027 loppuun. - Asunnon järjestettynä – ja työmatka sujuu mukavasti sisätiloja pitkin! - Monipuolisen työn buffet-, à la carte- ja tilausravintolassa. - Mahdollisuuden hyödyntää ja kehittää omaa ammattitaitoasi vauhdikkaassa matkailuympäristössä. - Mukavan, osaavan ja tekemiseen tarttuvan työporukan. - Osaamistasi ja kokemustasi vastaavan palkkauksen, josta sovimme yhdessä. Töitä teemme silloin, kun asiakkaat palveluitamme käyttävät. Talvella vauhtia riittää, mutta vastapainoksi Lappi tarjoaa ainutlaatuiset puitteet vapaa-ajalle.Jos tunnistit itsesi kuvauksesta, älä jää turhaan pohtimaan. Meillä on paikka valmiina, työt odottavat ja hyvä tekijä pääsee aloittamaan heti!**Laita hakemus otsikolla "Tarjoilijaksi Sodankylään", seuraaville henkilöille: Raili Karvonen-Willman hotellinjohtaja, raili.karvonen-willman@peerahotels.fi sekä liitä viestiin mukaan myös:**- **Vapaamuotoinen hakemus, jossa kerrot itsestäsi ja osaamisestasi.** - **Napakka CV.** - **Kahden suosittelijan yhteystiedot ja asemat viimeisen viiden vuoden työpaikoista.**

You’ll lead our Demand Generation & Events function, manage a team of two, and take ownership of our global demand generation campaigns and events program. Working closely with colleagues across Marketing, Sales/Growth and our regional teams, you’ll help ensure our marketing investments translate into measurable engagement, opportunities and pipeline.

This is a role for someone who enjoys combining people leadership, strategy and hands-on execution. You’ll step into an established function with ongoing campaigns, events and plans, while having plenty of opportunity to bring your own experience and ideas.

What you’ll do

Lead the Demand Generation & Events team

  • Translate Falkor’s commercial and marketing priorities into a focused demand generation and events plan.

  • Prioritize resources and investment across campaigns, markets, and events based on expected impact.

  • Build effective ways of working across Marketing and with our commercial and regional teams.

Drive demand generation

  • Plan, execute and optimize integrated demand generation campaigns across paid and organic channels.

  • Manage paid media activities across channels including LinkedIn and search.

  • Work closely with Product Marketing, content and commercial teams to develop campaigns for priority audiences, markets and offerings.

  • Track campaign performance and continuously optimize based on results.

  • Help strengthen the connection between marketing activity, engagement, opportunities, and pipeline.

Lead our events program

  • Own and coordinate Falkor’s international events program, from prioritization and planning through execution and follow-up.

  • Work with regional commercial teams to identify and assess event opportunities against clear business objectives.

  • Manage Falkor’s participation across conferences, exhibitions, sponsorships, speaking opportunities, executive engagements and hosted events.

  • Coordinate content, speakers, promotion, event pages, partners, vendors and internal stakeholders.

  • Establish measurable objectives for events and ensure structured follow-up and reporting.

  • Manage event budgets and help determine where Falkor should invest.

Who we’re looking for

We believe you'll thrive in this role if you:

  • Have solid experience in B2B demand generation, campaign management, field marketing and/or events.

  • Have experience leading and developing a small team.

  • Understand how marketing activity connects to commercial outcomes and pipeline.

  • Are data-driven and use performance insights to make decisions and improve results.

  • Can manage agencies, partners, budgets, and multiple stakeholders effectively.

  • Are comfortable setting priorities and providing direction while staying close to execution.

  • Are highly organized and can move between strategic planning and hands-on delivery.

  • Communicate confidently in English and are comfortable working across teams, markets and seniority levels.

  • Experience from B2B technology, SaaS, industrial technology, or energy would be an advantage.

Why join Falkor?

You'll be joining a global technology company helping to redefine how complex industries operate.

At Falkor, you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Work on meaningful challenges with real-world impact

  • Collaborate with talented colleagues across technology and industry domains

  • Learn from experts in software, engineering, operations, and digital transformation

  • Grow your career in a business that is expanding globally

  • Help shape technology that expands human capability in complex industries

We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels respected, included, and able to do their best work.

Location: Fornebu, Norway

Contract: Temporary maternity cover

Start: By agreement

Duration: To be confirmed

Ready to apply?

If you're excited about solving complex challenges and making an impact through technology, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today with your resume.

Agency notice

Falkor occasionally partners with selected recruitment agencies for specific hiring requirements. We do not accept unsolicited candidate submissions and will not be responsible for associated fees unless terms have been agreed in advance through our Procurement team.

jobs.title: Assistant/Associate Professor (tenure-track) in Behavioral Economics
jobs.description:
About the position

NHH in Bergen, Norway, invites applicants for a tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor position for seven years in Behavioral Economics at the Department of Economics.The department has around 50 faculty members and 30 PhD students. It offers an international research environment with a large share of young faculty. The research group in behavioral economics is particularly strong at the department and the successful candidate will be a part of FAIR which is a research centre of excellence. Other core fields at the department include development economics, economic history, industrial organisation, labour economics, macroeconomics and microeconomics.The department is particularly committed to providing a stimulating and supportive environment for young faculty and offers a dedicated young faculty development programme. For more information, visit our webpage.We are seeking a highly talented candidate with a strong interest in behavioral and experimental economics, particularly in questions related to fairness and economic decision-making. A successful candidate should have a strong publication record and/or highly promising work in the pipeline, and should also be an excellent teacher with good skills in communicating insights from behavioral economics to students. Outreach to society and dissemination of research are also of importance for the position. To be qualified for the tenure-track position, it should not be more than five years since the PhD degree was achieved (may be extended, for example in connection with statutory leave). For candidates undertaking the PhD, the expected completion of the PhD thesis should be no later than the date of commencement.

The position will involve a competitive teaching load, which also includes some graduate student supervision and administrative duties. Faculty members at NHH are expected to be good teachers. NHH offers the opportunity to participate in a program for university pedagogy, and candidates hired for tenure-track position as Assistant Professor must take one basic module of the program during the fixed-term period. Candidates hired for the tenure-track position as Associate Professor, who cannot document at least 200 hours of pedagogical coursework at the time of promotion to a permanent position, must complete this program within two years.NHH values effective communication and expects our faculty to have good language skills in both English and Norwegian. Candidates hired for a tenure-track position as Assistant Professor are required to master proficiency in Norwegian at the B2 level (The Common European Framework) within three years of appointment to a permanent position. Candidates hired for a tenure-track position as Associate Professor are required to master proficiency in Norwegian at the B2 level within three years of appointment to the tenure-track position. NHH offers courses in Norwegian for employees who may not initially have Norwegian or another Scandinavian language proficiency.The position is based in Bergen, Norway.

NHH offers
  • Annual salary of NOK 726 200 – 784 000 (Assistant Professor) or NOK 784 000 – 840 700 (Associate Professor), depending on the level of competence/length of service. The salary may be adjusted during 2027.
  • An academically stimulating working environment.
  • A favorable membership in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK) and good welfare benefits such as parental leave.
  • Research funds for travel and conference participation, and a bonus system for publication in top international journals (up to NOK 200 000).
  • Female associate professors appointed to permanent academic positions may apply for research leave (sabbatical) with half the standard accrual period, in accordance with NHH’s applicable guidelines. This will apply for the first two years of research leave.

Note that public health care, public schooling for children, and most other public services are free in Norway. The city of Bergen has a mild and coastal climate and offers rich opportunities for cultural and outdoor activities as well as a family-friendly environment (explore visitnorway.com). NHH offers dedicated support to international employees. More information about relocation and onboarding services is available on our Onboarding Services webpage.

General information

The appointee must comply with the guidelines that apply to the position at any time. NHH emphasises diversity and encourages qualified candidates to apply for the position regardless of gender, age, disability and cultural background.In the assessment of applicants, international experience and qualifications will be emphasised. For the sake of gender balance at NHH, female applicants will be given preference in the event of equivalent qualifications among candidates. The application should contain details of the applicant's scientific and pedagogical education and work experience. In addition, the applicant should provide a teaching statement, which also includes an overview and assessment of the applicants' teaching experience. The application package, including a CV, certificates with grades, a maximum of 5 published or unpublished research papers (for the position of Assistant Professor) or a maximum of 10 published or unpublished research papers (for the position of Associate Professor), a complete list of published papers and papers in the pipeline, and any other relevant documentation, should be submitted through the Jobbnorge online portal. To open the application, please click 'Apply for this job'. For English version, go to the menu at the top right side. 

Three reference letters (in PDF) must be submitted by the referees directly to NHH at hr-references@nhh.no by latest 22 December 2026. As part of the recruitment process, a background check may be conducted with the candidates' consent. In accordance with §25 (2) of the Freedom of Information Act, information about applicants may be made public even if they have requested not to have their names entered on the list of applicants. Applicants will be notified if their request is not granted. Enquiries about the position may be directed to:

  • Lars Sørgard, Head of Department, email: lars.sorgard@nhh.no
  • Bertil Tungodden, Professor, email: bertil.tungodden@nhh.no
  • Mette Soltvedt, Administrative Coordinator, email: mette.soltvedt@nhh.no

The deadline for applications is 22 December 2026. This date also applies to the submission of publications/written work.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

NHH Norwegian School of Economics is one of the leading business schools in Europe. We have an internationally recognised research environment and collaborate with 195 universities and business schools worldwide. NHH is the first choice for students who want to study business administration in Norway. Our activities are characterised by high quality, strong ethical standards, and a collective drive for common goals. 

In close partnership with the business community and society, we generate and disseminate new knowledge and create value for a sustainable future. NHH is located in the city of Bergen and has around 3,750 students and 455 employees.

jobs.title: Hotel Allrounder (Bar, F&B, Reception all in one role)
jobs.description:
Hospitality job in Copenhagen. One role, many hats. No two days alike.  Love good coffee, great drinks and even better conversation? Want a hotel job where no day feels the same? Keep reading.   Most hotel jobs put you in one spot. At Zoku, you’ll be everywhere that matters. 

From welcoming guests and sharing local tips to serving great food, making coffee, and mixing cocktails, you’ll help create the experience people remember long after they’ve checked out. If variety is your thing and making people feel genuinely at home comes naturally to you, you might be exactly who we’re looking for. 

At Zoku, we’re not your typical hotel. We’re a community-driven space where people can live, work, socialize, and connect with the city around them. We believe hospitality should feel personal, human, and effortless and that starts with the people on our team. That’s where you come in! 

WHAT IS A SIDEKICK?  

At Zoku, we call our hospitality all-rounders “Sidekicks”. You can think of this role as a Guest Experience Host: someone who combines reception, restaurant, bar, and guest services into one dynamic hospitality role. You’re the friendly face welcoming guests at check in, the person recommending your favorite local spots, the bartender making someone’s evening, and the host creating a warm atmosphere in our rooftop Living Kitchen restaurant. 

No two days are the same and that’s exactly why people love this role. 

WHAT YOU’LL ACTUALLY DO 

Behind the bar. Pull espressos in the morning, pour craft beer in the afternoon, shake cocktails at night. We'll teach you the recipes, you bring the chat. 

In the restaurant. Serve breakfast, lunch, dinner and bites in our Living Kitchen and on our rooftop terraces with great views over the city. Guide guests to the right wine, the right small plate, the right table. 

At the front desk. Welcome arriving guests, handle check-ins & check-outs, and answer the inevitable "where's the best bakery in Copenhagen?" with the kind of tips only a local would know. 

YOUR SCHEDULE 

You’ll work independently across different departments, with both morning and afternoon/evening shifts. A standard shift is 8 hours with a 30 minute meal break. Your responsibilities and hours may vary.

  • Morning Shift (AM Shift): 07:00 to 15:00 (+/- 1 hour)

  • Afternoon/Evening Shift (PM Shift): 15:00 to 23:00 (+/- 1 hour)

YOU’LL FIT RIGHT IN IF YOU 

  • Are genuinely friendly, and open. 

  • Love creating unforgettable stays where guests feel a true sense of belonging. 

  • Thrive in social, energetic environments. 

  • Like variety and can easily switch between different tasks. 

  • Are proactive, hands on, and team oriented. 

  • Have a genuine interest in hospitality, food, drinks, travel, or community. 

  • Love discovering and sharing the best spots in Copenhagen. 

 

A FEW MUST HAVES 

  • You have worked in hospitality or in a similar customer-facing industry.

  • You are fluent in English - Danish and any other languages are a big plus!

  • You are an EU resident or have a valid working and living permit to work in Denmark.

  • You have a CPR-number / tax number and a Danish bank account.

  • You are flexible, as there are no fixed working days / hours and enjoy working both week days and weekends.

  • You are available to work either 32 hours weekly (4 shifts) or 37 hours weekly (Full Time-5 Shifts).

 

Start date: We’re ready to welcome our next Sidekick as soon as possible! We’re reviewing applications on a rolling basis, so don’t snooze, apply today! We’re all about finding the right match for our amazing team.

RECRUITMENT PROCESS

  • We’ll screen applications as they are submitted.

  • We’ll give you a call to for a quick get to know each other chat.

  • We’ll invite you in for either 1 or 2 interviews to get a tour of Zoku and meet the Team.

  • We’ll finalize the offer and get you started!

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU 

You’ll join an international team filled with people who genuinely care about hospitality, creativity, and community. Plus, exciting training and events to celebrate every step of the journey! 

  • A market conform salary package including pension and health insurance.

  • A 40% discount on food & drinks for you and up to 4 friends 

  • Discounted Employee- and Friends & Family rates across all Zoku locations (Amsterdam, Copenhagen, Vienna and Paris) 

  • The best staff meals, enjoyed in our rooftop Social Spaces overlooking the city. 

  • A free night stay for you and a +1 in your first 3 months – plus another free night at any Zoku location for your birthday celebration 

  • Access to all community events, team celebrations, and after work drinks 

  • Exciting on-the-job training opportunities and fun events throughout the year to celebrate achievements and milestones.

  • A personal budget after your first year: spend it on extra days off, learning, or take it as cash  

Check out all benefits here.  

WHAT WE ARE PROUD OF 

Zoku combines the energy of a lifestyle brand with the warmth of a close knit team. We challenge traditional hospitality by creating spaces where people genuinely connect, whether they’re staying for one night or several months. 

Next to our award-winning design and our global press fan club, we’re proud to be a certified B Corp across all our locations, meaning we care deeply about people, community, and doing business with a heart (not just as a marketing line). 

WHAT THE ZOKU?!  We’re Zoku. Designed for the new generation of business travelers, we’re so much more than a long stay hotel. We’re a place you can call your second home, even on your first visit. We’ve created a hive of private Lofts and rooftop Social Spaces, so you can stay connected and well rested as you live and work throughout Europe. Throw yourself into your work and play, and effortlessly discover one of our home cities. It will be your home city next.  READY? Hit apply and tell us why this role has your name on it.

jobs.title: Vi søker Ass. butikksjef og Avdelingsledere Rema 1000 Holmen Senter
jobs.description:
Er du klar for å ta ansvar for en avdeling i butikk? Vi søker avdelingsleder!

Har du et øye for orden, kvalitet og gode kundeopplevelser? Er du en lagspiller som liker å ta ansvar? Som avdelingsleder hos REMA 1000 får du muligheten til å ta ansvar for din egen avdeling i butikken.

Hva går jobben ut på?🛒  Som avdelingsleder er du ansvarlig for at din avdeling alltid er innbydende, velfylt og effektivt drevet. Du sørger for at kundene får en god handleopplevelse og at dine kolleger trives og presterer godt. I løpet av en arbeidsdag vil du blant annet:

  • Ha ansvar for drift, varebestilling og budsjett i din avdeling
  • Sikre at avdelingen alltid er ryddig, attraktiv og fylt med varer
  • Planlegge og gjennomføre kampanjer og aktiviteter
  • Opplære og følge opp kolleger i avdelingen
  • Samarbeide om å skape en velfungerende butikk

Hvem ser vi etter?🔎  Vi ser etter deg som liker å ta ansvar og er opptatt av gode handleopplevelser. Vi tror du også kjenner deg igjen i dette:

  • Du har erfaring fra butikk, gjerne innen dagligvare
  • Er strukturert og liker å ha orden og kontroll
  • Motiveres av å skape gode handleopplevelser for kunden – vår øverste sjef
  • Jobber godt selvstendig, men også trives i team
  • Takler hektiske situasjoner med et smil

Hvorfor velge REMA 1000? 💙

I REMA 1000 er mulighetene mange for mennesker som tør å gi av seg selv, er positive og selvstendige. Hos oss er det plass til alle – mangfold gjør oss sterkere. Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg og gleder oss til å ønske deg velkommen som en del av teamet vårt.

Hos oss får du:

  • En trivelig arbeidsplass med hyggelige kollegaer.
  • Muligheter for utvikling.
  • Et miljø hvor du får støtten du trenger til å lykkes i rollen din.
  • Variasjon og energi i hverdagen – ingen dager er helt like!

Les mer på oss på vår karriereside: https://www.rema.no/karriere/

Høres dette ut som jobben for deg? Da gleder vi oss til å høre fra deg 👋

Om rekrutteringsprosessen: I våre rekrutteringsprosesser benytter vi oss av testverktøy for å kunne bli bedre kjent med deg. Aktuelle kandidater vil motta epost med link til testene kort tid etter innsendt søknad.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

REMA 1000 er blant Norges største dagligvareaktør og en av landets sterkeste merkevarer. Siden 1979 har REMA 1000 jobbet for å kunne tilby kunder over hele landet et godt utvalg av dagligvarer til laveste pris, av høy kvalitet, produsert og solgt på en ansvarlig måte. Ved å ha hyggelige og dyktige mennesker med riktige holdninger og fokus på å jobbe med de rette tingene, har REMA 1000 lykkes med å skape en solid virksomhet som er lønnsom ikke bare for sine kjøpmenn og for bedriften - men også for kundene. Ønsker du å lese mer om vårt arbeid med miljø og samfunnsansvar; https://www.rema.no/ansvar-i-rema-1000/

Er du en praktisk anlagt person med hænderne godt skruet på – og har du lyst til at blive en vigtig del af et stærkt team i vækst? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter!

Lyder det som noget for dig?Så send os din ansøgning og CV hurtigst muligt. Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Send din ansøgning og CV med billede til job@lindebjerg.dk. Skriv "Mekaniker" i emnefeltet.

Vi er netop i gang med åbning af to nye showrooms, herudover har vi lokationer i Aabenraa, Esbjerg, Holstebro, Aalborg, Aarhus, Odense, Sorø, Hillerød og København.Hos Lindebjerg sætter vi en ære i at omsætte ideer til handling og sidder derfor også med helt fremme i bussen når det handler om at forretningsudvikle, inden for branchen. I dagligdagen tilbyder vi stor frihed under ansvar og vægter det sunde arbejdsmiljø og godt kollegaskab, i et uformelt miljø, højt.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a Product Advisor to join our Navigation team, with a particular focus on K-Bridge and the Navigation portfolio.

In this role, you will work at the intersection of product, technology and market, collaborating closely with Engineering, Sales, Delivery and Service. You will help ensure competitive, robust and future-ready navigation solutions throughout the entire product lifecycle.

 

Key responsibilitiesAs Product Advisor, you will:

  • Manage and further develop K-Bridge and the Navigation portfolio
  • Develop and maintain product strategy and roadmaps
  • Manage products throughout their lifecycle, including upgrades, obsolescence and phase-out
  • Identify and prioritize product improvements based on customer, market and technology needs
  • Follow up product requirements, certification, type approval and relevant maritime standards
  • Support Sales and Delivery with product selection, technical clarifications and customer solutions
  • Collaborate with Engineering on the prioritization and development of new features and technologies
  • Contribute to business cases and decision-making related to product investments and technology choices

 We are continuously reviewing candidates, apply today! 

Qualifications and experienceWe are looking for someone with:

  • Relevant technical or maritime education, or equivalent experience
  • Experience with maritime systems, navigation or technical products
  • Good understanding of product development and lifecycle management
  • Ability to understand the relationship between customer needs, technology and commercial priorities
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills in both Norwegian and Englishx

Experience considered an advantageExperience with Integrated Bridge Systems, ECDIS, Radar, INS, Autopilot, maritime sensors, classification or product certification is an advantage.Candidates with Seafaring experience as a Navigation officer, with a certificate of competency will be preferred.

You are able to

  • Take ownership and drive topics towards clarification and decision
  • Work in a structured and solution-oriented way
  • Maintain a holistic product and system perspective
  • Work effectively across disciplines and organizational boundaries
  • Be curious about technology and constructively challenge established solutions

This employment may require a pre-employment check procedure in accordance with company security standards, role or site requirements. Please note that this might affect the offer process or employment.

What can we offer?At Kongsberg Maritime, you will have the opportunity to work with advanced maritime navigation systems and contribute to shaping the future direction of the Navigation portfolio.The role offers broad exposure across the organization and the opportunity to influence the entire product journey, from strategy and roadmap to development, certification, delivery and lifecycle management. 

Join us in developing navigation solutions for the maritime operations of tomorrow.

 

Practical information:

Work location: Kongsberg or other KM location in Norway

For further information about the position, please contact the hiring manager:Thor Olsen, Product Manager. thor.olsen@km.kongsberg.com

 

Kongsberg Maritime is a global leader in maritime technology. We deliver advanced solutions to the merchant fleet, offshore, fishing, and naval vessels, setting new standards for safe, efficient, and sustainable operations - both for new builds and existing fleets. In close collaboration with customers and research environments, we develop technology that solves real challenges at sea. Today, more than 30,000 vessels operate with our systems on board. Kongsberg Maritime has more than 8,300 employees in 35 countries.

Technologies for sustainable oceans

jobs.title: Huoltoasentaja, Algol Technics Oy, Tampere
jobs.description: _Algol Technics on teollisuuden kumppani ja materiaalinkäsittelyn asiantuntija. Algol Technics on osa suomalaista Algol-konsernia, jolla on kokemusta kansainvälisestä kaupasta vuodesta 1894 alkaen. Uskomme, että asiakkaidemme maailma automatisoituu, nopeutuu ja muuttuu aiempaa kompleksisemmaksi. Olemme vahvasti mukana tässä muutoksessa tarjoten asiakkaillemme sisälogistiikan ratkaisuja, mm. nostureita, robottisoluja, kuljettimia ja automaatiovarastoja sekä laajan valikoiman teknisiä tuotteita. Kaikkiin toimittamiimme ratkaisuihin tarjoamme kattavat kunnossapito- ja huoltopalvelut.__Algol-konsernin yhteistyökumppaniverkosto on maailmanlaajuinen ja yhtiöllä on toimipisteitä yhdeksässä eri maassa. Konsernin vuoden 2025 liikevaihto oli 198 MEUR. Työllistämme noin 503 ammattilaista._Oletko sähköalan tai huollon ja kunnossapidon kokenut tekijä? Lue eteenpäin, mitä Algol Technicsillä on tarjolla ja työllisty heidän kirjoilleen!**Mitä tulisit tässä tehtävässä tekemään?**Kunnossapidon ja huollon tavoitteena on pitää laitteistot toiminnassa keskeytyksittä. Algol Technicsin huoltoverkosto huolehtii siitä, että huoltotyöt sekä käynnissäpito hoidetaan ammattimaisesti ympäri Suomen.Huoltoasentajana Algol Technicsillä työskentelet monipuolisissa huolto-, kunnossapito- ja asennustehtävissä eri asiakaskohteissa Tampereen alueella. Halutessasi voit työskennellä myös laajemmalla alueella, asiakaskohteissa liikkumiseen saat Algolilta käyttöösi auton. Työnkuvaan kuuluu teollisuusnostureiden huoltoja, asennuksia, käyttöönottoja ja tarkastuksia. Lisäksi tehtäviisi voi kuulua nostoapuvälineiden tarkastuksia sekä sähköautomaatioon, nosto-oviin ja jonkin verran robotiikkaan liittyviä töitä.Tehtävässä huolehdit siitä, että asiakkaiden laitteet toimivat turvallisesti ja tuotanto pysyy liikkeessä. Työhösi voi sisältyä myös myynnin teknistä tukea sekä asiakkaiden opastamista ja kouluttamista. Työ on itsenäistä, ja pääset suunnittelemaan sekä aikatauluttamaan omia työpäiviäsi.Halutessasi voit toimia myös huoltopäivystäjänä, josta saat asianmukaiset korvaukset. Algolilla työskentelet osana osaavaa tiimiä, jolta saat kattavan perehdytyksen tehtävään.**Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**Tarjoamme sinulle mielenkiintoisen vakituisen työn ja TES:n mukaisen palkan, jonka lisäksi sinulla on mahdollisuus kasvattaa ansioitasi vapaaehtoisella lisämyynnillä. Ympärilläsi on rennot työkaverit, työyhteisön tuki sekä erinomaiset mahdollisuudet omaan ammatilliseen kasvuun ja kehittämiseen. Työaikasi on arkisin 7:00–15.30. Algolilla saat käyttöösi laajan työterveydenhuollon ja hyvinvointiasi ovat tukemassa E-passin palvelut, sekä säännölliset tykypäivät.Algol-konserni on innostava työpaikka. Arvomme, vastuunotto, yhteistyö ja kehitys, ohjaavat kaikkea työtämme. Arvojen lisäksi vastuullisuus on meille tärkeää. Jokainen Algolilainen vaikuttaa siihen, millainen jälki toiminnallamme on. Meillä uskaltaa kehittää ja kehittyä. Algol huolehtii myös, että työssäsi tarvittavat luvat ja sertifikaatit pysyvät ajan tasalla.**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on sähköasentajan koulutus ja aiempaa kokemusta sähköasennuksista tai huolto- ja kunnossapidosta. Alan koulutuksen ja kokemuksen lisäksi sinulla on rautainen asenne työntekoon sekä halu oppia ja kehittyä. Olet tärkeä osa asiakasyhteistyötä, joten toivomme sinulta palveluhenkisyyttä sekä omatoimisuutta. Kohtaat työssäsi haasteita ja vaihtelevia tilanteita, joten aikaisemmasta kokemuksestasi on etua. Turvallisuussyistä tehtävässä vaatimuksena on sujuva suomen kielen taito.

jobs.title: Senior Field Marketer
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion’s Field Marketing team owns the in-person moments that move our target sales assisted accounts forward. We design world class hosted events, executive experiences, and third-party activations that open new relationships, deepen the ones we have, and turn interest into pipeline.




As a Senior Field Marketing Manager, you will own the strategy and execute tier 1 field events that drive pipeline and contribute meaningfully to Notion’s business.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own end-to-end planning, execution, and measurement of field programs to support our AMER Sales team - encompassing executive experiences, large-format educational events, trade shows, and co-sponsored activations with partners.

 - Drive pipeline goals in partnership with Sales by building field programs that create new opportunities and help advance existing ones. Track and report on pipeline contribution and program ROI.

 - Build out strategies, shape our calendar, and work closely with sales to build out a calendar that touches the evolving sales needs.

 - Manage all event logistics, production, venue sourcing, budget tracking, marketing campaigns, sales enablement, content development, and audience acquisition.

 - Use data to guide field investments, combining quantitative results and qualitative feedback to evaluate what’s working. Measure both pipeline impact and top-of-funnel awareness, including reach and engagement with target audiences, and use those insights to improve future programs.

 - Partner closely with Sales and broader Marketing team to align events and audiences to objectives for top accounts and craft tailored programs that nurture those accounts




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 8+ years of related marketing experience.

 - You’re a leader. You take ownership, bring people together around a clear plan, and keep programs moving from idea through execution. You’re comfortable making decisions, navigating ambiguity, and building trust with partners along the way.

 - You love both strategy and execution. You can turn Sales priorities into a thoughtful field plan and roll up your sleeves to bring each event to life.

 - You're pipeline-obsessed. You understand how your programs connect to revenue and can speak credibly about pipeline contribution, not just top-of-funnel metrics.

 - You're a strong cross-functional collaborator. You know how to work with sales, ops, and creative teams — and you can align people around a shared goal without needing authority to do it.

jobs.title: Head of Creative
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Creative is how millions of people first meet Replit, from a first-time builder to a Fortune 500 buyer. Our product lets anyone turn an idea into working software. The creative challenge is making that feel obvious, exciting and human, whether you’re talking to someone who has never written a line of code or a CIO deciding how their company will build. We believe enterprise marketing doesn’t have to look like enterprise marketing, and we’re looking for the creative leader who believes that too.

As Executive Creative Director, you'll own the creative vision for everything Replit puts into the world: brand campaigns, product launches, the website, social and demand generation. You'll lead our in-house team of designers, and partner closely with product, product marketing, enterprise marketing and the executive team. You'll find the big ideas, sell them to leadership, and get them made at Replit's speed.

This is the right role if you’ve led integrated work that shaped culture and moved the business, both at agencies and inside tech companies, and across consumer and B2B brands. You can write and art direct well enough to tell a good idea from a great one, and you’d rather build an in-house creative engine than manage a roster of agencies.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Set the creative vision: Define how Replit looks, sounds and feels across every touchpoint, from major brand moments to product launches to everyday social

 - Lead big ideas end to end: Take integrated campaigns from brief to concept to production across film, OOH, social, web, events and paid, all organized around a single idea

 - Raise the craft bar: Push for higher production value, especially in video and motion, and know when to push for perfect and when to ship

 - Build and lead the team: Manage and develop designers, art directors and copywriters, grow senior talent into leaders, and hire where the team has gaps

 - Run the creative engine: Own intake, briefing and creative review so work comes in early with a clear strategy and goes out on-brand; decide what stays in-house, what goes to freelancers, and when an agency or production partner is worth it

 - Make AI part of the craft: Build AI creative tools into how the team concepts, produces and iterates, with a clear point of view on where human taste matters most

 - Champion the work: Present and defend creative to executives and cross-functional partners with clear strategic rationale and conviction




REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 - 12+ years of creative leadership at a top agency and/or an in-house consumer tech brand, with a portfolio of culturally relevant work that drove business results

 - Conceptual and craft range across verbal and visual: campaign ideas, brand platforms, verbal identity and art direction

 - Proven experience at both B2C and B2B brands and businesses, leading integrated campaigns across film, social, OOH, digital and experiential

 - Strong video and motion instincts, including directing higher-production shoots with production partners

 - Track record of building or scaling an in-house creative team, and recruiting, developing and retaining top talent

 - Experience making complex or technical products simple, emotional and accessible

 - Executive presence: you can sell a bold idea to a CEO and explain why it matters to the business

 - Comfort in a fast, lean, ambiguous environment where you set the strategy and stay hands-on in the work

 - Based in or able to relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area




BONUS QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience at an AI, developer-tool or product-led growth company

 - Hands-on use of generative AI creative tools, with evidence of building them into team workflows

 - Work recognized at Cannes, D&AD or One Show

 - Active Replit user, you've built and shipped something with the product



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.
